title: 1. atha snehādhyāyaḥ
text: Dī. atha uttarakhaṇḍaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ madhyamakhaṇḍānte rasāyanavājīkaraṇārthaṃ rasā uktāḥ, te cāviśuddhaśarīre na svakāryakaraṇakṣamāḥ; uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ | vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ’ ( vā. u. 39-4) iti | ’tasmāccharīraśuddhyarthaṃ pañcakarmāṇi yojayet | tāni ca snehasvedābhyāṃ vinā na saṃbhavanti, uktaṃ ca - ’snehasvedāvanabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkamivāyāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate (vā. sū. 18-59) iti tasmāt snehā'dhyāyameva prathamaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ -- atha snehapānavidhiḥ | Dī. snehasya ghṛtādeḥ pānasya vidhirvidhānaṃ, sa ca vidhiścarake yathā sapraśna uktastamāha - ?sāṃkhyaiḥ saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum | jagaddhitārthaṃ papraccha vahniveśaḥ svasaṃśayam || kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak | kālānupāne kaḥ kasya katidhā ca vicāraṇāḥ || kati mātrāḥ kathaṃ mānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate | kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ || snehyāḥ ke ke ca na snehyāḥ, snigdhā'tisnigdhalakṣaṇam | kiṃ pānātprathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiṃ ca hitāhitam || ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ | śodhane śamane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate || nareṣu keṣu vidhinā kena yojyā vicāraṇāḥ | snehasyāpyamitajñāna ! jñānamicchāmi veditum? (ca. sū. 13,1-6) iti | ’tatra saṃkhyānamadhīyante vindate vā te sāṃkhyāḥ, taiḥ; kiṃviśiṣṭaiḥ ? saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ, saṃkhyātā saṃkhyā yaiste saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyāḥ | jñātajñeyā ityarthaḥ | taiḥ saha āsīnam, uta cāsaṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaṃ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum iti pāṭhaḥ. | etaduktaṃ bhavati - sākhyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasuṃ saṃkhyāvikārakāyāṃ kathāyāṃ vartamānaṃ tatkālānurūpam agniveśo'pi svasaṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭavān | dvikarmako'yam | tatra ’ kati snehāḥ ? etasyottaramāha - snehaścaturvidhaḥ prokto ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā vasā | majjā ca - Dī. sa snehaḥ catuḥprakāraḥ, ghṛtādibhedāt | tatra ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt; tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ; vasā-’śuddhamāṃsasya yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā iti | majjā iti majjā mastakamajjā asthimajjā vā | tathāca - ’sthūlā'sthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti | taduktaṃ carake - ’tilāḥ priyālābhiṣukau bibhītakaścitrābhayairaṇḍamadhūkasarṣapāḥ | kusumbhabilvārukamūlakātasī nikocakākṣoṭakarañjaśigrujāḥ || snehāśayāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāstathā syurjaṅgamā matsyamṛgāḥ sapakṣiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ dadhi kṣīraghṛtāmiṣaṃ vasā sneheṣu majjā ca tathopadiśyate’ iti | abhayā harītakī, citrā dantī iti || ( ca. sū. 13,8) Gū. athottarakhaṇḍaḥ procyate | atha pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tailaṃ, vasā, majjā, iti caturvidhaḥ snehaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhasneheṣu ghṛtasya mukhyatvādādāvabhidhānaṃ, tatastailaṃ tilasaṃbhūtaṃ, tato vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, (tato) majjā, asthimadhyasnehaḥ | nanu pañcakarmādau vamanaṃ tadyathā – ‘vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhamanuvāsanam | jñeyaṃ pañcavidhaṃ karma vidhānaṃ tasya kathyate’ iti | tatkathaṃ snehapānamādau ucyate ? ( satyam, snehapānaṃ vinā vamanādisaṃśodhanānāṃ hānikaratvāt ) pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ, tataḥ svedaḥ, tato vamanaṃ, tato recanam; ayaṃ vidhiḥ || kaḥ kāla ’ etasya uttaramāha -- taṃ pibenmartyaḥ kiṃcidabhyudite ravau || 1 || Dī. ’ śītakāle divā snehamuṣṇakāle pibenniśi ’ iti || 1 || Gū. taṃ caturvidhaṃ snehaṃ kiṃcidabhyudite ravau pibet || 1 || ‘kiṃyonayaḥ’ etasyottaramāha - sthāvaro jaṃgamaścaiva dviyoniḥ sneha ucyate | Dī. tatra sthāvarāścaturvidhāḥ, vanaspatayaḥ, vṛkṣāḥ, vīrudhaḥ, oṣadhaya iti | jaṃgamāḥ khalvapi caturvidhāḥ – jarāyujā-ṇḍaja-svedajo-dbhijjāḥ eteṣāṃ svarūpamanyato jñātavyam | tathāca carake – ’snehānāṃ dvividhā saumya yoniḥ sthāvarajaṅgamā’ (ca. sū. 13,7) iti | Gū. sthāvarajaṅgamabhedena snehasya dvividhatvamāha | sugamam || varāvaratvamāha - tilatailaṃ sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ghṛtaṃ varam || 2 || Dī. tailaghṛtayorvaratvaṃ ca saṃskārasyānuvartanāditi | uktaṃca - ’tailaṃ saṃyogasaṃskārātsarvarogāpahaṃ matam’ iti | atraivodāharaṇaṃ candanādyaṃ tailam | tat ghṛtamapi śāstre vyavahārārtham || 2 || militasnehanāmānyāha - dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhistairyamakastrivṛto mahān | Dī. yo dvābhyāṃ snehābhyāṃ milito yogaḥ sa yamakaḥ kathitaḥ | yastribhiḥ snehairmilitaḥ sa trivṛtaḥ | yaścaturbhiḥ snehaiḥ saṃyutaḥ sa mahānkathita ityabhiprāyaḥ | Gū. yamakādisnehabhedānāha - dvābhyāṃ ghṛtatailābhyāṃ yamakaḥ | tribhirghṛtatailavasābhistrivṛtaḥ | caturbhirghṛtatailavasāmajjābhirmahānityarthaḥ || snehasātmye kālāvadhimāha -- pibetryahaṃ caturahaṃ pañcāhaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ tathā || 3 || sāptarātrātparaṃ snehaḥ sātmībhavati sevitaḥ | Dī. kutracitsnehaḥ sevitaḥ san tryahātparaṃ sātmyībhavati | kvacit caturahaṃ, pañcāhaṃ, ṣaḍahaṃ ca | saptāhātparamiti saptadinaṃ yāvat | iyam aharādimaryādā koṣṭhasya mṛdumadhyakṛtā jñeyā, paraṃ saptarātrādūrdhvaṃ sevitaḥ sātmībhavati | sātmībhūtasya snehasya guṇāḥ vāgbhaṭe – ’sātmībhūto hi kurute na malānāmudīraṇam’ iti | carake tu - ’snehanasya prakarṣau tu saptarātratrirātrakau ( ca. sū. 13,49) iti | vāgbhaṭe tu - ’tryahamacchaṃ mṛdukoṣṭhe krūre saptadinaṃ pibet’ iti ( vā. sū. 16,29) ihatyavirodhaḥ? maivaṃ - sarveṣāṃ viṣayabhedāt, mṛdu-mṛdutara-madhya-madhyatara-krūra-krūratara-koṣṭhaviṣayāṇi vacanāni jñātavyāni || 3 || Gū. pibet ghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ, tailaṃ caturahaṃ, vasā pañcāhaṃ, majjā ṣaḍaham evaṃ krameṇa snehaḥ kadā sātmībhavatītyāha - sneho ghṛtādiḥ sevitaḥ saptarātrātparaṃ sātmībhavati || 3 || atha snehapānamātrāviṣayamāha - doṣakālāgnivayasāṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayojayet || 4 || hīnāṃ ca madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ snehasya buddhimān | Dī. mātrālakṣaṇamagre vakṣyamāṇam | doṣāstrividhāścaturvidhā vā teṣāṃ balam utkṛṣṭa-madhyā-lpādibhedena jñeyam | kālāḥ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇāstrividhāḥ eṣāṃ balaṃ hīnamadhyātimātrasvarūpaṃ, bheṣajagrahaṇakālaṃ vā | agnirapi sama-viṣama-manda-tīkṣṇamedena caturvidhaḥ asya balaṃ pācakāpācakarūpam | vayo'pi bāla-madhyottarabhedena trividhaṃ tasyāpi balaṃ svaśaktisāmarthyam | buddhimāniti sadvaidya iti śeṣaḥ | tathāhi - ’yathādoṣaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāvyādhiṃ yathābalaṃ | snehapakvamapakvaṃ vā pākaṃ yuñjyāccikitsakaḥ’ iti | doṣādīnapekṣya snehasya hīnādimātrāṃ prayojayet, hīnatarāmapi prayojayet | uktaṃca - hīnamadhyottamā mātrā tāstābhyaśca hṛsīyasīm | kalpayedvīkṣya doṣādīn prāgeva tu kanīyasīm || ( vā. sū 16|17) ‘ajñātakoṣṭhe hi bahu kuryājjīvitasaṃśayam’ iti || 4 || Gū. taṃ doṣādīnāṃ balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭvā buddhimānpaṇḍitaḥ snehasya hīnāṃ madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ prayojayet | yasmindoṣe, yasminkāle, yasminnagnau yasminvayasi yaducitaṃ tat deyam || 4 || amātrādisevitasya snehasya doṣamāha - amātrayā tathā'kāle mithyāhāravihārataḥ || 5 || snehaḥ karoti śophārśastandrānidrāvisaṃjñatāḥ | Dī. sneho'mātrayā ( mātrā hrasvādiparimāṇāstābhyo'nyathā ) viṣamapramāṇena | akāle asamaye | tathā mithyā'hāravihārato vā sevitaḥ śophādīn karoti | mithyā'hāro yathā – ‘ akāle cātisātmyaṃ vā asātmyaṃ yacca bhojanam | viṣamāśanaṃ ca yadbhuktaṃ mithyāhāraḥ sa kathyate ’ iti | mithyāvihāro malaparityāgastrīsevādiṣu anyathā viharaṇam | visaṃjñatā mūrcchābhedaḥ | ( asyāgre - prakuryāllaṅghanaṃ tatra svedaṃ jñātvā virecanam || 6 || iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca) || 5 || 6 || Gū. amātrayā grahaṇe doṣamāha - amātrayā tathā'kāle tathā mithyā''hārataḥ snehaḥ śophādīn karoti || 5 || 6 || idānīṃ snehapānamātrāmāha - deyā dīptāgnaye mātrā snehasya palasaṃmitā | madhyamāya trikarṣā syājjaghanyāya dvikārṣikī || 7 || Dī. dīptāgnaye iti pradīptakoṣṭhapuruṣāyetyarthaḥ | jaghanyasaṃjñādoṣaviśeṣeṣu manyante tadapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | mātrā evaṃ madhyamāya trikārṣikī syāt ,jaghanyāya hīnabalānalāya dvikārṣikī | eke prabalamadhyajaghanyasaṃjñā doṣaviṣeṣu manyante tadapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | uktaṃ ca --’uttamasya palaṃ mātrā tribhiścākṣaiśca madhyamā | jaghanyasya palārdhena snehakvāthauṣadheṣu ca’ iti || 7 || Gū. dīptāgnyādiṣu kīdṛśī mātrā deyā tāmāha | madhyamāya madhyamāgnaye, jaghanyāya alpāgnaye || 7 || atha vikalpāntaravihitāṃ mātrāṃ darśayannāha - athavā snehamātrāḥ syustisro'nyāḥ sarvasaṃmatāḥ | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatyahni tu madhyamā || 8 || jīryatyalpā dinārdhena sā vijñeyā sukhāvahā | Dī. athaveti prakāreṇa kālabhedena ityarthaḥ | anyāḥ palādibhyo'nyāḥ vilakṣaṇāḥ, vailakṣaṇyatvādasaṃmatatvamityata āha - sarvasaṃmatā iti | carakavāgbhaṭādisaṃmatā | uktaṃca carake -‘ahorātramahaḥ kṛtsnamardhāhaṃ ca pratīkṣyate | pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati | iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ ( ca. sū 13, 27 | 28) iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ’ dvābhyāṃ caturbhiraṣṭābhiryāmairjīryanti yāḥ kramāt | hasvamadhyottamā mātrā ’ (vā. sū 16,17) iti | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatīti | nanvahorātragrahaṇaṃ sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādakaraṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ ? ahani dvayornāḍikayoranantaraṃ pītasya snehasya pare'hni ghaṭikādvayānantaraṃ pākaḥ sacāhorātragrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate | ahorātragrahaṇam aṣṭau praharapramāṇakālaparaṃ jñeyam | evaṃ paramacatureṇa vāgbhaṭenāṣṭau praharādipramāṇamevoktaṃ tadvadatrāpyahorātramaṣṭau praharaparaṃ jñeyam | evamuttaratrā'pi vyākhyeyam | seti | sā alpā hrasvā sukhāvahā jñātavyā | sukhakāriṇītyarthaḥ | śīghrapākatvāt || 8 || Gū. alpāṃ mātrāmāha - athavā pakṣāntare | anyāstisraḥ snehamātrā āha - mahatī ahorātreṇa pacyate sā palapramāṇā, madhyamā trikarṣā yā sā ahni yāmacatuṣṭayena jīryati, alpā dvikārṣikī dinārdhena yāmadvayena jīryati sā sukhāvahā vijñeyā || 8 || alpādīnāṃ guṇānāha - alpā syāddīpanī vṛṣyā svalpadoṣeṣu pūjitā || 9 || madhyamā snehanī jñeyā bṛṃhaṇī bhramahāriṇī | jyeṣṭhā kuṣṭhaviṣonmādagrahāpasmāranāśinī || 10 || Dī. atha tāsāṃ viṣayamāha - alpā mātrā snehasya dīpanī bhavati agnidīptikarītyarthaḥ | vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, svalpadoṣeṣu hīnabaleṣu doṣeṣu vā pūjitā | kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | svalpadoṣe svalparogeṣu vā iti svalpanidānenālpasaṃcite | madhyamā catuḥpraharairyā pākaṃ prāpnoti sā madhyamā | sā snehanī rūkṣāṇāṃ | bṛṃhaṇī sarvadhātūnām | bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ | vastudarśanam | jyeṣṭheti | jyeṣṭhā uttamā kuṣṭhādihāriṇī bhavati | carake tu hrasvādimātrāṇāṃ viṣayaguṇāścoktā yathā - ’ye tu vṛddhāśca bālāśca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ | riktakoṣṭhatvamahitaṃ yeṣāṃ mandāgnayaśca ye || jvarātīsāra- kāsāśca yeṣāṃ cirasamutthitāḥ | snehamātrāṃ pibeyuste hrasvā ye cāvarā bale || parihāre sukhā caiṣā mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī | vṛṣyā balyā nirābādhā ciraṃ cāpyanuvartate ||’ (ca. sū. 13,36 - 38) atra vṛddhādayaḥ kleśāsahiṣṇutvāt hrasvasnehamātrārhāḥ | sukhocitā iti na kumāraviśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃtu pṛthageva sukhasātmyā abhimatāḥ | riktakoṣṭhatvamahitamiti | vātaprakṛtivikārāṇām ahitaṃ ye cāvarā bale alpabalā ityarthaḥ | parihārasukheti vyāyāmamuccairvacanamityādike parihāre sati sukhamiyamādhatte ato hrasvā'pi mātrā parihāre sati sukhamādadhyāt | tatra madhyamottamayornitarāṃ parihāraḥ kartavyaḥ | ityevaṃ ’yato’ nirdeśa iti kaścit | anyastu vyācaṣṭe - parihāraviṣaye sukheyamakriyamāṇāpi parihāre na doṣāvahetyarthaḥ | ’prabhūtasnehasātmyā ye kṣutpipāsāsahā narāḥ | pāvakaścottamabalo yeṣāṃ ye cottamā bale || gulminaḥ sarpadaṣṭāśca visarpopahatāśca ye | unmattāḥ kṛcchramūtrāśca gāḍhavarcasa eva ca || pibeyuruttamāṃ mātrāṃ tasyāḥ pāne guṇān śṛṇu | vikārān śamayatyeṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā | doṣānukarṣiṇī mātrā sarvamārgānusāriṇī | balyā punarnavakarī śarīrendriyacetasām || ityuttamā | madhyamāmāha -aruṣkasphoṭapiṭikākaṇḍūpāmābhirarditāḥ | kuṣṭhinaśca pramīṭhāśca vātaśoṇitikāśca ye | nātibahvāśinaścaiva mṛdukoṣṭhāstathaiva ca | pibeyurmadhyamāṃ mātrāṃ madhyamāścāpi ye bale || mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśā na cātibaladāyinī | sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate ||’ iti (ca.sū 13|29-35) | arūṃṣyevārūṃṣyā | arūṃṣikā śirorogaviśeṣaḥ | arditāḥ pīḍitāḥ | pramīṭhā atyarthaṃ pramehapīḍitāḥ | tasyā guṇānāha - mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśeti | mandā alpā vibhraṃśāḥ balahānyādayo yasyāṃ sā | yadā āturādidoṣābhāvāt vibhraṃśo notpadyate tadā sukhena snehayati | śodhanārthe yujyate ityanenaitatkathayati uttamā mātrā śamanāya | tathāca carake -- ’vikārān śamayatyeṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā’ iti | hrasvāt bṛṃhaṇārthā | uktaṃca ’mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|38)| asyārthaḥ - snehanabṛṃhaṇakarmakāriṇī iyaṃ bhuvanakāmānāṃ virecanakāmānāṃ ca prayujyate | iti mātrāvivaraṇam || 9 || 10 || Gū. sugamam || 9 || 10 || atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa snehaviṣayamāha - kevalaṃ paittike sarpirvātike lavaṇānvitam | peyaṃ bahukaphe cāpi vyoṣakṣārasamanvitam || 11 || Dī. kevalaṃ prakṣeparahitaṃ paittike vyādhau lavaṇamatra saindhavaṃ, vyādhivihitaṃ cānyadapi lavaṇaṃ grāhyam | bahukaphe kaphaprāye vyādhau vyoṣādiyutaṃ hitaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāraṃ yavakṣārādi || 11 || Gū. doṣe anupānaviśeṣamāha - kevalamiti | paittike kevalamanupānena rahitam | vātike lavaṇānvitam | bahukaphe vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, tadyutam | vātaṃ vihāya pittābhidhānaṃ ghṛtasyādau gṛhītatvātpittaśamakatvācca lavaṇādayo māṣamitā deyāḥ || 11 || yeṣāṃ sarpirdīyate tānāha - rūkṣakṣataviṣārtānāṃ vātapittavikāriṇām | hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāṃ ca sarpiṣpānaṃ praśasyate || 12 || Dī. hitaṃ | rūkṣādibhistribhirārtāḥ rūkṣaṃ rūkṣaguṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rūkṣaguṇo vāyuśca vātaprakṛtīnāmityeke | kṣatam uraḥkṣataṃ, tena ārtaḥ | viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca tena ārtaḥ pīḍitaḥ vātapittavikāriṇāmiti | vātapitte atra pṛthak milite vā | tathā hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāmiti | medhā granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ, smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇam | anubandhātmikābuddhiriti yāvat | carake tu -- ‘vātapittaprakṛtayo vātapittavikāriṇaḥ | cakṣuḥkāmāḥ kṣatakṣīṇā vṛddhā bālāstathā'balāḥ || āyuḥprakarṣakāmāśca --balavarṇasvarārthinaḥ | puṣṭikāmāḥ prajākāmāḥ saukumāryārthinaśca ye || dīptyojaḥsmṛtimedhā'gnibuddhī- ndriyabalārthinaḥ | pibeyuḥ sarpirārtāśca dāhaśastraviṣāgnibhiḥ ||’ (ca. sū 13|39-41) iti | dīptiḥ prabhā | ojastu hṛdi tiṣṭhati yat śuddham īṣat lolitapītakam | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘tatra dhīsmṛtimedhāgnikāṅkṣiṇāṃ śasyate ghṛtam’ iti (vā.sū. 16|8) | ‘medhā'gnirityatra’ ’medhādikāṅkṣiṇām’ iti samyakpāṭhaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt -- ’śastaṃ dhīsmṛtimedhāgnibalāyuḥśukra-cakṣuṣām | bālavṛddhaprajākāntisaukumāryasvarārthinām || kṣatakṣīṇaparīsarpaśastrāgniglapitātmanām | vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham || snehānāmuttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param | sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhirghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt’ iti || 12 || Gū. sugamam || 12 || tailayogyānāha -- kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhāḥ pravṛdhdakaphamedasaḥ | pibeyustailasātmyā ye tailaṃ dārḍhyārthinastu ye || 13|| Dī. tailasya viṣayamāha - kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhādayastailaṃ pibeyuḥ | kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ koṣṭhāntaḥ kṛmayaḥ | analāviddhāḥ vātavyādhibhirvyāptaśarīrāḥ | dārḍhyārthinaḥ dṛḍhaśarīrākāṅkṣiṇaḥ | tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ | carake tu - pravṛddhaśleṣmamedaskāścalasthūlagalodarāḥ| vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ye || balaṃ tanutvaṃ laghutāṃ sthiratāṃ dṛḍhagātratām | snigdhaślakṣṇatanutvaktvaṃ ye ca kāṅkṣanti dehinaḥ || kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāstathā nāḍībhirarditāḥ | pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāśca ye’ iti (ca.sū013|42-44)| tanutvaṃ-kṛśatvaṃ, laghutā-lāghavaṃ, sthiratā-niścalatā, dārḍhyaṃ-kāṭhinyam iti || 13 || Gū. kṛmayaḥ koṣṭhe yeṣāṃ te kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ | anilāviṣṭā vāyuyuktāḥ pravṛddhakaphamedaso dīptāgnayaḥ ye tailasātmyāste tailaṃ pibeyuḥ || 13 || vasāyogyānāha - vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ śuṣkaretoraktā mahārujaḥ | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā vasāyogyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14|| Dī. atha vasāviṣayamāha - vyāyāmeti | evaṃvidhā narāḥ puruṣāḥ vasāyogyāḥ | vyāyāmena durbalaśarīrāḥ, śuṣkaṃ retaḥ śukraṃ, raktaṃ rudhiraṃ ca yeṣāṃ te tathā | ata eva carake - ’saṃśuṣkaretorudhirā (ca. sū013|45) ityuktam | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā iti mahāgnistīkṣṇāgnirbhasmako vā | mahāmārutaḥ balavān mārutaḥ | sa cānyo'nyasaṃcāralakṣaṇairjñeyaḥ | uktaṃca carake -- ’balavān māruto yeṣāṃ khāni cāvṛtya tiṣṭhati’ iti (ca. sū 13|46) | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘vātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti | mahāprāṇā mahābalāḥ | uktaṃca carake - mahaccāgnibalaṃ yeṣām iti (ca. sū. 13|47) | athavā prāṇo vāyuḥ | suśrute ca - ’agniḥ somo vāyuḥ sattvarajastamaḥ pañcendriyāṇi bhūtātmeti prāṇāḥ’ | kleśakṣamatvaṃ ca mahābalena | ata evoktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -- ‘rūkṣakleśakṣamātyagnivātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti ( vā. sū016|10) || 14 || Gū. evaṃbhūtā narā vasāyogyā bhavanti iti yojyaṃ | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ, vyāyāmo mallādiyuddhadhanurākarṣaṇādiḥ, tatkarṣitāḥ | kṣīṇāḥ, śuṣkaṃ kṣīṇaṃ reto vīryaṃ raktaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te śuṣkaretoraktāḥ | punaḥ mahārujaḥ vyathāvantaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtāḥ ? mahānagnirmāruto vāyuḥ prāṇāḥ balaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te mahāgnimārutaprāṇāḥ || 14 || majjāyogyānāha -- krūrāśayāḥ kleśasahā vātārtā dīptavahnayaḥ | majjānaṃ ca pibeyuste sarpirvā sarvato hitam || 15 || Dī. majjāviṣayamāha -- krūreti | krūrāśayāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāḥ, kleśasahāḥ ghasmarāḥ, vātārtāḥ vātarogiṇaḥ, dīptavahnayastīkṣṇāgnayaḥ | majjāyā alābhe sarpiḥprayogamāha - sarpirvā sarvato hitamiti | sarvataḥ sarvasnehaviṣaye sarvavyādhau ca, sarpirghṛtaṃ hitaṃ pathyam | etacca majjālābhe jñeyam || 15 || Gū. krūrāśayādinarā majjānaṃ pibeyuḥ | krūra āśayaḥ koṣṭho yeṣāṃ te krūrāśayāḥ | punaḥ kleśasahāḥ duḥkhasahāḥ | punaḥ vātārtāḥ | punaḥ dīptavahnayaḥ ||15|| snehapānakālaḥ | śītakāle divā snehamuṣṇakāle pibenniśi | vātapittādhike rātrau vātaśleṣmādhike divā ||1 6|| Dī. ātyayike vyādhau snehasya kālamāha -- śīteti | vātapittādhike iti | atra vātasya yogavāhitvāt pittādhikaśca gṛhyate | evaṃ vātaśleṣmādhika ityatrāpi vyākhyeyam | pittaśleṣmādhikastu nokto'pyatra sādhāraṇaḥ śīta eva kāle pibediti draṣṭavyam | rātrāviti sāyam || 16 || Gū. śītakālādau snehaḥ kadā peya ityāha -- śītakāle iti | sugamam || 16 || atha tailaghṛtayorviśiṣṭakarma darśayannāha — nasyābhyañjanagaṇḍūṣamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇaiḥ | tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yuñjīta dṛṣṭvā doṣabalābalam || 17 || Dī. doṣaśabdo'tra śarīradūṣaṇāddoṣāḥ vātādayaḥ, dhātavo rasādyāḥ,, malāśca grāhyāḥ | teṣāṃ balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samyagvicārya tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yatra tailasātmyaṃ doṣabalaṃ tatra tailameva yujyāt | yatra ghṛtasātmyaṃ tatra ghṛtameveti tattatsātmyānāṃ tattadyuñjīta || 17 || Gū. nasyādau ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā yojyaṃ tadāha -- nasyeti | nasā peyaṃ nasyam, abhyañjanaṃ mardanaṃ, gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaḥ, mūrdhā mastakaṃ, karṇaṃ śrotram, akṣi netram | tattarpaṇe āpyāyane ghṛtaṃ vā tailaṃ vā yojyam || 17 || idānīṃ snehānāmanupānānyāha - ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ taile yūṣaḥ praśasyate | vasāmajjñoḥ pibenmaṇḍamanupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 18 || Dī. ghṛte iti | anu paścāt niyataṃ pānam anupānaṃ ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣamanupānam | vasāmajjñoḥ maṇḍamanupānam | kecinmaṇḍaśabdenātra strotoviśodhanatvāt dadhimaṇḍamāhuḥ, tanna - yato bhaktamaṇḍo'pi mṛdūkaroti srotāṃsi | uktaṃca - ‘maṇḍo vātānulomanaḥ, tṛḍglānimedodoṣaghnaḥ, pācano, dhātusāmyakṛt’ iti | sukhāvahamiti | sukham āvahati karoti tatsukhāvaham, samyak pākādikaraṇāt | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘anupānaṃ karotyūrjāṃ tṛptiṃ vyāptiṃ dṛḍhāṅgatām | annasaṃghātaśaithilyavikḷptijaraṇāni ca’ iti | anyacca - ’jīrṇājīrṇaviśaṅkāyāṃ punaruṣṇodakaṃ pibet | tenodgāre viśuddhiḥ syāttataśca laghutā ruciḥ ||’ ( vā. sū016|23) iti | etaduṣṇodakaṃ sāmānyena sarvasnehe'pi hitam | uktaṃca - ’uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ca snehānāmatha śasyate | ṛte bhallātakasnehāttatra toyaṃ tu śītalam’ iti || 18 || Gū. ghṛtapānādau anupānamāha - ghṛte iti | ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣaḥ | vasāmajjādiṣu maṇḍaṃ bhaktādibhūtaṃ tadanupānaṃ, anupāne sukhāvaham || 18 || sānnasnehasya viṣayamāha - snehadviṣaḥ śiśūnvṛddhānsukumārān kṛśānapi | udyākāmānuṣṇakāle saha bhaktena pāyayet || 19 || Dī. sānnasnehasya viṣayamāha - sneheti | snehadviṣaḥ snehārucayaḥ ‘uṣṇakāmān’ ityatra ‘tṛṣṇālukān’ iti paṭhanti kecit | sahabhakteneti | bhaktamodanaḥ cakāro'tra luptodayaḥ tena carakoktāścaturviṃśatisnehavicāraṇā grāhyāḥ, tā yathā - ‘odanaśca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi | yavāgūḥ sūpaśāke ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaṃ khaḍaḥ || śaktavastilapiṣṭaṃ ca madyaṃ lehāstathaiva ca | bhakṣyamabhyañjanaṃ bastistathaivottarabastayaḥ || gaṇḍūṣaḥ karṇatailaṃ ca nasyaṃ mūrdhākṣitarpaṇam | caturviṃśatirityetāḥ snehasya pravicāraṇāḥ ||’ iti (ca. sū. 13|21-23) vāgbhaṭoktāścatuḥṣaṣṭivicāraṇāścātraiva grāhyāḥ, tā yathā - ‘rasabhedaikakatvābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭirvicāraṇā’ iti | (vā. sū. 16| 15) nanu - ’acchapeyastu yaḥ sneho na tāmāhurvicāraṇām (ca. sū. 13|24) iti carakavacanātkathaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidhā iti virodhaḥ ? maivaṃ nādyaḥ, peyo vicāraṇā ityasyāyamarthaḥ - acchapeyasnehaḥ sā na vicāraṇā, sātmyartuvyādhyādiṣu vicāraṇāstyeva | uktaṃca carake - ’rasaiścopahitaḥ snehaḥ samāsavyāsayogibhiḥ | ṣaḍbhistriṣaṣṭidhā saṃkhyā prāpnotyekaśca kevalaḥ || evametāścatuḥṣaṣṭisnehānāṃ pravicāraṇāḥ | sātmyartuvyādhipuruṣānprayojyā jānatā bhavet ’ iti | ( ca. sū013|23-26) puruṣagrahaṇena deśasātmyamavaruddhaṃ, yato deśamapekṣya puruṣasya tatsātmyaṃ, tathā puruṣagrahaṇena prakṛtibalavayaḥśarīraprabhṛtayo'varuddhvā iti || 19 || Gū. yeṣāṃ snehaṃ pāyayettānāha - sneha iti | uṣṇakāle grīṣmādau etān bhaktena saha snehaṃ pāyayet | snehaṃ dviṣantīti snehadviṣaḥ tān atiprītau śiśūn , bālān , vṛddhān , sukumārān , kṛśādīn , tṛṣṇāturāṃścāpi| || 19 || idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanamāha - sarpiṣmatī bahutilā yavāgūḥ svalpataṇḍulā | sukhoṣṇā sevyamānā tu sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī ||20|| śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe dohanasthe ghṛte tu gām | dugdhvā kṣīraṃ ṣibeduṣṇaṃ sadyaḥ snehanamucyate || 21 || Dī. rūkṣāṇāṃ sadyaḥ snehanayogadvayamāha - sarpiṣmatīti | sarpiṣmatī bahughṛtā | sadya iti tasminneva divase tvarayā snehanaṃ karoti | sadyograhaṇaṃ stutiparamityanye tryaheṇa snehayatītyarthaḥ | ata evoktaṃ sevyamāneneti | aparamapi - śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe iti | dohanasthe dohanabhāṇḍe sthite ghṛte | kiṃbhūte ? śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe śarkarāmiśrite | tadbhāṇḍe gāṃ dugdhvā rūkṣaḥ puruṣaḥ taddugdhaṃ sadyaḥ svalpakālena snehamucyate iti || 20 || 21 || Gū. idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanamāha - sarpiṣmatīti | evaṃbhūtā yavāgūḥ sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī bhavati | kiṃbhūtā ? sarpiṣmatī, punaḥ bahutilā svalpataṇḍulā, punaḥ sukhoṣṇā | kṣīramapi sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati | tadāha śarkarācūrṇasaṃbhṛṣṭe bharjite dohanasthe gāṃ dugdhvā kṣīramuṣṇaṃ pibet sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati || 20 || 21 || atha snehājīrṇe cikitsāmāha — mithyācārādbahutvādvā yasya sneho na jīryati | viṣṭabhya vāpi jīryeta vāriṇoṣṇena vāmayet ||22|| Dī. atha snehājīrṇe cikitsāmāha — mithyeti | mithyācaraṇāduṣṇodakādīnām | amithyācārastu vāgbhaṭenoktaḥ -’uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhavyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān|| pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥ svapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca || yānyahāni pibettāni tāvantyanyānyapi tyajet | iti | (vā. sū. 16|25-27) bahutvātsamānādhikyādvā | athavā viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā jīryati tamapi vāmayedityarthaḥ | asyāgre kecitpaṭhanti - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punardadyāt laghukoṣṭhāya dehinaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭho bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate vaidyasaṃpradāye tu - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punardadyāt’ iti dināntare jātabale deyamiti || 22 || Gū. mithyācārāderyasya sneho na jīryati tatpratīkāramāha - mithyeti | mithyācārānmithyācaraṇāt, bahutvātsnehādhikyādvā yasya sneho na jīryati viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā vā jīryati tam uṣṇavāriṇā vāmayet || 22 || snehājīrṇe anyadapi pratīkāramāha -- srehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāṃ pibeduṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | tenodgāre bhavecchuddho bhaktaṃ prati rucistathā || 23 || Dī. sneheti | ‘snehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāmapi uṣṇodakaṃ pibet kimuta jīrṇe ityanena sarvāsvapyavasthāsu uṣṇodakamanupāne praśastamityabhiprāyaḥ | phalamāha - teneti | tena uṣṇodakena udgāraśuddhiḥ ruciśca bhaktaṃprati jāyate, bhojane rucirjāyate ityapi | tantrāntare tu - ’syuḥ pacyamāne tṛṭdāhabhramasādāruciklamāḥ | pariṣicyādbhiruṣṇābhirjīrṇe snehe tato naram ’ iti || 23 || Gū. sneheti | sugamam || 23 || snehopadravabhūtāyāstṛṣṇāyāścikitsāmāha - snehena paittikasyāgniryadā tīkṣṇatarīkṛtaḥ | tadāsyodīrayettṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ tasya vāmayet || 24 || śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayecca pipāsā tena śāmyati | Dī. sneheneti | paittikasya pittaprakṛteḥ puruṣasya tīkṣṇatarīkṛta iti atyarthaṃ tīkṣṇatvaṃ prāptaḥ | tadā tasmin kāle asya puruṣasya tṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ kaṭhinām udīrayet utpādayet tadā vāmayet uṣṇāmbu pītvā snehamiti śeṣaḥ | uktaṃca - ’snehapītasya cettṛṣṇā pibeduṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | evaṃ cānupaśāmyantyāṃ snehamuṣṇāmbunā vamet (suśru. ci. 31/24) iti | uddharet vāmayedityarthaḥ | ’ ca ’ śabdaḥ prakārāntare | śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayet tena hetunā pipāsā śāmyati || 24 || Gū. snehe pittaprakopāt pratīkāramāha - sreheneti | paittikasya pittapradhānapuṃsaḥ || 24 || atha snehā'yogyānāha - ajīrṇī varjayetsnehamudarī taruṇajvarī || 25 || durbalo'rocakī sthūlo mūrcchārto madapīḍitaḥ | dattabastirviraktaśca vāntastṛṣṇāśramānvitaḥ || 26 || akālaprasravā nārī durdine ca vivarjayet | Dī. ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī snehaṃ varjayet na pibet | tathā jīrṇajvarī āmajvarī | durbalo balahīnaḥ | arocakī arocakārtaḥ | sthūlo meduraḥ | madapīḍitaḥ madātyayī | dattabastiḥ yasya bastikarma kṛtam | viriktaḥ kṛtavirekaḥ kṛtavāntiśca | tṛṣṇāyuktaḥ śramayuktaśca | akālaprasavā nārīti | garbhapātasrāvābhyāṃ yuktā strī | ṣoḍaśavarṣādarvāgapi prasavo'kālaprasava ityeke | durdinaṃ meghacchanne'hni durdinam | cakārādvāgbhaṭoktāḥ - ‘snehyā natvatimandāgnitīkṣṇāgnisthūladurbalāḥ | ūrustambhātisārāmagalarogagarodaraiḥ || mūrcchāchardyaruciśleṣmatṛṣṇāmadyaiśca pīḍitāḥ | apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane’ iti ( vā. sū. 16|6, 7) || 25 || 26 || Gū. yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tānāha - ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī ajīrṇavān snehaṃ varjayet, tathā udarī udararogavān taruṇajvarī arocakarogayuktaḥ | durdinaṃ ’meghacchanne'hni durdinam |’ spaṣṭamanyat || 25 || || 26 || yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ praśastaṃ tānāha - svedyasaṃśodhyamadyastrīvyāyāmāsaktamānasāḥ || 27 || vṛddhā bālāḥ kṛśā rūkṣāḥ kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaretasaḥ | vātārtāstimirārtā ye teṣāṃ snehanamuttamam || 28 || Dī. snehyānāha - svedyeti | svedyādīnāṃ snehanam uttamam | ete snehārhāḥ, svedyāḥ svedārhāḥ, saṃśodhyā vamanavirecanārhāḥ | madyādiṣu āsaktaṃ mānasaṃ cittaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā | tathā kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ, kṣīṇaretasaḥ kṣīṇaśukrāḥ, vātārtā iti vātenārtāḥ pīḍitāḥ, timirārtāḥ taimirikāḥ iti || 27 || 28 || Gū. svedyeti | evaṃbhūtā ye teṣāṃ snehapānam uttamam | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? svedyāḥ svedanārhāḥ, śodhyā vamanādiśodhanocitāḥ | madyastrīvyāyāmasaktāḥ anuraktāḥ cintakāstu cintanaparāśca | kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ kṣīṇavīryāḥ || 27 || 28 || samyak snigdhasya lakṣaṇamāha - vātānulomyaṃ dīpto'gnirvarcaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam | mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā glāniḥ snehodvego'tha lāghavam ||29|| vimalendriyatā samyak snigdhe Dī. vātānulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya anulomatā, agnirjaṭharāgnirdīptaḥ | varcaḥ purīṣaṃ snigdhaṃ cikkaṇam asaṃhataṃ śithilaṃ mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā ca bhavati | glānirojaḥkṣayaḥ snehodvegaḥ snehapāne dveṣaḥ, lāghavaṃ śarīralaghutā | vimalendriyateti - cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ vimalatvaṃ svasvaviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam | etairlakṣaṇaiḥ samyaksnigdho jñeyaḥ || 29 || Gū. snehe pīte samyaksnigdhalakṣaṇamāha - vātānulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe vātānulomyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya samyakpravṛttiḥ, agnirdīptaḥ, varcaḥ purīṣaṃ, snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇam, asaṃhatam amilitam | mṛdvaṅgatā komalāṅgatā, snigdhāṅgatā sacikkaṇāṅgatā, aglāniḥ aklamaḥ, snehāvegaḥ snehopadravābhāvaḥ | lāghavaṃ dehasya, vimalendriyatā nirmalendriyatā || 29 || rūkṣe lakṣaṇamāha – ---- rūkṣe viparyayaḥ | Dī. rūkṣe viparyayaśca bhavati | sa cāsnigdhalakṣaṇasya | uktaṃca carake - ’purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ rūkṣaṃ vāyurapraguṇo mṛduḥ | paktā kharatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca gātrasyāsnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|55) vāyuratra guṇaḥ mṛduḥ paktā agnimāndyam | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ’rūkṣaṃ purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ pakvānnaṃ na vipacyate | uro vidahyate vāyuḥ koṣṭhādupari dhāvati || nirbalo durbalaścāpi rūkṣo bhavati mānavaḥ’ iti || Gū. rūkṣe tu etadviparyayaḥ || atisnigdhalakṣaṇamāha -- bhaktadveṣo mukhasrāvo gude dāhaḥ pravāhikā ||30|| tandrātīsārapāṇḍutvaṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya lakṣaṇam | Dī. bhaktadveṣa iti | bhṛśasnigdhasyātisnigdhasya bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇam | tatra bhaktadveṣo bhojanānākāṅkṣā | mukhasrāvaḥ hṛllāsaḥ, gude dāhaḥ | ’gude pākaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ | tandrā prāg vyākhyātā | atīsaraṇamatīsāraḥ | pāṇḍutvaṃ śarīrasya | carake tu - pāṇḍutā gauravaṃ jāḍyaṃ purīṣasyāvipakvatā | atyutkleśo'rucistandrī syādatisnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|57) sadanaṃ aṅgānāṃ jāḍyaṃ jaḍībhāvaḥ kāyasya, purīṣasyāvipākatā'samatā, atyutkleśo hṛllāsaḥ, nidrārtasya viṣayāgrahaṇaṃ tandrīti || 30 || Gū. atisnigdhapāne lakṣaṇamāha - bhakteti | bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya atisnehapītasya, idaṃ bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojyam | bhakte dveṣaḥ bhaktāruciḥ, mukhasrāvaḥ mukhasyāsamantāt srāvaḥ lālāsravaṇaṃ, gude dāhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ, tandrā īṣanmudritanetratvam, atīsaraṇaṃ, pāṇḍutvaṃ pītavarṇatā || 30 || athahīnātisnigdhasyopakramamāha - rūkṣasya snehanaṃ snehairatisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇam || 31 || Dī. athahīnātisnigdhasyopakramamāha - rūkṣasyeti | rūkṣasya puruṣasya snehaiḥ sadyaḥsnehanakāribhistailaghṛtādibhiḥ snehanaṃ kāryaṃ, atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam || 31 || Gū. rūkṣasya snigdharūkṣaṇamiti | pratīkāramāha - rūkṣasya snehanaiḥ snehanam | atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇai rūkṣaṇam || 31 || rūkṣayogamāha - śyāmākacaṇakādyaiśca takrapiṇyākasaktubhiḥ | Dī. rūkṣayogamāha - śyāmāketi | śyāmākādibhī rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam | ādigrahaṇāt vāgbhaṭoktaṃ sarvaṃ grāhyam | yathā – ‘kṣuttṛṣṇollekhanasvedarūkṣapānānnabheṣajam | takrāriṣṭakhaloddālayavaśyāmākakodravam || pippalī triphalā kṣaudraṃ pathyā gomūtragugguluḥ | yathāsvaṃ pratirogaṃ ca snehavyāpadi sādhanam’ iti || kecit ’śyāmākacaṇakādyaiḥ’ ityatra ‘śyāmākakoradūṣānnaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti | piṇyākaṃ niḥsnehatilakalkam || Gū. kaiḥ ? takrapiṇyākādyaiḥ snehanam | śyāmākacaṇakādyai rūkṣai rūkṣaṇam | śyāmākaḥ dhānyaviśeṣaḥ | (sāva) piṇyākastilakalkaḥ || atha snehasevino lakṣaṇamāha - dīptāgniḥ śuddhakoṣṭhaśca puṣṭadhāturdṛḍhendriyaḥ || 32 || nirjaro balavarṇāḍhyaḥ snehasevī bhavennaraḥ | Dī. atha snehasevino lakṣaṇamāha - dīpteti | snehasevī naraḥ dīptāgniḥ syāt | agniratra jaṭharāgniḥ | śuddhakoṣṭha iti madhyakoṣṭhakrūrakoṣṭhādirahitaḥ | puṣṭadhātuḥ rasādipuṣṭadhātuḥ | dṛḍhendriyaḥ cakṣurādīndriyabalayuktaḥ’ | nirjaraḥ, balavarṇāḍhyaḥ, varṇāḍhyaśca, surūpaśca | vāgbhaṭe tu – ’dīptāntarāgniḥ pariśuddhakoṣṭhaḥ pratyagradhāturbalavarṇayuktaḥ | dṛḍhendriyo mandajaraḥ śatāyuḥ snehopasevī puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ iti (vā. sū. 16|46) || 32 || Gū. snehasevī yādṛśo bhavati tādṛśamāha - dīpteti | nirjaraḥ jarārahitaḥ | balavarṇayuktaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 32 || snehasevāyāṃ varjyānyāha - snehe vyāyāmasaṃśītavegāghātaprajāgarān || 33 ||divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || Dī. snehasevāyāṃ varjyānyāha - snehe snehapāne | vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajananakarma | saṃśītamiti atyarthaśītavātādikaṃ | vegāghātamiti vegānāṃ mūtrapurīṣotsargecchānām āghātam avarodhaṃ vegadhāraṇamityarthaḥ | prajāgaramiti rātrijāgaraṇam | abhiṣyandi śleṣmaprakopi dadhyādikamityarthaḥ | rūkṣānnamiti śyāmākacaṇakādikam | etacca sāmānyasnehapānaviṣaye yatra ca atisnigdhatā bhavati tatra rūkṣānnaṃ vihitameva | tatpūrvameva || 33 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehapānādhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ || 1 || Gū. snehapāne yanniṣiddhaṃ tadāha - snehe iti | snehe snehapāne, vyāyāmādīn vivarjayet | saṃśītam atiśītalaṃ, vegāghātaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣādirodham | divāsvapnamabhiṣyandivirodhi | rūkṣāścāṇakādi | spaṣṭamanyat || 33 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi snehapānaṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

title: 2. atha svedavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: Dī. atha snehādhyāyānantaraṃ svedavidhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - atha svedavidhiḥ Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | snehavidhikathanānantaraṃ svedavidhiḥ | svedasya vidhirvidhānam | uktaṃca prāk - ’ snehasvedāvanabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkamivānāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate’ iti | carake'pri snehapūrvaprayuktena svedamāvarjite'nile | purīṣamūtraretāṃsi na sajjanti kadācana’ iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - śuṣkānyapi hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ | śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvatām’ iti | tena yuktaṃ snehānantaraṃ svedā'bhidhānam | Gū. snehapānānantaraṃ svedasya vihitatvāt || tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ svedasaṃkhyāmāha - svedaścaturvidhaḥ proktastāpoṣmasvedasaṃjñakau | upanāho dravaḥ svedaḥ sarve vātārtihāriṇaḥ || 1 || svedau tāpoṣmajau prāyaḥ śleṣmaghnau samudīritau | upanāhastu vātaghnaḥ pittasaṅge dravo hitaḥ || 2 || Dī. sveda iti | svidyate'neneti vyutpattyā svedo'gniḥ, tasya vidhiḥ karmacāturī | caturvidhatvamāha - ekastāpasaṃjñaḥ svedaḥ| dvitīyastūṣmāsaṃjñaḥ| tṛtīya upanāhaḥ upanāho nibandhanamiti pralepena | asya bhedaḥ sālvaṇa iti | caturtho dravasveda iti | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ anyatrāpyuktaṃ ca ’kṣāmaḥsaikatapārṣṇikāsyavasanaiḥ svedo'thavāṃgārakairlepairvātaharaiḥ sahāmlalavaṇaiḥ snehaiḥ sukhomlairbhavet | evaṃ taptapayombuvātaśamanakvāthādisekādibhistaptaistoyaniṣecanāhatamahābāṣpaiḥ sitādyaiḥ kramā’diti | eṣveva caturṣu yathākramaṃ carakoktasaṃkarasvedādyavarodhaḥ | śaṃkarādisvedā yathā ’śaṃkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko'vagāhanaṃ | jetākoṣmaghanaḥ karṣaḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhireva ca | kūpo dolaka ityete svedayanti trayodaśa iti ’ | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti | pittayukte vāte dravasvedo hitaḥ pittasaṃge'tra svedasaṃghāto vihitaḥ | vātakaphayorevaṃ svedaśaṃkaraḥ | yaduktaṃ carake - vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyata iti | alpe pittasaṃsarge vāte dravasvedaḥ | sacoṣṇatvāt prabalau vātakaphau hanti | hīnapittaṃ tu dravatvena saukṣmyatvāt | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘ svedastāpopanāhoṣmadravabhedāścaturvidhāḥ ’ iti ||1||2|| Gū. svedaścaturvidhaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhatvamāha – tāpoṣmau etau dvau svedasaṃjñitau bhavataḥ | upanāho dravaśca etau dvau , evaṃ catvāraḥ sarvato vātaharāḥ vātahāriṇo bhavanti | caturvidhasvedasya vātanāśakatve'pi viśeṣamāha – svedāviti | topoṣmajau svedau śleṣmaghnau samudīritau kathitau | upanāhaḥ svedaḥ vātaghnaḥ pittasaṃyoge dravo dravaḥ svedyamatipittasaṅge vā tau | tathāca suśrutaḥ - ‘tatra tāpoṣmasvedau viśeṣataḥ śleṣmaghnau, upanāhasvedo vātaghnaḥ | anyatarasmin pittasaṃsṛṣṭe dravasvedaḥ’ iti | anyatarasaṃsṛṣṭe vātamiśrite pitte dravaḥ svedo'bhihitaḥ iti suśrutā'bhiprāyaḥ | kevalapitte tu sarva eva svedā niṣiddhāḥ | kiṃtu śītalajalāvagāha eva praśastaḥ tathā coktaṃ - ‘pariṣekāvagāheṣu vyañjanānāṃ ca sevanam | śasyate śiśiraṃ toyaṃ tṛṣṇāpittoṣmaśāntaye’ iti ||1||2|| atha trividhasvedasya viśeṣamāha - mahābale mahāvyādhau śīte svedo mahānsmṛtaḥ | durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhye madhyatamo mataḥ || 3 || Dī. mahābalapuruṣe mahāvyādhau ca kapholbaṇavātavikārādau | śīte śītale śītārditapuruṣe vā mahān svedo vihitaḥ | durbale puruṣe pittaprāye vā durbalaḥ svedo dravaprāyo vihitaḥ | madhye madhyamabalapuruṣe vātaprāye vā madhyaḥ madhyamaḥ sveda upanāhaprāyo vihitaḥ | tathācoktaṃ -‘tāpopanāhadravabāṣpapūrvāḥ svedāstato'ntyaḥ prathamau kaphe staḥ | vāyau dvitīyaḥ pavanaṃ kaphe ca pittopasṛṣṭe vihitastṛtīyaḥ ’ iti || 3 || atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa svedaviśeṣamāha – balāse rūkṣaṇasvedo rūkṣasnigdhaṃ kaphānile | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ raveḥ karān ||4|| niyuddhaṃ mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇaṃ kṣudhaḥ | cintāvyāyāmabhārāṃśca sevetāmayamuktaye ||5|| Dī. balāse kaphe |rūkṣasvedaṃ vālukāvastrakapālāṃgārādinimittaṃ | kaphānile iti kaphānilasaṃsarge rūkṣasnigdhamiti | tacca śālvaṇaprabhṛtikaṃ | kaphamedovṛte vāte iti | medo hi sarvaśarīrāṇāmudarastham aṇvasthiṣu ca | tathāhi ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjātvabhyantarasthitā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate ’ iti | anena sakaphenāvṛte vāyau koṣṇagehādikaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | koṣṇagehamaṅgārādibhiḥ saṃtaptamityarthaḥ | raveḥ karān sūryakiraṇān | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddhaṃ | guruprāvaraṇamiti pravarājinakauśeyapraveṇīkuthakaprabhṛtikaṃ | kruddhaṃ kopaṃ pittajanakaṃ cintācittabhrāṃtikaraṃ vidhānaṃ medonāśakaratvāt | vyāyāmamiti śarīrāyāsajananam | viyuddhādivyatiriktaṃ karma etān āmayamuktaye kaphamedovṛtavātajanitarogaśāntyai seveta ātura iti śeṣaḥ | cintāsthāne bhayamiti kecit | tenāpi manaḥsaṃtāpatvāt krodhavat | tathāhi ‘vyāyāmoṣṇagṛhakṣudgurubalakrodhamānabhayasamarāḥ | upanāhasūryatāpau daśāgniguṇavarjitāḥ svedāḥ’ | bhayaṃ tu yathā unmādakāraṇamapi tanmādyakaṃ syāt | yathā dṛśyate yatsvedanaṃ calitasya sandheḥ punarghaṭṭanena tena samyagavasthānaṃ tadvadihāpi jñeyam ||4||5|| Gū. yādṛśe vāyau yādṛśaḥ svedo vihitaḥ tatprakāramāha – balāse iti | balāse kaphe | rūkṣaṇaḥ svedo vālukādibhirhitaḥ | kaphānile rūkṣasnigdhaṃ | kaphānile kaphavāte | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ saṃseveta | raveḥ karān kiraṇān seveta | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddham | mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇam | kopaṃ balādidhāraṇaṃ śītādīnāṃ śamanaṃ , cintāvyāyāmabharāṃśca seveta | āmayamuktaye roganāśāya ||4||5|| prāksvedyāḥ - yeṣāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bastiścāpi hi dehinām | śodhanīyāśca ye kecitpūrvaṃ svedyāśca te matāḥ ||6|| Dī. atha krameṇa ye pūrvaṃ svedyāstānāha - yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyamiti nasyaṃ dātavyaṃ te nasyātmakasvedyā ityarthaḥ | na tu nasyaṃ vidhāya paścāt svedyā iti bhāvaḥ | yeṣāṃ dehināṃ bastiranuvāsananirūhākhyā dātavyā teṣāmapi pūrvaṃ svedakarma kāryaṃ, ye kiṃcicchodhanīyāḥ vamanavirekādiyogyāste'pi pūrvaṃ svedyā ityartha: | paramārthatastu virecane vidhātavye sati tryahaṃ snehapānaṃ paramam | vamane punarekāhoparame svedaḥ | yadāha kaścitsudāntasenaḥ - ekāhaṃ dinamanyacca kaphanut kleśyatakṣarairiti (?) || 6 || Gū. pūrvaṃ ye svedyāstānāha - yeṣāmiti | bhagandarī aśmaryāturaśca ete trayaḥ pūrvaṃ svedyāḥ || 6 || paścātsvedyāḥ - paścātsvedyā gate śalye mūḍhagarbhagade tathā | kāle prajātā'kāle vā paścātsvedyā nitambinī ||7|| Dī. idānīṃ ye paścāt svedyāstānāha - mūḍhagarbhādyupadrava ityeke | mūḍhagarbhagate tathetyapīti pāṭhaḥ kaścit | arthādraktasrāvādyupadravarahitāḥ paścāt svedyā ityarthaḥ | kāle prasavasamaye prajātakāle samyagjātasamaye | nitambinī strī | tantrāntare'pi ’paścātsvedyā hṛte śalye mūḍhagarbhā'nupadravā | samyakprajātakāle ca paścāt svedyā vijānateti’ | (cakradatte) ||7 || Gū. ye paścātsvedyāstānāha - paścāditi | gate śalye tathā mūḍhagarbhagade paścātsvedyāḥ | kāle prajātā navamamāsādagre prasūtā | akāle navamamāsādadhaḥ prasūtā vā nitambinī strī paścātprasavāt svedyā ||7|| kāladvayasvedyānāha -- svedyā: pūrvaṃ trayaḥ plīhabhagandaryarśasastathā | aśmaryaścāturo jantuḥ samaye śastrakarmaṇaḥ || 8 || Dī. athobhayataḥ śodhyāstānāha | plīhabhagandarārśasāṃ traya eva doṣāḥ | traya evopadravā vāte cāpi vātādidoṣajanitā ityarthaḥ | tathetigrahaṇānnaite pūrvaṃ svedyā: kiṃtu paścāt svedyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathā – coktaṃ - ’svedyāḥ punarayathādāhanāntaramuṣṇāmbutaptakaṭāhopaveśanarūpam’ | evamanyadapi yathāyogyaṃ boddhavyaṃ | janturāturaḥ śastrakarmaṇaḥ śastravidhānasya samaye kāle plīhabhagandarādīnityarthaḥ | śastrakarmaṇaḥ paścātpūrvaṃ caite svedyā ityabhiprāyaḥ || 8 || svedakālaḥ - savānsvedān nivāte ca jīrṇāhāre ca kārayet | Dī. atha svedakālāvasthāṃ darśayitumāha | sarvāniti tāpoṣṇopanāhadravasaṃjñān nivāte vātarahitasthāne jīrṇāhāre sati ca | jīrṇāhāralakṣaṇaṃ coktam | tathāhi - ‘udgāraśuddhirutsāho vegotsargo yatheritā | laghutā kṣutpipāsā ca jīrṇāhārasya lakṣaṇami’ti | prāyeṇa tu viṣṭavdhe'jīrṇepi svedo vihitaḥ | uktaṃ hi - ’viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kārya’miti vacanāt || Gū. svedān kārayedityāha - sarvāniti | nivāte nirvātasthāne | tathā''hāre jīrṇe paripakve sati sarvān caturvidhān svedānkārayet || svedaphalam - svedāddhātusthitā doṣāḥ snehaklinnasya dehinaḥ ||9|| dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatvā yānti virekatām | Dī. atha svedāddoṣasya yena vidhyapagamastamāhala - doṣā vātādayaḥ | dhātusthitā iti | rasādidhātugatāḥ snehaklinnasya dehina iti | snehasvedābhyaktaśarīrasya puruṣasya | yataḥ snehasvedapūrvakameva śodhanaṃ | dravatvaṃ prāpyeti doṣa eva yataḥ | ye mārgeṣu līnā svasthānasthā vā dhātusaṃsthā api vā te samyaksvedairyojitāḥ saṃtaḥ dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatāḥ paścācchodhanaiḥ kṛtvā śāntiṃ yāntītyabhiprāyaḥ | tathācoktaṃ ’snehāt klinnā dhātusaṃsthāśca doṣāḥ svasthānasthā ye ca mārgeṣu līnāḥ | samyaksvedairyojitāste dravatvaṃ nītā: koṣṭhaṃ śodhane yānti śāntim’ iti || 9 || Gū. svedāddoṣaḥ kathaṃ yātītyāha - svedāditi | svedādvālukādisvedāt | tathā snehasvinnasya tailāvagāhanādyaiḥ svinnasya dehinaḥ puruṣasya dhātusthitā doṣāḥ koṣṭhāntargatvā dravatvaṃ prāpya virekatāṃ yāntīti yojanā || 9 || sveditasya rakṣā | svidyamānaśarīrasya hṛdayaṃ śītalaiḥ spṛśet || 10 || snehābhyaktaśarīrasya śītairācchādya cakṣuṣī | Dī. atha sveditasyāśvāsanārthaṃ viṣayamāha -- svidyamānaśarīrasya snehābhyaktaśarīrasyeti pādadvayasyetyayamabhiprāyaḥ - anena pūrvaṃ snehābhyaktaśarīrasya paścāt sveditasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | yataḥ sarvasvedeṣvapi snehābhyaṅgo vihita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathācoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena | nānābhyaktenāpi ca snigdhadehe svedo yojyaḥ svedavidbhiḥ kathaṃcit | dṛṣṭaṃ loke kāṣṭhamasnigdhamāśu tāpādbhayaṃ sveda- yogairgṛhītamiti | śītairācchādya cakṣuṣī iti | sarvāṃgeṣu svede kriyamāṇe cakṣūrakṣaṇārthamuktaṃ śītairiti padmāpatrādibhiḥ | asyāgre ’hṛdayaṃ vṛṣaṇau dṛṣṭiṃ svedayenmṛdu naiva ve’ti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | atra cakṣuṣī ityupalakṣaṇatvāt hṛdayādirakṣaṇameva kāryamityanenaiva gṛhītārthatvāt || 10|| Gū. doṣavireke jāte tatsthāpanārthaṃ cikitsitamāha - svidyamānaśarīrasyeti | bālukādeḥ svinnasya vireke sati hṛdayaṃ śītalaiḥ candanādibhiḥ spṛśet | snehābhyaktaśarīrasya snehasvinnasya śītaiḥ kamalakadalīpatrādyaiḥ cakṣuṣī ācchādya virekāt upācaret ityuttarakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ || 10 || asvedārhāḥ - ajīrṇī durbalo mehī kṣatakṣīṇaḥ pipāsitaḥ ||11|| atisārī raktapittī pāṇḍurogī tathodarī | madārto garbhiṇī caiva nahi svedyā vijānatā || 12|| etānapi mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyānupācaret | Dī. atha ye'pi rogiṇo'svedyāstānāha - ajīrṇītyādi | ete rogiṇo na svedyāḥ | yataḥ svedādapi teṣāṃ dehanāśo bhavati, kadācinna bhavati tadā eteṣāṃ vikārā api sādhyatvaṃ yāntīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vijānatā puruṣeṇeti grahaṇam | tathāhi - ’svedāddoṣā yānti dehāvināśaṃ saṃsādhyatvaṃ yāṃti caiṣāṃ vikārāḥ’ iti bhāvaḥ | ajīrṇīti ajīrṇe bhakta iti sāmānyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa viṣṭabdhājīrṇī svedo vihitaḥ viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kāryamiti vacanāt | yaduktamanyatrāpi - ‘svedaiḥ sādhyo durbalo'jīrṇabhaktaḥ syātāṃ cedvau svedanīyau tatastā’viti | śeṣaṃ subodhaṃ || 11 || 12 || kecidatrārdhaṃ paṭhanti- ’mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta tathā hṛnmuṣkadṛṣṭiṣu || 13 || iti || 13 || Gū. yeṣāṃ svedo nocitastānāha - ajīrṇīti | etānapi mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyānupācaret | ajīrṇo ajīrṇavān, durbalaḥ, mehī pramehavān, kṣatakṣīṇaḥ uraḥkṣatakṣīṇaḥ, mado madyajanitarogī | etānapi svedasādhyānupācaret | keṣu ? mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta ityāha | hṛt hṛdayam, muṣko'ṇḍakoṣaḥ | dṛṣṭirnetram || 13 || svedātiyogajā rogāḥ - atisvedātsandhipīḍā dāhatṛṣṇā klamo bhramaḥ | pittāsṛkpiḍakākopastatra śītairupācaret || 14 || Dī. atha svedasyātiyogastena doṣamāha - piḍakākoṭha iti sphoṭādīnām | athavā piḍakākoṭha iti pāṭhaḥ | koṭho varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃkāśaḥ tatra śītairupācarediti | pānābhyañjane cātra śītāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā vidhijñena iti śeṣaḥ | yaduktam ‘atisvinnamathāśvāsya śītāmbuvamanaṃ hita’miti | carake tu uktaḥ - ‘uktastasyātiśaye graiṣmikaḥ sarvaśo vidhiḥ | sotisvinnasya kartavyo madhurasnigdhaśītalam’ iti || 14 || Gū. atisvedāt kiṃ bhavatītyāha - atisvedāditi | atisvedātsaṃdhipīḍādayo bhavanti | klamaḥ glāniḥ, bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva | pittāsṛk pittaraktam | piṃḍakā sphoṭikā | tatra śītairupācaredityanvayaḥ | tathācoktaṃ - ‘svinne'tyarthaṃ saṃdhipīḍāvidāhaḥ sphoṭotpattiḥ pittaraktaprakopaḥ | mūrcchā bhrāṃtirdāhatṛṣṇe klamaśca kuryāttūrṇaṃ tatra śītaṃ vidhānam’ iti || 14 || tāpasvedaḥ - teṣu tāpābhidhaḥ svedo vālukāvastrapāṇibhiḥ | kapālakandukāṅgārairyathāyogyaḥ prayujyate || 15 || Dī. idānīṃ yatpūrvaṃ cāturvidhyamuktaṃ tadyogadvāreṇa prakaṭayannāha - teṣu pūrvoktatāpādisvedeṣu | tāpābhidhastāpasvedaḥ | kapāla: kharparaḥ vālukādayo'tra vahnisaṃtaptā jñeyāḥ | yathāyogya iti | yathādoṣāpekṣayā yathāsthānasthitavyādhyanurūpa ityarthaḥ | ayaṃ tāpasvedo'bhihitaḥ || 15 || Gū. atha tāpādisvedānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - teṣviti | teṣu caturvidhasvedeṣu tāpādayaḥ svedā vālukādibhiryathāyogyaṃ prajāyante utpadyante | vālukā sikatā vastraṃ cīram, pāṇibhirhastaiḥ, kapālaḥ kharparaḥ, kandukaḥ vastrakandukaḥ, yadvā bahucchidro gṛhamadhye racitaḥ kandusaṃjñaḥ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -’bahucchidro gṛhāntasthaḥ kandurjetāka ucyate’ iti | tasya nirmāṇaṃ carake likhitam - ‘aṅgāraiḥ khadirādyaiśca nirdhūmairvālukātaptaṃ kṛtvā evaṃ pātrāntaritaiḥ svedaḥ aṅgārasya mṛtpātre sthāpayitvā svedaḥ kartavyaḥ’ iti || 15 || ūṣmasvedaḥ - ūṣmasvedaḥ prayoktavyo lohapiṇḍeṣṭakāśmabhiḥ | ataptairamlasiktaiśca kāye naktakaveṣṭite || 16 || athavā vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ | uṣṇairghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve chidraṃ vidhāya ca || 17 || vimudryāsyaṃ trikhaṇḍāṃ ca dhātujāṃ kāṣṭhavaṃśajām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ nalīṃ yuñjyādvihastikām ||18|| sukhopaviṣṭaṃ svabhyaktaṃ guruprāvaraṇāvṛtam | hastiśuṇḍikayā nāḍyāṃ svedayedvātarogiṇam || 19|| puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ vā bhūmimutkīrya khādiraiḥ | kāṣṭhairdagdhvā tathābhyukṣya kṣīradhānyāmlavāribhiḥ ||20|| vātaghnapatrairācchādya śayānaṃ svedayennaram | evaṃ māṣādibhiḥ svinnaiḥ śayānaṃ svedamācaret ||21|| Dī. athoṣmasvedavivakṣāyāṃ yogadvāreṇa taptarūpamāha - kāye naktakaveṣṭite iti | naktakāḥ vātaharavaṭapallavādayaḥ | tairveṣṭitaṃ śarīraṃ kṛtvā paścādvihitasvedadravyeṇa svedayediti bhāvaḥ | anyadapyāha - athaveti | vātanirnāśadravyāṇi daśamūlaprabhṛtīni | teṣāṃ kvāthaṃ svarasaṃ ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ca grāhyaṃ pārśve chidraṃ vidhāyeti ghaṭapārśve nāḍikāmukhapramāṇaṃ randhraṃ kārayet | vimudryāsyamiti| ghaṭamukhaṃ mudrayedityarthaḥ | nāḍikāghaṭasaṃdhimapi mudrayediti saṃpradāyaḥ | nāḍīsvarūpamāha -trikhaṇḍamityādi | trikhaṇḍāṃ mṛdumadhyaprabalasvedaviṣayatvātkhaṇḍatrayayuktāmityarthaḥ | dhātujāmiti suvarṇādidhātunirmitam | athavāpyabhāve kāṣṭhajāmiti vaṃśādikāṣṭhaghaṭitām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāmiti ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥ kuṇḍalākṛtimuttaralagnaṃ nāḍikāmukhamiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃcidvimañcaghaṭalagnamukhaṃ bhavatīti gopucchākārānukārābhidhānatvāt saṃpradāyaviṣayaḥ | tena laghumukhaṃ ghaṭalagnaṃ kārayet | bṛhanmukhamāturalagnamiti bhāvaḥ | dvihastakāmiti dvihastaparimāṇaṃ trikhaṇḍānāmityarthaḥ | guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlīprabhṛtikam | hastiśuṇḍikayetyuktamapi nāḍyākāraṃ draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | athavā hastiśuṇḍiketi nāmnā'sya svedasya saṃjñā vihitā | hastiśuṇḍiko'yaṃ sveda iti tātparyārthaḥ | anyoṣmasvedavidhānamāha - puruṣāyāmamātrāmiti | puruṣapramāṇaṃ yathā syāt| āyāmañca dīrghavistārayoḥ khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhairiti | khadiro raktasāraḥ | dagdhveti bhūgartasthānamiti śeṣaḥ | tatra kāṣṭhajvalanaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | tatheti paścāt kṣīrādibhiḥ kṛtvābhyukṣyeti | na tu kāṣṭhāṅgārāṇi tatratyopanīya kṣīradhānyāmlaprabhṛtīnāmekatamena kṛtvā tadeva sevayediti bhāvaḥ | dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaviśeṣam | tadabhāve takraṃ grāhyamiti vyavahārāt| paścātkāryamāha - vātaghnapatrairityādi | tatra vātaghnapatraireraṇḍaprabhṛtikaiḥ | tacchayanaṃ bhūgartanirmitarūpam | tatpatrairācchādya tatra vātārtapuruṣaṃ saṃviśya svedayedityabhiprāyaḥ | evamityanenaiva prakāreṇa svinnairmāṣādibhirapi śayanasvedamāvaraṇīyam | etaduktaṃ bhavati | māṣakvāthajalenāpi bhūgartasyeti siṃcanam | athavā svinnabāṣpaiḥ bāṣpaparisvinnaṃ vātārtamadhaḥsthaṃ svedayedityeke || 16-21 || Gū. athoṣṇasvedaḥ - lohapiṇḍikeṣṭakādibhiḥ taptai: amlasaṃsiktaiḥ, punaḥ kāye dehe, rallakaveṣṭitairyaḥ svedaḥ sa uṣṇasvedaḥ | athavā pakṣāntare | vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ ghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve tiryak chidraṃ kṛtvā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ vimudrya tasminpārśve chidre dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | kiṃbhūtāṃ nāḍīṃ ? trikhaṇḍāṃ trigranthivaṃśajām | kāṣṭhajāṃ, dhātujāṃ dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ veti vikalpaḥ | sukhopaviṣṭaṃ sukhena sthitam | svabhyaktaṃ kṛtatailābhyaṅgam | punaḥ guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlādyairāvṛtam | anayā hastiśuṇḍikādhārayā nāḍyā vātarogiṇaṃ svedayet | apara uṣṇasvedaprakāraḥ - puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ puruṣapramāṇamātrāṃ bhūmimutkīrya khanayitvā khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhairdagdhvā tathā'mlamūtrādibhirabhyukṣyābhiṣiṃcya vātaghnapatrairācchādya śayānaṃ svedayet || 16-21 || upanāhasvedamāha - athopanāhasvedaṃ ca kuryādvātaharauṣadhaiḥ | pradihya dehaṃ vātārtaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ || 22 || amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiḥ | upagrāmyānūpamāṃsairjīvanīyagaṇena ca || 23 || dadhi-sauvīraka-kṣīrairvīratarvādinā tathā | kulattha-māṣa-godhūmairatasī-tila-sarṣapaiḥ || 24 || śataṣuṣpā-devadāru-śephālī-sthūlajīrakaiḥ | eraṇḍamūlaṃ bījaiśca rāsnāmūlakaśigrubhiḥ || 25 || miśi-kṛṣṇā-kuṭheraiśca lavaṇairamlasaṃyutaiḥ | prasāriṇyaśvagandhābhyāṃ balābhirdaśamūlakaiḥ || 26 || guḍūcī-vānarībījairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtaiḥ | kṣuṇṇaiḥ svinnaiśca vastreṇa baddhaiḥ saṃsvedayennaram ||27|| mahāśālvaṇasaṃjño'yaṃ yogaḥ sarvānilārtihṛt | Dī. athopanāhasvedavidhānamāha | upanāhaḥ koṣṇabahalālepaḥ bandhanamityeke | vātaharauṣadhairiti kākolyādigaṇādyathālābhaṃ grāhyamiti vyavahāraḥ | kṣīramāṃsarasānvitairiti kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ tadabhāve ājaṃ sāmānyatvācca yathāyogyaṃ deyamiti | māṃsamatra grāmyānūpasaṃbhavaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasya rasaṃ māṃsarasamityarthaḥ | amlapiṣṭairiti amlaiḥ kāñjikādibhiḥ | salavaṇairiti lavaṇo'tra saindhavaṃ | snehasaṃyutairiti sneho'tra caturvidho deyo yathāyogyasaṃbhavāt | ayamapi śālvaṇasaṃjñaḥ | aparamapyupanāhavidhānamāha | grāmyānūpamāṃsādivānarībījaparyantadravye yathālābhaprāptaiḥ kṣuṇṇai: sūkṣmakuṭṭitaiḥ svinnaiḥ kathitaiḥ tadanu vastreṇa baddhvā poṭṭalikākāraiḥ saṃsvedayet | naramiti vātārtaṃ puruṣam | ayaṃ mahāśālvaṇasaṃjñayogaḥ prasiddha eva | yaduktam - ‘ānūpagrāmyamāṃsādyaiḥ svedaḥ śālvaṇako mata’ iti | grāmyāḥ aśvāśvataragokharorabhramedaḥpucchakaprabhṛtaya: | ānūpavargastu | pañcavidha:| tadyathā kūlacarāḥ, pallavāḥ, kośasthāḥ, pādinaḥ, matsyāśceti | tatra kūle caranti, te yathā - ‘tatrebha-mahiṣa-nyaṅku-ruru-rohita-śūkarāḥ | khaṅgi-gokarṇa-camarāḥ - sṛmarāḥ kālapucchakaḥ | kodrakāramaledyāśca paśavaḥ kūlacāriṇaḥ’ | plavā yathā - ’haṃsa-sārasa-kādamba-krauñca-kāraṇḍava-plavāḥ| balākā-baka-cakrāhvajīvajīvāmbukukkuṭā: | utkrośa-puṇḍarīkākṣa-śaśarīmaṇituṇḍikāḥ | kākatuṇḍadhanānāvamadgupuṣkaraśāyikāḥ | kāvākṣimallikāśvetavarāhādyāḥ plavā smṛtāḥ’ | kośasthā yathā - ‘śaṅkhaḥ śaṅkhāṇakaḥ śuktirbhallūkaśambukādayaḥ | kośasthāśca - udrakumbhīraśiśumārakumbhīrakāḥ | nakrakūrma-bhallūkādyāḥ pādinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ’ | matsyā yathā-‘gomatsyo marulaḥ kṛṣṇamatsyako bahulo rasaḥ | rājī cilici-mādyāśca matsyāḥ proktāḥ samāsataḥ’ iti | ityānūpamāṃsavargaḥ | eteṣāṃ svarūpamatra vistarabhayānna likhitaṃ | jīvanīyagaṇena veti | taduktaṃ suśrute – kākolīkṣīrakākolījīvakarṣabhakau | mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇīmedāmahāmedācchinnaruhākarkaṭa-śṛṅgītugākṣīrīṛddhivṛddhimṛdvīkājīvantyo madhukaṃ ceti jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ | dadhisauvīrakakṣīrairiti | sauvīrakaḥ kāñjikabhedaḥ | vīratarvādinā tatheti | vīratarvādigaṇaḥ suśrute'vagantavyaḥ | vīratarusahacaradarbhavṛkṣādanīguṇḍānalakuśakāśāśmabhedakāgnimanthamoraṭavasukavasirabhallakakundurūke-ndīvarakapotavaṅkāśvadaṃṣṭrā ceti| śephālīsthūlajīrakairiti | śephālī nirguṇḍī ‘saṃbhārū’ iti loke | sthūlajīrakaḥ kṛṣṇajīraka:| eraṇḍasya mūlaṃ bījaṃ, ca grāhyaṃ | miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | kuṭherakaḥ khanāmaprasiddhaḥ | lavaṇairiti bahuvacanenātra pañcalavaṇāni yathāyogyaṃ deyāni | aparāṇyapi pāṃśukṣāraprabhṛtīni grāhyāṇi na doṣaḥ | amlasaṃyutairiti amloṣṇavargo hito grāhyaḥ | balābhiriti bahuvacanādbalācatuṣṭayeṣu yathālābhamiti yojyam | daśamūlaḥ prasiddhaḥ sa ca daśadravyairmilitaḥ | tadyathā - ’śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā | tathā gokṣurakaścaiva laghumūlamiti smṛtam | bilvo'gnimanthaḥ syonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalāstathā | jñeyaṃ mahatvaṃ mūlaṃ ca daśamūlamubhe smṛta’miti | vānarībījairiti kapikacchūbījaiḥ | etairdravyairvyastairvā yogā boddhavyāḥ bhinnatṛtīyāntapadatvāt | śeṣaṃ subodham || 22-27 || Gū. athopanāhasvedaḥ - vātaharauṣadhairdaśamūlādibhirupanāhaṃ svedaṃ kuryāt | kiṃ kṛtvā ? vātārtadehaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ pradihya pralepaṃ kṛtvā | uta amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiśca pradihya | atha mahāśālvaṇasvedavidhānamāha - grāmyāḥ chāgorabhrādayaḥ, anūpā matsyacakravākādayaḥ | jīvanīyagaṇaścūrṇoktaḥ | sauvīraṃ kāñjikam | kṣārairyavakṣārasvarjīṭaṅkaṇaiḥ | vīratarvādiśca pūrvoktaḥ | atasī prasiddhā, śephālī nirguṇḍī, miśiḥ śatapuṣpā, kuṭheraḥ vāvarī | lavaṇaiḥ saindhavādyaiḥ | pañcabhiramlairdāḍimādyaiḥ | vānarī kapikacchū: | etairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtairānītaiḥ, kṣuṇṇaiḥ kuṭṭitaiḥ, svinnaiḥ sveditaiḥ, punarvastreṇa baddhaiḥ svedayet || || 22-27 || dravasvedavidhi: | dravasvedastu vātaghno dravyakvāthena pūritam || 28 || kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ vā'pi sūpaviṣṭo'vagāhayet | Dī. idānīṃ dravasvedavidhimāha - dravasveda iti | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti pūrvoktatvāt | vātaghnadravyakvātheneti vātaghnadravyaṃ kākolyādigaṇapramukhaṃ tacca pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ | kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ ca | dvividhamiti dravasvedaṃ | vā grahaṇāt carmadroṇīprabhṛtikamapi yathālābhaṃ dravasvedavidhau grāhyam || 28 || Gū. vātaghnaṃ daśamūlādyaṃ dravyam | tatkvāthena pūrite kaṭāhe tāmrādikoṣṭhake vā sūpaviṣṭaḥ sukhena sthitaḥ avagāhayet || 28 || idānīṃ dravasya parimāṇamāha - nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmagnaḥ kvāthasya dhārayā || 29 || koṣṇayā skandhayoḥ siktastiṣṭhet snigdhatanurnaraḥ | evaṃ tailena, dugdhena, sarpiṣā svedayennaram || 30 || Dī. ’nābherityādi | yāvannāmerūrdhvaṃ sūpaviṣṭaḥ puruṣo magno bhavati tāvat kvāthādikaṃ dhārayet yojayedityarthaḥ | ityevaṃ kaṭāhāvagāha iva parimāṇam | koṣṭhe tūtthitaḥ puruṣo yāvat skandhayorupari sikto magnaḥ tāvattiṣṭhedityabhiprāyaḥ | snigdhatanutā sarvasvede'pi boddhavyā evamuktaprakāreṇaiva tailādināpi yathāyogyaṃ svedayedi tyarthaḥ || 29 || 30 || Gū. tasya vidhānamāha - snigdhatanuḥ kṛtatailābhyaṅgaḥ | koṣṇayā dhārayā sthitaḥ skandhayoḥ siktaḥ | kvāthena dhārayā nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmagnastāvattiṣṭhet | evaṃ tailena dugdhena sarpiṣā ghṛtena vā svedayet | ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ || 29 || 30 || avagāhanakālaniyamaḥ | ekāntaro dvyantaro vā snehayukto'vagāhane | Dī. athāvagāhanakālaniyamamāha - athāvagāhane yathādau snehayuktaḥ snehāvagāhastadā ekāntara ekadyantara: dvyantaro dvidināntaro vā kartavya iti vyavasthāviṣayaḥ | na tu sarvāvagāhane niyamanamidaṃ | nanvatra kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ, tantrāntare tu na kṛtaḥ, tathā pūrvamuktaṃ - nābherūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaṃ kvāthatailādidhāraṇam | tantrāntare tu anyathā | vaidyālaṃkāre - ’kaṭāhe mṛṇmaye pātre kiṃvā pāṣāṇasaṃbhave | ākaṇṭhamagno nivaset praharaṃ prātareva vā || romānteṣvanukūpeṣu sthitvā mātrā śatatrayam | tataḥ praviśati snehaiścaturbhirgacchati tvacam | pañcabhiśca bhajedraktaṃ ṣaḍbhirmāṃsaṃ prapadyate | medaḥ - sthānaṃ saptaśatairaṣṭabhiścāsthiṣu vrajet || navabhiryāti majjānaṃ tato mātrāṃ na kārayet | tatastu rogānsaṃgṛhya vātapittakaphodbhavān || srotasāṃ mārdavakaraḥ kaphavātavināśanaḥ | dhātūnāṃ puṣṭijanano balavarṇakaraḥ paraḥ || vātarogānaśeṣāṃśca jayedeṣa viśeṣataḥ’ iti | anyatrāpi kaṇṭhaparyantadhāraṇamuktaṃ yathā - droṇīkāṣṭhasya tailena sukhoṣṇena prapūrayet | tatra sthitvā yathā mātrā kaṇṭhaparyantamāhanum || sukhinaḥ sukumārasya sukhārthī śramapīḍitaḥ | gāhayet ghaṭikāsārdhaṃ tailadroṇyāṃ ca yatnataḥ || tato niḥsṛtya hastābhyāṃ khaṭvāyāṃ carmake punaḥ | sukhena mardanaṃ kṛtvā yāvattailaṃ viśudhyati || udvartanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsnānaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam || tvaci kāntikaraṃ sadyaḥ pāruṣyaṃ na vinaśyati || balapuṣṭikaraṃ sadyo vātarogaṃ ca nāśayet | anye ca tvagbhavā rogā mandānalasamudbhavāḥ || yasya śuṣyati sarvāṅgaṃ gatiryasya tu vihvalā | tasya droṇyāṃ ca taileṣu gāhayedghaṭikātrayam || kṣīṇendriyāḥ kṣīṇaśukrā jvarakṣīṇāśca ye narāḥ | vātārtau vṛṣaṇau yeṣāmantravṛddhiśca dāruṇā || paṅgulaḥ pīṭhasarpī ca gṛdhrasī vātaśūlavān | kalāyakhañjakaṃ tūnīṃ pratūnīṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || etatsarvān nihantyāśu channābhramiva mārutam’ iti | tenātra śārṅgadharoktaṃ kālaniyamavacanaṃ sukumārādiviṣayam | tathā nābherūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulagrahaṇaṃ hṛdayarakṣārthaṃ, tantrāntaroktaṃ dāruṇavātarogagrastaviṣayaṃ | kaṇṭhaparyantāvagāhanaṃ tu sukumārādiviṣayam | ata evoktaṃ carake - ‘padmotpalapalāśairvā svedyaḥ saṃvṛttya cakṣuṣī | muktāvalībhiḥ śuddhābhiḥ śītalairbhojanairapi || jalārdraiḥ sajalairhastaiḥ svidyato hṛdayaṃ spṛśet’ iti | netrahṛdayarakṣārthaviṣayamidaṃ śārṅgadharavacanaṃ jñeyam || Gū. yathāyogyam ekāntare dvyantare vā'vagāho yuktaḥ || avagāhanaphalam - sirāmukhai romakūpairdhamanībhiśca tarpayet || 31 || śarīre balamādhatte yuktaḥ sneho'vagāhane | Dī. atha samyaksnehāvagāhane phalamāha - avagāhane yuktaḥ sneha ekāntarādividhinā samyak prayuktaśīlaḥ | tādṛśa eva śirādistarpayan san śarīre balamādhatte tarpayan dhātūniti śeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ -‘mātrābhistriścatuḥpaccaṣaṭsaptāṣṭabhirāvrajet | rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjādhātūn yathākrama’miti | mātrāyāśca prasaṃgato lakṣaṇaṃ saṃkhyā ca likhyate | yathā – sphajāūnaḥ - karāvartaṃ kuryāttāṃ sphoṭikāyutām | eṣā mātrā bhavedekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ | saṃkhyā yathā - ‘vedanopaśamaḥ pañcaśatasaptaśatāni vā | sahasraṃ vāpi mātrāṇāṃ kuryāddoṣabalābala’mityādi | śirāmukhai romakūpairiti | śirāṇāṃ mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhānīti bhāvaḥ | sirāśca doṣādivahā iti granthakāraḥ sandhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣādhātuvahāḥ śirā iti | tāśca sthūlasūkṣmabhedenāpi dvidhā bhavanti tāsāṃ nābhimūlatvādadhastiryak ca prasaraḥ | tathāhyuktam - ’yāvantyastu sirāḥ kāye saṃbhavanti śarīriṇām | nābhipravṛddhāḥ sarvāstāḥ pratanvanti samantata’ iti | dhamanībhiśceti | dhmānādanilāpūraṇāddhamanyo rasavahāścaturviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | etāścāpi nābhiprabhavā abhihitāḥ | cakārāttāsāmapi mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhāni jñātavyāni | yataḥ ye svedamabhivahanti rasaṃ cābhitarpayantyantarbahiśca | taireva cābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhālepanavīryāṇyantaḥ śarīramabhipratipadyanta iti ||31 || Gū. tasya phalamāha - sirāmukhairlomakūpairlomavivarairdhamanībhirnāḍībhiśca tarpayet | tadā śarīre balam ādhatte || 31 || dhātuvardhanamāha - jalasiktasya vardhante yathāmūle'ṅkurāstaroḥ || 32 || tathā dhātuvivṛddhirhi snehasiktasya jāyate | nātaḥ parataraḥ kaścidupāyo vātanāśanaḥ || 33 || śītaśūlādyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe | dīptāgnau mārdave jāte svedanādviratirmatā || 34 || Dī. atha snehāvagāhanādvāyuvṛddhau satyāṃ taddṛṣṭāntenāsya prādhānyamāha | mūle pānīyasiktasya vṛkṣasya yathāṅkurāḥ pallavādirūpā vardhante tadvadatrāpi dhātuvṛddhau boddhavyaṃ | nātaḥ para iti | asmāt snehāvagāhanāt aparo vātanāśako yogo na pradhāna iti bhāvaḥ | atha svedakarmaṇo virativiṣayamāha - śītaśīlādyuparame iti | śūlaśāntau satyāṃ śūlaśabdena vātādijanito vedanāsamūho boddhavyaḥ | stambho gauravaṃ cāṃgānāṃ tayornirgraho nāśaḥ | tasmiñjāte sati dīptāgnau sati | mārdavamapi aṅgānāṃ mṛdutā tasminnapi jāte sati viratirviśrāmaḥ; tena ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ svedaguṇo'vagantavyaḥ | tathā hyuktam - ’agnau dīpte mārdavaṃ tvakprasādaṃ bhaktaśraddhāṃ srotasāṃ nirmalatvam | kuryātsvedastandranidre ca hanyāt sandhīnbandhāṃśceṣṭayedāśu yukta’ iti | sauṣadhasvedātiyogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ’pittāsrakopatṛṇmūrcchāsvarāṅgasadanabhramāḥ | sandhipīḍājvaraḥ śyāvaraktamaṇḍaladarśanam | svedātiyogācchardiśca tatra stambhanamauṣadham’ iti || 32-34 || Gū. svedanātkadā nivṛttirbhavati ? ityatrāha - śīta iti | śītaśūlādīnāmuparame nivṛtte sati stambhagauravayornigrahe sati, mārdave mṛdutve sati dehasyaiva tadā svedanādviratirnivṛttirmatā || 32-34 || susvinnasya paścāt karma darśayati - samyak svinnaṃ vimṛditaṃ snānamuṣṇāmbubhiḥ śanaiḥ | bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet ||35|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedavidhirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || Dī. vimṛditamiti | snehāvagāhānantaraṃ sukhamardanam, uṣṇāmbubhiruṣṇodakaiḥ snānam, anabhiṣyandi bhojayet | jāṭharāgne: saṃdīpanārthaṃ vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma | kecit - ’vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet’ ityatra - ‘sarvatrācāramācaret’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | tatra ācāraḥ snehācaraṇaṃ, tacca vāgbhaṭe'pyuktam - ‘uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān | pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥsvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 35 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 || Gū. svedānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha - samyak svinnaṃ samyak sveditam | punaḥ vimṛditaṃ kṛtābhyaṅgam | paścācchannairuṣṇāmbunā kuryāditi pūrvakriyāsambandha: | anabhiṣyandi sroto rodhi bhojayet | vyāyāmaṃ śramādyaṃ na kārayet | suśrute caturvidhaḥ navasvedaḥ kathitaḥ | cakārādvāgbhaṭādau trayodaśavidhaḥ | granthajñāpanārthaṃ tadapi likhyate | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ’śaṅkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko'vagāhanam | jetāko'śmaghanaḥ karpū: kuṭī, kumbhī tathāca bhūḥ || kūpo lohākaraścaite svedāścaiva trayodaśa’ iti | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe darśitam || 35 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyaḥ || 2 || Editor's notes 1 śaṃkaraḥ sukhakaraḥ | tasyābhidhānamagre praśastatvāt | eteṣāṃ svedānāṃ vaidyānāṃ vijñānārthaṃ svarūpamuktaṃ carake - ‘ tatra vastrāntaritaiḥ piṇḍairyathoktairupasvedanaṃ śaṅkarasveda’ iti | tasyoṣmasvede'ntarbhāvaḥ | vastrāntaritatvamavastrāntaritatvañca sukumārāsukumāraviṣayaṃ jñeyam | prastaramāha - ‘ śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāṃ , veśavāra-pāyasa-kṛśaro-tkarikādīnāṃ vā prastare kauśeyā-'vikottarapracchade vā, pañcāṅgulorubukādīnāṃ vā , kauśeyāvikottarārkapatrapracchanne vā svabhyaktagātrasya śayānasyopasvedanaṃ prastarasvedanaṃ iti vidyāt ’ | ayaṃ coṣmasveda eva | śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāmiti bhāvaḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ‘ pulākamatrametāvaddravyāṇāmiha ṣaṭśatam | svabuddhyaiva sahasrāṇi koṭīrvā samprakalpayet’ iti | athavā ‘pulāka’ śabdaḥ svinnavacanaḥ , śūkaśimbidhānyānāṃ svinnānāṃ prastare ityarthaḥ | anye tu pulākā gavedhukākārā deśāntare prasiddhāḥ | iti vyākhyānayanti | tadayuktaṃ śūkaśimbidhānyeṣvevāntarbhāvāt | tāsāṃ ca na svedavattāyogyatā pratipattuṃ śakyā , doṣaviśeṣāharaṇāt | kauśeyāvikottarapracchannadeśe-kauśeyāvikābhyāṃ vā upari pracchanne prastare ityarthaḥ | uttaracchadagrahaṇādadhastādapi pracchado'stīti gamyate | iti prastarasvedaḥ ||2|| nāḍīsvedamāha - ‘ svedanadravyāṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ mūlapatraphalabhaṅgādīnāṃ mṛgaśakunipiśitaśirasādīnām uṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ yathā'mlalavaṇaṃ snehopahitānāṃ mūtrādīnāṃ kumbhyāṃ voṣmamanu dhamantyāmutkvathitānāṃ nāḍyā vaṃśadalakarañjārkapatrāṇāmanyatamakṛtayā gajāgrahastasaṃsthānayā vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā vā svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgrapariṇāhasrotasā sarvato vātaharapatrasaṃvṛtacchidrayā dvistrirvā vinamitayā vātaharasnehābhyaktagātrasya voṣmamupāharet , bāṣpo'hyanṛjugāmī vihitacaṇḍavegastvacamavidahan sukhaṃ svedayatīti nāḍīsvedaḥ ’ | bhaṅgāḥ pallavāḥ | svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgra-pariṇāhasrotaseti | vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā ceti | pramāṇaniyame ko hetuḥ ? brūmaḥ – vyādhyāturabalāpekṣayā , uttamabalavyādhāvāture ca vyāyāmadīrghā karttavyā , madhyabalaṃ hi vyādhimāturaṃ cāvekṣyamāṇena vyāyāmādhyardhadīrghayā dūragatvena vihitacaṇḍavegatā bhāvayet iti | iti nāḍīsvedaḥ bāṣpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ ||3|| pariṣekasvedamāha - ‘ vātikottaravātikānāṃ punarmūlaphalādīnāmutkvāthaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ kumbhīrvarṣaṇikāḥ praṇāḍīrvā pūrayitvā yathārthasiddhasnehābhyaktagātravastrāvacchannaṃ pariṣecayet iti pariṣekasvedaḥ’ dravasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | iti pariṣekasvedaḥ ||4|| avagāhasvedamāha - ‘ vātaharotkvāthakṣīraghṛtapiśitarasonasalilakoṣṭakāvagāhastu yathokta evāvagāho jñeyaḥ’ | utkvāthairiti utkṛṣṭakvāthairityarthaḥ | dravyāccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaḥ kṛta utkṛṣṭaḥ kvātho bhavati ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ | ityavagāhasvedaḥ | jetākasvedamāha – atha jetākaṃ cikīrṣurbhūmiṃ parīkṣyeta – tatra pūrvasyāṃ diśi uttarasyāṃ vā guṇavati praśastabhūmibhāge deśe kṛṣmamṛttike suvarṇavarṇamṛttike vā nadīparivāpaḥ vāpīpuṣkariṇyādīnāṃ jalāśayānāmanyatamasya kūle dakṣiṇe paścime vā sutīrthe samavibhaktabhūmibhāgadeśe saptāṣṭau vā'ratnīḥ parikramodakān prāṅmukhodaṅmukhaṃ vā'bhimukhatīrthaṃ vā kūṭāgāraṃ kārayet | utsedhavistārasampannaṃ anekavātāyanamasya kūṭāgārasyāntaḥ samantato'bhivistārotsedhāṃ piḍikāṃ kārayet ākapāṭāt | madhye cāsya kūṭāgārasya catuḥkiṣkumātraṃ dvipuruṣapramāṇaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ kandukasaṃsthānaṃ bahusūkṣmacchidramaṅgārakoṣṭakastambhaṃ sapidhānaṃ kārayet | taṃ ca khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | sa yadā jānīyāt dagdhāni kāṣṭhāni vigatadhūmāni avataptaṃ kevalamagninā tadagnigṛhaṃ svedayogyena yoṣmaṇā yuktamiti | tatra cainaṃ vātaharābhyaṅgābhyaktagātraṃ vastrācchannaṃ praveśayet | praveśayaṃścānuśiṣyet - ‘ saumya ! praviśārogyakalyāṇāya vā ’ iti praviśya caināṃ piṇḍikāmadhiruhya pārśvābhyāṃ yathāsukhaṃ śayīthāḥ | na ca te svedamūrchāparītenā'pi satā piṇḍikaiṣā prayoktavyā āprāṇocchvāsāt | bhraśyamāno hi yataḥ piṇḍikāvaśāt dvāramavadhiṃ gacchan svedamūrchāparītatayā sadyaḥ prāṇān jahyāt , tasmāt piṇḍikāṃ na kathañcana muñcethāḥ | sa yadā jānīyādvigatābhiṣyandamātmānaṃ samyak prastutasvedapicchaṃ sarvasrotovinirmuktaṃ laghubhūtamapagataṃ vibandhastambhagauravasuptivedanamiti | tatastāṃ piṭikāmanusaran dvāraṃ prapadyeta niṣkramya ca na sahasā cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthaṃ śītodakamanupraviśet | vyapagatasaṃtāpaklamaḥ sumuhūrtāt sukhoṣṇena vāriṇā yathānyāyaṃ pariṣikto'śnīyāt ’ iti jetākaḥ | ayaṃ cāgārakoṣṭastambho jetāka ucyate ‘bhūgṛheṣu sa jetākeṣu ’ iti vacanāt | taṃ khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | iti jetākasvedaḥ sa ūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti jetākasvedaḥ ||6|| athāśmaghanasvedamāha - ‘ śayanasya pramāṇenā'śmamayīṃ śilāṃ tāpayitvā'nilaghnaistu dārubhiḥ sampradīpitaiḥ vyapohya sarvānaṅgārān prokṣya coṣṇavāriṇā śilāmatha kurvīta kauśeyā'vikasaṃstarām , kauśeyaprāvārādyaiḥ susaṃvṛttaḥ ityukto'śmaghanasvedaḥ ’ iti || ghanāṃ sthūlāṃ | nanu śilā yā sā'śmamayyeva punaraśmamayīmiti viśeṣaṇamanarthakam ? ucyate – sannahyārthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitāni tenāśmaśabdaḥ kāṭhinye vartate iti | kaucavo mṛgaromamayīralikā, ajinaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgacarma, kauśeyaṃ traśaraṃ prāvāraḥ paṭṭikā ādigrahaṇātkambalorṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | iti aśmaghanasvedaḥ, tāpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | ityaśmaghanasvedaḥ ||7|| atha karpūsvedaḥ pracakṣyate - ‘ khānayecchayanasyādhaḥ karpūsthānavibhāgavit | dīptairvidhūmairaṅgāraistāṃ karpūṃ pūrayennaraḥ | tatropariṣṭācchayane svapan svidyati nā sukham ’ iti karpūsveda ūṣmasvedabhedaḥ | iti karpūsvedaḥ ||8|| atha kuṭīsvedamāha - ‘ anatyutsedhavistarāṃ vṛttākārāmalocanām | ghanamitiṃ kuṭiṃ kṛtvā kuṣṭhādyaiḥ sampralepayet | kuṭīmadhye bhiṣak śayyāṃ svāstīrṇāṃ copakalpayet | prāvārājinakauśeyakuthakambalagauṇakaiḥ | hasantikābhiraṅgārapūrṇābhistāṃ ca sarvataḥ | āroheta parīvāryābhyaktaḥ svidyati nā sukham ’ iti || parivārya pariveṣṭya | iti kuṭīsvede svedabhedaḥ | iti kuṭīsvedaḥ ||9|| bhūsvedamāha - ‘ya evāśmaghanasvede vidhirbhūmau sa eva tu | praśastāyāṃ nivātāyāṃ samāyāmupadiśyate’ iti | ayamapyuṣṇasvedabhedaḥ | iti bhūsvedaḥ ||10|| atha kumbhīsvedamāha – kumbhīṃ vātaharakvāthapūrṇāṃ bhūmau nikhānayet | ardhamātraṃ tribhāgaṃ vā śayanaṃ tatra copari || sthāpayedāsanaṃ vā'pi nātisāndraparicchadam | atha kuṃbhyāṃ bhiṣak dadyātsutaptānāyaso guḍān || pāṣāṇān voṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati nā sukham | suvṛttāṅgaḥ svabhyaktaḥ snehairanilanāśanaiḥ || athavāpyūṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati pūrvavat ’ iti | ayamapyūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti kumbhīsvedaḥ | kūpasvedamāha - ‘ kūpaṃ śayanavistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ vāpi vaidyataḥ | deśe nivāte śakte ca sumṛṣṭaṃ kārayettataḥ || hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ karīṣairdagdhapūritam ’ iti kūpasvedaḥ | ayaṃ coṣmasvedabheda eva kūpasvedaḥ ||12|| atha holākasvedamāha - ‘vītikāṃ tu karīṣāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ pradīpayet | śayanāntaḥ pramāṇena śayyāmupari tatra ca | sudagdhāyāṃ vidhūmāyāṃ yathoktāmupakalpayet | svavacchannāṃ svayaṃ tasyāṃ svoktaḥ svidyati mānavaḥ || holākasveda ityeṣa sukhaḥ prokto maharṣiṇā’ iti | vītikā kumārikā holāsañjñitaḥ svedaḥ holāsvedaḥ | iti holāsvedaḥ | iti carakoktāstrayodaśasvedāste caturṣu svedādiṣvantarbhūtāḥ | ’rū. ↩ 2 ’traya’ iti padaṃ plīhādīnāṃ labdhe tritve tridoṣajanyatvaparaṃ jñeyam | arśasa iti arśorogī ’arśa āditvādac’ ↩ 3 nanu hṛdayadṛṣṭayoḥ prāk rakṣaṇamuktaṃ, iha tu mṛdusve- do'bhihita iti viruddham? maivam, carake tūttaratantre śūlādau svedo vihitaḥ sa tu saṃmilitākṣairbāhye kriyate, na dṛṣṭau | carake'pyayameva pāṭho likhitaḥ | tadagre ca madhyamaṃ akṣṇau śeṣamaṅgāvayavamiṣṭataḥ svedayet | ru. ↩ 4 carake tu - ’kaṣāyamadyanityānāṃ garbhiṇyā raktapittinām| pittināṃ sātisārāṇāṃ rūkṣāṇāṃ madhumehināṃ | vida-gdhabhraṣṭabadhnānāṃ viṣamadyavikāriṇām | santāpānnaṣṭasaṃjñānāṃ sthūlānāṃ pittamehinām | tṛṣyatāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ ca kruddhānāṃ śocatāmapi | kāmalyudariṇāṃ caiva kṣatānāmāḍhyarogiṇāṃ | durvalātiviśuṣkāṇāmupakṣīṇaujasāṃ tathā | bhiṣakutaimirikāṇāṃ ca na svedamavatārayet’ iti | atra ’kaṣāya’śabdena kaṣāyamadyaṃ kaṣāyadravyakṛtamathavā kaṣāyaṃ madhu grāhyam | tasya ca kaṣāyavarge madhuravarge ca pāṭhāt | tasya ca svedāyogyatvāt | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’pītadugdhadadhisnehamadhūnī’tyādi | etānityādi etānajīrṇyādīn svedasādhyān ātyayike rogotpattau mṛdu svedayet | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’mṛdu vātyāyike gade’ iti| | ↩ 5 nanu snigdhasyaiva svedādhikārātpunaḥ snigdhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? ucyate - punargrahaṇaṃ tatsamayasnigdhatādyotanārtham | ru. ↩

title: 3. atha vamanavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: athedānīṃ kṛtasnehasvedasya śodhanādhikāraḥ | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhā'sthisaṃsthāḥ | doṣāḥ svedaiste dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyak śuddhibhirnirhriyante’ iti | atra śuddhibhiriti bahuvacanagrahaṇātpañcakarmaṇāṃ grahaṇam | tenā'trādau sthānānurodhātprāk vacanaṃ paścādvirecanādīti | ata evāha - vamanapradhāno vidhiḥ vamanavidhiḥ śodhanaprakāraḥ | ata evāha - śaratkāle vasante ca prāvṛṭkāle ca dehinām | vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva kārayetkuśalo bhiṣak || 1 || Dī. ūrdhvabhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ vamanam, adhobhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ virecanam | cakārādvastinasyādayaḥ | vamanādīnāṃ kālamāha - śaratkāle ityādi | śaratkālādiśabdaistatsamīpasādhāraṇakāla upalakṣyate | uktaṃca - ’śrāvaṇe kārtike caiva māsi sādhāraṇe kramāt | grīṣmavarṣāhimacitān vāyvādīnāśu nirharet’ iti | kuśalo bhiṣagiti | doṣadeśakālasātmyaprakṛtivayovahridhātumalaviśeṣajñāne śodhane ca kuśala: iti || 1 || Gū. svedānantaraṃ vamanasyoktatvādvamanamāha - tatrādau vamanakālamāha - śaraditi | śaratkāle vasante prāvṛṭkāle eṣu triṣveva ca dehināṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vamanaṃ recanaṃ ca kārayet | yaḥ kuśalo bhiṣak pravīṇavaidyaḥ sañcayaṃ jñātvā vamanonmukhaṃ doṣaṃ jñātvā, anyathā svasthaviṣaye doṣadarśanāt | tathācoktaṃ granthāntare - ’bhiṣajaḥ śodhanaṃ prāhurvarjyaḥ svasthena sarvadā | pannagasya vadhovaṃkṣṇe doṣasya samudīraṇam’ iti | nanu śaratkāle pittasyā'pi vamanaṃ yuktaṃ vasante kaphasyā'pi vamanaṃ recanaṃ yuktam | dvayoḥ prāvṛṭkāle vā hetutvātkathaṃ vamanaṃ recanaṃ dīyate tatra vātādhikyaṃ kathaṃ syāt ? ucyate - varṣākāle niṣedho, na prāvṛṭkāle | tathācoktam agniveśena - ‘ativiṣṭenātigharme prāvṛḍityabhidhīyate | tatraiva śodhanaṃ pathyaṃ varṣāsu kadācana’ iti | śodhanena sarvadoṣanāśo bhavatītyeke | tathācoktaṃ tīsaṭe - ’prāvṛṭghanātyayavasantadineṣu yasmāt prādurbhavanti pavanādirujastataśca | vātādidoṣavigamācca śarīraśuddhiḥ’ iti | ambudāgamaśaranmadhuvāsareṣu agniveśena triṣveva ca śodhanaṃ nānyeṣu | tathācoktaṃ - ’triṣu tvanuśītatvātpreṣṭhaṃ śeṣeṣu śodhanam | hitaṃ bhavati yasmācca tatra hetuṃ nibodha me’ iti || 1 || vāmyāḥ - balavantaṃ kaphavyāptaṃ hṛllāsādinipīḍitam | tathā vamanasātmyaṃ ca dhīracittaṃ ca vāmayet ||2|| Dī. saṃprativamanārhatvamāha - balavantamiti vamanasāmarthyayuktaṃ | kaphavyāptamiti kapholbaṇagadāvyāptahṛllāsaḥ uparisthitivamanatā tadādirogapīḍitamityarthaḥ | ādiśabdāt kāsaśvāsātmapitta prabhṛtayaḥ | vamanasātmyamiti | vamanaṃ sātmyaṃ yasya tattathā te | puruṣamiti śeṣaḥ | dhīracittaṃ na kātaramityaryaḥ || 2 || Gū. yeṣu vamanaṃ deyaṃ tānāha - hṛllāso hṛdayanirgamaḥ | upasthitavamanamityanye | vamanasātmyaṃ vamanasahajam || 2 || vamanārhā rogāḥ - vamanārhā rogāḥ - viṣadoṣe stanyadoṣe mando'gnau śrlīpade'rbude | hṛdroga-kuṣṭha-vīsarpa-mehā-jīrṇa-bhrameṣu ca || 3 || vidārikā-pacī-kāsa-śvāsa-pīnasa-vṛddhiṣu | apasmāre jvaronmāde tathā raktātisāriṣu ||4 || nāsā-tālvoṣṭha-pākeṣu karṇasrāve dvijihvake | galaśuṇḍyāmatīsāre pittaśleṣmagade tathā || 5 || medogade'rucau caiva vamanaṃ kārayet bhiṣak | Dī. atha ye rogā vāmyāstānāha - viṣa iti | nanu apasmārādīnāmanilapradhānatvātkathamatra vamanaṃ yuktam ? ucyate, pāṇḍurogī kṛmivyāpta iti vakṣyamāṇavyāptaśabdena pravṛddhapāṇḍuroge niṣiddhopakrame kaphāvasthāyāṃ ca mṛdu jñeyaṃ | yaduktaṃ ‘pāṇḍuroge bhiṣak kuryādūrdhvādhaḥśodhanaṃ sadā’ iti | atra ūrṣvaśodhanaṃ vamanādikam | adhaḥ śodhanaṃ virecanaṃ | virecanaṃ cātra tīkṣṇameva, ‘vātasya tīkṣṇānyanulomanānī’ti vacanāt || 3-5 || Gū. stanyadoṣe mātṛdugdhodbhave | vidārī rogaviśeṣaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 3-5 || athāvāmyānāha - na vāmanīyastimirī na gulmī nodarī kṛśaḥ || 6 || nātivṛddho garbhiṇīṃ ca na sthūlo na kṣudhāturaḥ | madārto bālako rūkṣaḥ śudhitaśca nirūhitaḥ || 7 || udāvartyūrdhvaraktī ca duśchardī kevalānilī | pāṇḍarogī kṛmivyāptaḥ paṭhanātsvaraghātakaḥ || 8 || Dī. timiraprabhṛtibhirvyādhibhirvyāptāḥ puruṣā na vāmanīyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ -‘avamyavamanādrogāḥ kṛcchratāṃ yānti dehinaḥ | asādhyatāṃ vā gacchanti naite vāmyā hyatiśrutā’ iti | duśchardirityanena yatsāmānyaṃ tathāpi bahudoṣānvitaśchardyāṃ vamanaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ suśrute -‘chardiṣu bahudoṣāsu vamanaṃ hitamucyate’ iti || 6-8 || Gū. yeṣāṃ vamanaṃ na deyaṃ tānāha - ete timiryādayaḥ na vāmanīyāḥ || 6-8 || atha yadyapyete'pyajīrṇādivyāpitāstadā vāmanīyā iti vicāryāha - ete'pyajīrṇavyathitā vāmyā ye viṣapīḍitāḥ | kaphavyāptāśca te vāmyā madhukvāthasya pānataḥ || 9 || sukumāraṃ kṛśaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhīruṃ ca vāmayet | pīttvā yavāgūmākaṇṭhaṃ kṣīratakradadhīni vā || 10 || asātmyaiḥ śleṣmalairbhojyairdoṣānutkliśya dehinaḥ | snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate ||11 || Dī. ete pūrvoktāstimiryādayaḥ te yadā ajīrṇavyathitā upaviṣapīḍitāḥ kaphavyāptā vā bhavanti tadā vāmyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | kaphavyāptā iti niyatam | tathāhi - ‘kaphaje vamanaṃ śastaṃ recanaṃ pittaje gade | bastirvātagate kāye āmaye tvāmapācana’miti | kena vāmyāstamāha - madhukvāthasya pānata iti | madhukvātho madhuyaṣṭīkvāthaḥ | yadvā madhu kṣaudraṃ | kvāthaṃ kvathitaṃ jalaṃ | anyadvihitadravyaśṛtaṃ vā prakaraṇatvāt | kaṣāyaścātra sarvaḥ koṣṇaḥ kārya iti carakavacanāt | uṣṇavirodhitvena madhūṣṇaṃ niṣiddhamiti vivakṣāyāṃ na cātra madhūṣṇaṃ viruddhaṃ | yaduktaṃ - ‘pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivārayet | alaghvapākamāśveva tayostasmānnivartate’ iti | ata eva yātyadhodoṣamādāya pacyamānaṃ virecanaṃ | guṇotkarṣaṇātdūrdhvamapakvaṃ vamanaṃ punariti | yadā'jīrṇādipīḍitatimirādayo'pi sukumārādiṣu bhavanti tadā vakṣyamāṇaprayogenaiva vāmyā ityata āha - vamanasādhyavikārapīḍitāḥ sukumārādayo'pi yavāgvādīnāmanyatamenākaṇṭhaṃ pāyayitvā vāmayedityarthaḥ | yavāgvapyanena kaphakaratvāt kaphotkleśanārthamityabhiprāyaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘pāṃśudhānye yathā vṛṣṭiḥ kledayatyatikardamam | tathā śleṣmaṇi saṃvṛddhe yavāgū śleṣmavardhanī’ti | ityabhiprāyaviṣayaṃ vakṣyamāṇenaiva caritārthatvāt | kṣīratakradadhi yathādoṣāpekṣayā vyastaṃ deyaṃ | pūrvamuktaṃ vakṣyamāṇenaiva caritārthatvāttānāha - ‘asātmyaiḥ śleṣmalairbhojyairdoṣānukteśca dehinaḥ | snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate | snigdhasvinnāyeti snehapānapūrvakāya khedapūrvakāya puruṣāyetyarthaḥ | na tu snehasvedāyeti, yataḥ snehapānādekāhamuparatamaparādinā etatsvinnamiti prasiddhiḥ | bhālukinā snehapānāt tryahena vamanaṃ darśitaṃ | tadyathā ‘snigdhasvinnaśarīrasya dadyātpracchardanaṃ tryahāt | daśarātre gate vānte bhūyo dadyādvirecana’miti || 9-11 || Gū. eteṣvapi ajīrṇavyathitā vāmyāḥ, kaphavyāptāśca vāmyāḥ | madhūko guḍapuṣpaḥ tatkvāthapānataḥ | kṛśabālavṛddhānāmapi punaruktiviśeṣaniṣedhārthaḥ | vamanādau yadvihitaṃ tadāha - ‘naraḥ śvo vamanaṃ pātā bhuñjīta kaphavardhanam | sujaraṃ dravabhūyiṣṭhaṃ laghu śītaṃ virecanam ||’ iti | yavāgūm ākaṇṭhaṃ pītvā asātmyaiḥ arucyaiḥ śleṣmavardhakai: bhojyairvā doṣānutkleśya dehinaḥ puruṣasya snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate | snigdhāya kṛtaghṛtapānāya sveditāya | nanu snehapānātsvedātkadā vamanaṃ deyam ? tadāha granthāntarāt - atra nāsti | tathāca bheḍaḥ ‘ekāhaṃ parataḥ snehāt sthitvā pracchardanaṃ pibet | bhuktvā grāmyodakairmāṃsairanūpaiśca susaṃskṛtaiḥ | trirātrāt paratastadvat svedātprakledanaṃ pibet iti || 9-11 || ?madhusaindhavayoḥ prādhānyam - vamaneṣu ca sarveṣu saindhavaṃ madhu vā hitam | Dī. atha vamanadravyeṣu madhusaindhavayorviśeṣeṇaivopādeyatvamāha | madhusaindhavayorabhimantraṇaṃ ca sarvatraiva jñeyaṃ | yaduttaṃ ‘yathāvyādhi ca vihitaṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutaṃ | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajyamātrāṃ maṃtrābhimantritā’mityādi | atroṣṇe'pi kaṣāye madhusaindhave na viruddhe | namanasyāpakvasyaivordhvagamanatvāt | vaidyāstvatra yoge pākasaṃbhavaṃ manyamānā madhu na prakṣipante iti kecit | mantraśca ‘brahmadakṣāśvirudrendre’tyādiśloko jñeyaḥ | Gū. carakāt vamaneṣu yaddhitaṃ tadāha - vamaneṣu vamanadravyeṣu sarveṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu saindhavaṃ madhu vā hitam || vamanārhaṃ dravyam - bībhatsaṃ vamanaṃ dadyāt viparītaṃ virecanam || 12 || Dī. kīdṛśaṃ vamanārhaṃ dravyaṃ deyaṃ tadāha - bībhatsavikṛtarasavarṇaprāyaṃ vamanaṃ vamanadravyamityarthaḥ | tena lālādullāsakaradravyamityabhiprāyaḥ | viparītaṃ virecanamiti viparītaṃ bībhatsadravyāt | tena bhakṣaṇe manojñamavikṛtamityarthaḥ || 12 || Gū. vamanaṃ bībhatsaṃ saghṛṇaṃ, virecanaṃ ghṛṇādirahitam || 12 || kvāthyakvāthayormānam - kvāthyadravyasya kuḍavaṃ śrapayitvā jalāḍhake | ardhabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca vamaneṣvavacārayet || 13 || Dī. idānīṃ kvāthyakvāthayormānamāha - kvāthyadravyaṃ paṭolavāsānimbaprabhṛtikaṃ, teṣu kuḍavamitaṃ catuḥpalapramāṇaṃ | jalāḍhaka iti catuḥṣaṣṭipalamite pānīye ardhabhāgāvaśiṣṭamiti prasthadvayamitaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ parimāṇo'pyaikadaiva pānāśaktatvādvibhajya deyaḥ | kvāthabahutve tu sajalaguṇo yadyayogaḥ syāttadā sa eva punaḥ peya iti vyavahārādayamevāvagantavyaḥ | kaṣāyamapi pūrṇaśarāvaṃ pāpayedityuktaṃ tathehā'pi kaṣāyapānavyavastheti kecit || 13 || Gū. vamane kvāthyadravyaparimāṇamāha - kuḍavaṃ catuḥpalam | kvāthyadravyasya jalādeḥ catuḥprasthake śrapayitvā ardhaṃ śritaṃ vamaneṣvavacārayet || 13 || bheḍamatena vamane kvāthapānamātrā - kvāthapāne navaprasthā jyeṣṭhā mātrā prakīrtitā | madhyamā ṣaṇmitā proktā triprasthā ca kanīyasī ||14|| Dī. atha kvāthyakvāthādīnāṃ pāne'tra mānamāha - ṣaṇmiteti | ṣaṭprasthā kanīyasī laghvī | etatparimāṇaṃ paścājjalapānasyāhuḥ | anyathā pūrvāparayoravyavasthā syāt | yadvā pūrvaparimāṇaṃ tu yavāgvādīnāṃ pācanārthamabhihitaṃ | paścāt kvāthapānasyetyarthaḥ | tatra yavāgvā dyupakalpayediti pāṭhāntare vṛndoktamātrayā vyavahāraḥ iti cakra: | carake tu ‘madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu khalu sarvasaṃśodhanamātrāpramāṇāni pratipuruṣamavekṣitavyāni bhavanti | yāvaddhi yasya saṃśodhanaṃ pītaṃ vaikārikadoṣaharaṇāyopapadyate | na cātiyogāya tāvadasya mātrāpramāṇaṃ veditavyam’ iti (ca.sū015|12) | tatra vāgbhaṭena koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajyamātrāmityādivacanenaiva darśitaṃ koṣṭhaśca pratipuruṣaṃ bhinna eva | dṛḍhabalena śarāvamātrā coktā | ekavāraṃ pānārthaṃ jalāḍhakāviśiṣṭaṃ praśastaṃ ca | dvitrivāraṃ pānamityeke | śarāvasya pūrṇatvābhidhānaṃ maṅgalamiti jaijjaṭacakrau iti || 14 || Gū. kvāthapāne navaprasthā jyeṣṭhā mātrā madhyamā ṣaṭprasthā triprasthā kanīyasī idaṃ kvāthapānapramāṇam | nanu śārṅgadhareṇa kuḍavadravye āḍhakaṃ jalaṃ datvā ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvāthaṃ vamane deyamityuktaṃ punaḥ kvāthasya navaprasthapramāṇā jyeṣṭhā mātrā likhitā tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ ? ucyate, etatpramāṇe śārṅgadhareṇa bheḍamataṃ likhitaṃ tadā - kaṇṭhapānārthaṃ viṣādau jñeyam | mahākāyaviṣayaṃ vā | tathāca bheḍaḥ ‘navaprasthā tu jyeṣṭhā syānmadhyamā ṣaṭprakīrtitā | niḥkvāthasya traya: prasthā māgadhī tu kanīyasī’ | carake tvevaṃ likhitaṃ ‘madhumadhukasaindhavaphāṇitopahatāṃ madanakalkakaṣāyamātrāṃ pāyayet | madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāpramāṇaṃ tu sarvasaṃśodhanamātrāpramāṇāni ca pratipuruṣāpekṣitavyāni bhavanti yāvadviṣasya śodhanaṃ pītaṃ vaikārikadoṣaharaṇāyopapadyate bhavati na cātiyogāsya tāvadasya mātrā pramāṇaṃ veditavyam’ || 14 || kalkādimānam - kalkacūrṇāvalehānāṃ viphalaṃ śreṣṭhamātrayā | madhyamāṃ dvipalāṃ vidyātkanīyā palasaṃmitā ||15|| Dī. aparamapi dravyaviśeṣeṣu mānaviśeṣamāha - iyaṃ tu doṣavyādhīnavekṣya prayoktavyā | kalkaṃ dṛṣadi peṣitam | cūrṇaṃ vastragālitam | avaleho lehyadravyam||15|| Gū. vamane kvāthaparimāṇamuktvā kalkādīnāṃ parimāṇamāha - spaṣṭam || 15 || vamanavegāḥ - vamane cā'pi vegāḥ syuraṣṭau pittāntamuttamāḥ | ṣaḍvegā madhyamā vegāścatvārastvavare smṛtāḥ ||16|| Dī. atha vamanasaṃkhyāmāha - vamane tu madhyamottamāvaravegānāṃ ṣaḍaṣṭau catvāro vihitāḥ | iyameva doṣādivyavasthā kalpitā | aṣṭau vegā iti aṣṭavāraṃ yadvāmayedityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ ṣaṭcatvāro'vagantavyāḥ | pittānte iti kaphe | athavā pittāntaṃ yāvat ityanena suvāntalakṣaṇaṃ pratipāditameva | yaduktaṃ - ‘pitte kaphasyānumukhaṃ pravṛtte śuddheṣu hṛtkaṇṭhaśiraḥsu cāpi | laghau ca dehe kaphasaṃsrave ca sthite suvātaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasye’diti || 16 || Gū. vamane uttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhavegaparimāṇamāha - vamana iti | anyat sugamam || 16 || prasthamānam | vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe | sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prasthamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 17 || Dī. athedānīṃ vegānāṃ parimāṇamāha - ardhamityanena dviguṇitaṃ jñeyo'yamiti dviguṇitaṃ tathāhi - ‘jaghanyamadhyaprabaleṣu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke svasthastathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ce’ti || 17 || Gū. ardhenādhikena vartamānaṃ trayodaśapalamityucyate || 17 || atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviśeṣamāha -
