kaphaṃ kaṭukatīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pittaṃ svāduhimairjayet | susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā kapham ||18|| kṛṣṇā rāṭhaphalaṃ sindhu kaphe koṣṇajalaiḥ pibet | paṭolavāsānimbaiśca pitte śītajalaṃ pibet || 19 || saśleṣmavātapīḍāyāṃ sakṣīraṃ madanaṃ pibet | ajīrṇe koṣṇapānīyaiḥ sindhu pītvā vametsudhīḥ ||20|| Dī. kaṭukaṃ maricādi | tīkṣṇaṃ rājikādi | uṣṇamagnisaṃtaptamityarthaḥ | uṣṇavīryaprāyaṃ dravyaṃ vā | svāduhimairiti | svādu madhurarasāyikaṃ dravyaṃ, himaṃ śītasparśaṃ śītavīryaṃ vā | susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇairiti | madhurarasasahitābhyāmamlalavaṇarasābhyāmityarthaḥ | uṣṇamapyatra sparśāt | saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā kaphamiti | ata eva kevalānilaṃ vamane niṣiddham iti pūrvaṃ darśitameva | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘kaphe tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭukaiḥ pitte svāduhimairapi | vametsnigdhāmlalavaṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mārutā kaphe’ iti || yadetaddoṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviṣayamuktaṃ tadarthaṃ yogasaṃdhānamāha - kṛṣṇā, rāṭhaphalaṃ madanaphalaṃ, siṃdhu saindhavam, etacca kalkīkṛtam uṣṇapānīyenāloḍya pītvā vamedityarthaḥ | kṛṣṇādīnāṃ militvā karṣa iti kecit | vyavahārācca kṛṣṇādīnāṃ pṛthakkarṣamātraṃ deyamiti saṃpradāyaḥ | paṭolavāsanimbaiśceti | paṭolādibhiḥ kṛtvā śītaḥ kāryaḥ | paṭoladīnāṃ militvā palaṃ, pākārthaṃ jalāḍhakaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ sakṣīramadanaṃ pibediti | kṣīreṇa madanaphalaṃ kalkīkṛtya tenaiva sahāloḍya pibet ityabhiprāyaḥ | madanaphalakalkasya karṣaḥ prakṣepeṇa pracāraḥ | ajīrṇetyādi | atra saindhavaprakṣepamāhuḥ || 18-20 || Gū. vamanādau nādhikakaṭukādibhirdravyaiḥ kaphādikaṃ jayedityāha - kaṭutīkṣṇena vamanadravyeṇa kaphaṃ jayet | svādurmadhuraḥ | himaṃ śītalam | tathā madhuraiḥ pittaṃ jayet| susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ militaṃ vāyunā kaphaṃ jayet | vamanāyāha - kṛṣṇā-pippalī, rāṭhaphalairmadana-phalaiḥ, sindhu saindhavam | kaphavamanāya etān koṣṇajalaiḥ pibet | paṭolaṃ paṭolapatram, vāsānimbau prasiddhau | etān pitte śītajalaiḥ pibet | saśleṣmavātapīḍāyāṃ sakṣīraṃ sadugdhaṃ madanaphalaṃ pibet | kvāthakalkādīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ pūrvoktameva || 18-20 || uttamaśuddhiparyantaṃ vamanasūcanārthaṃ vamanavidhimāha - vamanaṃ pāyayitvā ca jānumātrāsane sthitam | kaṇṭhameraṇḍanālena spṛśantaṃ vāmayedbhiṣak || 21 || lalāṭaṃ vamataḥ puṃsaḥ pārśve dve ca pradāpayet | Dī. vamanaṃ vamanakvāthaṃ pāyayitvā bhiṣak vāmayet | kaṃ | jānumātre āsane sthitaṃ rogiṇam | kiṃbhūtam eraṇḍanālena kaṇṭhaṃ spṛśantaṃ, tasya vamataḥ lalāṭaṃ dve pārśve dhārayet | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pīte muhūrtamanupālayet | tanmanā jātahṛllāsaprasekaḥ chardayettataḥ | aṅgulibhyāmanāgrasto nālena mṛdunā'thavā | galatālvarujatvena nāpravṛttān pravartayan | pravartayan pravṛttāṃśca jānubhyāmāsane sthitaḥ | ubhe pārśve lalāṭaṃ ca vamataścāsya dhārayet’ iti || 21 || Gū. vamanakaraṇe vidhānamāha - spaṣṭam || 21 || durvāntalakṣaṇamāha - praseko hadgrahaḥ koṭha: kaṇḍūrduśchardite bhavet ||22|| Dī. atha durvānte lakṣaṇamāha – duśchardite durvānte puruṣe kiñcidvānte ityabhiprāyaḥ | praseko mukhasya kaphastrāva ityarthaḥ | hṛdgraho hṛdayāviśuddhiḥ | hṛdroga ityapare | koṭhaḥ kṣudraroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā ‘varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmān lohitāmrakaphapittān | kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñai’riti | duścharditā ca vāntividhāraṇādeva proktā | tasmādapi koṭhādayaḥ saṃbhavanti | tathāhi - ‘visarpakoṭhakuṣṭhākṣikaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayajvarāḥ | sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsavyaṅgaśca śvayathurvame’riti | vameriti vāntividhāraṇādityarthaḥ | asyānte taccikitsārthaṃ sārdhaṃ ślokaṃ kecitpaṭhanti | tadyathā - ‘gaṇḍūṣadhūmānāhārān rūkṣaṃ bhuktvā tadudvamaḥ | vyāyāmaṃ śrutirasrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanaṃ | sakṣāralavaṇaṃ tailamabhyaṅgārthe ca śasyata’ iti prakṣepakamanyamānairasmābhirapi na likhitaṃ, yato bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate || 22 || Gū. vikriyāprāptachardilakṣaṇamāha - praseko mukhaśaraṇam | hṛdgrahaḥ pīḍā, koṭho varaṭīdaṣṭavanmaṇḍalotpattiḥ, kaṇḍūḥ kaṇḍūti: , duśchardita etallakṣaṇam || 22 || ativānterlakṣaṇamāha - ativānte bhavet tṛṣṇā hikkodgārau visaṃjñitā | jihvāniḥsarpaṇaṃ cākṣṇorvyāvṛttirhanusaṃhatiḥ || 23 || raktacchardiḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ ca kaṇṭhapīḍā ca jāyate | Dī. idānīṃ ativānterlakṣaṇānyāha - visaṃjñitā mūrcchābhedaḥ, jihvāniḥsarpaṇaṃ ca bhavati | jihvāyāḥ niḥsarpaṇamatra dvividhaṃ ekamantaḥpraviṣṭarūpam aparaṃ bahirnirgamanaviṣayaṃ akṣyorvyāvṛttirnetrayoḥ parivartanaṃ | athavā vyāvṛttirityākuñcanaṃ | hanusaṃhatiriti cibukacalanādirāhityaṃ | ṣṭhīvantaṃ raktasyetyasakṛcca || 23 || Gū. ativānteḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha - visaṃjñitā saṃjñānāśaḥ, jihvāniḥsaṃraṇam, akṣṇorvyāvṛttiḥ, niḥsaraṇameva bhrāntirvā, hanusaṃhatiḥ stabdhatā pīḍā vā, raktacchardi: raktodgiraṇam | kaphena niḥsaraṇam | kaṇṭhe ca pīḍā vyathā || 23 || vamanotpannarogacikitsāmāha - vamanasyātiyoge tu mṛdu kuryādvirecanam || 24 || vamanāntaḥ praviṣṭāvāṃ jihvāyāṃ kavalagrahaḥ | snigdhāmlalavaṇairhṛdyairghṛtakṣīrarasairhitaḥ || 25 || phalānyamlāni khādeyustasya cānye'grato narā:| ni:sṛtāṃ tu tiladrākṣākalkaṃ liptvā praveśayet ||26|| vyāvṛtte'kṣṇi ghṛtābhyakte pīḍayecca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | hanumokṣe smṛtaḥ svedo nasyaṃ ca śleṣmavātahṛt ||27|| raktapittavidhānena raktacchardimupācaret | dhātrīrasāñjanośīralājācandanavāribhiḥ || 28 || manthaṃ kṛtvā pāyayecca saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram | śāmyantyanena tṛṣṇādyā pīḍāśchardisamudbhavāḥ ||29|| Dī. atha vamanātiśayotpannānāṃ rogāṇāṃ cikitsāmāha - snigdhāmlalavaṇairhṛdyairghṛtamanatiśīlanena prabhavā tṛṣṇādirogā ebhirvihiprayogaiḥ śāmyantītyabhiprāyaḥ | kathaṃ yathetyāha - yadā vamanātiyogo bhavati tadā mṛduvirecanaṃ dadyāt | mṛduvirecanaṃ mastukṣīrādinā | aparamapi dvividhaprakāraniḥsarpitajihvāyā yogacatuṣṭayamuktaṃ tadvyākhyānamāha - vamanāntaḥpraviṣṭāyāmityādi | antaḥpraviṣṭāyāmiti saṃkucitāyām, atra kavalagrahāḥ snigdhādyaiḥ kalpitāḥ hitāḥ pathyā ityarthaḥ | snigdhaṃ tailādi, amlo amlikā mātuluṅgādiḥ, lavaṇaḥ saindhavādiḥ | eteṣāṃ madhye hṛdyairmanohlādakarairityarthaḥ | ghṛtakṣīrasamairiti | ghṛtakṣīramilitairityarthaḥ | nanu snehagrahaṇenaiva ghṛtagrahaṇaprāptireva tatkathaṃ punarghṛtagrahaṇam ? ucyate, snigdhaśabdetyukte punarghṛtopādānaṃ snehakriyātiśayadyotanārtham | aparamapyupāyamāha - phalānītyādi | amlānīti jambīranimbukaprabhṛtīni tasyāgrata iti | tasya jihvārtasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | purato'grataḥ sthitveti śeṣaḥ | anyanarā iti anyapuruṣāḥ | anena jihvā calitā bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | etaccāntaḥpraviṣṭāyāṃ bahirniḥsṛtāyāṃ ca jihvāyāṃ boddhavyam | atha ni:sṛtāyāḥ pṛthagyogadvayamāha - niḥsṛtāmityādi | niḥsṛtāṃ bahirnirgatāṃ jihvāmiti śeṣaḥ | tiladrākṣākalkamatra sāmyena kevalamāhuḥ | aparamapi vyāvṛtte'kṣṇi yogamāha - ghṛtābhyakta iti | vyāvṛdityapi pāṭhāntaraṃ | vyāvṛditi jihvā pūrvakalkādinā calitetyarthaḥ | yadi calitā jātā drākṣākṣīraghṛtābhyakte sati jihvāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛtvā pīḍayet | antarnayediti bhāvaḥ | hanumokṣārthamapyāha hanumokṣe smṛtaḥ sveda ityādi | khedo'tra caturṇāṃ madhye vihitasveda eva kāryaḥ | nasyamapi tadvihitam | tacca śleṣmavātaghnadravyarahitamityarthaḥ | tena śleṣmavātaghnaṃ yannasyaṃ taddeyaṃ; apare yogamenaṃ śleṣmavātaghnaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti | yataḥ kaphavātanirharaṇatvena hanumokṣaḥ syāt tanmūlatvāt | anye śleṣmavātaghnaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti | yataḥ kaphavātanirharaṇatvena hanumokṣaḥ syāt, tanmūlatvāt anye śleṣmavātahṛdityanenāparamapyupāyaṃ kathayanti | tadvicārya yojyānīti | raktacchardyāmapi yogamāha - raktapittavidhānenetyādi | raktapittavidhānaṃ raktapittacikitsāyāmanyatamena jñātavyaṃ | anyopadravāṇāṃ cikitsitamāha - dhātrīrasāñjanośīretyādi | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavam, uśīraṃ mṛṇālaṃ, lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyaprabhavāḥ | candanaṃ raktaṃ | vāribhiriti | eteṣāṃ vāri toyaṃ grāhyaṃ | śṛtatvāt kalkatvācca || 24-29 || Gū. vamanātivyāptau tadrogaśāntyarthaṃ cikitsitamāha - vamanasyātiyogaścettadā recanaṃ kuryāt | vamanātiyoge jihvāpratīkāramāha - vamane antaḥpraviṣṭāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ snigdhāmlalavaṇairghṛtakṣīrarasaiḥ kavalagraho hitaḥ | tasyāgrato'neke narāḥ amlanimbukādīni phalāni khādeyu: sugamam | vyāvṛtte'kṣṇi cikitsitamāha - vyāvṛttekṣṇi prasārite'kṣṇi ghṛtābhyakte śanaiḥ pīḍayet | hanumokṣe kriyāmāha - stambhāddhanumokṣakaraṇe svedaḥ smṛtaḥ | śleṣmavātaharaṃ nasyam | atha raktacchardipratīkāramāha - raktapittavidhānena raktapittacitkitsitena raktacchardimupācaret cikitset | aticchardijanitatṛṣṇācikitsitamāha - dhātrī āmalakī, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhūtam, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ lājā dhānyajāḥ, candanaṃ śītaṃ, vāri netravālakam | ebhirmanthaṃ kṛtvā pāyayet | kiṃbhūtaṃ manthaṃ ? saghṛtaṃ kṣaudraśarkaraṃ, ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu, śarkarā sitā etaiḥ sahitam | anena manthena yā tṛṣṇāstāḥ śāmyanti | tathā chardisamudbhavāḥ pīḍāḥ śāmyanti || 24-29 || atha samyagvāntalakṣaṇamāha - hṛtkaṇṭhaśirasāṃ śuddhirdīptāgnitvaṃ ca lāghavam | kaphapittavināśaśca samyagvātasya lakṣaṇam || 30 || Dī. hṛcchuddhiḥ hṛdayalaghutārūpā, kaṇṭhaśuddhiḥ kaṇṭhe pāṭavaṃ kaṇṭhasthaśleṣmāpagamāt | śiraḥśuddhiḥ śirolaghutvaṃ tatsthapīḍādivināśāt | dīptāgnitvamiti | nanu vāntasya sahasā mando'gnirbhavati | uktaṃca - ‘saṃśodhanāsravisrāvasnehayojanalaṅghanaiḥ | yātyagnirmandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet’ iti | tatkathamatra dīptāgnitvam ? iti | ucyate - atra śodhanenāgnirupaghāto bhavati nāgnerhāniḥ, tasyopaghātasya peyādipathyadānena punardīptatvāt dīptatvam | uktaṃca dṛḍhabalena -‘peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtañca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīnubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro'nnakālaṃ pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddha:’ iti | tathā'ṇuragnistṛṇagomayādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣamāṇo bhavati krameṇa | mahān sthiraḥ sarvasamaṃ tathaiva śuddhasya peyādibhirantarāgniriti | tasmāddīptāgnitvaṃ yuktaṃ, tathā lāghavaṃ śarīsya, ata eva kaphapittavināśaśca iti | ityanena śarīrapāṭavamapyuktam | athavā vāntisamaye taddina evāgnihānirdurvānte ca | samyagvānte aparadine ca dīpto'gnirityadoṣaḥ | ata eva vakṣyamāṇaśloke ‘ajīrṇārditaṃ varjayet’ sudhīriti grahaṇāt || 30 || Gū. athānantaraṃ samyagvāntasya puruṣasya idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati tadāha - hṛtkaṇṭhaśirasāṃ śuddhiḥ kaphādirahitatvam | agnirdīptaḥ, lāghavaṃ dehasya kaphapittavināśaśca iti || 30 || atha vāntasya pathyamāha - tato'parāhṇe dīptā'gniṃ mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālibhiḥ | hṛdyaiśca jāṅgalarasaiḥ kṛtvā yūṣaṃ ca bhojayet || 31 || Dī. tato'nantaraṃ śuddheranantaramityarthaḥ | dīptāgnim, aparāhṇe aparadine tṛtīyayāmāvasāne vā | ata eva dīptāgnitvamiti bhāvaḥ | mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālibhirbhojayet | mudgādayo'tra peyādikaraṇopayogitvena mudgādīnāṃ yūṣapeyāvilepya: kāryāḥ | adīptāgniśceti dvitīye divase | uktaṃ ca - ‘tataḥ sāyaṃ prabhāte vā snātaḥ śuddhān sukhāmbunā | purāṇaraktaśālīnāmasnehalavaṇauṣaṇam | bhuñjāno raktaśālyannaṃ bhojetpeyādikaṃ kramam’ iti | tathā yūṣaṃ ca paraṃ jāṅgalarasaiḥ hṛdyaiḥ kṛtvā bhojayet | tenā'yamarthaḥ - yūṣarasādīnāmakṛtakṛtatvena hṛdyatvaṃ jñeyam | uktaṃca - ‘peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtañca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīnubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro'nnakālaṃ pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ’ iti | ‘jñeyā: kṛtākṛtāste ca snehādiyutavarjitā’ iti | ṣaṣṭiko'tra gauraṣaṣṭikaḥ ‘gauraścāsitagaurata’ iti vacanāt | śāliratra raktaśāliḥ evaṃvidhā mahāśālyādayaḥ || 31 || Gū. pathyavidhānamāha - jāṅgalarasairmāṃsarasairlavādyaiḥ || 31 || suvāntasyaite pīḍādyarthaṃ na bhavanti ityāha - tandrā nidrāsyadaurgandhyaṃ kaṇḍūśca grahaṇī viṣam | suvāntasya na pīḍāyai bhavantyete kadācana || 32|| Dī. tandrā ardhonmīlananetratvam, nidrā prāgvyākhyātā, āsyadaurgandhyaṃ mukhadurgandhatā, viṣaṃ viṣajanitopasargāḥ | yaduktaṃ - ’kaphaprasekaṃ svarabhedanidrātandrāsyadaurgandhyaviṣopasargāḥ | gurutvakaṇḍūgrahaṇīvikārā na santi jantorvamataḥ kadācit’ iti | kadācana iti na kasmiṃścitkāle bhavantītyarthaḥ | yathā - ‘chinne tarau puṣpaphalaprarohā yathā vināśaṃ sahasā vrajanti | tathā hṛtaślaiṣmaṇi chardane ca tajjā vikārāḥ pralayaṃ prayanti’ iti || 32 || Gū. suvāntasya tandrādyā na bhavantītyāha - tandrā tathā nidrā, āsyadaurgandhyaṃ mukhadurgandhatā, kaṇḍūḥ kharjūḥ grahaṇī saṃgrahaṇī viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca suvāntasyaite pīḍāyai na bhavanti || 32|| vamane yanniṣiddhaṃ tadāha - ajīrṇaṃ śītapānīyaṃ vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ tathā | snehābhyaṅgaṃ prakopaṃ ca dinaikaṃ varjayetsudhī: || 33 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgādharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe vamanavidhirnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || Dī. kṛtavamanasya pathyamāha - ajīrṇamiti | peyādyannasyājīrṇamatimātrapānāt, tatrāgnermandatvāt | śītapānīyaṃ śītajalasya srotaḥśuddherakaraṇāt | ata evoktam - ‘uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapākṣayaḥ | avegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān || pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyātyāsanasaṃsthitiḥ | nidrātyuccopadhānāhasvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti | ata evoktaṃ - ‘tṛṣṇāyāmalpamuṣṇāmbu pibedvātakaphajvare | tatkaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇāmāśu nivartayet || udīrya cāgniṃ srotāṃsi mṛdukṛtya viśodhayet | līnapittānilasvedaśakṛnmūtrānulomanam || nidrājāḍyāruciharaṃ prāṇānāmavalambanam | viparītamataḥ śīghraṃ doṣasaṃghātavardhanam’ iti | vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma dinaikamityupalakṣaṇaṃ tenā'nyadapi kālaṃ boddhavyam | yaduktaṃ -‘vamanādividhāneṣu yāvatkālaṃ tu gacchati | tāvattu parihartavyaṃ śītatoyādimaithunam’ iti || 33 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe vamanādhyāyaḥ || 3 || Gū. ajīrṇe ca śītapānīyaṃ varjayet | uṣṇameva praśastam | vyāyāmaṃ śramādikam | maithunaṃ strīsevanam, snehābhyaṅgaṃ tailamardanam, visūcyādau praśastaṃ na kṛtrimaṃ vamane prakopaṃ krodhaṃ sudhī: paṇḍitaḥ etatsarvaṃ dinaikaṃ varjayet || 33 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpi- kāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi vamanaprakaraṇaṃ samāptam || Editor's notes 1 te ca vāgbhaṭoktāḥ - ‘viśeṣaṇa tu vāmayet | navajvarātisārādha:pittāsṛgrājayakṣmiṇaḥ | kuṣṭhamehāpacīgranthiśrlīpadonmādakāsinaḥ | śvāsahṛllāsavīsarpastanyadoṣordhvarogiṇa’ iti ↩ 2 ‘vā’ śabdo'tra na bhinnakrame, apiśabdārthe dvayorapyekatra yogāt | uktaṃca vāmmaṭe-’yathāvikāravihitāṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutām | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajvamātrāṃ madhābhimadhitām | brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkā'nilā'nalāḥ | ṛṣaya: sauṣaghigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāśca pāṃtu vaḥ | rasāyanamivaṣīṃṇāmamarāṇāmivā'mṛtam | sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te || oum namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyagurave vaiḍūrya prabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tadyathā- oum bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye samudgate svāhā | prāḍmukhaṃ pālyetpīte muhartamanupāyayet’ ityādi | ru. ↩ 3 yadyapyayaṃ pāṭhaḥ ‘ajīrṇaṃ śītapānīya’ mityantima śloke'dhyāyasamāptau mātṛkāsu dṛśyate paramasmābhiḥ yo- myatvādyāthāsthāne niveśita rati bodhyam || ↩

title: 4. atha virecanavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: atha virecanādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ - atha virecanavidhiḥ | Dī. sambandhastu prāgukta eva | virecanaviṣayamāha - snigdhasvinnasya vāntasya dadyātsamyag virecanam | Dī. pūrvasnehapānayuktasya svedayuktasya cetyarthaḥ | vāntasyeti vamanaṃ kṛtvā | etena snehapānādīnāmanantareṇa virecanaṃ na kāryamityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi - ‘pittamatyulbaṇīkṛtya snehasvede kṛte sati | vamane ca kṛte pūrvamataḥ samyagvirecayet’ iti | vamanāntaramapi snigdhasvinnasyeti | yaduktaṃ - ‘karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāmantaraṃ tvantare punaḥ | snehasvedau prayuñjīta saṃśodhanamanantaram’ iti | snigdhasvinnamatra kimarthaṃ tat dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | yathā ‘snehasvedāvakṛtvā'gre yastu saṃśodhanaṃ pibet | dāruśuṣkamivānāmaṃ dehastasya viśīryata’ iti || Gū. vamanānantaraṃ virecanasya vihitatvādvirecanamāha - snigdhasya pītasnehasya, svinnasya kṛtasvedasya || vamane'pyakṛte sati doṣamāha - avāntasya tvadhaḥ srasto grahaṇīṃ chādayetkaphaḥ || 1 || mandāgniṃ gauravaṃ kuryājjanayedvā pravāhikām | athavā pācanairāmaṃ balāsaṃ ca vipācayet || 2 || snigdhasya snehanaiḥ kāryaṃ svedaiḥ svinnasya recanam | Dī. avāntasyetyādi | adhaḥsrastodhaḥ prāptaḥ recanadravyaprabhāvavaśāt | etādṛśaḥ kaphastadā grahaṇīmācchādayet | grahaṇīmagnisthitānnasthānaṃ | yaduktam - ‘agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya grahaṇādgrahaṇī mate’ti | ata evādau vamanenātra kaphanigraho vidheyaḥ | so'pyāśrayasamāśrayaṇātsroto'varodhahetuḥ na kevalaṃ grahaṇīcchādanaṃ karoti | mandāgnimityādi | atra gauravaṃ śarīrasyeti | pravāhikātīsārabhedaḥ | atha kāryāntaramāha - pācanairiti | pācanadravyaiḥ sāmamityaparipakvarasaṃ || tathāhi - ’jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopaka’ iti | na kevalamāmaṃ śrleṣmāṇaṃ ca vipācayet | etena kṛtavamanasyāpi pūrvaṃ pācanaṃ dattvā paścādvirecayedityabhiprāyaḥ | athaveti grahaṇāttena vamanaṃ vinā pācanaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | saṃśodhanakrame'pi pācanasya prādhānyamuktaṃ | tathā tīsaṭe coktaṃ - ‘prāk pācanaṃ snehavidhirvidheyaḥ svedastataḥ syādvamanaṃ virekaḥ | nirūhaṇaṃ snehanabastikarma nasyaṃ kramaśceti bhiṣagvarāṇām’ iti | eṣāṃ kramābhiprāyeṇa vināpi virecanasya pūrvaṃ pācanaṃ kartavyameveti vyavahāraḥ saṅgata eva | atha pācanamabhidhāya virecanamapi kasya kathaṃ dātavyamityāha - snigdhasyeti | pūrvakṛtasnigdhapācanasya, kaiḥ snehanairghṛtādibhiḥ | na kevalaṃ snigdhasya recanaṃ kiṃtu svedairapi svinnasya sveditasya virecanaṃ praśastaṃ | yadvā snehanaiḥ svedairiti saṃbandhaḥ | snehasvedairityanena doṣāṇāṃ sukhamutpāṭanaṃ sūcitaṃ | yataḥ ‘snehasvedaiḥ pracalitā rasaiḥ snigdhairudīritāḥ | doṣāḥ koṣṭhagatā jantoḥ sukhaṃ haṃti virecanai’riti | pūrvamuktamapyadaḥ punareva draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyena | kecidvakṣyamāṇena śaradṛtāviti ślokena militvā vyākhyānayanti | tatra śaradṛtau snigdhasya snehanaiḥ kṛtvā virecanaṃ kāryaṃ | vasante ca svedaiḥ svinnameva recanaṃ deyaṃ | na tu snigdhasya iti na sarvamatam || 1 || 2 || Gū. adhaḥsrastaḥ patitaḥ, grahaṇīṃ pittadhāriṇīṃ kṛtvā kapha ācchādayet | yadā kaphaḥ grahaṇīmācchādayet tadā kiṃ kuryāt ityāha - mandāgniṃ gauravaṃ ca kuryāt | pravāhikātīsārabhedastāṃ janayet | adhasrastasya kaphasya pratīkāramāha - athavā pakṣāntare | āmaṃ balāsaṃ kaphaṃ ca pācanaiḥ śuṇṭhyairaṇḍādibhiḥ pācayet | yadvā snehanairghṛtadugdhādibhiḥ snigdhasya sveditasya recanaṃ kāryamiti vidhiḥ tatrocyate | vamanādvirecanaṃ kadā deyamityapekṣāyāmatrānuktamiti likhyate | tatra bhedaḥ | samyakpravṛtte vamane saptarātre gate sati | susaṃskṛtaśarīrasya pradātavyaṃ virecanaṃ’ | carake ca ‘vātaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ saṃsnehitaṃ tathā | uṣṇaṃ laghu tryahaṃ bhuktaiḥ ṣoḍaśe'hni virecayet’ | ṣoḍaśadine yadvā pakṣāntare pakṣādvireko vāntasyeti suśrutavacanam | asyārthaḥ vātaṃkṛtaṃ samyagvamanaṃ ṣaḍahasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ ṣaḍahetyuktavamanaṃ punastryahaṃ saṃsnehitaṃ punastryahamuṣṇakṛtasvedaṃ punastryahaṃ laghubhuktaṃ athainaṃ vāmitaṃ bhūyaḥ snehasvedopapāditaṃ | śleṣmakāle gate jñātvā koṣṭhaṃ samyagvirecayet’ | vāgbhaṭe evaṃ likhitam | asyārthaḥ. athainaṃ puruṣaṃ vāmitaṃ kṛtavamanaṃ ṣaḍahānantaraṃ snehasvedopapāditaṃ bhūyaḥ punaḥ śleṣmakāle dvādaśadivase gate sati punastrayahaṃ laghu bhaktaṃ ṣoḍaśe hyeva koṣṭhaṃ samyagvirecayediti vāgbhaṭārthaḥ || 1 || 2 || svamate tu - virecanakālamāha - śaradṛtau vasante ca deyaṃ śuddhau virecanam || 3 || anyadātyayike kārye svedanaṃ śīlayedbudhaḥ | Dī. atra śuddhau cāsvasthasya śodhanāya śaradṛtau vasante ca virecanaṃ deyaṃ | cakārādvarṣāsvapi | taduktam - ‘śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhayan grīṣmajamabhrakāle | ghanātyaye vārṣikamāśu samyak prāpnoti rogānṛtujānna jātu’ iti | virecanamityanena viśeṣeṇa recanaṃ śaradāditriṣveva | anyadā himaśiśiragrīṣme kāle akārye tasmin virecanaṃ kṛte sati pūrvaṃ paścādvihitaśodhanaṃ śīlayedityabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva budha iti kālaviśeṣajño doṣaviśeṣajñaśca || 3 || Gū. idānīṃ virecanayogye virecanakālamāha - śaradṛtau āśvinakārtike tathā vasante caitravaiśākhe dehaśuddhau bhiṣagvirecayet | anyadā anyasminkāle vā satyapi rogotpattau budhaḥ śodhanaṃ śīlayet || 3 || śarīraśuddhau śodhanamuktaṃ tasya phalamāha - doṣāḥ kadācitkupyanti jitā laṅghanapācanaiḥ ||4|| ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ | Dī. laṃghanamatropavāsaḥ, pācanasya pṛthugupādānāt | saptasu śamaneṣu dvayorgrahaṇaṃ pradhānatvāt | ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā doṣāsteṣāṃ na punarudbhavaḥ | ayamarthaḥ laṅghanādayaḥ śamanatvāt saṃcitān doṣān mūlān nonmūlayaṃti kiṃtu śamayanti te kadācitsvalpahetunā'pi kupyanti ye śodhanaiḥ śuddhāḥ teṣāṃ punarudbhavo na bhavati chinnasaṃcayatvāt | uktaṃ ca suśrute - ‘sañcayopahṛtā doṣā labhante nottarā gatīḥ’ iti | bahupustakeṣu ‘doṣāḥ kadācitkupyanti’ amuṃ ślokaṃ ‘pittaṃ virecanaṃ yuñjyāt’ asyāgre paṭhanti tadasaṅgatameva śodhanaparataivāsya ślokasya pūrvaślokaḥ | ‘śaratkāle vasante ca’ ityayaṃ śodhanapara eva tena śodhanaphalārtha evāyaṃ ślokaḥ | tena - ‘śaratkāle vasante ca’ asya ślokasyāgre ‘doṣāḥ kadācitkupyanti ayaṃ ślokaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ | virecanasyā'pi śodhanatvādyathākathañcitsamādheyaṃ vā || 4 || Gū. doṣanāśe śodhanotkṛṣṭamāha - sugamam ||4|| atha pittādau virecanam | pitte virecanaṃ yuñjyādāmodbhūte gade tathā || 5 || udare ca tathā'dhmāne koṣṭhaśuddhyai viśeṣataḥ || Dī. atha virecanaṃ keṣāṃ niyataṃ tānāha - ‘pittavirecanamiti | pittajanitānāmupadravāṇāṃ pittātmakānāṃ niyato vināśa iti kevalapitte'pi virecanamabhihitam | tathāca tantrāntare'pi -‘śarīrajātānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadhaṃ | bastirvireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaghṛtaṃ madhviti’ | āmodbhūte gade tatheti | āmajanitavyādhau | āmavātavikārādāvityaryaḥ | udara iti udararogarūḍhi:| ādhmānodarāpūraḥ | koṣṭhāśuddhāviti | koṣṭhasya aśuddhiḥ baddhakoṣṭha iti prasiddhiḥ | viśeṣata ityanenaivamādīnāmapareṣāmapi virecanaṃ viśeṣeṇa kuryādityarthaḥ | atha śodhanasya prādhānyaviṣayatvena virecanamukhyatvamāha - ayaṃ ślokaḥ śodhanapadagrahaṇenānyacchodhanaparo'pi bhavati | atrācāryeṇa laṅghanapācanairityuktena vamanaviṣayasya niṣedhaparatvādvirecanādhyāye svīkṛtaḥ | nanu ye'pi laṅghanapācanairjitāste punaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavanti ? ucyate | kadācidatisvalpahetulābhena jitā apyajitāḥ doṣamūlānucchedāt mūlabhūtāśayagatadoṣadūṣyasamudbhavāt samyagjitāḥ alpamapi hetuṃ prāpya punaḥ kupyantīti bhāvaḥ | tena teṣāṃ punarudbhava iti | saṃśodhanena mūladoṣajanyādalpahetunā na kadāpi prakopaḥ balavattarahetunā bhavatyeva || 5 || Gū. yeṣu rogeṣu virecanaṃ dīyate tānāha - pitte pittavikāre, āmodbhūte āmavātādau | udare udararoge | ādhmāne koṣṭhāśuddhau baddhakoṣṭhādau || 5 || idānīṃ ye virecane niṣiddhāstānāha - bālavṛddhāvatisnigdhaḥ kṣatakṣīṇo bhayānvitaḥ || 6 || śrāntastṛṣārtaḥ sthūlaśca garbhiṇī ca navajvarī | navaprasūtā nārī ca mandāgniśca madātyayī || 7 || śalyārditaśca rūkṣaśca na virecyā vijānatā | Dī. virecyā iti | viśeṣeṇa recyā na bhavantītyabhiprāyeṇālparecanasyā prāptireva | ata eva bālavṛddhayorapyayaṃ niṣedhaḥ sāmānyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa tu virekasādhyavyādhyupagrastayoḥ kiṃciddeyamityuktaṃ | tathāca - ‘agnikṣāravirekaistu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet | tatsādhyeṣu vikāreṣu mṛdvīṃ kuryāt laghukriyām’ iti | niṣiddhācaraṇamanyatrāpyuktam - ‘atyantapittādviparītadehān vireca- yettānapi mandamandam’ iti | tānapi niṣiddhabālavṛddhādīn | atisnigdha ityatisnehapānādiyuktaḥ | tathāhi ‘navā'tisnigdhakāyasya dadyātsnehavirecanaṃ | doṣāḥ prabhāvitā bhūyo līyante tena vartmasu’ iti | kṣatakṣīṇā iti | dhātuśoṣaṇatvena śoṣī kathitaḥ | sa ca rājayakṣmabhedaḥ | bhayānvito bhayayuktaḥ | bhayagrahaṇatvena śokābhitaptasya dīnasya vā niṣedho darśitaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘kṣīṇastathā rūkṣitabālavṛddhadīno'tha śoṣī bhayaśokataptaḥ’ ityādi | sthūlo bahumedonvitaḥ | mandāgnirapi kapholbaṇatvāt | rūkṣo vātolbaṇa iti | athavā rūkṣa ityasnigdhaḥ | tathāhyuktaṃ ‘virūkṣaṃ snehasātmyaṃ tu bhūyaḥ saṃsnihya recaye’diti | vijānatetyanena virecanaviṣayavikalpaviśeṣajñena vaidyenetyarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘virecanairyānti narā vināśamajñaprayuktairavirecanīyā’ iti || 6 || 7 || Gū. avirecanayogyānāha - ete bālādayo vijānatā viśeṣajñapuruṣeṇa na virecyāḥ || 6 || 7 || virecanayogyānāha - jīrṇajvarī garavyāpto vātaraktī bhagandarī || 8 || arśaḥ pāṇḍūdaragranthihṛdrogārucipīḍitāḥ | yonirogapramehārtā gulmaplīhavraṇārditāḥ || 9 || vidradhicchardivisphoṭavisūcīkuṣṭhasaṃyutāḥ | karṇanāsāśirovakragudameḍhrāmayānvitāḥ || 10 || plīhaśothākṣirogārtā: krimikṣīṇānilārditā: | śūlino mūtraghātārtā virekārhā narā matāḥ || 11 || Dī. virekasādhyān rogānāha - jīrṇajvarādayo virekārhāḥ narā matāḥ | ācāryāṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | jīrṇajvarīti purāṇajvarī tasya virekasādhyatvāt | garavyāpta iti garaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ tena vyāptaḥ duḥkhitaḥ | tathā'rśādipīḍitāḥ | tathā yonirogādibhirarditāḥ | tathā vidradhyādiyutāḥ | tathā karṇanāsāśirovakragudameḍhrāmayānvitā iti | karṇādijanitāmayānvitā ityarthaḥ | tenāmayaśabdo karṇādibhiḥ saha saṃbadhyate | plīhaśothākṣirogārtā iti plīhādirogavyāptā ityarthaḥ | krimikṣīṇānilārditā iti | kṛmyādibhirarditāḥ pīḍitāḥ | virekārhā iti virecanayogyā ityarthaḥ || 8-11 || Gū. jīrṇajvarī cirajvarī, garavyāpto viṣayukta:, udaram udararogiṇaṃ, granthirogaḥ | nanūdaraṃ pūrvamuktamatrāpyucyate tatkathaṃ na punaruktiḥ ? ucyate - udare punaruktirvirecanārthaṃ | yadvā udaragranthirbhinnarogaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 8-11 || atha virecanajñānārthaṃ koṣṭhabhedānāha - bahupitto mṛduḥ koṣṭho jahuśleṣmā ca madhyamaḥ | bahuvātaḥ krūrakoṣṭho durvirecya: sa kathyate || 12 || Dī. bahupittaḥ koṣṭhaḥ mṛduḥ, bahukapho madhyaḥ, bahuvātaḥ krūraḥ | madhyamena śodhanena hīnayogī krūraḥ | atiyogī mṛduḥ, samyagyogī madhyaḥ | saṃsargasannipātajakoṣṭhe yogavāhitvaṃ kaphasya jñeyaṃ vacanabalāt | yadāha khāraṇādiḥ - ‘vātolbaṇā syādbhahaṇī krūrakoṣṭhasya dehinaḥ | pittalā mṛdukoṣṭhasya yogavāhī tayoḥ kaphaḥ’ iti | tena vātakaphābhyāṃ krūraḥ, madhyo vātapittābhyāṃ, sannipātācca mṛduḥ | nanu bahuvātaśleṣmabhyāṃ krūraḥ, iti suśrutena bahukaphasya krūratvamuktam | iha tu madhyamatvamiti virodhaḥ ? maivaṃ - suśrutavākyasya saṃsargaparatvāditi bopadevapaṇḍitāḥ | durvirecya iti kṛcchrātsāmādiko'pyavirecyaḥ || 12 || koṣṭhānurūpāṃ mātrāmāha - mṛdvī mātrā mṛdukoṣṭhe madhyakoṣṭhe ca madhyamā | krūre tīkṣṇā matā dravyairmṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇakaiḥ ||13|| Dī. mṛdvādidravyaiḥ mṛdvādikoṣṭhakeṣu mṛdvādimātrā matā, ācāryāṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | nanu mṛdurdravyairmṛdvādyā mātrā bhavati kimarthaṃ mṛdvādimātretītyādi ? ucyate -hīnayogātiyogasamyagyogāya, te ca vaidyādhīnāḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ prabhūtasyālpakarmatām | kuryāt saṃśleṣaviśleṣakālasaṃskārayuktitaḥ’ ityādi mātrājñānārthamuktam || 13 || Gū. virecane mṛdumadhyakrūrakoṣṭhamāha - mṛdviti | mṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇakairdravyairmṛdvīmātrādayo matāḥ| sugamam ||13|| mṛdvādidravyāṇi kāni tāni ityata āha - mṛdurdrākṣāpayaścāmbutailairapi viricyate | madhyamastrivṛtātiktārājavṛkṣairviricyate || 14 || krūraḥ snukpayasāhemakṣīrīdantīphalādibhiḥ | Dī. mṛduriti | mṛduḥ koṣṭhaḥ drākṣādibhiḥ samyak viricyate | tatra drākṣā gostanī, payaḥ godugdham uṣṇāmbu uṣṇodakam, pānīyatvena madhyame'pi grahaṇam | athavāmbuśabdaḥ sārakamastvādidravopalakṣaṇaḥ, tailamairaṇḍatailam | madhyastu madhyakoṣṭhaḥ na krūro na mṛduriti madhyapadābhidhānāt | sa ca trivṛtādibhiḥ samyak viricyate | trivṛtā śyāmā, tiktā kaṭukī, rājavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ| krūra iti | krūrakoṣṭhaḥ snukpayohemakṣīryādibhirviricyate | snuk sehuṇḍaḥ, hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī, dantīphalaṃ jayapālaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt kumbhātilvakādayaḥ || 14 || Gū. tāni dravyāṇyevāha - payo dugdham, tailaiḥ eraṇḍāditailaiḥ, trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, tiktā kaṭukī, rājavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ, snuk sehuṇḍaḥ tasya dugdham, hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī dantī jayapālaḥ | ādiśabdāt indravāruṇībrahmalavaṇyādayaḥ || 14 || virekasyottamādimātrāyai vāṅgakailiṅgakaparimāṇamāha - mātrottamā virekasya triṃśadvegaiḥ kaphāntagā || 15|| vegairviṃśatibhirmadhyā hīnoktā daśavegakaiḥ | Dī. mātrottameti | pravarā vegamātrā triṃśadvegairjñaiyā, tathā kaphāntageti kailiṅgakaṃ mānam | tathā viṃśatibhirvegairmadhyā, tathā daśabhirvegairhīnā | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthastathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ca’ iti | tulāmānamapyuktaṃ tenaiva - ‘prasthastathā syāddvicaturguṇaśca | dvitrānsaviṭkānapanīya vegānmeyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam’ iti | keciduttamasya vāyoḥ krūrakoṣṭasya ca uttamā mātrā tīkṣṇā'bhimatā, ata eva kaphāntagānmeyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītamiti, madhyamā'pi tasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya hīnā iti vyākhyānayanti || 15 || Gū. uttamādibhedena virekapramāṇamāha - mātrottameti | sugamam || 15 || idānīṃ kaṣāyaguṭikācūrṇātmakānāṃ virecanadravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha - dvipalaṃ śreṣṭhamākhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ ca palaṃ bhavet || 16|| palārdhaṃ ca kaṣāyāṇāṃ kanīyastu virecanam | kalkamodakacūrṇānāṃ karṣaṃ madhvājyalehataḥ || 17 || karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā'pi vayorogādyapekṣayā | Dī. kaṣāyāṇāmiti | kaṣāyaśabdena rasaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaphāṇṭānāṃ caturṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ kalkasya pṛthagupādānāt | dvipalaṃ śreṣṭhamityanena vātajanitakoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ | virecanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ kaṣāyāṇāmuttamā mātretyarthaḥ | palaṃ madhyamaṃ madhyamā mātrā pittajanitamṛdukoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ | ardhapalaṃ kanīyo mātrā hīnā mātretyarthaḥ | kaphena madhyamakoṣṭhaḥ kathitaḥ | kalkamodakacūrṇānāmiti | kalkādīnāṃ karṣaṃ madhvājyayogataḥ virecanam | vā athavā vayorogādyapekṣayā karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā virecanam | madhughṛtamānaṃ viṣamatayā yojyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘bhajato viṣarūpatvaṃ tulyāṃśau madhusarpiṣī’ iti | ādigrahaṇātkoṣṭhādi jñātvā virecanaṃ deyam || 16 || 17 || Gū. vireke kaṣāyādīnāṃ mātrākathanam - virecanaṃ dvipalaṃ śreṣṭham, palaṃ madhyamaṃ, palārdhaṃ kanīyaḥ svalpam | kaṣāyānantaraṃ virecane kalkādīnāṃ pramāṇamāha - madhvājyalehataḥ karṣadvayaṃ trayaṃ vā'pi deyam | vayorogādyapekṣā vicāraṇīyam || 16 || 17 || trivṛtācūrṇam | atha vātādīnāṃ koṣṭhamātrādibhedena katipayayogān darśayannāha - pittottare trivṛccūrṇaṃ drākṣākkāthādibhiḥ pibet ||18|| triphalākkāthagomūtraiḥ pibedvyoṣaṃ kaphārditaḥ | trivṛtsaindhavaśuṇṭhīnāṃ cūrṇamamlaiḥ pibennaraḥ || 19 || vātārdito virekāya jāṅgalānāṃ rasena vā | Dī. pitte virecanasya prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ prāk | pittottaragrahaṇam | pittottare koṣṭhe drākṣākvāthādibhiḥ trivṛccūrṇaṃ pibet | ādigrahaṇāt kṣīrekṣukāśmaryasvāduskandavarārasādibhiḥ | kaphārditaḥ triphalākvāthagomūtraiḥ vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ ca pibet| atrāpi virekāyeti saṃbandhaḥ | vātārditaḥ trivṛtśuṇṭhīsaindhavānāṃ cūrṇamamlairmadyakāñjikabījapūrarasādibhiḥ athavā jāṅgalānāṃ rasairhariṇaiṇatittiralāvādīnāṃ rasairmāṃsarasairvirecanaṃ pibet | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘atha kāle tu taccūrṇaṃ kiṃcinnāgarasaindhavam | vātāmaye pibedamlaiḥ pitte sājyasitāmadhu | kṣīradrākṣekṣukāśmaryasvāduskandhavarārasaiḥ | kaphāmaye pīlurasamūtramadyāmlakāñjikaiḥ | pañcakolādicūrṇaiśca yuktyā yuktaṃ kaphāpahaiḥ | trivṛtkalkakaṣāyeṇa sādhitaḥ sasito himaḥ | madhu trijātasaṃyukto leho hṛdyaṃ virecanam | ajagandhā tavakṣīrī vidārī śarkarā trivṛt | cūrṇitaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate | sannipātajvarastambhapipāsādāhapīḍitaḥ | tvagelābhyāṃ samā nīlī taistrivṛttaiśca śarkarā | cūrṇaṃ phalarasakṣaudrasaktubhistarpaṇaṃ pibet | vātapittakaphottheṣu rogeṣvalpānaleṣvapi | nareṣu sukumāreṣu nirapāyaṃ virecanam’ || iti | cakradatte tu - ‘bhittvā dvidhekṣu parilipya kalkaistribhaṇḍijātaiḥ pariveṣṭya rajjvā | pakvaṃ tu samyak puṭapākayuktyā khādettu taṃ pittagadī suśītam’ iti || 18 || 19 || Gū. trivṛtādivirecanaṃ kathaṃ pibet ? ityāha - pittottare pittādhikye trivṛccūrṇaṃ drākṣākkāthādibhi: pibet | kaphārditaḥ triphalākkāthaṃ gomūtraiḥ pītvā trikaṭukaṃ pibet | vātārditaḥ vātapīḍitaḥ trivṛtsaindhavaśuṇṭhīnāṃ cūrṇamamlairnimbādibhiḥ pibet | jāṅgalānāṃ jāṅgalamāṃsānāṃ vā rasena iti pakṣāntare || 18 || 19 || eraṇḍatailaprayogaḥ | eraṇḍatailaṃ triphalākkāthena dviguṇena ca || 20 || yuktaṃ pītaṃ payobhirvā nacireṇa viricyate | Dī. atha krūrakoṣṭhādīnāmapi tatkṣaṇameva virekārthaṃ prakāramāha - eraṇḍataileti | ayaṃ yogastrikoṣṭhaviṣaye yojyaḥ | tatra payobhirveti | ’vā’ śabdo vikalpārthe | tena triphalākvāthadugdhābhyāṃ militvaiva tailaṃ peyamityeke | vyāsena vā payasaiva kevalena dviguṇenetyanye || 20 || Gū. anyadapi auṣadhayoge virecanavidhānamāha - eraṇḍataile | dviguṇena triphalākvāthena yuktaṃ pītvā, payobhirdugdhairvā pītvā pumān nacireṇa śīghreṇa viricyate || 20 || ṣaḍṛtuvirecanam | trivṛtā kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam || 21 || samṛdvīkārasakṣaudraṃ varṣākāle virecanam | trivṛddurālabhā mustā śarkarodīcyacandanam || 22 || drākṣāmbunā sayaṣṭyāhvaṃ śītalaṃ ca ghanātyaye | pippalī nāgaraṃ sindhu śyāmā ca trivṛtā saha ||23 || lihetkṣaudreṇa śiśire vasante ca virecanam | trivṛtā śarkarā tulyā grīṣmakāle virecanam ||24|| Dī. idānīṃ ṣaḍṛtuvirekaviṣayatvena tadyogānurūpānyogānāha - trivṛteti | trivṛtādibhirvarṣākāle prāvṛṣi virecanaṃ tatra doṣasañcayāt | trivṛt śyāmā, kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ indrayavā:, pippalī māgadhī, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, drākṣā gostanī, tasyā rasaḥ, kṣaudraṃ madhu iti | varṣāgrahaṇena prāvṛṭgrahaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopanimittāt | ghanātyaye śaratkāle yogamāha - trivṛddurālabhetyādi | trivṛt śyāmā, durālabhā samudrāntā tasyā alābhe yavāsakaḥ, mustā bhadramustā, śarkarā sitopalā, udīcyaṃ vālakaṃ, candanaṃ śvetacandanaṃ cūrṇayogyatvāt | drākṣāmbunā gostanīkvāthena rasena vā | sayaṣṭyāhvaṃ yaṣṭīmadhusahitaṃ, śītalaṃ śītaguṇaṃ śītasparśaṃ ca tena pittaghnatvamasya yogasya kathitam | ata eva śaratkāle yogyatā'sya yogasya iti | śiśire vasante ca virecanamāha - pippalī nāgaramiti | pippalī kaṇā, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, saindhavam, śyāmā śyāmamūlā, trivṛt mālavikākhyā aruṇamūlā ca | uktaṃ ca - ‘vidyāddvidhā ca tanmūlaṃ śyāmaṃ śyāmāruṇaṃ trivṛt’ iti | śiśiragrahaṇena hemantasyā'pi grahaṇam | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīsaralaṃ vacām | svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pibet’ iti | grīṣme virecanamāha - tulyā śarkarā grīṣmakāle grīṣmākhye kāle virecanaṃ deyam | anyat sugamam | atra kecitsarvartukaṃ yogaṃ paṭhanti || 21-24 || tadyathā - trivṛtāṃ hapuṣāṃ dantīṃ saptalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayetryaham ||25|| eṣa sarvartuko yogaḥ snigdhānāṃ maladoṣahā | Gū. varṣākāle virecanavidhānamāha - trivṛtāniḥsṛtā, kauṭajaṃ bījam indrayavāḥ, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, mṛdvīkā drākṣā tadrasaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu, varṣākāle idaṃ virecanam | śaradvirecanamāha -trivṛt niḥsṛtā, durālabhā yavāsā, śarkarā sitā, candanaṃ śvetam, udīcyaṃ vālakam, yaṣṭayāhvaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | etaddrākṣāmbunā drākṣājalena ghanātyaye śaradvirecanam | atha hemantavirecanam - sindhu saindhavam, śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ trivṛt niḥsṛtā | grīṣme virecanam - sugamamanyat || 25 || asya ślokasya dantīsthāne vāgbhaṭe trāyantī paṭhitā | trivṛt trāyantī, hapuṣā sātalā, kaṭurohiṇī samānaṃ jñeyam | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate kṣepako'yamiti manyamānairasmābhirapi na vyākhyātaḥ || 25 || abhayādimodakāḥ | abhayā maricaṃ śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgāmalakāni ca || 26 || pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ tvakpatraṃ mustameva ca | etāni samabhāgāni dantī ca dviguṇā bhavet ||27|| trivṛdaṣṭaguṇā jñeyā ṣaḍguṇā cātra śarkarā | madhunā modakānkṛtvā karṣamātrapramāṇataḥ || 28 || ekaikaṃ bhakṣayetprātaḥ śītaṃ cānu pibejjalam | tāvadviricyate janturyāvaduṣṇaṃ na sevate || 29 || pānāhāravihāreṣu bhavenniryantraṇaḥ sadā | viṣamajvaramandāgnipāṇḍukāsabhagandarān || 30 || durnāmakuṣṭhagulmārśogalagaṇḍabhramodarān | (vi dāhaplīhamehāṃśca yakṣmāṇaṃ nayanāmayān ||31|| vātarogāṃstathādhmānaṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṇi cāśmarīm| ) pṛṣṭapārśvorujaghanajaṅghodararujo jayet || 32 || satataṃ śīlanādeṣāṃ palitāni praṇāśayet | abhayāmodakā hyete rasāyanavarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||33|| Dī. atha sarvakālīnaśīlanārthaṃ abhayāmodakānāha - abhayeti | ete abhayāmodakāḥ sarvartuṣu prasiddhāḥ | kvāpi śītavirecanasaṃjñaḥ| tvak guḍatvak, dantī triguṇā pṛthagbhārayāpekṣayā, evaṃ trivṛdapi cāṣṭaguṇā, śarkarāpyevaṃ ṣaḍguṇā | kecitsakaladravyebhyaḥ ṣaḍguṇatvamaṣṭhaguṇatvaṃ vyākhyānayanti, tanna tantrāntarasaṃvādāt uktaṃca - abhayā, pippalīmūlaṃ, maricaṃ, nāgaraṃ, tathā | tvak, patraṃ, pippalī mustaṃ viḍaṅgāmalakāni ca || karṣaḥ pratyekameṣāṃ tu dantyāḥ karṣatrayaṃ tathā | ṣaṭkarṣāstu sitā deyā dvipalaṃ trivṛtā bhavet || sarvaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ kṛtvā madhunā modakaṃ tathā | khādetpratidinaṃ caikaṃ śītaṃ cānu pibejjalam || tāvadviricyate janturyāvaduṣṇaṃ na sevate | pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ jaṅghāpārśvarujastathā || pṛṣṭyartimūtrakṛcchūṃ ca durnāmaṃ sabhagandaram | aśmarī mehakuṣṭhaṃ ca dāhaśothodarāṇi ca || yakṣmāṇaṃ cakṣūrogaṃ ca kramaṃ vaidyena jānatā | yojito'yaṃ nihantyāśu abhayānāma modakaḥ’ iti | dṛḍhabalena elācādhikā'sti -‘vyoṣatvak patramustailāṃ viḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ| samabhāgā bhiṣak dadyāt triguṇaṃ ca mukūlakam | trivṛtā'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ śarkarāyāśca ṣaḍguṇam’ ityādi | mukūlaṃ dantī, madhuneti modakakaraṇocitamānena | śītāmbunā pibejjalamiti yogaprabhāvo'yam | anyatra ‘śītāmbhasā stambhaḥ syāt rasāyanam’ iti | rasādikaraṇādrasāyanam | puṣṭibalavarṇakṛt | athavā rasāyanāṅgamidaṃ virecanaṃ rasāyanamiti prāṇadā modakāḥ || 26-33 || Gū. atha sukhavirecanamāha - abhayā harītakī, āmalakaṃ, tvak guḍatvak, patraṃ patrajaṃ, mustaṃ bhadramustakam, etāni samabhāgāni, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ triguṇā tribhāgā, tṛvṛt śyāmā aṣṭabhāgā, śarkarā ṣaḍguṇā ṣaḍbhāgā | keciddantyādīn cūrṇānbhāgavṛddhānāhuḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 26-33 || virecanaṃ pītvā kiṃ kuryāttadāha -- pītvā virecanaṃ śītajalaiḥ saṃsicya cakṣuṣī | sugandhiṃ kiñcidāghrāya tāmbūlaṃ śīlayedvaram ||34|| nivātastho na vegāṃśca dhārayenna svapettathā | śītāmbu na spṛśet kkāpi koṣṇanīraṃ pibenmuhuḥ ||35|| Dī. śītajalairiti | virekauṣadhaklamanāśārthaṃ śītalajalena netrasecanam | tathā sugandhaṃ mṛgamadasurabhi uttamacandanādīnyāghrāya paścādvaraṃ śreṣṭhajīrṇatāmbūlīpatrakṛtaṃ śīlayet | nivātastha iti vegapravṛttyarthaṃ vegāṃśca na dhārayet, ūrdhvavātādirogotpādakatvāt | svāpena virekauṣadhaśaktihāniḥ syāt | śītāmbu ityādi | śītalodakaṃ kvāpi pānādau na spṛśet | rekastambhakatvāt | ata evāha - koṣṇanīraṃ pibenmuhuriti | vāraṃ vāraṃ koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ rekaikakaraṇārthamityarthaḥ ||34||35|| Gū. virecanānte yatkartavyaṃ tadāha - sugandhaṃ dravyam | vireke jāte kathaṃ tiṣṭhedityāha - vegān vātādīn na dhārayet, na svapet nidrāṃ na kuryāt, koṣṇanīraṃ muhuḥ pibet | kvāpi kadāpi uṣṇatve śītāmbunā spṛśet na sarvadā || 34 || 35 || samyagvāntalakṣaṇena samyagvirekalakṣaṇamāha - balāsauṣadhapittāni vāyurvānte yathā vrajet | rekāttathā malaṃ pittaṃ bheṣajaṃ ca kapho vrajet ||36|| Dī. yathā vamane prathamaṃ balāsaḥ kaphaḥ pravartate | paścādvamanadravyaṃ nirgacchet | tadanu pittāni | bahuvacanatvena haritapītāni kaṭutittaprāyāṇīti | tatpaścādvāyuriti | tathā evamapi virekātprathamaṃ malaṃ purīṣaṃ tadanu pittaṃ tatpaścādvirecanaṃ dravyaṃ | tadanu kaphaḥ pravartata iti | tena kaphānte ca virecanamiti vacanāt | etena samyagvā'samyagviriktaśca kathita ityabhiprāyaḥ | anyathā durvānto durvirikta iti | tena durvāntalakṣaṇamanādhyāye'bhihitaṃ durviriktalakṣaṇamatraivāgre vakṣyati | nābheriti ṣaṣṭhaṃ vadanti kecit | tatra nābhereva srastatvam ||36|| Gū. virekāt kiṃ niḥsaratītyāha - vānte sati yathā balāsauṣadhapittāni vāyuḥ vrajet tathā raikātkaphaḥ malaṃ pittaṃ bheṣajaṃ ca gamayet balāsaḥ kapham, auṣadhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ malaṃ purīṣam ||36|| atha durviriktalakṣaṇamāha - durviriktasya nābhestu stabdhatvaṃ kukṣiśūlatā | purīṣavātasaṃgaśca kaṇḍūmaṇḍalagauravaḥ || 37 || vidāho'rucirādhmānaṃ bhramaśchardiśca jāyate | Dī. durviriktasya na samyagviriktasya narasya nābheḥ stabdhatvādayo jāyante | nābheriti | nābheḥ nābhyupalakṣitasya pradeśasya pakvāśayākhyasya stabdhatvaṃ stabdhatā, tathā kukṣiśūlatā kukṣyoḥ śūlaṃ | purīṣavātasaṅgaśceti malavātayoḥ saṅgo rodhaḥ | tathā kaṇḍūmaṇḍalagauravamiti kaṇḍūḥ śarīre, maṇḍalaśabdenātra varaṭīdaṃśasadṛśaṃ gauravaṃ śarīrodarayoḥ | vidāhaḥ pittavaddāhaḥ | arucirarocakaḥ | ādhmānamudarāpūraḥ | bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva vastudarśanam | vāntiḥ chardiśceti | iti durviriktasya lakṣaṇam ||37|| Gū. vireke durviriktalakṣaṇamāha - durviriktasya asamyagviriktasya nābheḥ stambhatvaṃ stabdhatā, tu punaḥ kukṣiśūlatā, purīṣavātayoḥ saṃgaḥ apravṛttiḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 37 || athāsya durviriktasya punaḥ cikitsāmāha -- taṃ puna: pācanaiḥ snehaiḥ paktvā saṃsnehya recayet ||38|| tenā'syopadravā yānti dīptāgnerlaghutā bhavet | Dī. tamiti | durviriktaṃ puruṣaṃ pācanaiḥ pācanauṣadhaiḥ paktvā arthādāmaṃ doṣaṃ ca snehaiḥ saṃsnehya recayet | teneti | tena svedanasnehanenāsya durviriktasyopadravā yānti naśyantītyarthaḥ | tataḥ dīptāgnirbhavet | laghutā ca śarīrasya bhavati || 38 || Gū. idānīṃ durvirecitacitsāmāha - āragvadhādibhistathā snehairghṛtapācanādyairāmaṃ paktvā saṃsnehya snehanaṃ kṛtvā virecayet || 38|| idānīṃ virekātiśayasya lakṣaṇamāha - virekasyātiyogena mūrcchā bhraṃśo gudasya ca ||39|| śūlaṃ kaphātiyogaḥ syānmāṃsadhāvanasaṃnibham | medonibhaṃ jalābhāsaṃ raktaṃ vā'pi viricyate ||40|| Dī. virekasyātiyogena mūrcchādayo bhavanti | gudasya bhraṃśa iti | gudasya bahirnirgamanaṃ, taccātisaṃpravāhaṇādbhavati | uktaṃca - ‘pravāhikā'tisārābhyāṃ nirgacchati gudo bahi:’ iti | śūlaṃ nānāprakārakamatra jñeyam | tena parikartikā'pyatra bhavati | kaphātiyogaḥ syāt kaphasya atisaraṇaṃ bhavati | ‘tathā māṃsadhāvanasaṃnibhādikaṃ viricyate māṃsadhāvanodakatulyaṃ, medonibhaṃ medaḥsadṛśam | jalābhāsamiti | jalasadṛśaṃ svacchamityarthaḥ | raktaṃ vā'pi viricyata iti raktameva vā viricyate | anye māṃsadhāvanādīni cāsya viśeṣaṇāni manyante niṣpurīṣatvāt | iti virekātiyogalakṣaṇam || 39 || 40 || Gū. virekasyātiyogenādhikyena mūrcchādayo bhavanti | māṃsadhāvanādinibhaṃ viricyate ceti ||39||40|| atha virekātiyogacikitsāmāha -- tasya śītāmbubhiḥ siktvā śarīraṃ taṇḍulāmbubhiḥ | madhumiśraistathā śītaiḥ kārayedvamanaṃ mṛdu || 41 || sahakāratvacaḥ kalko dadhnā sauvīrakeṇa vā | piṣṭvā nābhipralepena hantyatīsāramulbaṇam || 42 || ajākṣīraṃ rasaṃ vā'pi vaiṣkiraṃ hāriṇaṃ tathā | śālibhiḥ ṣaṣṭikaiḥ svalpaṃ masūrairvāpi bhojayet ||43|| śītaiḥ saṃgrāhibhirdravyaiḥ kuryāt saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhiṣak | Dī. tasya vamanaṃ mṛdu kārayet | tasya virekārditasya vamanaṃ mṛdu kārayet | kiṃ kṛtvā ? śītāmbubhiḥ śītajalaiḥ śarīraṃ siktvā siñcayitvā | taṇḍulāmbubhiriti | taṇḍuladhāvanodakaiḥ | madhumiśrairiti | taṇḍuladhāvanairmadhumiśrairityarthaḥ | śītairiti | śītavīryadravyairlepamāha - sahakāratvaca ityādi | sahakāra āmraḥ tasya tvacaḥ kalkaḥ dadhnā sauvīrakeṇa kāñjikabhedena peṣayitvā nābhipralepena ulbaṇamatīsāraṃ hanyāt | bhojanamāha - ajākṣīramityādi | kṣīrādikaṃ raktaśālibhiḥ ṣaṣṭikairvā saha bhojayet | kṣīrasya kevalasyā'pi pānamāhureke saṃgrāhakatvāt | rasaṃ māṃsarasaṃ, vaiṣkiraṃ hāriṇaṃ vā | viṣkirā lāvatittirādayaḥ | śālibhiriti raktaśālyādibhiḥ | ṣaṣṭikairiti prasiddhaiḥ | svalpamityanena bhṛṣṭataṇḍulabhavaṃ śāktukamapi deyaṃ | masūrairapi svalpaṃ bhojanaṃ deyam | svalpamajīrṇabhayāt | athavā śītaiḥ śītavīryairdravyaiḥ saṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt iti || 41-43 || Gū. ativiriktopadrave pratīkāramāha - tasya śītāmbubhiḥ śītajalai: śarīraṃ siktaṃ sevitaṃ kuryāt | tathā madhumiśraistaṇḍulāmbubhirmṛdu vamanaṃ kārayet | pratīkārāntaramāha - sahakāraḥ āmraḥ tasya tvacaḥ dadhnā sauvīraṃ kāñjikaṃ tena piṣṭvā lepayet | sa lepaḥ ulvaṇamatīsāraṃ hanti | atirekagrahaṇārthaṃ pathyamāha - śīteḥ saṃgrāhibhirdravyaiḥ saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhiṣak kuryāt, ajākṣīraṃ pāyayet tathā hāriṇaṃ hariṇamāṃsajaṃ rasaṃ vaiṣkiraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ māṃsarasaṃ vā ṣaṣṭikaiḥ śālibhirmasūrairvā bhojayet | svalpaṃ tuccham | tathā śuṇṭhyādibhiḥ śītairdravyairdāḍimādyairbhiṣak saṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt || 41-43 || samyagviriktasya pācanādiprakāramāha - lāghavaṃ manasastuṣṭiranulomaṃ gate'nile || 44|| suviriktaṃ naraṃ jñātvā pācanaṃ pāyayenniśi | Dī. lāghavaṃ śarīrasyeti | manasastuṣṭiriti | cittasaṃtoṣaḥ | anile vāyau anulomam adhobhāgaṃ gate sati etādṛśalakṣaṇena suviriktaṃ naraṃ jānīyāt | evaṃ jñātvā tasyā'pi pācanaṃ niśi dadyāt | pācanamaśeṣasyātra boddhavyaṃ | tacca mudgayūṣādikamityeke | yaduktaṃ ‘virecanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dadhyannaṃ stambhane hitam | āmānte ca pradātavyamanyathā mudgamūṣaka’miti | kecittu pācanaṃ pāyayenniśītipadaṃ vinā paṭhanti na tu samyagviriktasyāyameva kramaḥ | yathāprāptiśca viṭpittakaphānilā na samyagviriktasya bhaveyuḥ krameṇeti | na caivaṃ kaphāntapadavyāghātaḥ | tena pācanapādaḥ keṣāṃcinmanoharaṃ | yato vāyurhi niḥśeṣaṃ kaphe kṛte āmāśaye śūnyatayā kevalaḥ saratīti | yadvā ācāryeṇa padapūraṇārthaṃ likhitam | tenāsyā'nyo'bhiprāyaḥ | pācanaṃ rātrāvevetyarthaḥ || 44|| Gū. idānīṃ suviriktalakṣaṇamāha - dehasya lāghave sati manaḥ saṃtuṣṭyāṃ satyām anile vāyau anulomaṃ gate svamārge prāpte sati lakṣaṇairnaraṃ suviriktaṃ jñātvā niśi pācanaṃ eraṇḍaśuṇṭhīdhānyajaṃ pāyayet || 44 || virecanasya phalamāha -- indriyāṇāṃ balaṃ buddheḥ prasādaṃ vahnidīpanam || 45 || dhātusthairyaṃ vaya:sthairyaṃ bhavedrecanasevanāt | Dī. indriyāṇāmiti | cakṣurādīnāṃ balaṃ svasvaviṣayagrāhakatāśaktyatiśayaḥ | buddheḥ prasādaḥ prasannatā, vahneḥ kāyāgneḥ dīpanaṃ bhavati | dhātūnāṃ rasādīnāṃ sthairyaṃ mārgasya śuddhatvāt | tenaiva hetunā vayasaḥ sthairyaṃ karoti | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘buddheḥ prasādaṃ balamindriyāṇāṃ dhātusthiratvaṃ jvalanasya dīptiḥ | cirācca pākaṃ, vayasaḥ karoti saṃśodhanaṃ samyagupāsyamānam’ iti ||45|| Gū. recanasevanātkiṃ bhavati ? ityāha - indriyāṇāṃ netrādīnāṃ balaṃ sthairyaṃ buddheḥ prasādam || 45 || kṛtavirecanasya pravātādīn niṣedhayati - pradātasevāśītāmbusnehābhyaṅgamajīrṇatām || 46 || vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ caiva na seveta virecitaḥ | Dī. virecitaḥ kṛtavirecanaḥ pravātasevādīn na seveta, prakṛṣṭavātasevanaṃ tasya ca doṣakaratvāt | śītāmbusevanaṃ srotorodhādikāraṇāt | snehābhyaṅgasyāgnimāndyakaratvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘varjyo'bhyaṅgaḥ kaphagrastastathāsaṃśuṣyajīrṇibhiḥ’ iti | cakārāt kṣaṇajāgaraṇavegānāṃ ca rodhanaṃ krodhaśokahimātapātibhāṣyatyāsanasaṃsthitinīcātyuccopavidhānāhaḥsvapnāni ||46|| Gū. virecananiṣedhavargamāha - virekataḥ pravātasevādyaṃ na seveta ityanvayaḥ || 46 || atha viriktasya pathyārthaṃ peyādi dravyāṇyāha - śāliṣaṣṭikamudgādyairyavāgūṃ bhojayetkṛtām || 47 || jaṅghālaviṣkirāṇāṃ vā rasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharapraṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe virecanavidhirnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || Dī. yavāgūśabdaḥ peyādyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ | tena śālyādibhiḥ kṛtāḥ peyādayo sevyāḥ | sā yavāgū: nānāvidhaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā | tathā jaṅghālaviṣkirāṇāṃ rasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitam | uktaṃ ca -‘krameṇānena bhuñjāno bhajetprakṛtibhojanam’ iti | saṃśodhane peyādikrama eva hitaḥ | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe -‘śodhanāsravavisrāvasnehayojanalaṅghanaiḥ | yātyagnirmandatāṃ tasmātkramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet’ | sa ca yathā - ‘peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīnubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro'nnakālānpradhānasādhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ’ iti | tatra jaṅghālā hariṇaiṇādayaḥ | viṣkirā lāvatittirādayaḥ | pradhānaśuddhyā śuddhaḥ puruṣaḥ trīn, annakālān peyādīn seveta | madhyaśuddhyā śuddhaḥ dvau dvau annakālau | avaraśuddhyā śuddhaḥ ekaikamannakālaṃ peyādikaṃ seveta iti || 47 || iti śrīvāstatryānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe virecādhyāya:|| Gū. vireke pathyavargamāha - virekānantaraṃ śālyādibhiḥ kṛtāṃ yavāgūṃ bhojayet jāṅgalairjāṅgalamāṃsarasairviṣkirāṇāṃ viṣkirasaṃjñānāṃ vā māṃsarasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitaṃ bhavati | virekauṣadhipīte asamyagvireke punaḥ kriyāmāha vireko nikṣepakaḥ || 47 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadhara- gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi virecanādhyāyaḥ || 4 || Editor's notes 1 cakārāt pittasaṃyoge'pi pittolbaṇe yojyam - uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘kaphe vidadhyādvamanaṃ saṃyāge vā kapholbeṇe | tadvadvirecanaṃ pitte’ iti | ↩ 2 bahuṣu pustakeṣu mūlapāṭhe nāyaṃ ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ | ↩ 3 dīpikā'saṃmata:| ↩

title: 5. atha snehabastividhiradhyāyaḥ
text: atha bastividhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - atha bastividhiḥ | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - ‘pañcakarma vamī, reko, nirūho'nvāsa-nāvanam’ iti | vamanavirekayoruktatvātpāriśeṣyādvastividhimāha - bastirdvidhānuvāsākhyo nirūhaśca tataḥ param | bastibhirdīyate vasmāttasmādvastiriti smṛtaḥ || 1 || Dī. bastirdvidhā dviprakāraḥ, eko'nuvāsanākhyaḥ, dvitīyo nirūhasaṃjña: | bastiniruktimāha - yasmādbastibhiścarmapuṭakairdīyate tasmādbastiḥ || 1|| Gū. virekānantaraṃ bastividhānādvastividhānamāha - bastiryasmādbastibhirdīyate gudadeśe tasmādbastiriti smṛtaḥ | bastibhireraṇḍakośādyaiḥ tadvakṣyati | sa bastirdvidhā eko'nuvāsākhyaḥ aparo nirūhākhyaḥ || 1 || tayorlakṣaṇamāha - yaḥ snehairdīyate sa syādanuvāsananāmakaḥ | kaṣāya-kṣīra-tailairyo nirūhaḥ sa nigadyate || 2 || Dī. athānurāsananirūhayoḥ saṃprāptimāha - snehaiḥ pakvasnehai: yaḥ dīyate so'nuvāsākhyaḥ | yaḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ sa nirūho nigadyate | nirūhaḥ basterbheda evāsthāpanakṣīrakaṣāyādibhirevāyaṃ dīyate || 2 || Gū. yaḥ snehaistailādyai: dīyate so'nuvāsanākhyaḥ, aparo yaḥ kaṣāyādyairdīyate sa nirūha: | anuvāsanaṃ kevalatailaina dīyate, nirūhe kaṣāyakṣīramiśritaṃ tailam ataḥ pūrvasmādbhinnaḥ || 2 || athānuvāsanādīnāmanukramavidhānamāha -- tatrānuvāsanākhyo hi bastiryaḥ so'tra kathyate | pūrvameva tato bastirnirūhākhyo bhaviṣyati || 3 || nirūhāduttaraṃ caiva bastiḥ syāduttarābhidhaḥ | Dī. tatra teṣu bastiṣu madhye yaḥ anuvāsananāmā bastiḥ sa pūrvamevā'trā'dhyāye kathyate | pūrvameveti sambandhaḥ | tata iti | anuvāsanānantaraṃ nirūhākhyaḥ bastirbhaviṣyati | kathayiṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ | nirūhāduttaraṃ nirūhabasteranantaram uttarābhidhaḥ uttaranāmā bastiḥ kathayiṣyata iti sambandhaḥ tena traya evādhyāyāḥ pṛthak jñātavyāḥ | yadvā pūrvamevānuvāsanabastiḥ kāryaḥ | tatpaścānnirūhabastiḥ kāryaḥ | tadanu uttarabastiriti | iti kramaviṣayānukramaḥ | tathāhi - ‘basteḥ snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścānnirūhayet’ ityādivacanāt ||3|| Gū. tayoḥ kathanapratijñāmāha - pūrvaṃ prathamataḥ anuvāsanākhyo yo bastiḥ so'tra kathyate tasmādanantaraṃ nirūhākhyo bastirbhaviṣyati nirūhāgre uttarābhidhaḥ uttarākhyabastirbhaviṣyati || 3 || athavā kathanakrameṇaiva bastiranuvāsanabheda eva ityata āha - anuvāsanabhedaśca mātrā bastirudīritaḥ || 4 || Dī. mātrākṛtabhedatvānmātrābastiḥ || 4 || Gū. anuvāsanabheda eva mātrābastirudīritaḥ kathitaḥ | ete catvāro bastibhedabhedāḥ || 4 || tasya mātrāmāha - paladvayaṃ tasya mātrā tasmādardhā'pi vā bhavet | Dī. tasyeti mātrā basteḥ paladvayaṃ dvipalapramāṇaṃ | tasmāditi dvipalārdhapalapramāṇamātrā bhavet | etenāyamartha: saṃpannaḥ yasyottamā palādimātrārhati tasya dvipalāṃ prathamaṃ | tataḥ palārdhena vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhirdinaiḥ ṣaṭpalī mātrā pūrṇā bhavati | tathā yasya tripalī mātrārhati tasya palaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ tataśca karṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhirdinaiḥ tripalī mātrā bhavati | evaṃ kanīyasī mātrā'pi jñeyā sāpi vāgrahaṇādboddhavyā | tā mātrā agre prakaṭayiṣyati granthakṛt || Gū. teṣāṃ mātrāmāha - tasya basteḥ snehādīnāṃ mātrā paladvayaṃ tasmādardhaṃ vā palaṃ bhavet || anuvāsanayogyāḥ | anuvāsyastu rūkṣaḥ syāttīkṣṇāgniḥ kevalānilī ||5|| Dī. athānuvāsanayogamāha rūkṣaḥ puruṣo'nuvāsana anuvāsanayogya ityarthaḥ | tīkṣṇāgniriti bhasmakākhyavahniyutaḥ | kevalānilīti | nanu ‘bastirvāte ca pitte ca kaphe caiva hi śasyate | saṃsarge sannipāte ca bastireva hitaḥ sade’tyādivacanātkathaṃ kevalānilī anuvāsya iti | ucyate | trīnapi doṣān pakvāśayagatān bastirjayati | āmāśayagatabastiḥ pacyamānā saṃyogaṃ taṃ pittavirekaḥ | iti paramaṃ matpūrvapakkasiddhāntaḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ‘pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pittāśayagataṃ haret | asanaṃ trīn malān bastirjayet pakkāśayasthitān’ iti | evaṃ raktamapi duṣṭaraktaprasādanivṛtto bastiḥ prasādayati | svamate tu kevalānilītyasya samādhānametat | tadyathā āsthāpanānuvāsanaṃ khalu sarvopakramebhyo vāte pradhānatamaṃ | rogaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ boddhavyamityadoṣaḥ | anyadapi samādhānaṃ savistaraṃ tadatra vistarabha yānna likhitaṃ || 5 || Gū. anuvāsanayogyamāha - rūkṣaḥ snehapānarahitaḥ pumān anuvāsyaḥ syāt | tathā tīkṣṇāgnirvṛddhāgniḥ | tathā kevalānilīti kevalavātarogavān | evaṃbhūta anuvāsyaḥ anuvāsanayogyaḥ syāt || 5 || athānuvāsane ye tyājyāstānāha - nānuvāsyastu kuṣṭhī syānmehī sthūlastathodarī | nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāścājīrṇonmādatṛḍarditāḥ ||6|| śokamūrcchārucibhayaśvāsakāsakṣayāturāḥ | Dī. kuṣṭhī tathā pramehī sthūlo medasvī tathā udarī ca ete'nuvāsyā na bhavantītyarthaḥ | tu punariti grahaṇāt ete tu āsthāpanīyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | yaduktamanyatrāpi - ‘udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaśca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyāste nānuvāsyāḥ kathaṃcane’ti | atha ye tūbhayakarmarahitāstānāha - jīrṇeti | anirvārdhakyatvādvyāptaśarīrāḥ | ‘nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāste'jīrṇonmādatṛḍarditāḥ’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ | atra ajīrṇārdita ityarthaḥ | ajīrṇamatrāmaṃ vidigdhaṃ vā na tu viṣṭabdhājīrṇaṃ | tatra tu vihitamevetyeke | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 6 || Gū. anuvāsanāyogyānāha - kuṣṭhī mehī sthūlastathā udarī na anuvāsya: na anuvāsanayogyaḥ | anye ye nānuvāsyāstānāha - ete'pi ajīrṇyādayo'nuvāsyā na syu: yathāsthitasthāpanīyāḥ | tathāca suśrute - ’udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaśca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyāśca nānu'vāsyā kathaṃcana’ iti ||6|| bastikaraṇadravyāṇi - netraṃ kāryaṃ suvarṇādidhātubhirvṛkṣaveṇubhiḥ || 7 || nalairdantairviṣāṇāgrairmaṇibhirvā vidhīyate | ekavarṣāttu ṣaḍvarṣaṃ yāvanmānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam || 8 || tato dvādaśakaṃ yāvanmānaṃ syādaṣṭasaṃmitam | tataḥ paraṃ dvādaśabhiraṅgulairnetradīrghatā || 9 || mudgacchidraṃ kalāyāmaṃ chidraṃ kolāsthisaṃnibham | yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavennetraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ gopucchasannibham || 10|| āturāṅguṣṭhamānena mūle sthūlaṃ vidhīyate | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhamagre ca guṭikāmukham || 11 || tanmūle karṇike dve ca kārye bhāgāccaturthakāt | yojayettatra bastiṃ ca bandhadvayavidhānataḥ || 12 || mṛgājaśūkaragavāṃ mahiṣasyāpi vā bhavet | mūtrakoṣasya bastistu tadalābhena carmajaḥ || 13 || kaṣāyaraktaḥ sumṛdurbastiḥ snigdho dṛḍho hitaḥ | vraṇabastestu netraṃ syācchlakṣṇamaṣṭāṅgulonmitam || 14|| mudgacchidraṃ gṛdhrapakṣanalikāpariṇāhi ca | Dī. netramityādi | netraṃ yantraṃ bastigatasnehakaṣāyādidravyaṃ nayanaṃ cārutvānnetramiti saṃjñā | kimarthaṃ bastividhānārthaṃ bastidārḍhyārthaṃ | tacca suvarṇādidhātubhirvidhīyate kriyate | ādigrahaṇādraupyatāmratrapulohādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tathā veṇvādibhirveṇurvaṃśaḥ | nalairnalikādibhiḥ tṛṇaviśeṣajātaiḥ | dantairhastidantaiḥ | viṣāṇāgrairiti śṛṅgāgraiḥ | uparitanasūkṣmabhāgaiḥ| maṇibhirmarakatapuṣparāgavaiḍūryādibhiḥ | etena śuddhapāṣāṇairapi vidhīyata iti sampradāyaḥ | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena - ‘suvarṇarūpyatraputāmrarītikāṃsyāya sāsphigdrumaveṇudantaiḥ | nalairviṣāṇairmaṇibhiśca taistaiḥ kāryāṇi netrāṇi trikarṇikāni | ṣaḍdvādaśāṣṭāṅgulasaṃmitāni ṣaḍṃviśatidvādaśavarṣajānām | syurmudgakarkandhusatīnavāhi chidrāṇi vartyā pihitāni cāpi | yathāvayo'ṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ mūlāgrayoḥ syu: pariṇāhavanti | ṛjūni gopucchasamākṛtīni ślakṣṇāni vā syurguṭikāmukhāni | syātkarṇikaikāgracaturthabhāge mūlāśrite bandhanibandhane dve | jaradgavo māhiṣahāriṇo vā syācchaukaro bastirajasya vā'pi’ iti ( ca. saṃ. 3) | sphigasthi | atha netraparimāṇamāha - ekavarṣāditi | ekavarṣātprathamavarṣātṣaḍvarṣaṃ yāvat tāvanmānaṃ netrasya ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmānaṃ ṣaḍvarṣam, etatparimāṇamāyāmena kathitaṃ | ṣaḍvarṣādūrdhvaṃ yāvat dvādaśavarṣāṇi tāvannetrāyāmaparimāṇaṃ daśāṅgulam | eke - ‘mānaṃ syādaṣṭasaṃmitam’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tataḥ paramiti dvādaśavarṣādārabhya yāvadviṃśativarṣāṇi tāvaddvādaśāṅgulaṃ netrāyāmam, ataḥ paraṃ netrāyāmatā nāstītyuktatvāt | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘ūne'bde pañcapūrṇe'sminnā saptabhyo'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ | saptame sapta tānyaṣṭau dvādaśe ṣoḍaśe nava | dvādaśaiva paraṃ viśādvīkṣya varṣāntareṣu ca | vayo balaśarīrāṇi pramāṇamabhivardhayet’ iti | atha netrāgrarandhraparimāṇamāha - mudgetyādi | ṣaḍaṅgulanetrasya mudgapramāṇaṃ ākāreṇa vartulatvāt | tacca svinnam, evaṃ māṣādirapi khinnameva | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘mudga māṣaṃ kalāyānnaṃ svinnaṃ karkandhukaṃ kramāt’ iti | kaṣāyo'tra vartulakalāyaḥ satīnasaṃjña | yathāsaṃkhyamiti krameṇa ityarthaḥ | tacca netraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ komalaṃ | gopucchākāramiti | ākāreṇa āturāṅguṣṭhamānena mūlasthūlam | mūlamatra carmabandhanamukham | agre ca netrāgre kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāhatā jñeyā | agre iti gudāsannihitamukhe | guṭikāmukhamiti | tadagramukhe ca guṭikā kāryā vartulā ityarthaṃ: | tanmūle iti | netrasya mūle carmalagnamukhe dve karṇike kārye | karṇikā mekhalāśabdavācyā yayoścarmapuṭakāgraṃ saṃnahyate | ata evāha - ‘yojayettatra bastiṃ ca bandhadvayavidhānata’ iti | dvābhyāṃ bandhanābhyāṃ netre bastiṃ badhvā gudādau yojayetpraveśayedityarthaḥ | caturthabhāgādityādi | etena uttaramukhe caturthabhāgaparyantam ekā karṇikā kāryā iti vaidyasampradāyaḥ | tatastāṃ maryādīkṛtya gudamadhye praveśayedityarthaḥ | uktaṃca cakradatte - ‘syātkarṇe cāgracaturthabhāge mūlāśrite bastinibandhane dve’ ityādi | bastinetrakaraṇadravyaprasaṃgādvraṇabastimāha - tu punaḥ vraṇabasteḥ, vraṇo nāḍīvraṇaḥ tannimittaṃ yannetraṃ yantraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ komalaṃ tathā'ṣṭāṅgulonmitaṃ parimāṇaṃ netraṃ kāryam | etacca pūrvoktabastidravyasya mudgacchidraṃ nalikāyantraṃ sacchidraṃ bahīrandhraṃ kāryam | tathā gṛdhrapakṣanalikāpariṇāhi, tena nalikāpariṇāhamānamuktam || 7-14 || Gū. bastimukhasthāpanārthaṃ suvarṇādīnāṃ netramāha - netraṃ gudapraveśanalikārūpaṃ suvarṇādidhātubhiḥ kāryaṃ tathā vṛkṣaveṇubhiḥ veṇurvaṃśaḥ tathānalairdantaiḥ hastidantaiḥ viṣāṇaḥ ślakṣṇastadagrabhūtairmaṇibhiḥ sūryakāntādibhirvā vidhīyate | vayaḥpramāṇe netrapramāṇamāha - ekavarṣādārabhya yāvat ṣaḍvarṣaṃ tāvat ṣaḍaṅgulamātraṃ bhavati | tataḥ ṣaḍvarṣādyāvat dvādaśavarṣaṃ syāttāvadaṣṭasaṃmitam aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaṃ netraṃ syāt | tataḥ paraṃ dvādaśavarṣānantaraṃ dvādaśabhiraṅgulairnetraṃ īryatāṃ prāpyatāṃ tasya yādṛśaṃ chidraṃ bhavati tādṛśamāha mṛducchidraṃ netraṃ kalāpo vartulakaḥ tatsadṛśaṃ punaḥ kolāsthisannibhaṃ kolaṃ badaraṃ tadasthisadṛśaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ caturaṅgulādipramāṇaṃ bhavet | punaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ cikkaṇaṃ punargopucchasannibhaṃ gopucchākāraṃ mūle sthūlam agre sūkṣmaṃ mūle sthūlaṃ tu mānena aṅguṣṭhākāraṃ vidhīyate kriyate agre kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāham - agrabhāge kaniṣṭhikāṅgulisthūlaṃ tathā guṭikāmukhaṃ vartulaṃ tanmūle caturthakān bhāgān dve karṇike kārye karṇike kamalapatrākāre | bandhadvayavidhānataḥ bandhadvayayogataḥ tatra bastiṃ yojayet | bastiḥ kasya mūtrakośasya bhavatītyāha - mūtrakośo'ṇḍastasya bastiḥ | sa mūtrakośo mṛgādīnāṃ bhavati tadalābhena cāṇḍalābho carmajo'pi bhavati | kiṃbhūto bastiḥ kaṣāyaraktaḥ kaṣāyeṇa badaryādicūrṇakaṣāyeṇa raktaḥ rañjitaḥ mṛdu komalaḥ snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ dṛḍho navaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ | vraṇabasteśca pramāṇamāha - vraṇasya śarīrādervraṇasya yo bastistasya evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ syāt | ślakṣṇaṃ cikkaṇam aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tathā mudgacchidraṃ tathā gṛdhrapakṣanalikācchidradīrgham || 7-14 || bastisevāguṇānāha - śarīropacayaṃ varṇaṃ balamārogyamāyuṣaḥ || 15 || kurute parivṛddhiṃ ca bastiḥ samyagupāsitaḥ | Dī. samyaktayā yathoktatayā upāsita: sevito bastiḥ śarīropacayādīn kurute | uktaṃ ca - ‘bastirvayaḥ sthāpayitā sukhāyurvarṇāgnimedhāsvaravarṇakṛcca | sarvārthakārī śiśuvṛddhayūnāṃ niratyayaḥ sarvagadāpahaśca’ iti | suśrute'pi - ‘vīryeṇa bastirādatte doṣānāpādamastakāt | pakvāśayasthaḥ svastho'rkaścāpo yadvanmahītalāt’ iti | atha basteḥ sevāphalamāha | vidhikramaṃ tu tantrāntare'pyuktam | yathā ‘dattastu prathamo basti: snehayedvastivaṃkṣaṇau | samyagdatto dvitīyastu koṣṭhasthamanilaṃ jayet | balavarṇau ca janayet tṛtīyastu prayojitaḥ | raktaṃ caturthaḥ paṃcamaḥ snehayenmāṃsamedasaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḥ snihyati sarvatra saptamo'pi tathā mataḥ | aṣṭamo navamaścaiva vasāmajjānameva ca | evamuktaṃ tān doṣāddviguṇaṃ sādhayediti || 15 || Gū. samyagupāsito bastiḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha -- śarīropacayaṃ, sthaulyaṃ, balaṃ, varṇam, ārogyam, āyuṣaḥ vṛddhiṃ ca kurute || 15 || atha basteḥ kālaniyamamāha - divā śīte vasante ca snehabastiḥ pradīyate || 16 || grīṣmavarṣāśaratkāle rātrau syādanuvāsanam | na cātisnigdhamaśanaṃ bhojayitvā'nuvāsayet ||17|| madaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayedvidhisnehaḥ prayojitaḥ | rūkṣaṃ bhuktavato'tyannaṃ balaṃ varṇaṃ ca dīyate || 18 || Dī. śīte hemantaśiśirākhye vasante ca | snehe bastirdivā divase pradīyate na tu rātrau atiśītārditatvāt | yaduktaṃ - ‘uṣṇābhibhūteṣu tathātiśītān śītābhibhūteṣu tathā sukhoṣṇān | tatpratyanīkeṣu samaṃ prayuktān sarvatra bastīnpravibhajya dadyā’diti | rātrau syādanuvāsanamiti | kasmin samaye grīṣmavarṣāśaratkāle iti | anuvāsūno nirūhāṃgatvena yasya ca virecanaṃ nocitaṃ sañcitaṃ ca malaṃ, bastiṃ tasya ca tanmalāpagamārthaṃ kṣīravaitaraṇaṃ vā bastiṃ datvānuvāsanaṃ deyaṃ | triśuddhasya snehabastyupadeśāt | taduktaṃ - ‘snehabastirvidheyastu nāviśuddhasya dehina’ iti | kṛtāhārāyānuvāsanaṃ deyamityukte'tisnigdhabhojane'nuvāsanaṃ niṣiddham | tadāha - ‘dvidhā prayojitaḥ sneha iti’ sugamaḥ || 16-18 || Gū. bastiḥ kadā śasyate ? ityāha - snehabasti: vasante divasānte dīyate grīṣmādau anuvāsanaṃ rātrau syāt | atisnigdham asamaṃ bhojayitvā na anuvāsayet | dvidhā prayojitaḥ snehaḥ madaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayet ||16-18|| atha basterhīnātimātrayorniṣedhamāha - hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau smṛtau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || 19 || Dī. ubhau bastīti | anuvāsananirūhākhyau āsthāpanānuvāsanāvityeke || 19 || Gū. hīnamātrau atimātrau bastī kāryakarau na ityāha - hīneti | ubhau anuvāsananirūhākhyau hīnamātrau mātrā'lpau atikāryakarau na | atimātrau tau klamātīsārakārakau bhavataḥ mātrāyā basterbahuphalatvāt || 19|| bastimātrā uttamasya palaiḥ ṣaḍbhirmadhyamasya palaistribhiḥ | palasyārdhena hīnasya yuktā mātrā'nuvāsane || 20 || Dī. atha ca mātrāvidhānamāha - uttamasyeti | balānalādibhiruttamasya puruṣasya | evaṃ madhyamahīnayorboddhavyam | asyābhiprāyamāha - yasyottamā ṣaṭpalā mātrārhati tasya dvipalaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ | tataśca karṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhirdinaistripalā mātrā syāt | kanīyasī yasya mātrā sārdhā palamātrānvitā tasya prathamamardhapalocitaṃ | tato vṛddhiraṣṭamāṣakaireva navabhirdinaiḥ sārdhapalaṃ syāt | navadinadānamuktaṃ tenāto'rvāgapi snehalakṣaṇodaye'nuvāsananivṛttiḥ kāryā | yaduktaṃ - ‘prasṛtasya palārdhena palasyāpi punastathā | palārdhaṃ sārdhakarṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ kāryāyathākramam’ | kramo yathā taduktaṃ - ‘prāgdānamādye dvipalaṃ palārdhaṃ vṛddhirdvitīye palamasya vṛddhiḥ | karṣadvayenaiva samāṣavṛddhirbastau tṛtīye krama eṣa ukta’ iti | iyaṃ mātrā dravaviṣaye || 20|| Gū. uttamādimātrāmāha - anuvāsane iyaṃ mātrā yuktā | uttamasya uttamabalapuruṣasya ṣadbhiḥ palaiḥ, madhyamasya madhyabalasya tribhiḥ palaiḥ sārdhapalena hīnasya hīnabalasya mātrā anuvāsane yuktā | ardhāpi vā bhavediti yaduktaṃ ‘paladvayaṃ tasya mātrā tasmādardhā'pi vā bhavet’ iti yuktaṃ tanmātrābastiviṣayaṃ natvanuvāsanaviṣayam || 20 || sa ca snehaḥ kenopahito deyaḥ ? ityāha - śatāhvā saindhavābhyāṃ ca deyaṃ snehe ca cūrṇakam | tanmātrottamamadhyāntā ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakaiḥ || 21|| Dī. śatāhvāsaindhavacūrṇasya māṣaparimāṇena pracāraḥ | tatra snehasya palamānam iti pakṣāntaramityeke | yataḥ cūrṇaṃ māṣaḥ pale snehe sindhu janmaśatāhvayorityādivacanāt | etena kimuktaṃ yasyaiva anuvāsano deyastasya kadācit antaḥkṣayaṃ vrajedityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi yasyaivaṃ vānuvāsaḥ syāt sakṛdantaḥkṣayaṃ vrajediti paramārthatastu uttamamadhyamādhameṣu ṣaṭcatvāraḥ dvau ca māṣakā yathākramaṃ jñeyāḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘devadāruvacārāsnāśatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ | ataścūrṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakai’riti || 21 || Gū. snehe saindhavaśatāhvāpramāṇamāha - snehe taile śatāhvāsaindhavacūrṇaṃ kiṃpramāṇaṃ deyaṃ tadāha tanmātrā ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakaiḥ krameṇa uttamā ṣaṇmāṣā, madhmamā caturmāṣā, antyā kaniṣṭhā dvimāṣā etatpramāṇam || 21 || anuvāsanaviṣayamāha - virecanātsaptarātre gate jātabalāya ca | bhuktānnāyānuvāsyāya bastirdeyo'nuvāsanaḥ ||22|| athānuvāsyaṃ svabhyaktamuṣṇāmbusveditaṃ śanaiḥ | bhojayitvā yathāśāstraṃ kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ tataḥ ||23|| utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ yojayetsnehabastinā | suptasya vāmapārśvena vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ ||24 || kuñcitāparajaṅghasya netraṃ snigdhagude nyaset | vaddhvā bastimukhaṃ sūtrairvāmahastena dhārayet || 25 || pīḍayeddakṣiṇenaiva madhyavegena dhīradhīḥ | jṛmbhākāsakṣavādīṃśca bastikāle na kārayet ||26|| triṃśanmātrāmitaḥ kālaḥ prokto bastestu pīḍane | tataḥ praṇihitaḥ sneha uttāno vākśataṃ bhavet ||27|| jānumaṇḍalamāveṣṭya kuryācchoṭikayā yutam | ekā mātrā bhavedeṣā sarvatraiṣa viniścayaḥ. || 28 || prasāritaiḥ sarvagātrairyathāvīryaṃ visarpati | tāḍayettalayorenaṃ trīnvārāṃśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 29 || sphijoścaivaṃ tataḥ śroṇīṃ śayyāṃ caivotkṣipettataḥ | jāte vidhāne tu tataḥ kuryānnidrāṃ yathāsukham ||30|| Dī. virecanāditi | virecanāt saptarātre gate sati virecanadivasātprabhṛti saptarātraṃ yāvadbhavati tadupari anuvāsanaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | ata eva jātabalāya prāptabalāya balavate ityabhiprāyaḥ | bhuktānnāyeti kṛtabhojanāya | ānuvāsyāyeti anuvāsanayogyāya | eke bhuktānnāyānuvāsyāyetyasya sthāne kṛtāhārāya sāyamahni iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | athānuvāsanasya vidhiṃ vaktumāha - anuvāsyamiti | anuvāsanayogyam anuvāsyaṃ puruṣamiti śeṣaḥ | eke nirūhaviṣayamenamāmananti | tattu anuvāsyamityanena pūrvam anuvāsanaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛtyetyabhiprāyaḥ | yaduktam anuvāsitamabhyaktaṃ svinnadehaṃ nirūhayedityādi | bhojayitvā yathāśāstramityanenātibhojananiṣedho'vagantavyaḥ | utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtre dāpayet | viṇmūtramiti parityaktaviṇmūtrādikaṃ anyathā basterantaḥ - praveśo na bhavati | tathāhi - ‘utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtre nare bastiṃ nidhāpayet | anyathā nihito bastirnaivāntaḥ saṃprapadyata’ iti | yojayet snehabastineti vaidya iti śeṣaḥ | kecinnirūhabastiviṣayameveti vadanti tattu na samyak | kṛtānuvāsanasya nirūhasyoktatvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘anuvāsitamabhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ dehaṃ nirūhayet’ iti | atha bastiṃ kathaṃ yojayedityāha - suptasya vāmapārśveneti | suptasya śayānasya | bhāvini bhūtavadupacāraḥ | tena prathamaṃ jāgratastasya paścāt suptasyetyarthaḥ | śayane ityadhyāhāryam | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ muktaviṇmūtraṃ śayane sukhe | nātyucchrite na cocchiṣṭe saṃviṣṭe vāmapārśvataḥ || saṃkocya dakṣiṇaṃ sakthiṃ prasārya ca tato'param | athāsya netraṃ praṇayetsnigdhasvinnagude mukhe’ iti | vāmapārśveneti bastidānaṃ praśastaṃ bhavati | yaduktaṃ ‘vāmāśrayognirgrahaṇīgudaṃ ca tatpārśvasaṃsthasya sukhopalabdhiḥ | līyanta evaṃ valayaśca tasmāt savyaṃ śayāno'rhati bastidāna’miti | ata eva vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ puruṣasya kuñcitāparajaṅghasya | vāmajaṅghāyāṃ prasāritāyāṃ tadupari dakṣiṇajaṅghā ākuñcitā kāryā ityabhiprāyaḥ | netramiti vāme puṭakasahitaṃ nalikākāraṃ snigdhe gude iti snigdhasvinne gude gudamukhe | atha paścātkarmāha iti bastividhānādanantaraṃ snehe snehabastau praṇihite sthāpite | antaḥpraviṣṭe iti bhāvaḥ | uttānaḥ puruṣaḥ vākśataṃ yāvattiṣṭhet | te ca bastidānārthaṃ pūrvaṃ vāmapārśvaṃ bhūtvā paścādbastidāne kṛte sati bhūtvā vāṃchitaṃ yāvattiṣṭhedityabhiprāyaḥ | vākśatamiti choṭikāśataṃ | ‘tataḥ praṇihite snehe uttāne vāṃchitaṃ bhave’dityapi pāṭhaḥ | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | prasāritaiḥ sarvagātraiḥ kṛtvā yathā puruṣo bhavati tathā vastivīryaṃ prasarpatīti bhāvaḥ | asyāgre ‘ākuñcayecchanaistristriḥsakthibāhū tataḥ para’miti padadvayaṃ paṭhanti kecit | tanmate tu jaṅghābāhulatayorgṛhītvā trirutkṣipya saṃkocayet sakthibāhvākuñcanaṃ ca snehavīryavisarpaṇārtham | evaṃ hi śiromukhānāṃ sphuṭatvaṃ bhavati | tāḍayettalayorenamityādi | talayoriti hastapādatalayo: sphijośca tāḍanaṃ | basteḥ śīghragamanadhāraṇārtham | yaduktaṃ - dṛḍhabale ‘datvā sphijau pāṇitalena hanyāt snehasya śīghrāgamarakṣaṇārtha’miti | tata ityanenātra trivāragrahaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ | tena śayyāṃ trirutkṣipediti | śayyāṃ prati śroṇīstrirukṣipet ityarthaḥ | anenaiva carakoktagātramardanādikamapi yathecchasthitihetuḥ saṃgṛhyate | yaduktaṃ - ‘snehena pārṣṇyaṅgulipiṇḍikāśca ye vāsya gātrāvayavā rujārtāḥ | tāṃścāvamṛdyāt sasukhaṃ tataśca nidrāmupāsīta kṛtopadhāna’ iti | asyāgre tu ‘evaṃ praṇihite bastaumandāyāso'tha mandavāk | uttānāṅgo bhavettāvadyāvanmātrā śataṃ bhavediti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti | ‘kūrpare jānunī caiva kuryāt trīṇi gatāgataṃ | trikasarvalanāṃ vāpi kuryāddvāraṃ ca tantrita’ ityapi ślokaṃ paṭhanti, kecit | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘datte cottānadehasya pāṇinā tāḍayetsphijau | tatpārṣṇibhyāṃ tathā śayyāṃ pādataśca trirutkṣipet || tataḥ prasāritāṃgasya sopadhānasya pārṣṇike | āhanyānmuṣṭināṃgaṃ ca snehenābhyajya mardayet’ iti || tataḥ kiṃ kuryāt ? ityata āha - jāte iti | yathāsukhamityanenācārakakramaṃ smaran nidrāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘svāstīrṇe śayanaṃ kāmaṃ śayītācārake rataḥ’ iti || 22-30 || Gū. virecanādanuvāsanaḥ kadā dīyate ityāha - virecanāt saptarātre gate sati jātabalāya puruṣāya bhuktānnāya anuvāsyāya anuvāsanayogyāya anuvāsano bastirdeyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -‘pakṣādvireko vamite tataḥ pakṣānnirūhaṇaṃ | sadyo nirūḍhaścānvāsya saptarātrādvirecita’ iti | snehabastinā yena prakāreṇa yojayet tatprakāramāha - athānantaram anuvāsyam anuvāsanayogyaṃ puruṣaṃ svabhyaktaṃ kṛtasnehābhyaṅgaṃ punaḥ uṣṇāmbusveditaṃ snāpitaṃ bhojayitvā caṃkramaṇam itastataścalitaṃ punaḥ utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ niḥsṛtavātādyaṃ puruṣaṃ snehabastinā yojayet | yojanaprakāramāha - suptasyetyādi | vāmapārśvena suptasya vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ kuñcitāparajaṅghasya saṃkocitāparajaṅghasya snigdhe gude netraṃ vāmahastena dhārayet | dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇahastena pīḍayet madhyasthavegena madhyavegenetyarthaḥ | dhīraḥ dhairyavān punarbastidānakāle jṛmbhādīnna kārayet | kiyatparyantaṃ bastirdhāryā iti mātrāmāha -bastipīḍite triṃśanmātramitaḥ kālaḥ proktaḥ tataḥ praṇihitaḥ snehaśaḥ prātasneha uttānaḥ vākśataṃ vacanaśataṃ tiṣṭhet | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu jānviti jñeyaṃ prasāritairityādi | prasāritaiḥ sarvagātrairhastapādādikairyathā | vīryaṃ visarpati tathā enaṃ trīṃstalayostāḍayet | sphikpradeśe tāḍayet | tathā śroṇīrnitambaṃ tāḍayettataḥ śayyāṃ kṣipet sthāpayet | tataḥ vidhāne jāte nidrāṃ kārayet || 22-30 || samyaganuvāsitalakṣaṇamāha - sānilaḥ sapurīṣaśca snehaṃ pratyeti yasya vai | upadravaṃ vinā śīghraṃ sa samyaganuvāsitaḥ || 31|| Dī. yasya snehaḥ sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaḥ viṣṭhāsahitaḥ pratyeti niḥsarati | kathaṃ ? upadravaṃ vinā upadravo'tra ūṣacoṣādiḥ | ata eva kecidevaṃ paṭhanti - ‘ūṣacoṣau vinā śīghraṃ sa samyaganuvāsitam’ iti | ūṣaḥ prādeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣo vedanāviśeṣaḥ pipāsetyapare | suśrute'pyayameva pāṭhaḥ iti bhānumatī | śīghramiti yāmādūrdhvam || 31 || Gū. samyaganuvāsitasya lakṣaṇamāha - sānila ityādi | sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaśca yasya snehaḥ pratyeti gacchati upadravaṃ vinā samyaganuvāsito bhavatītyarthaḥ || 31 || snehāgate vidhimāha - jīrṇānnastvatha sāyāhne snehe pratyāgate punaḥ | laghvannaṃ bhojayet kāmaṃ dīptāgnistu naro yadi ||32|| Dī. srehe pratyāgate sati sadya iti jñeyaṃ, dīptāgniḥ sa naraḥ yadi tathā kāmaṃ bhojayet | sāyāhne pratyāgate laghvannaṃ bhojayet iti viṣamavibhāgaḥ | kecidapare'hni bhojayedityāhuḥ || 32 || anuvāsanavyāpattau pratīkāramāha - anuvāsitāya dātavyamitare'hni sukhodakam | dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā snehavyāpattināśanam ||33|| Dī. itare'hni aparadine sukhodakam uṣṇodakam | athavā dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā tadapi koṣṇaṃ dadyāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhāṭe - ‘prātarnāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ kevalameva ca’ iti | asyāgre kecitpaṭhanti - ‘ekāntaropayogena dhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | tanmate tu ekāntarānuvāsanaṃ, dhānyaśuṇṭhīkkātha: paradine prātaḥ deya iti | dhānyanāgarasiddhaṃ ca toyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā iti cakraḥ | koṣṇodakaṃ ca pittottare deyam | uktañca cakre - ‘kvāthārdhamātrayā prātardhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet | pittottare kaduṣṇāmbu tāvanmātraṃ pibedatha | tenāsya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti || 33 || Gū. snehānuvāsanānantaraṃ snehavyāpattiharaṇavidhānamāha - anuvāsitāya kṛtānuvāsanāya | itare'hni tadagrimadine sukhodakaṃ deyam | tatsnehavyāpattināśanaṃ bhavati | snehasya vā kācidvyāpattirvikriyārūpā || 33 || athoktaprakāramupasaṃharan bastidānasaṃkhyāmāha - anena vidhinā sapta cāṣṭau vātha navā'pi vā | vidheyā bastayasteṣāmantarā tu nirūhaṇam || 34|| (dattastu prathamo bastiḥ snehayet bastivaṃkṣaṇaiḥ | samyagdatto dvitīyastu mūrdhasthamanilaṃ jayet ||35|| balaṃ varṇaṃ ca janayettṛtīyastu prayojitaḥ | caturthapañcamau dattau snehayetāṃ rasāsṛjī || 36 || ṣaṣṭho māṃsaṃ snehayati saptamo meda eva ca | aṣṭamo navamaścāpi majjānaṃ ca yathākramam || 37 || evaṃ śukragatāndoṣāndviguṇaḥ sādhu sādhayet | aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakānbastīnāṃ yo niṣevate || 38 || sa kuñjarabalo'pyaśvaṃ jayettulyo'maraprabhaḥ | rūkṣāya bahuvātāya snehabastiṃ dine dine || 39 || dadyādvaidyastathānyeṣāmanyāṃ bādhāmapāharet | sneho'lpamātro rūkṣāṇāṃ dīrghakālamanatyayaḥ ||40|| tathā nirūhaḥ snigdhānāmalpamātraḥ praśasyate |) Dī. anena pūrvoktavidhineti | pūrvoktaprakāreṇa ṣaṭ, sapta, aṣṭau, nava bastayaḥ krameṇa vidheyāḥ yojyāḥ | kramo yathā kaphaje vikāre ṣaṭ, vāgrahaṇāt ekaḥ trayo vā prāptāḥ | pittātmake ca sapta aṣṭau vā | cakārātpañcagrahaṇaprāptiḥ | vāte nava iti vāgrahaṇādekādaśaprāptiḥ | nanu tantrāntare -‘rūkṣasya bahuvātasya dvau trīn vāpyanuvāsanam | datvā snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścānnirūhayet’ ityanena virodhaḥ tatkathamatra ṣaṭsaptādisaṃkhyā ? satyam, rūkṣasya bahuvātasya yadi mṛdukoṣṭhatvaṃ tadā dvau vā trayo vā snehabastayaḥ | ata eva ‘snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā’ iti kṛtavān | na tu snigdhatanutā dvitrisnehabastidānasya carake vihitatvāt | yathā - ‘ekaṃ tathā trīn kaphaje vikāre pittātmake pañca ca sapta vā'pi | vāte'pi caikādaśadhā punarvā bastīnayugmān kuśalo vidadhyāt’ iti | ucyate -ayugmadānaṃ svatantrānuvāsanaviṣayam na tu nirūhāṅgānuvāsanaviṣayaṃ | nirūhāṅgānuvāsane carakeṇā'pi yugmadānaṃ darśitam | yathā -‘trīn pañca vā caturo vā bastīn datvottaranirūhaṇaṃ vinā punaḥ snehadānena yugmān tathā kuryāditi darśayati nirūhāntaritaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | viṣayasaṃkhyopādānaṃ dvicaturādibasterapi madhyaviṣayaṃ parigrahārtham’ iti| rūkṣasyetyādividhānaṃ tu kṣīṇaviṣayabhedādavirodhaḥ | teṣāmantarā tu nirūhaṇamiti teṣāṃ snehanabastīnām antarā nirūhaṇaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikamevātra śīlayet | snehāt pittakaphotkleśau syātāṃ na pavanādbhayam| tasmānnirūho'nuvāso nirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ| naivaṃ pittakaphotkkeśau syātāṃ ca pavanādbhayam’ ||34-40|| Gū. vātādau kiyanto bastayo deyāstatpramāṇamāha - anena vidhinā pūrvoktavidhinā ṣaḍvā sapta vā aṣṭa vā nava vā etatpramāṇā bastayo deyāḥ | teṣāṃ bastīnāmantarā nirūhaṇaṃ vidheyam | vāgbhaṭe triṃśadbastayaḥ kathitāḥ | tathāca - ‘prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni tu | sānvāsakāni karmaiva bastayastriṃśadīritāḥ’ iti || 34-40 || nivṛtte'nuvāsane snehe punarapi anuvāsanamāha - athavā yasya tatkālaṃ sneho niryāti kevalaḥ ||41|| tasyānyo'lpataro deyo na hi snihyatyatiṣṭhati | aśuddhasya malonmiśra: sneho naiti yadā punaḥ ||42|| tadā śaithilyamādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaśca jāyate | pakvāśaye gurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyānnirūhaṇam || 43 || tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairyuktā phalavartirhitā tathā | yathānulomanaṃ vāyurmalaṃ snehaśca jāyate || 44 || yathā virecanaṃ dadyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate | yasya nopadravaṃ kuryātsnehabastiraniḥsṛtaḥ || 45 || sarvo'lpo vā vṛte raukṣyādupekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā | Dī. athavā anuvāsanasnehaḥ yasya puruṣasya tatkālaṃ śīghrameva niryāti tasya puruṣasyānyo'lpataro'nuvāsanasneho deyaḥ | kuta ityata āha - atiṣṭhati ityādi | atiṣṭhati snehena hi snihyati | alpatara iti pūrvadattāt | tantrāntare tu - ‘yasyānuvāsano dattaḥ sakṛdantaḥkṣayaṃ vrajet | atyuṣṇo vā'titīkṣṇo vā vāyunā vā prapīḍitaḥ || savāte caikamātro vā gurutvādvā subheṣajaḥ | tasyānyo'lpataro deyo nahi strihyatyatiṣṭhati’ iti | atra vāyunā iti koṣṭhasthena vātena ityarthaḥ | savāta iti | anucchvāsya vihitabandhādinā bastipuṭakasthitavāyusahite tu snehe mukhakaṣāyatā jṛmbhā vātarujastāstā vepathurviṣamajvara iti | atha ca snehānirgame'pi vidhānamāha - aśuddhasyeti | akṛtaśodhanasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | ata eva malonmiśraḥ sneha iti | tathāhi ‘snehabastirvidheyastu nāviśuddhasya dehinaḥ | snehavīryaṃ tathā datte dehenānuvisarpatī’ti | yadā naiti na pratyāgacchati sneha iti sambandhaḥ na tadā śithilāṅgādayo bhavanti | śithilasthāne sadanamiti pāṭhāntaram | tatra dadyānnirūhaṇamiti | tīkṣṇamiti nirūhamityasya viśeṣaṇam athavā tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ sadyuktyā phalavartirapyatra vihitā | pāṭhāntaro'pi ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairyuktā phalavartirhitā'thaveti’ phalavartistu vakṣyamāṇottarabastau draṣṭavyā | eke ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ siddhaṃ vāpyanuvāsanami’ti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | ‘yadyanulomanavāyuḥ malaṃ snehaśca jāyate | tadā virecanaṃ dadyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate |’ tīkṣṇaṃ virecanaṃ nasyaṃ ca tīkṣṇamityarthaḥ | athāniḥsṛto'pi bastirna vikārāya bhavatītyata āha - nopadravāmiti upadravo'tra rogaḥ sa ca mukhakaṣāyatvādikaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘upadravābhibhūteṣu snehe bastikaṣāyatā | jṛmbhāvātarujastāstā vepathurviṣamajvara’ iti | raukṣyāditi | śarīraraukṣyādasnigdhaḥ yato rūkṣaṃ śarīraṃ bhāvayettenopakṣīṇaḥ sa khalu snehaḥ tattenopadravaṃ karoti | ata evopekṣita ityuktaṃ | upekṣya iti | tanniḥsaraṇāya pratikriyāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | ‘anāyātaṃ tvahorātrāt snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | snehabastāvanāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate’ ||41-45|| Gū. athavā yasya puruṣasya snehastatkālaṃ niryāti na tiṣṭhati tasya anyo'nyatarastasmādanyo bastirdeyaḥ | sneho vā bastyantare | yadā sneho naiti tadā kiṃ kartavyamityāha - aśuddhasya vamanādiśuddhirahitasya malonmiśraḥ snehaḥ yadā na yāti tathā śaithilyam ādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaśca jāyate utpadyate tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha | tatra nirūhaṇaṃ dadyāt | anyadapi tatra dīyate tadāha | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhayuktaphalavarttirhitā yathā vāyuḥ anulomanam anulomanatvaṃ vāyuryāti malaṃ snehaśca jāyate tathā kāryamiti tathā virecanaṃ dadyāt | tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca tatra śasyate | snehabastiryatra upadravaṃ na kuryāttatra kiṃ vidhātavyamityāha - aniḥsṛtaḥ aniṣkāsitaḥ | snehabastiryasya upadravaṃ śvāsaśūlādikaṃ na kuryāt sarvaḥ alpaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ rokṣyādvijānatā sa upekṣyaḥ ciraṃ sthāpyaḥ || 41-45 || ahorātrādaniḥsṛte pratīkāramāha -- anāyātaṃ tvahorātre snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | snehabastāvanāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate || 46 || Dī. anāyātaṃ aniḥsṛtaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanaiḥ śodhanabastibhirharet | kecit śodhanairityatra sopadravamiti paṭhanti | tatropadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ | anyaḥ snehaḥ snehabastirna vidhīyate | snehābhibhavāt śodhanabastistu deyaḥ | anāyātamityasya ślokasyāgre adhikaṃ paṭhanti yathā - ‘kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ tu pāyayeccāmlasaṃyutam | auṣṇyāttaikṣṇyāt saratvācca bastiḥ so'syānulomayet gomūtreṇa tṛvṛtpathyākalkaṃ vātrānulomanam |’ ityādi pāṭho bahupustakeṣvadṛṣṭaḥ, tasmādasmābhirapi na vyākhyātaḥ | ‘nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyata’ ityatra ‘tābhyāṃ sekaḥ praśasyata’ iti kecitpāṭhaṃ paṭhanti || 46 || Gū. ahorātre yadā snehaṃ na yāti tadā kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha - ahorātre'nāyātaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | asnehabastau snehe anāyāte tadā tābhyāṃ sneho vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa sthāpyate || 46 || athānuvāsanārthaṃ guḍūcyāditailamāha - guḍūcyeraṇḍapūtīkabhārṅgīvṛṣakarohiṣam || 47 || śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palonmitām | yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthānprasṛtonmitān || 48 || caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca | pacettailāḍhakaṃ peṣyairjīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 49 || anuvāsanametaddhi sarvavātavikāranut | Dī. guḍūcyādīni kākanāsāntāni pratyekaṃ palonmitāni grāhyāṇi | tatra guḍūcī chinnaruhā, eraṇḍaḥ pañcāṅgulaḥ, pūtīkaḥ pūtikarañjaḥ, bhārṅgī dvijā, vṛṣo vāsakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ sugandhitṛṇaṃ, śatāvarī nārāyaṇī, sahacaraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ, kākanāsā prasiddhā iti | yavādīni prasiddhāni prasṛtonmitāni paladvayamitāni pratyekaṃ grāhyāṇi | tailāḍhakaṃ kṛṣṇatilasnehaḥ āḍhakamitaḥ peṣyai: jīvanīyaiḥ pūrvoktakalkīkṛtaiḥ pratyekaṃ palonmitaiḥ iti | jīvanīyagaṇo yathā - ‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyuk kākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ || iti || 47-49 || Gū. athānuvāsanatailamāha - pūtīkaḥ karañja:, vṛṣakaḥ āṭarūṣakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sahacaraḥ pītavāsā, kākanāsā kākajaṅghā, etāḥ palamitāḥ pratyekaṃ | yavādīn prasṛtonmitān paladvayonmitān | kolaṃ badaraṃ, jīvanīyairjīvanīyagaṇadravyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet | etadanuvāsanatailam || 47-49 || idānīṃ snehavyāpatcikitsāmāha ṣaṭsaptativyāpadastu jāyante bastikarmaṇā | dūṣitāt samudāyena tāścikitsyāstu suśrutāt ||50|| Dī. bastivyāpadaśca suśrutāccikitsyā ityata āha - asyāgre kecidadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā - snehapītasya vātasya viriktasya sṛtāsṛjaḥ | nirūḍhasya ca kāyāgnirmando bhavati dehinaḥ || sa cālpairlaghubhiścānnairupayuktairvivardhate | kāṣṭhairaṇubhiralpaiśca saṃdhukṣita ivānalaḥ || yukte'gnau jīvati ciraṃ rogī syādvikṛtiṃ gate | śānte pañcatvamāyāti dehī tasmādbalo'nalaḥ’ || iti | etadarthaṃ cikitsāpi - ‘prātaruṣṇodakaṃ deyaṃ dhānyanāgarasādhitam | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | snehapītasya ityādipāṭhaḥ kṣepaka iti kṛtvā asmābhirapi nātra vyākhyātaḥ ||50|| Gū. bastikarmaṇaḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ vyāpadaḥ rogā jāyante utpadyante | tāḥ vyāpadaḥ suśrutāt cikitsyāḥ | kiṃbhūtādbastikarmaṇaḥ | dūṣitāt taddoṣairduṣṭā bastikriyāyāḥ ||50|| anuvāsane pānādipathyamāha - pānāhāravihāraśca parihāraśca kṛtsnaśaḥ | snehapānasamāḥ kāryā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 51 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehabastividhirnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || Dī. snehapānasamā iti | ye pānā'hāravihārādaya: snehapānaviṣaye pūrvaṃ darśitāḥ, te'pyatra kramaśa: kāryāḥ | tenā'tra vicāraṇā na kāryā | āgamoktatvāt | pānādayo'pyatra tatratyā avagantavyāḥ | asyāgre paṭhanti, kecit - ‘aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakaṃ bastīnāṃ yo niṣevate | yathoktena vidhānena parihārakrameṇa ca || sa kuñjarabalo'śvatya javatulyo'maraprabhaḥ | nītivākyaśrutidharaḥ sahasrāyurnaro bhavet’ iti | anyadapi - ‘mūlasekādyathā vṛkṣa: snigdhaśca navapallava: | tathā bastipradānātsyānnara: kāntibalādimān’ iti || 51 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttare khaṇḍe bastividhiradhyāya: || Gū. pathyasaṃgrahamāha - pānāhāreti | sugamam || anuvāsananiruktimāha suśrutāt -‘anuvasannapi na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ nāpi na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ vā dīyate ityanuvāsanam’|| 51 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi anuvāsana- bastyadhikāraḥ || 5 || Editor's notes 1 tathāhi rudrabhaṭe na vistarato likhitaṃ - kevalānilīti kevalānilī cānuvāsya: | iti viruddhamivābhāti ta- nnāntarasaṃvādāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘vātolvaṇeṣu doṣeṣu vāte vā bastiriṣyate’ iti | suśrute'pi - ’bastivati pitte ca kaphe rakte ca śasyate | saṃsarge sannipāte ca
