cikitsā coktā suśrute - atha netre vicalite tathā caiva vivartite | gude kṣataṃ rujā vā syāttatra sadyaḥ kṣatakriyāḥ || atyutkṣipte'vasanne ca netre pāyau bhavedrujā | vidhiratrā'pi pittaghnaḥ kāryaḥ snehaiśca secanam || tiryakpraṇihite netre tathā pārśvāvapīḍite | mukhasyāvaraṇādbastirna samyakpratipadyate || ṛju netraṃ vidheyaṃ syāttatra samyagvijānatā | atisthūle karkaśe ca netre cāvanate tathā || gude bhavet kṣataṃ rukca sādhanaṃ pūrvavatsmṛtam | āsannakarṇike netre bhinne'ṇau vāpyapārthakaḥ || avaseko bhavedbastestasmāddoṣān vivarjayet | prakṛṣṭakarṇike raktaṃ gudamarmaprapīḍanāt || kṣaratyatrā'pi pittaghno vidhirbastiśca picchilaḥ | pratyāgacchaṃstataḥ kuryādrogān bastivighātajān || dīrghe mahāsrotasi ca jñeyamatyavapīḍavat | prastīrṇe bahale cāpi bastau durbaddhadoṣavat || bastāvalpe'lpatā vā'pi dravyasyā'lpaguṇā matāḥ | durbaddhe cāṇubhinne ca vijñeyaṃ bhinnanetravat || atiprapīḍito bastiḥ prayātyāmāśayaṃ tataḥ | vāterito nāsikābhyāṃ mukhato vā prapadyate || tatra tūrṇaṃ galāpīḍaṃ kuryāccāpyavadhūnanam | śiraḥkāyavirekau ca tīkṣṇau sekāṃśca śītalān || śanaiḥ prapīḍito bastiḥ pakvādhānaṃ na gacchati | na ca sampādayatyarthāṃstasmādyuktaṃ prapīḍayet || bhūyo bhūyo'vapīḍena vāyurantaḥ prapīḍyate | tenādhmānaṃ rujaścogrā yathāsvaṃ tatra bastayaḥ || kālātikramaṇātkleśo vyādhiścābhipravardhate| tatra vyādhibalaghnaṃ tu bhūyo vastiṃ nidhāpayet || gudopadehaśophau tu sneho'pakva: karoti hi | tatra saṃśodhano bastirhitaṃ cāpi virecanam || hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau matau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || mūrcchāṃ dāhamatīsāraṃ pittaṃ cātyuṣṇatīkṣṇakau | mṛduśītāvubhau vātavibandhādhmānakārakau || tatra hīnādiṣu hitaḥ pratyanīkaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ| tatra sāndre tanuṃ basti tanau sāndraṃ ca dāpayet|| snigdho'tijāḍyakṛdrūkṣastambhādhmānakṛducyate | basti rūkṣamatisnigdhe snigdhaṃ rūkṣe ca dāpayet || atipīḍitavaddoṣān vidhiṃ cāpyavaśīrṣake |ucchīryake samunnāhaṃ bastiḥ kuryācca mehanam || tatrottaro hito bastiḥ sukhinnasya sukhāvahaḥ | nyubjasya bastirnāpnoti pakvādhānaṃ vimārgagaḥ || hṛdgudaṃ bādhate cātra vāyuḥ koṣṭhamathāpi ca | uttānasyāvṛte mārge bastirnāntaḥ prapadyate || netrasaṃvejanabhrānto vāyuścāntaḥ prakupyati | dehe saṅkucite dattaḥ sakthnorapyubhayastathā || na samyaganilāviṣṭo bastiḥ pratyeti dehinaḥ | sthitasya bastirdattastu kṣipramāyātyavāṅmukhaḥ || na cāśayaṃ tarpayati tasmānnārthakaro hi saḥ | nāpnoti bastirdattastu kṛtsnaṃ pakvāśayaṃ punaḥ || dakṣiṇāśritapārśvasya vāmapārśvānugo yataḥ | nyubjādīnāṃ pradānaṃ ca basternaiva praśasyate || paścādanilakopo'tra yathāsvaṃ tatra kārayet | vyāpadaḥ snehabastestu vakṣyante taccikitsite || ayogādyāstu vakṣyāmi vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ | anuṣṇo'lpauṣadho hīno bastirnaiti prayojitaḥ || viṣṭambhādhmānaśūlaiśca tamayogaṃ pracakṣate | tatra tīkṣṇā hito bastistīkṣṇaṃ cāpi virecanam || saśeṣānne'thavā bhukte bahudoṣe ca yojitaḥ | atyāśitasyātibahurbastirmandoṣṇa eva ca || anuṣṇalavaṇasneho hyatimātro'thavā punaḥ | tathā bahupurīṣaśca kṣipramādhmāpayennaram || hṛtkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭheṣu śūlaṃ tatrātidāruṇam | tatra tīkṣṇataro bastirhitaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇo rūkṣo bastiḥ prayojitaḥ | sapittaṃ kopayedvāyuṃ kuryācca parikartikām || nābhibastigudaṃ tatra chinattīvātidehinaḥ | picchābastirhitastasya snehaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ || atyamlalavaṇastīkṣṇaḥ parisrāvāya kalpate | daurbalyamaṅgasādaśca jāyate tatra dehinaḥ || parisravettataḥ pittaṃ dāhaṃ sañjanayedgude | picchābastirhitastatra bastiḥ kṣīraghṛtena ca || pravāhikā bhavettīkṣṇānnirūhāt sānuvāsanam | sadāhaśūlaṃ kṛcchreṇa kaphāsṛgupaveśyate || picchābastirhitastatra payasā caiva bhojanam | sarpirmadhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇo nirūho vā savāte cānuvāsanaḥ | hṛdayasyopasaraṇaṃ kurute cāṅgapīḍanam || doṣaistatra rujāstāstā mado mūrcchāṅgagauravam | sarvadoṣaharaṃ bastiṃ śodhanaṃ tatra dāpayet || rūkṣasya bahuvātasya tathā duḥśayitasya ca | bastiraṅgagrahaṃ kuryādrūkṣo mṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ || tatrāṅgasādaḥ prastambho jumbhodveṣṭanavepakāḥ | parvabhedaśca tatreṣṭā: svedābhyañjanabastayaḥ || atyuṣṇatīkṣṇo'tibahurdatto'tisveditasya ca | alpadoṣasya vā bastiratiyogāya kalpate || virecanātiyogena samānaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam | picchābastiprayogaśca tatra śītaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || atiyogātparaṃ yatra jīvādānaṃ viriktavat | deyastatra hitaścāpi picchābastiḥ saśoṇitaḥ || navaitā vyāpado yāstu nirūhaṃ pratyudāhṛtāḥ | snehabastiṣvapi hitā vijñeyāḥ kuśalairiha || ityuktā vyāpadaḥ sarvāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ | bhiṣajā ca tathā kāryaṃ yathaitā na bhavanti hi || title: 6. atha nirūhabastividhiradhyāyaḥ
text: atha ṣaṣṭho'dhpāyaḥ | atha (pāriśeṣyāt) nirūhabastividhimāha - tatra tadbhedānāha - nirūhabastirbahudhā bhidyate kāraṇāntarai: | taireva tasya nāmāni kṛtāti muniṣuṅgavaiḥ ||1|| nirūhasyāparaṃ nāma proktamāsthāpanaṃ budhai: | svasthānasthāpanāddoṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam || 2 || Dī. yo nirūhabasti: pūrvaṃ saṃgṛhīta:| so'pyatra kāraṇāntarai: kṛtvā bahudhā bhidyate kathyata ityartha: | kāraṇāntarāṇi vakṣyamāṇadoṣahara-saṃśamana-śodhana-lekhana-bṛṃhaṇāni picchila-yāpana-vaitaraṇabastiprabhūtīniboddhavyāni | taireva kāraṇāntaraireva tasyā nirūhabaste: nāmāni munipuṅgavai: ṛṣiśreṣṭhai: kṛtāni kathitāni ityabhiprāyaḥ, doṣaharabastirityādīni tasya viśeṣanāmānyāha -nirūhasyeti | budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ nirūhasya nāma āsthānaṃ proktaṃ, āsthāpayati vaya: iti āsthāpanaṃ paramutkṛṣṭam utkṛṣṭatvaṃ ca vayaḥsthāpanenaiva | athavā doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanādāsthāpanaṃ, tacca kṣīreṇa kvāthaiśca kriyate| uktaṃ ca - ‘snehairyo dīyate sa syādanuvāsananāmaka:| eke ‘svasthāpanaṃ sthāpanāddoṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam’ iti nāma paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | suśrute'pi -‘sadoṣanirharaṇāccharīrarohaṇādvā nirūha iti so'sthāpana iti nāma | asyāmapi niruktau sa eva | yathā vaya:sthāpanādvā'yu:sthāpanādvā''sthāpanaṃ, tataśca sarvadoṣanirharaṇānnirūha iti vamanādikam ||1||2|| Gū. atha nirūhaṇabastividhi: | nirūhasya nāmāntaramāha - sa doṣanirharaṇādvā nirūha:, tasya nirūhasya aparam āsthāpitaṃ nāma budhai: doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanādvā nāma matam ||1||2|| atha doṣādyapekṣayā mātrāmāha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ ca prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prasthamuddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ ca kuḍavāstraya: ||3|| Dī. nirūhsya nirūhasaṃjñasyāsthāpanasya paramamutkṛṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ pādottaraṃ prasthaṃ sapādaprasthaṃ madhyaṃ prasthaṃ uddiṣṭham | traya: kuḍavā: hīnaṃ mānam | uktaṃ ca pārāśare - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prastha: pādottara: para:| madhyaprasthastu nirdiṣṭo vijñeyā: kuḍavāstraya:’ iti| uttamādimānaṃ ca doṣabalāpekṣayā'vagantavyam | nanu carakādāvanyathā paṭhitaṃ tadyathā - ‘ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nirūhasyopakalpanam | dvādaśaprastutasyādau tato'nyānupakalpayet’ iti | tatkathamatra viṃśatipalānyuttamamātrāyāṃ pratipāditāni ? | satyam, dvādaśaprasṛtamāno nirūha: pañcāṅgamāno yuktyā darśita: | tathāhi - ‘madhusnehanakalkākhyakaṣāyā vāpyata: kramāt | trīṇi, ṣaṭ, dve, daśa, trīṇi palānyanilarogiṇām || pitte catvāri catvāri tri pañca ca catuṣṭayam | ṣaṭ, trīṇi, dve, daśa, trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | anyacca – ‘datvākṣaṃ saidhavasyādau madhuna: prasṛtidvayam| vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam || ekībhūte tata: snnehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet | saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catu:prasṛtasaṃmitam || vitarecca tathā'vāpamante dviprasṛtonmitam | vastrapūtaṃ tathoṣṇāmbukumbhībāṣpena tāpita: | evaṃ prakalpito bastirdvādaśaprasṛto bhavet || na dhāvatyauṣadhaṃ prāṇairna tiṣṭhatyavalipya ca| na karoti ca sīmāntaṃ sa nirūha: suyojita’ iti | etenotkṛṣṭadoṣabale dvādaśaprasṛtamāna: madhyabale viṃśatipalānītyadoṣa: | sāmānyaviśeṣakathanādadoṣa: | svakīyamate sāmānyaḥ paramate viśeṣa ityadoṣaḥ | yadvā śodhanasaṃśamanalekhanaprabhṛtīnāṃ bastīnāṃ viṣayatvena viṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ caturviṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ mānamupadiśanti tadanumānato jñātavyaṃ granthagauravabhayānna likhitamityadoṣa: ||3|| Gū. nirūhapramāṇamāha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ pādottaraṃ vaṃkṣaṇādhikaṃ prasthaṃ mataṃ, prasthaṃ madhyamaṃ mataṃ, trayaḥ kuḍavā hīnaṃ matam || 3 || athānāsthāpanīyānāha - atisnigdhotkliṣṭadoṣau kṣatoraska: kṛśastathā | ādhmānacchardihikkārśa: kāsaśvāsaprapīḍitaḥ || 4 || gudaśophātisārārto viṣūcīkuṣṭhasaṃyutaḥ | garbhiṇī madhumehī ca nāsthāpyaśca jalodarī || 5 || Gū. yeṣāṃ na vihitaṃ tānāha - vaya:sthāpanādāyuḥ sthāpanādvā sthāpanam āsthāpanaśabdena nirūhaṇamucyate’ tannirūhaṇakarma atisnigdhādīnāṃ na vidhīyate | utkliṣṭadoṣo vamanonmukhadoṣaḥ, kṣatamuro yasyāsau kṣatoraska:, kṛśo durbalaḥ, spaṣṭamanyat || 4 || 5 || Gū. ete nāsthāpyāḥ, cakārādanuvāsyāśca na | uktaṃca - ‘bhayonmādastathā śoṣājīrṇārucipramehinaḥ| mūrcchākuṣṭhodarasthaulyaśvāsakāsakṣayāturāḥ || śothabhramamadacchardiyutā bastyamalācalāḥ | nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāśca vātarogādṛte narāḥ’ iti | kuṣṭhaśabdenātra mahākuṣṭhaṃ grāhyaṃ na kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ tasya vihitatvāt | pramehagrahaṇāt sarvaprameheṣu hitam | evaṃ jalodaragrahaṇena anyodareṣu hitam | uktaṃ ca - ‘udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaśca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyāste nānuvāsyāsta eva ca’ iti || 4 || 5 || atha nirūhyānāha - vātavyādhāvudāvarte vātāsṛgviṣamajvare | mūrcchātṛṣṇodarānāhamūtrakṛcchrāśmarīṣu ca ||6|| vṛddhāsṛgdaramandāgniprameheṣu nirūhaṇam | śūle'mlapitte hṛdroge yojayedvidhivadbudha: || 7 || Dī. vātavyādhāviti | vātavyādhyādiṣu nirūhaṇam āsthāpanasaṃjñaṃ yojayet | vātavyādhiḥ ākṣepakādi:, udāvarta udarāpūra:, vātāsṛk vātaraktaṃ, viṣamajvara: ekāhikādi:, udaramatra jalodaravyatiriktaṃ sarvodaraṃ grāhyam | eke - ‘mūtrakṛcchrodarānāhamūtradoṣāśmarīṣu ca’ iti paṭhanti | tatra mūtradoṣaṃ mūtrāghātamapi jñeyam | athavā mūtragrahaṇena strīṇāmapi mūtraretorajodoṣā api gṛhyante | yaduktaṃ – ‘mūtraretorajodoṣān asṛgdaragrahaṇaṃ premeheṣu ityatrāpi madhumehavyatirekeṇānye pramehā grāhyā:| tasya niṣiddhatvāt | vidhivadityanena tantrāntaroktavidhānaṃ boddhavyam | tadyathā - ‘nātyucchritaṃ nāpyatinīcapādaṃ sapādapīṭhaṃ śayanaṃ praśastam | pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇopapannaṃ prākśīrṣakaṃ śuklapaṭottarīyam || prakṣipya bastau mathitaṃ khajena subaddhapucchāsya ca nirvalīkam | āṅguṣṭhamadhyena mukhaṃ pidhāya netrāgrasaṃsthāmapanīya vartim | tailāktagātraṃ kṛtamūtraviṭkaṃ nātikṣudhārtaṃ śayane manuṣyam || samethaveṣannataśairase vā nātyucchrite svāstaraṇopapanne | savyena pārśvena sukhaṃ śayānaṃ kṛtvā jayedasya bhujopanāham || niṣkuñcya savyetaradasya sakthiṃ vāmaṃ prasārya praṇayecca bastim | snnigdhe gude netracaturthabhāgaṃ snnigdhairjanairjānu ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśam || akampanā'vepanalāghavādīn pāṇyaṅgulīścāpi nidarśayanti | prapīḍya caikagrahaṇena datte netraṃ śanaireva tato'pakarṣayet || tiryakpraṇītena tu yātidhārā gude vraṇa: syāccalite ca netre | datta: śanairnāśayameti basti: kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvatyatipīḍitastu’ ityādi ||6||7|| Gū. yeṣāṃ nirūhaṇaṃ vihitaṃ tānāha - vātavyādhau vātaroge, udāvarte udāvartaroge tathāsṛgdararogādau nirūhaṇaṃ yojayet | jalodare niṣedhaḥ nānyasmin udare || 6 || 7|| yena prakāreṇa nirūhaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhasvinnamabhojitam | madhyāhne gṛhamadhye ca yathāyogyaṃ nirūhayet || 8 || snnehabastividhānena budhaḥ kuryānnirūhaṇam | jāte nirūhe ca tato bhavedutkaṭakāsanaḥ || 9 || tiṣṭhenmuhūrtamātraṃ tu nirūhāgamanecchayā | anāyātaṃ muhūrtaṃ tu nirūhaṃ śodhanairharet ||10|| nirūhaireva matimānkṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavaiḥ | Dī. evaṃvidhaṃ nirūhayet | utsaṣṭetyādi | utsaṣṭaṃ parityaktaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣaṃ yena | snigdhaṃ kṛtasnehanaṃ | svinnaṃ sveditam | abhojitamakṛtabhojanaṃ | madhyāhneti tasyocitakālatvakhyāpanārtham | gṛhamadhye iti | vātātaparajodoṣādinirāsārtham | snehabastividhānaṃ pūrvamevānuvāsanādhyāye uktam | budhagrahaṇaṃ nirūhadāne'tikuśalatvakhyāpanārtham | nirūhadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ityata āha - jāte iti | anāyate nirūhaṃ śodhanairnirūhairharet | śodhananirūhāḥ kṣārādibhiḥ kartavyāḥ | utkaṭakāsanaḥ ūrdhvajānusthitaḥ muhūrtaṃ ghaṭikādvayaparyantam | yadā muhūrtādupari anāyātaṃ nirūhaṃ syāt, tadā śodhanairnirūhaiḥ kṛtvā āharetkṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavairnirūhaṇairiti saṃbandhaḥ || anāyātasya vyāpattiruktā cakradatte - ‘aśuddhaśca malonmiśraḥ sreho naiti yadā punaḥ | tadāṅge sadanādhmānaśūlā: śvāsaśca jāyate || pakvāśayagurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyānnirūhaṇam | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ siddhaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam’ iti || 8-10 || Gū. evam utsṛṣṭānilamūtrādilakṣaṇaṃ nirūhayet | yathāyogyaṃ yathāvihitam utsṛṣṭaḥ niḥsṛtaḥ anilo vāyurviṭ purīṣaṃ, mūtraṃ ca yasya tam | snigdhaṃ snehitaṃ, svinnaṃ sveditam, abhojitam akṛtāhāraṃ, madhyāhne madhyāhnakāle gṛhamadhye gṛhābhyantare | nirūhaṇaṃ kena vidhinā kuryādityāha -pūrvokto yaḥ snehabastistadvidhānena budhaḥ nirūhaṇaṃ kuryāt | nirūhe jāte utkaṭakāsanaḥ utkaṭaṃ bhavet | punaḥ nirūhāgamanecchayā muhūrtamātraṃ tiṣṭhet | muhūrtāt anāyāntaṃ nirūhaṃ tataḥ śodhanairnirūhai: kṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavaireva śodhayet || 8-10 || atha sunirūḍhalakṣaṇamāha - yasya krameṇa gacchanti viṭpittakaphavāyavaḥ | lāghavaṃ copajāyeta sunirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||11 || Dī. yasya krameṇa tantrāntarokte'gnimūtrapittakaphavāyavaḥ gacchanti lāghavaṃ copajāyate sunirūhaṃ tamādiśet | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena - ‘prasṛṣṭaviṇmūtrasamīraṇatvaṃ rucyagnivṛdhyāśayalāghavāni | rogopaśāṃtiḥ prakṛtisthatā ca balaṃ ca tatsyātsunirūḍhaliṅgam’ iti | sunirūḍhamityādinā caikadvitriprabhṛtinirūhadānaviṣayamuktam | uktaṃ ca - ‘eko'pakarṣatyanilaṃ svamārgātpittaṃ dvitīyastu kaphaṃ tṛtīya’ ityādi || 11 || atha durnirūhalakṣaṇamāha -- yasya syādvastiralpālpavego hīnamalānilaḥ | mūrcchārtijāḍyārujimān durnirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||12|| Dī. alpālpavega iti | bastidānena svalpadravānāmantaḥ praveśananiṣayaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘dattaḥ śanairnāśayameti bastiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvatyatipīḍitastu’ iti | etena tūrṇamavalambitamiti | hīnamala iti hīnamalo bastirityarthaḥ | na purīṣādinirgamaḥ | yataḥ - ‘alpālpavego viḍvātahīno hīnanirūhaṇaḥ | mūrcchācchardikaphaprāyo mahāvego'tiśabditaḥ’ iti | mūrcchārtijāḍyārucimān iti | mūrcchāsthāne mūtrārtiriti pāṭhāntaram | jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā kaphaprāyetyabhiprāyaḥ | kecida- trāsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdānalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti | tadyathā - ‘viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ snigdhatā vyādhinigrahaḥ | āsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdāne tu lakṣaṇam’ iti || viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ | sugamamanyat || 12 || Gū. durnirūhalakṣaṇamāha - āsthāpanasnehabastyo: samyagdāne lakṣaṇamāha - viviktatā ekāntatā, manastuṣṭiḥ manasaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ, snigdhatā sacikkaṇatā, vyādhinigrahaḥ roganāśaḥ | āsthāpitaṃ nirūhaṇaṃ | snehabastiḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tayoḥ samyagdāne idaṃ lakṣaṇam ||12|| nirūhasya bastidānavaddeyatāmāha - anena vidhinā yuñjyānnirūhaṃ bastidānavat | dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathocitam || 13|| Dī. anena pūrvoktena vidhinā nirūha bastidānavat bastidānatulyaṃ, vāgrahaṇāt prathamam ekaṃ, paścāddvitīyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturthaṃ ca | etena bastipuṭakaṃ kathitamiti bhāvaḥ | caturthaṃ vā yathocitamiti | yathārhamiti | nanu tṛtīyādhikapuṭamaniṣiddham | yathā - ‘snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane nirūho dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte | trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ’ iti | naivaṃ, niṣedho bahupuruṣaviṣayatayā prāyikaḥ, caturthapuṭadānaṃ tu kasminnapi krūrakoṣṭhe balīyasi bahudoṣe puruṣe, tataḥ kuto virodhaḥ | kecidatrāmuṃ ślokaṃ paṭhanti - sasneha ekaḥ pavane, pitte dvau payasā saha | kaṣāyakaṭumūtrāḍhyā: kaphe koṣṇāstrayo hitāḥ || asyārthaḥ pūrvameva pratipakṣe darśitaḥ tenātra kairapi paṭhitaḥ || 13 || Gū. anena vidhinā bastidānavit nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt | nirūhasya dvitīyādiyojanavidhimāha - ekaṃ nirūhaṃ dvitīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ nirūhaṃ vā yathocitaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yuñjyāt | tatra nirūhayojane doṣakramamāha - pavane vāte ekaḥ nirūhaḥ sasneha eva | dvau nirūho pitte payasā dugdhena saha | kaṣāyakaṭurūkṣādyāḥ kaphe trayaḥ koṣṇāḥ || 13 || atha bhojanakramamāha - pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ kramāt | nirūhaṃ bhojayitvā ca tatastamanuvāsayet || 14 || Dī. pittādīnāmatra kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ saha bhojanaṃ kāryam | kramāditi anukrameṇaiva | anukramo yathā - pittāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ kṣīrodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścādanuvāsayet, bṛṃhaṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ | śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścādanuvāsanaṃ deyam | anilāviṣṭaṃ māṃsarasaudanaṃ bhojayitvā anuvāsayediti padārthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ’pratyāgate koṣṇajalāvasiktaḥ śālyannamadyāttanunā rasena | jīrṇe ca sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto'nuvāsya: paribṛṃhaṇārtham’ iti || 14 || Gū. pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayet kramāt kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ | pittāviṣṭaṃ kṣīraiḥ, śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣaiḥ, anilāviṣṭaṃ rasaiḥ | evaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayitvā paścādanuvāsanaṃ kārayet || 14 || idānīṃ bālavṛddhayormṛdubastimāha - sukumārasya vṛddhasya bālasya ca mṛdurhitaḥ | bastistīkṣṇaḥ prayuktastu teṣāṃ hanyādbalāyuṣī ||15|| Dī. sukumārādīnāṃ mṛdurbastirhitaḥ | ’tu’ punaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ bastiḥ prayuktaḥ teṣāṃ balāyuṣī hanyāt | tantrāntare viśeṣaḥ | ‘viśeṣātsukumārāṇāṃ hīna eva kramo hitaḥ | mṛdurbastiḥ prayoktavyo viśeṣādbālavṛddhayoḥ’ iti || 15 || Gū. kīdṛśaṃ nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt ? tadāha - sukumārādermṛdurbastirhitaḥ | tīkṣṇabastisteṣāṃ balāyuṣī ||15|| idānīṃ bastīnāṃ dānakramamāha - dadyādutkleśanaṃ pūrvaṃ madhye doṣaharaṃ tataḥ | paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ ca dadyādbastiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16 || Dī. utkleśanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ, doṣaharaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ, saṃśamanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ samīkaraṇācchamanam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||16|| Gū. ādau madhye ante ca kīdṛśaṃ basti yuñjyāt ? tadāha - utkleśanaṃ dadyāt ukleśanaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ, madhye doṣaharaṃ vātādidoṣaśamanaṃ, paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ samasthāpakaṃ upaśamakaramityarthaḥ || 16 || atha teṣāṃ svarūpāṇyāha -- utkleśanabastiḥ | eraṇḍabījaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī saindhavaṃ vacā | hapuṣā phalakalkaṃ ca bastirutkleśanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17|| Dī. ayamutkleśanasaṃjño bastiḥ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||17 || Gū. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā || 17 || atha doṣaharabastimāha - śatāhvā madhukaṃ bilvaṃ kauṭajaṃ phalameva ca | sakāñjikaḥ sagomūtro bastirdoṣaharo mataḥ || 18|| Gū. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, kauṭajaṃ phalam indrayavaḥ ||18|| atha teṣāṃ doṣaharamāha -- priyaṅgu madhukaṃ mustaṃ tathaiva ca rasāñjanam | sakṣīraḥ śasyate bastirdoṣāṇāṃ śamanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||19|| Dī. ayaṃ doṣasaṃśamano bastiḥ | priyaṅguḥ kāntā, rasāñjanamatra kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravaviśeṣaḥ | tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ yojyam || 19 || śodhanabastimāha - śodhanadravyani:kvāthaistatkalkaiḥ snehsaindhavaiḥ | yuktyā khajena mathitā bastaya: śodhanā: smṛtā: ||20|| Dī. śodhanadravyāṇi nikumbhādīni prasiddhāni | tāni nikumbha-triphalā-gavakṣīra-snuk-śaṃkhinī-nīlinī-tilvakāni, śamyāka-kampillaka-hemadugdhā-dugdhaṃ ca virecanāni ityādīni | ‘khajena’ ityatra ‘kṣaṇena’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ || 20 || lekhanabastimāha - triphalākkāthagomūtrakṣaudrakṣārasamāyutāḥ | uṣakādipratīvāpā bastayo lekhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||21|| Dī. uṣakādiḥ prāguktaḥ | yathā - oṣakādisaindhavaśilājatukāsīsadvayahiṃgūni truṭakaśceti | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 21 || Gū. athe lekhanabastayaḥ - kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ | uṣakādirgaṇaḥ suśrute | lekhanā medorogādikṛśīkaraṇāt || 21 || atha bṛṃhaṇabastīnāha - bṛṃhaṇadravyaniṣkvāthā: kalkairmadhurakairyutāḥ | sarpirmāṃsarasopetā bastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 || Dī. bṛṃhaṇāni kākolī-kṣīrakākolī-jīvakarṣabhaka-medā-mahāmedāprabhṛtīni madhurakairiti | drākṣā-kharjūra-vātāmadīni || śeṣaṃ subodham || 22 || Gū. bṛṃhaṇā bastayaḥ matāḥ kathitāḥ || 22 || picchilabastimāha - badaryai-rāvatī-śelu-śālmalī-dhanvanāgarāḥ | kṣīrasiddhāḥ kṣaudrayuktā nāmrā picchilasaṃjñitāḥ | ajorabhraiṇarudhirairyuktā deyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 23 || mātrā picchilabastīnāṃ palairdvādaśabhirmatā | Dī. badarī prasiddhā (kolam), airāvatī nāgabalā iti bhānumatī, śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvanāgaro dhanvadeśajo nāgaramustam | dhanvanāgarasthāne ‘dhanvanākurāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ, dhanvayāsakāṃkurāḥ || ajaḥ chāga:, urabhro meṣa:, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | eke suśrutādhyāyino'tra paṭhanti - ‘varāhamahiṣorabhrabaiḍālaiṇeyakaukkuṭam | sadyaskamasṛgājaṃ vā deyaṃ picchilabastiṣu’ iti | tathā vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣepako'yamiti manyamānatvāt na samyak likhitaḥ | mātrāpicchilabastīnāmiti | dvādaśapalairevātra pūrmoktā hīnamātrā niyatā viśeṣagrahaṇāt ||23|| Gū. atha picchilabastayaḥ - badarī kolam, airāvatī nāgaraṅgaphalaṃ, śelu gundriṇī, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvo yavāsaka:, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī | ajā barkarī, urabhra ūrṇāmeṣaḥ, eṇo mṛgaḥ tadrudhireṇa deyaḥ | tatpramāṇaṃ dvādaśapalam || 23 || atha nirūhārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇapūrvakaṃ vidhānamāha - dattvādau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtidvayam || 24 || vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam | ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet ||25|| saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam | kṣiptvā vimathya dadyācca nirūhaṃ kulaśo bhiṣak ||26|| vāte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyātsnehasya ṣaṭpalam | pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyātpalatrayam || 27 || kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipetsnehaṃ catuṣpalam | Dī. atra saindhavaparimāṇaṃ tūttamamātrāyāṃ na gaṇitam ata eva ‘ādau’ iti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam | uttamamātrā viṃśatipalaireva | pūrvamuktaṃ yathā - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prasthamuddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ tu kuḍavāstraya’ iti | cakradatte tu - ‘dattvākṣaṃ saindhavasyādau madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam | vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam || ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet | saṃmūrcchitaiḥ kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam || kṣiptvā vimathya dadyācca nirūhaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak | vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyātsnehasya ṣaṭpalam || pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyātpalatrayam | kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipet snehaṃ catuḥpalam || vitarecca yathāvāpamante dviprasṛtonmitam | evaṃ prakalpito bastirdvādaśaprasṛto bhavet’ iti | etadapi pañcāṅgamānayuktyā samīcīnaṃ darśitam | tathāhi -‘madhusnehana-kalkākhyakaṣāyāvāpataḥ kramāt | trīṇi ṣaṭ dve daśatrīṇi palānyanilarogiṇām | pittaṃ catvāri catvari tripañca ca catuṣṭayam || ṣaṭ trīṇi dve daśa trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | vātādīnāṃ kevalamadhusnehayorviśeṣamānamāha - vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudram ityādi | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 24-27 || Gū. atha nirūhaḥ | saindhavasya akṣaṃ dadyāt | madhunā prasṛtidvayaṃ catu:palaṃ snehasya tailāde: prasṛtitrayaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ kalakasya dravyasya prasṛtiḥ dvipalam | saṃmūrcchite paripakve kaṣāye catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam aṣṭapalaṃ kṣiptvā vimathya nirūhaṃ dadyāt, vāte kṣaudraṃ catuḥpalaṃ snehaṃ catuḥpalam evaṃ vibhajya deyam | iti nirūhaṇamātrāvidhi: || 24-27 || madhutailikasaṃjñaṃ bastividhānamāha - eraṇḍakkāthatulyāṃśaṃ madhutailaṃ palāṃśakam || 28 || śatapuṣpāpalārdhena saindhavārdhena saṃyutam | madhutailakasaṃjño'yaṃ basti: khajaviloḍita: || 29 || medogulmakṛmiplīhamalodāvartanāśana:| balavarṇakaraścaiva vṛṣyo dīpanabṛṃhaṇaḥ || 30 || Dī. madhutailaṃ palāṃśakamityasya sthāne madhutailapalāṣṭakamityeke paṭhanti | tanna, uktaṃ ca tantrāntare - ‘madhutaile same syātāṃ kvāthaścairaṇḍamūlajaḥ | palārthaṃ śatapuṣpāyāstato'rdhaṃ saindhavasya ca | palenaikena saṃyuktaṃ khajena tu viloḍita: | deya: sukhoṣṇo bhiṣajā madhutailasaṃkara’ iti | malodāvartanāśane ityatra udarodāvartanāśana iti pāṭha: | ayameva tantrāntare ardhamātrikanirūha: kathita: sa tu tatraiva jñātavya: ||28-30|| Gū. śatapuṣpā palārdhena yojyā saindhavārdhena ca saṃyutaṃ | madhutailakasaṃjño'yaṃ bastirmedogulmādiharaḥ | khajaviloḍita iti khajo manthānaviśeṣa:, tena viloḍita: mathitaḥ || 28-30|| atha yāpanabastimāha - kṣaudrā-jya-kṣīra-tailānāṃ prasṛtaṃ prasṛtaṃ bhavet | hapuṣāsaindhavākṣāṃśo basti: syāddīpanaḥ para: || 31 || Dī. hapuṣā vipuṣā || 31 || Gū. atha yāpanabastimāha - kṣaudrādīnāṃ prasṛtirdvipalaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā, saindhavaṃ ca etayorakṣāṃśau dvau dvau akṣau karṣau ||31 || atha yuktarathabastimāha - eraṇḍamūlaniṣkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam | eṣa yuktaratho basti: savacāpippallīphalaḥ || 32 || Dī. kvāthādīnāṃ pariramāṇaṃ tu madhutailikabastivajjñeyam | tasyāntaḥpātitvāt | ‘yaduktaṃ madhutailaṃ ca kkāthaṃ sarasasaindhavam | phalapippalīsaṃyukto bastiryuktaratha: smṛta:’ iti | atrā'pi pūrvoktameva | phalamatra madanaphalam | iti yuktarathaḥ || 32 || Gū. atha yuktarathabasti: - phalo madanaphalaḥ, eṣa yuktaratho nāma bastiḥ || 32 || atha siddhabastimāha - pañcamūlasya niṣkvāthastailaṃ māgadhikā madhu | sasaindhava: samadhukaḥ siddhabastiriti smṛta: || 33 || Dī. sugamam || iti siddhabastinirūha: ||33|| Gū. pañcamūlaṃ bṛhadbilvādi:, tasya niṣkvātha:, tailaṃ tilatailaṃ, māgadhikā pippalī, madhu kṣaudraṃ, saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ, madhuko madhukasāra iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ ||33|| pathyāpathyamāha - snānamuṣṇodakaiḥ kuryāt divā svapnamajīrṇatām | varjayedaparaṃ sarvam, ācaretsnehabastivat || 34 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nirūhabasti- vidhiradhyāya: samāpta: || 6 || Dī. atha tyājyānyāha - snehabastivaditi | snehabastividhau yadācaritaṃ tatsarvam ācaret | tattatraiva jñātavyam || 34 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe bastinirūhakalpanādhyāya: samāpta: || Gū. bastau sevyaṃ niṣedhaṃ ca - uṣṇodakena snānaṃ kuryāt iti vihitam | tathā snehabastau yadvihitaṃ tadācaret | divā svāpam ajīrṇatāṃ ca varjayet || 34 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi nirūhabastividhiradhyāya: ṣaṣṭha:|| 6|| Editor's notes 1 ‘kathaṃcana’ pā. | ↩ 2 ‘rūkṣādyā’ pā. ↩

title: 7. atha uttarabastividhiradhyāyaḥ
text: atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | pāriśeṣyāduttarabastimāha - ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bastimuttarasaṃjñitam | dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ netraṃ madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam || 1 || mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ chidraṃ sarṣapasannibham | Dī. ataḥ paraṃ bastinirūhayoranantaram uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi iti | uttarabastinetrasvarūpamāha - madhye ca kṛtakarṇikamiti | madhye ṣaḍaṅgulopari karṇikā mekhalākārā mudrikā | ata eva mūtramārge ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ netraṃ praveśayedityuktamagre | yantracchidraṃ tu mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kāryaṃ sarṣapākāram | yantre chidramāha - chidraṃ sarṣapasannibhaṃ nirgamacchidramityartha: | kecit ‘sarṣapanirgamam’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | siddhārthakapraveśāgramiti tantrāntare | nanu kvacidapi caturdaśāṃgulamapi paṭhitaṃ tadyathā - ‘caturdaśāṅgulaṃ netraṃ tatra kāryaṃ vijānatā | mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kartavyaṃ chidrameva ca’ iti | tatkathamatra dvādaśāṃgulam ? ucyate, karṇikārthaṃ tu netraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulameva sarvasaṃmatam | śeṣaṃ tu carmapuṭakasya samīcīnagrathanārthaṃ kathitamityadoṣaḥ | carakādau tu dvādaśāṃgulamevoktatvāt, athavā - ‘meḍhrāyāmasamaṃ kecidicchanti khalu tadvida’ ityādi matamālocya carakamatameva śārṅgadhareṇa svīkṛtamityalaṃ vistareṇa || 1 || Gū. ataḥ param uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi pūrvaṃ vidhānamāha - dvādaśāṃgulikaṃ netraṃ nālikā lakṣaṇaṃ madhye kṛtakarṇikaṃ kamalapatrakarṇikāvanmadhyabhāgaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ sthūlaṃ punaḥ chidre sarṣapanirgamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā chidram || 1 || snehamātrāmāha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmadho mātrā dvikārṣikā || 2 || tadūrdhvaṃ palamātrā ca snehasyoktā bhiṣagvaraiḥ | Dī. pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmadhaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣādadho'rvāk caturviṃśatiparyantaṃ mātrā snehasya dvikārṣikī | tadūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśādūrdhvaṃ palamātrā | bhiṣagvarairiti grahaṇena doṣadeśadehakālānalādyapekṣya nyūnādhikā'pi mātrā yojyā sampradāyadarśanāt | ata evoktaṃ -‘pañcaviṃśativarṣonamadho mātrā dvikārṣikī’ iti kvacitpāṭho'pi || 2 || Gū. vayo'numānena pramāṇamāha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇām adhovayasāṃ snehasya tailāderdvikārṣikī palārdhamānamātrā, tadūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśaterūrdhvaṃ snehasya palamānā mātrā || 2 || athottarabastervidhānamāha - athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ || 3 || sthitasya jānumātre ca pīṭhe'nviṣya śalākayā | snigdhayā meḍhramārge ca tato netraṃ niyojayet || 4 || śanaiḥ śanairghṛtābhyaktaṃ meḍhrarandhre'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ | tato'vapīḍayedbastiṃ śanairnetraṃ ca nirharet || 5 || tataḥ pratyāgate snehe snehabastikramo hitaḥ | Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | āsthāpanaṃ kaṣāyabastiḥ, kaṣāyairdīyamānatvāt | nirūhamevāsthāpanakamityeke | kasya ? snānabhojanaiḥ tṛptasya, bhojanagrahaṇena ghṛtakṣīramāṃsādīnāṃ grahaṇam | uktaṃ ca - ‘athāntaramupasnigdhaṃ svinnaṃ praśithilāśayam | yavānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pītavantaṃ yathābalam’ ityādi | jānumātre pīṭhe iti jānuparimāṇe āsane | uccatayā boddhavyam | uktaṃ ca -‘niṣaṇṇamājānusame pīṭhe’ ityādi | anviṣya śalākayā iti meḍhramārgaṃ śalākayā anviṣya anveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā | kiṃviśiṣṭayā śalākayā snigdhayā ślakṣṇayā | athavā ghṛtābhyañjanena vā | tato netraṃ niyojayet iti | netraṃ nalikā uttarabastisaṃjñasya |‘athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ’ asyāgre - ‘svabhyaktabastiśīrṣasya tailenoṣṇena yuktitaḥ | tataḥ samaṃ sthāpayitvā nālamasya praharṣitam’ ityeke paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, prācīnapustake na dṛṣṭaḥ | atha yantrapīḍanamāha - netraṃ yantraṃ ghṛtābhyaktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ meḍhrarandhre meḍhramārge praveśayedvaidya iti śeṣaḥ | ata evoktaṃ prāk ‘madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam’ iti | tena karṇikāparyantaṃ sasnigdhaṃ meḍhramārge praveśayedityarthaḥ | tato'nantaraṃ praveśānantaraṃ bastiṃ snehādisaṃbhṛtaṃ carmapuṭakaṃ śanairyathāsyādavapīḍyate yathā'ntaḥ sneho'ntaḥ praviṣṭo bhavati | netraṃ ca harediti | punaḥ śanairyathā syāttathā netraṃ haret mūtramārgādityarthaḥ | snehe pratyāgate snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ | ‘snehabastikramo hita’ ityasya sthāne -‘aparāhṇe vicakṣaṇaḥ | payasā bhojayedenaṃ yūṣairmāṃsarasena vā’ iti kecit, tadapi yuktaṃ tantrāntarasaṃvādāt | ‘snehakramo hita’ iti tatra granthakarturayamāśayaḥ - tatra samyagdattasya liṅgāni bhavanti, vyāpadaśca tāḥ | tatratyopakramaśca kartavyaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘samyagdattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca | basteruttarasaṃjñasya samānaḥ snehabastinā’ iti ||3-5 || Gū. athottarabastidāne yogyamāha - athānantaram āsthāpane tu nirūhaṇena śuddhasya punaḥ snānabhojanaistaptasya punaḥ jānumātre pīṭhe sthitasya iṣṭaśalākayā snigdhayā kṛtaṃ netramārgaṃ | tataḥ netram uttarabastinalikāṃ yojayet | śanaiḥ śanairghṛtābhyaktaṃ ghṛtavyāptaṃ netraṃ meḍhrarandhre ṣaṭ aṅgulāni yojyaṃ, bastinā pīḍayet | punaḥ śanairnetraṃ nirharet niṣkāsayet | tataḥ snehe pratyāgate ayaṃ snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ kathitaḥ || 3-5 || puṃsāmuttarabastinetramuktvā strīṇāmuttarabastimāha - strīṇāṃ kaniṣṭhikāsthūlanetraṃ kuryāddaśāṃgulam || 6 || mudgapraveśayogyaṃ ca yonyantaścaturaṅgulam | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca sūkṣmaṃ netraṃ niyojayet || 7 || Dī. kaniṣṭhikā striya eva | daśāṅgulamiti | dairghyeṇa mudgapraveśaṃ randhramiti śeṣaḥ | tena mudgavāhinalikācchidramityarthaḥ | yonyantaścaturaṅgulamiti | tacca netramatyarthamārge caturaṅgulapramāṇamantaḥ praveśayedityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - mūtrasrotaḥparīṇāhamudgavāhidaśāṅgulam | tāsāmatyarthamārge tu nidadhyāccaturaṅgulam’ iti | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca iti | strīṇāmatra mūtramārge jñeyam | tatra dvyaṅgulanetraṃ praveśayediti bhāvaḥ | tacca sūkṣmanetraṃ kāryaṃ yathā puruṣameḍhramārgārthaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛttābhaṃ kathitaṃ tadvadatrā'pi jñeyam || 6 || 7 || Gū. atha strīṇāṃ bastidāne vidhimāha -- strīṇāmiti sugamam || 6 || 7 || bālānāmapi netraparimāṇamāha - mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu bālānāṃ tvekamaṅgulam | śanairniṣkampamādheyaṃ sūkṣmanetraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 || Dī. mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu iti padaṃ pūrveṇa saṃbandhanīyam | bālānāmapi vā mūtrakṛcchravikāre'pi bālaḥ ‘ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyanto bālaḥ’ ekamaṅgulaṃ netreṇa saṃbandhanīyam | sūkṣmanetramityanena mālatīpuṣpavṛttākāratvāt sūkṣmatvaṃ jñeyam || 8 || Gū. atha bālānāṃ bastidānapramāṇamāha - mūtrakṛcchreti sugamam || 8 || athāpatyamūtramārgayorviṣayatvāt snehaparimāṇamāha - yonimārgeṣu nārīṇāṃ snehamātrā dvipālikī | mūtramārge palonmānā bālānāṃ ca dvikārṣikī ||9|| Dī. yonyādimārgatrayaṃ strīṇāmeva | kiṃ tu punarbālānāṃ dvikarṣapramāṇā iti || 9 || Gū. strīṇāṃ bālānāṃ ca snehamātrāpramāṇamāha - dvipālikī dvipalapramāṇā | bālānāṃ dvikārṣikī dvikarṣamānā || 9 || atha strīṇāmuttarabastiḥ kathaṃ yojyaḥ ? ityāha - uttānāyai striyai dadyādūrdhvajānvai vicakṣaṇaḥ | apratyāgacchati bhiṣagbastāvuttarasaṃjñite || 10 || bhūyo bastiṃ nidadhyācca saṃyuktaiḥ śodhanairgaṇaiḥ | phalavartiṃ nidadhyādvā yonimārge dṛḍhāṃ bhiṣak || 11|| sūtrairvinirmitāṃ snigdhāṃ śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | dahyamāne tathā bastau dadyādbastiṃ viśāradaḥ || 12 || kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa payasā śītalena vā | bastiḥ śukrarujaḥ puṃsāṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam|| 13|| hanyāduttarabastistu nocito mehināṃ kkacit | Dī. vicakṣaṇasthāne samāhita iti vā pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ | asyāgre - ‘anena vidhinā dadyāt bastīn trīn caturo'pi vā’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | anirgame punarbastirdeya ityata āha - uttarasaṃjñite bastau pratyāgacchati sati bhūyaḥ punarapi bastimuttarasaṃjñaṃ nidadhyāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ ? śodhanairgaṇaiḥ saṃyuktam | śodhanagaṇo virecanagaṇaḥ | vā athavā phalavartiṃ nidadhyāt | kva ? yonimārge apatyamārge | kiṃbhūtāṃ ? dṛḍhām aśithilām | ata eva sūtrairvinirmitām | tathā snigdhāṃ tathā śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | śodhanadravyakṛtāmityarthaḥ | vartistu agre vakṣyamāṇā jñātavyā | asyāgre kecidadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā -- ‘payobastiṃ nidadhyāttu proktaṃ gulmacikitsitam | praveśayedvā matimān bastidvāre ca peṣaṇī || pīḍayedvāpyadho nābherbastinā pariveṣṭitaḥ | āragvadhasya patreṣu nirguṇḍyā: svarasasya ca || kuryādgomūtrapiṣṭeṣu vartiṃ cā'pi sasaindhavām | mudgailāsarṣapasamāṃ pravibhajya payāṃsi ca || basterāgamanārthāya tannidadhyācchalākayā |’ ityādipāṭho bahupustakeṣvadarśanānna vyākhyātaḥ | atha bastidāhacikitsāmāha - dravyasyānirgamādbastau mūtrāśaye dahyamāne sati viśārado vaidyakaśāstrakriyākuśalaḥ kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa bastiṃ dadyāt | vā athavā śītalena payasā bastiṃ dadyāt | kṣīravṛkṣā vaṭodumbarādayaḥ | eke kṣīravṛkṣaṃ rājādanamāhuḥ | rāyaṇīti loke | payo'tra pānīyamāhuḥ | śītaleti | śītaladravyamadhukādiyuktatvena śītalena ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘śarkarāmadhumiśreṇa śītena madhukāmbunā | dahyamāne bhiṣak bastau pāyau bastiṃ pradāpayet’ iti | athānantaraṃ basteḥ prabhāvapūrvakaṃ niṣedhamāha - puṃsāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vasādyāśritā rujaḥ rogān strīṇāmārtavajā rujaḥ asṛgdarādayaḥ hanyāt | mehināṃ pramehiṇāṃ nocitaḥ na yuktaḥ | pramehasya bastigatatve'pi nocitatvam | yathānuvāsanaṃ kuṣṭhapramehināṃ niṣiddham | kecinmehaśabdena madhumehamāhuḥ || 10-13 || Gū. uttānāyai bhiṣak dadyāditi saṃbandhaḥ | tathā dadyāt yathā snehaḥ pratyāgacchati | bhūyaḥ punaḥ kṛcchre viśeṣavyādhau śodhanairgaṇaiḥ eraṇḍatailādibhirbastiṃ nidadhyāt | yonimārge bastyabhāve phalavartikāṃ nidadhyāt | phalānām eraṇḍabījādīnāṃ vartiryadvā phalasadṛśī vartiḥ phalanāmnī vāsoghanadravyasaṃyutasya sūtreṇa vinirmitāṃ punaḥ snigdhām evaṃbhūtā vartiṃ dadyāt | vartyā dahyamāne bastau mūtrākāśe kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa udumbarādi punaḥ payasā śītalena bastiḥ puṃsāṃ śukradoṣajā rujaḥ strīṇām ārtavajā rujaḥ uttarabastirhanyāt | mehinaḥ kvacit na ucitaḥ || 10-13 || uttarabasteḥ snehabastisamānāyāḥ guṇadoṣānāha - samyagdattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca || 14 || basteruttarasaṃjñasya samānaṃ snehabastinā | Dī. uttarasaṃjñasya uttarabasteḥ snehabastinā'nuvāsanena samāni liṅgāni lakṣaṇāni tathā vyāpadaḥ hīnātimithyāyogajaḥ kramaśca upakramaśca samānaḥ snehabastinā tulya ityarthaḥ | tantrāntare tu — ‘duṣṭaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitaṃ cāṅganānāmasṛgdaraṃ tasya nāśaṃ ca puṣpam | mūtrāghātaṃ mūtradoṣān pravṛddhān yonerdoṣān tatparāyāśca saṃgam | śukrāghātaṃ śarkarāmaśmarīṃ ca śūlaṃ bastau vaṃkṣaṇe mehane ca | ghorānanyānbastijāṃścāpi rogān mohādṛte uttaro hanti bastiḥ’ iti || 14 || Gū. samyagdattalakṣaṇamāha - śamanaṃ śukratvaśamanaṃ bhavati | pramehalakṣaṇaṃ śamanaṃ bhavati || 14 || atha pūrvoddiṣṭāṃ phalavartimāha - ghṛtābhyakte gude kṣepyā ślakṣṇā svāṅguṣṭhasannibhā ||15|| malapravartanī vartiḥ phalavartiśca sā smṛtā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || Dī. ślakṣṇā komalā, svāṃguṣṭhasannibhā āturāṃguṣṭhatulyā sthūlatayā | malaṃ mūtrapurīṣādikam | malaśabdena strīṇāmapi rajodoṣādikam | apatyamārge deyā īdṛśī phalavartiḥ smṛtā kathitā || 15 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ cottarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhiradhyāyaḥ || Gū. phalavartimāha - tatpramāṇā sā phalavartiḥ, malapravartanī bhavati | phalānāṃ vā nirmitā || 15 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi uttarabastividhi- radhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ ||

title: 8. atha nasyavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha nasyavidhiḥ | nasyasya niruktimāha - nasyaṃ tatkathyate nīrairnāsāgrāhyaṃ yadauṣadham | nāvanaṃ nasyakarmeti tasya nāmadvayaṃ matam || 1 || Dī. atha pañcakarmapāriśeṣyānnasyavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - nasyeti | auṣadhaṃ kvāthasvarasasnehādi, nasyamiti nāsayā dīyate iti nasyam | tasya nasyasya nāmadvayaṃ coktam, nāvanamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ nasyamiti || 1|| Gū. atha nasyavidhiḥ | tatra nasyalakṣaṇaṃ dhīrairyat nāsāgrāhyamauṣadhaṃ tat nasyaṃ kathyate | nāvanaṃ nasyakarma ceti tasya nāmadvayam || 1 || nasyabhedānāha - nasyabhedo dvidhā prokto recanaḥ snehanastathā | recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ matam || 2 || Dī. nāsikayā dīyate yattat nasyaṃ tasya bhedo dviprakāraḥ, eko recanaḥ dvitīyaḥ snehanaḥ, recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇam, upakramyasya dvitvāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘upakramyasya hi dvitvāddvidhaivopakramo mataḥ | ekaḥ saṃtarpaṇastatra dvitīyaścāpatarpaṇaḥ’ iti | nanu vāgbhaṭena trividhaṃ nasyaṃ saviṣayamuktaṃ tadyathā - ‘virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ jāḍyaṃ spandagalāmaye | śophagaṇḍakrimigranthiku- ṣṭhāpasmārapīnase || bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātaje śūle sūryāvarte svarakṣaye | nāsā'syaśoṣe vāksaṃge kṛcchrabodhe'vabāhuke | śamanaṃ nīlikāvyaṅgakeśadoṣākṣirājiṣu || yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehairyathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ | kalkakvāthādibhiścādyaṃ madhupaṭvāsavairapi || bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhanvamāṃsottharasāsṛksvapurairapi | śamanaṃ yojayetpūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti, tatkathamatra dvividhaṃ coktam ? ucyate - śamanasya bṛṃhaṇe'ntarbhāvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘śamanaṃ yojayetpūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti | ata eva raviguptādau pañcabhedāste yathā - ‘nasyaṃ śirovirekaśca pratimarśo'vapīḍanam | jñeyaṃ pradhamanaṃ caitannasyakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | dṛḍhabale tu dhūmo'dhiko'sti na ca śirovireka iti | tadyathā - ‘nāvanaṃ cāvapīḍaśca dhmāpanaṃ dhūma eva ca | pratimarśaśca vijñeyo nastakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | kāśmīrāstu ṣaṭprakāraṃ paṭhanti yathā - ‘avapīḍaṃ pradhamanaṃ nasyaṃ recanatarpaṇam | pratimarśaśca dhūmaśca nasyakarma tu ṣaḍvidham’ iti | te'pyatraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ| te tu granthakṛtā evāgre spaṣṭatayoktāḥ | yathā - śirorecane pradhamanāvapīḍanasaṃjñāvantarbhūtau, te tu karṣaṇatvātkarṣaṇe'ntarbhūtau, pratimarṣamarṣau tu bṛṃhaṇentarbhūtau, evaṃ dhūmo'pi śodhanaśamanatvāt yathā svāntarbhāvanīya iti susthitametat ||2|| Gū. recanasnehananasyabhedadvayamāha - recanastathā snehana iti dvidhā nasyabhedaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | tatra yadvirecanaṃ vātakaphādīnāṃ chedanaṃ yat snehanaṃ tat bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaram || 2 || nasyakarmakālamāha - kaphapittāniladhvaṃse pūrvamadhyāparāhṇake | dine tu gṛhyate nasyaṃ rātrāvapyutkaṭe gade || 3 || Dī. kaphapittānilānāṃ dhvaṃse vṛddhilakṣaṇe kope, ‘sraṃsudhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane’ ityasya rūpaṃ | kutra kopa ityata āha - dinasya pūrvamadhyāhne'parāhṇake, tenā'yamarthaḥ siddhaḥ - dinasya pūrvāhṇe kaphakope, dinasya madhyāhne pittakope, dinasyāparāhṇe vātakope iti | athavā utkaṭe gade rātrāvapi nasyaṃ deyamiti | uktaṃ ca - ‘yathā doṣodaye kāle rogiṇe nāvanaṃ bhiṣag’ | iti ata eva svasthāsvasthaviṣayasambandhena kālā darśitāstantrāntare tadyathā - ‘śaraddhemantayoḥ svasthe pūrvāhṇe saṃprayojayet | varṣāsu śītaje grīṣme sāyaṃ madhyaṃdine tathā’ iti ||3|| Gū. nasyadāne nasyakālamāha - kaphapittavātadhvaṃse kaphapittavātanāśau krameṇa dinasya pūrvamadhyaparāhṇeke nasyaṃ gṛhyate | kaphanāśārthaṃ dinasya pūrvabhāge, pittanāśārthaṃ dinasya madhyabhāge, vātanāśārthaṃ dinasyāparabhāge | utkaṭe gade rātrāvapi nasyaṃ gṛhyate || 3 || nasyaṃ yasminkāle tyājyaṃ yaiśca tyājyaṃ tānāha - nasyaṃ tyajedbhojanānte durdine cāpatarpite | tathā navapratiśyāyī garbhiṇī garadūṣitaḥ || 4 || ajīrṇī dattabastiśca pītasnehodakāsavaḥ | kruddhaḥ śokābhibhūtaśca tṛṣārto vṛddhabālakau || 5 || vegāvarodhī snātaśca snātukāmaśca varjavet | Dī. durdine meghacchanne'hni, apatarpite asantarpite puruṣe | saṃtarpaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaraṇārthaṃ tena dhātubalo nasyena vidheyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | cakārādvāgbhaṭoktāste yathā - ‘yojayennatu nāvanam | toyamadyagarasnehapītānāṃ pātumicchatām || bhuktabhaktaśiraḥsnātasnātukāmasrutāsṛjām | navapīnasavegārtasūtikāśvāsakāsinām || śuddhānāṃ dattabastīnāṃ tathā'nārtavadurdine| anyatrātyayikādvyādheḥ’ iti | navapratiśyāyīti navatvaṃ dvividhanidānabhedena | ekaṃ sadyojanakaṃ dvitīyaṃ doṣacayapūrvakam | tatrādyo yathā - ‘nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ | saṃdhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam’ iti | dvitīyo yathā -‘cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakupyamānā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaistataḥ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi’ iti | tena sadyonidānajanakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so'pi navaḥ pratiśyāya iti kecit | anye tvevamāhuḥ - ‘āmapakvabhedena pratiśyāyasya navapurāṇatve kathite | tenāpi yaḥ āmasaṃjñakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so'pi taruṇatvena nasyaviṣaye tyājyaḥ na tu pakva iti bhāvaḥ | garaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ tena vyāptaḥ | kevalaviṣaprāpte'vapīḍasyoktatvāt | uktaṃ ca -‘cetovikāraviṣābhipannānāṃ cūrṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅguladvimukhayā nāḍyā deyam’ | anyacca - ‘viṣābhighātasaṃ- nyāsamūrcchāmohāpatantrake | mahāpasmāraśokārticintākrodhāmayādiṣu || mānaseṣu ca rogeṣu mūḍhavyākulacetasaḥ | saṃjñāprabodhahetvarthamavapīḍaṃ pradāpayet iti | bālavṛddhayorapi utkaṭadoṣeṣu nasyaṃ deyam, ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānām’ ityādivakṣyamāṇatvāt | snātaḥ śirasnāta:, snātukāmaśca ityanena pūrvaṃ vidhāya paścātsnānaṃ kuryādityeke vyākhyānayanti || 4 || 5 || Gū. yasminkālai nasyaṃ tyājyaṃ tadāha - durdine meghacchanne'hni durdinam | apatarpaṇe laṅghane, navapratiśyāyī navapratiśyāyavān | garadūṣitaḥ viṣadūṣitaḥ | pītasnehodakāsavaḥ pītaṃ sneham udakam āsavaṃ madyaṃ yena saḥ | vegāvarodhī mūtrapurīṣakāvarodhī | spaṣṭamanyat || 4 || 5 || nasyārhānarhānāha -- aṣṭavarṣasya bālasya nasyakarma samācaret || 6 || aśītivarṣādūrdhvaṃ ca nāvanaṃ naiva dīyate | Dī. atha bālavṛddhayornasyagrahaṇāgrahaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha - aṣṭavarṣādūrdhvaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | aṣṭavarṣādupari nasyakarma kuryāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘na nasyamūnasaptābde nātītāśītivatsare’ iti | aṣṭavarṣādarvāgapi doṣodrekādātyayike vyādhau bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyata’ iti | evaṃ vṛddhasyā'śītivarṣasyāpi jñeyam || 6 || Gū. yasya nasyaṃ deyaṃ tadapyāha - nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ | sugamam || 6 || atha vairecanaṃ nasyamāha - atha vairecanaṃ nasyaṃ grāhyaṃ tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ || 7 || tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhairvā snehaiḥ kvāthai rasaistathā | Dī. tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ sarṣapādijaiḥ tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhaiḥ snehairvā | tīkṣṇadravyāṇi maricapippalīśṛṅgaveraśobhāñjanādīni, taiḥ ye siddhā ye snehāḥ kvāthāśca iti || 7 || Gū. atha virecanasya vidhānamāha – sugamam ||7|| virecanasya mātrāmāha - nāsikārandhrayoraṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraśca bindavaḥ || 8 || pratyekaṃ recane yojyā mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā | Dī. nāsikārandhrayoriti | dvayorapi nāsāpuṭayornasyaṃ yojanīyam | aṣṭāvityādi | mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā iti | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyamātrā | recanasya ṣaṭbindavaḥ madhyamā | catvāraḥ antyā mātrā hīnamātrā iti | uktaṃ ca - ‘catvāro bindavaḥ ṣaṭ vā tathāṣṭau vā yathābalam | śirovirecane yojyā ūrdhvajatruvikāriṇām’ iti | bindulakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt | yāvatpatatyasau bindurdaśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te || marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrāstā eva ca kramāt | bindudvayonāḥ kalkādeḥ’ iti || 8 || Gū. virecanasya pramāṇamāha - nāsikārandhrayoḥ chidrayoḥ dvayoḥ aṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraśca bindavaḥ mukhyamadhyāntyātmamātrayā recane yojyāḥ | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyā mātrā | ṣaṭ madhyā mātrā | catvāro bindavaḥ antyā kaniṣṭhā mātrā || 8 || nasyārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha - nasyakarmaṇi dātavyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ tīkṣṇamauṣadham || 9 || hiṅgu syādyavamātraṃ tu māṣaikaṃ saindhavaṃ matam | kṣīraṃ caivāṣṭaśāṇaṃ syātpānīyaṃ ca trikārṣikam ||10|| kārṣikaṃ madhuraṃ dravyaṃ nasyakarmaṇi yojayet | Dī. tīkṣṇamiti | maricapippalīhiṃguśṛṅgavera-śobhāñjanatṛvṛtādikam | madhuraṃ dravyaṃ sitāprabhṛtikam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||9|| 10|| Gū. nasyakarmaṇi auṣadhapramāṇamāha - nasyakarmaṇīti spaṣṭam || 9 || 10 || atha śirovirecanabhedānāha - bhavapīḍapradhamanau dvau bhedāvaparau smṛtau || 11 || śirovirecanasyātra tau tu deyaṃ yathāyatham | Dī. atha śirovirecanasya yau dvau avapīḍapradhamanasaṃjñau tāvāha - yathāyathaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathāmātraṃ vā deyau | tayorvidhānaṃ cāgre vakṣyamāṇaṃ jñeyam || 11 || Gū. virecanasya dvau bhedāvaparāvapyāha - avapīḍaḥ, pradhamanam, etau dvau virecanasya bhedau tau śirovirecanasthāne deyau || 11 || athāvapīḍapradhamanayoḥ svarūpamāha - kalkīkṛtādauṣadhādyaḥ pīḍito niḥsṛto rasaḥ || 12|| so'vapīḍaḥ samuddiṣṭastīkṣṇadravyasamudbhavaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgulā dvivaktrā yā nāḍī cūrṇaṃ tathā dhamet ||13|| tīkṣṇaṃ kolamitaṃ vakravātaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hi tat | Dī. kalkīkṛtādauṣadhādyaḥ raso niḥsṛtaḥ so'vapīḍaḥ, kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? pīḍitaḥ āturanāsāpuṭe iti śeṣaḥ | pradhamanaṃ tat, yat dvivakrā nāḍī ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇā tayā cūrṇaṃ pradhamet | kiṃbhūtam ? tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇadravyakṛtam | kolaṃ kolamātram | vakravātairiti vaidyamukhotthaiḥ kṛtvā pradhamedityarthaḥ || 12 || 13 || Gū. avapīḍalakṣaṇamāha - kalkīkṛtāditi sugamam || 12 || 13 || ūrdhvajatrugate roge kaphaje svarasaṃkṣaye || 14 || arocake pratiśyāye śiraḥśūle ca pīnase | śophā'pasmārakuṣṭheṣu nasyaṃ vairecanaṃ hitam || 15 || Dī. ūrdhvajatrugate virecanaṃ hitamiti | te ca grīvāgalādirogā dṛḍhabale'pi - ‘stambhāntāḥ suptirudrādyāḥ śleṣmikā ye śirogadāḥ | śirovirecanaṃ teṣu nasyakarma praśasyate’ iti | kapharoge iti | kāsaśvāsādyāḥ | pratiśyāye nāsāsrāve pīnase purāṇe iti ratnaprabhākāraḥ | cakradatte'pi -‘śirovirecanaṃ dadyāt rogeṣveteṣu buddhimān | gaurave śirasaḥ śūle jāḍye spande galāmaye || śophagaṇḍakṛmigranthikuṣṭhāpasmārapīnase’ iti | anyatrā'pyuktaṃ - ‘śirovirecanamapi śleṣmaṇā'bhivyāptatālugalaśirasāṃ tathā'rocakaśirogauravaśūlapīnasārdhāvabhedakakṛmipratiśyāyā-pasmārāghrāṇājñāneṣu cordhvajatrugadeṣu śirovirecanadravyasiddhena snehena’ iti || 14 || 15 || atha bṛṃhaṇanasyaviṣayamāha - bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyaṃ snehena śasyate | Dī. snehena nasyamiti | bṛṃhaṇākhyam | yadā recananasyadāne pratipāditarogairabhibhūtānāṃ bhīruprabhṛtīnāṃ recanaṃ dātavyaṃ tadā snehakṛtaśirovirecanaṃ deyamityapi dvitīyo'rthaḥ sāmpradāyikaḥ || yeṣu avapīḍanaṃ yujyate tānāha - galaroge sannipāte nidrāyāṃ viṣamajvare || 16 || manovikāre kṛmiṣu yujyate cāvapīḍanam | Dī. avapīḍananasyasya viṣayamāha - manovikāre iti | madamūrcchā'pasmārasaṃnyāsonmādabhūtonmādādiṣu | kṛmiśabdenātra kṛmijā rogā api grāhyāḥ ||16|| Gū. sugamam || 16 || yeṣu pradhamanaṃ yujyate tānāha -- atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu visaṃjñeṣu ca dīyate || 17 || cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ dhīraistaddhi tīkṣṇataraṃ yataḥ | Dī. pradhamananasyaviṣayamāha - atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu cetovikāraviṣābhipanneṣvityarthaḥ | evaṃvidheṣvanyeṣvapi visaṃjñeṣu madāpasmārādiṣu | yatastīkṣṇataram atyantatīkṣṇadravyakṛtaṃ | dhīrairiti vaidyaiḥ | dhīratvaṃ dṛḍhaśāstrābhyāsakarmatvena jñeyam | tīkṣṇadravyato yathā -- ’pippalyaḥ śigrubījāni viḍaṅgamaricāni ca | avapīḍaḥ praśasto'yaṃ garacetovikāriṇām’ iti || 17 || Gū. atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu mūrcchāpasmārādivisaṃjñeṣu saṃnyāsādiṣu || 17 || idānīmavapīḍanapradhamanayoḥ katipayayogānāha - guḍādinasyam | nasyaṃ syādguḍaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ - Dī. guḍaśuṇṭhībhyāmeko yogaḥ | pippalyādinasyam | pippalyāḥ saindhavena vā || 18 || jalapiṣṭena tenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ | manyāhanugalodbhūtā naśyanti bhujapṛṣṭhajāḥ || 19 || Dī. pippalīsaindhavābhyāṃ dvitīyaḥ | tena nasyenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ naśyanti | gadaśabdo'tra pratyekamabhisambadhyate | tathā manyāhanugalodbhūtā rogā iti śeṣaḥ | bhujapṛṣṭhajā iti | bhujajāśca bāhukāsaśoṣādayaḥ, pṛṣṭhajāḥ kubjabahirāmādayaḥ | kecidvirecanabhedameva yogadvayamicchanti tadbhedādavapīḍapradhamanayoruktatvāt || 18 || 19 || Gū. atitīkṣṇataraṃ virecanamāha - nasyamiti sugamam || 18 || 19 || madhūkasārādinasyam - madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ | nasyaṃ koṣṇajale piṣṭaṃ dadyātsaṃjñāprabodhanam ||20|| apasmāre tathonmāde saṃnipāte'patantrake | Dī. madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāmeko yogaḥ | madhūko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya sāraṃ madhyasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣam | vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ kṛtvā paraḥ sakaladravyakṛto vā eka eva yogo vyavahārāt | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 20 || Gū. madhūkasāraḥ guḍapuṣpaḥ || 20 || tandrāyāṃ saindhavādinasyam - saindhavaṃ śvetamaricaṃ sarṣapāḥ kuṣṭhameva ca || 21 || bastamūtreṇa piṣṭāni nasyaṃ tandrānivāraṇam | Dī. tandrāyāṃ nasyamāha - śvetamaricamatra śigrubījaṃ tatsaṃjñatvāt | bastaḥ chāgaḥ | piṣṭānīti pūrvoktadravyāṇi iti śeṣaḥ | teṣāṃ tandrānivāraṇaṃ bhavati ||21 || Gū. atha tandrāyāṃ nasyam - śvetamaricaṃ prasiddham, yadvā śigrubījam | bastamūtreṇa || 21 || maricādinasyam - rohitamatsyapittena bhāvitaṃ saindhavaṃ vacā || 22 || maricaṃ pippalī śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ laśunaṃ puram | kaṭphalaṃ ceti taccūrṇaṃ deyaṃ pradhamanaṃ budhaiḥ || 23 || Dī. pradhamanamāha - kaṭphalaṃ vacā ca samatvena pūrvaṃ maricacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādrohitamatsyapittena bhāvanā deyā, paścāccūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ deyam | budhairityanena paribhāṣoktarītyā pracārayedityabhiprāyaḥ || 22 || 23 || Gū. pradhamananasyamāha - kaṅkolaṃ, maricaṃ, puro gugguluḥ, kaṭphalam etatpradhamanacūrṇaṃ tandrādau deyamiti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||22|| 23|| iti virecananasyakalpanā | atha bṛṃhaṇanasyakalpanāmāha – atha bṛṃhaṇanasyasya kalpanā kathyate'dhunā | marśaśca pratimarśaśca dvau bhedau snehanī matau || 24 || marśasya tarpaṇī mātrā mukhyā śāṇaiḥ smṛtā'ṣṭabhiḥ | madhyamā ca catuḥśāṇairhīnā śāṇamitā smṛtā ||25|| ekaikasmiṃstu mātreyaṃ deyā nāsāpuṭe budhaiḥ | marśasya dvitrivelaṃ vā vīkṣya doṣabalābalam || 26 || ekāntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ vā nasyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tryahaṃ pañcāhamathavā saptāhaṃ vā suyantritam || 27 || marśe śirovireke ca vyāpado vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ | doṣotkleśātkṣayāccaiva vijñeyāstā yathākramam ||28|| doṣotkleśanimittāsu yuñjyādvamanaśodhanam | atha kṣayanimittāsu yathāsvaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam || 29 || śironāsākṣirogeṣu sūryāvartārdhabhedake | dantaroge bale hīne manyābahvaṃsaje gade || 30 || mukhaśoṣe karṇanāde vātapittagade tathā | akālapalite caiva keśaśmaśruprapātane || 31 || yujyate bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ snehairvā madhuradravaiḥ | Dī. atha virecananasyasya vidhānādikamabhidhāya saṃprati bṛṃhaṇanasyasya bhedaprabhṛtikaṃ darśayannāha - sugamam | tasya bhedānāha - marśaśceti | snehane bṛṃhaṇākhye nasye dvau bhedāviti | ekaḥ marśaḥ, dvitīyaḥ pratimarśaḥ | atha marśasya bhedamātrādikamāha - marśasya tarpaṇasnehasya yā mātrā sā aṣṭabhiḥ śāṇairmukhyā smṛtā | madhyamā caturbhiḥ śāṇairhīnā śāṇapramāṇā | cakradatte - ‘nasyasya snaihikasyātha deyāstvaṣṭau tu bindavaḥ | pratyekaśo nastakayornṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ || śuktiśca pāṇiśuktiśca deyā'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ’ iti | binduparimāṇamuktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt | yāvatpatatyasau bindurdaśāṣṭau ṣaṭkrameṇa te | marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrāstā eva ca kramāt | bindurdvayonāḥ kalpādeḥ’ iti | suśrute'pi nasyapramāṇaṃ tu ‘aṣṭau bindavaḥ pradeśinīparvadvayaparisrāvo binduḥ, eṣātra prathamā mātrā, dvitīyātra śuktiḥ, tṛtīyā pāṇiśuktiḥ etāstisro mātrā yathābalaṃ prayojyā bhavanti’ iti | śuktiparimāṇaṃ tu ‘dvātriṃśadbiṃdavaścāpi śuktirityabhidhīyate | dve śuktī pāṇiśuktiśca deyā'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ’ iti | snehanasyaṃ na gilet kiṃtu tyajedeva | tathāhi suśrutaḥ - ‘snehanasyaṃ na copagiletkathaṃcit’ iti | athaitatparimāṇamekavāraṃ bahuvāraṃ vā deyamiti śaṅkāyāṃ samādhānamāha - ekaiketi | marśasya iyaṃ mātrā pūrvoktā ekaikasminnāsāpuṭe deyā | etenaikavāraviṣayaṃ darśitam | yaduktaṃ - pratyekaśo nastakayornṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ’ iti |‘vā’ athavā doṣabalābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvivāraṃ trivāraṃ vā saiva mātrā deyā iti || nasyadānakālamaryādāmāha -- ekāntaramiti | vicakṣaṇo vaidyaḥ | ekāntaram ekadivasāntaraṃ vā prayojya saptāhaṃ yāvat paramadānena sātmībhavati | atrā'pi punaḥpunariti śeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘saptāhaṃ tu paraṃ deyaṃ miśritasya punaḥpunaḥ’ iti | vāgrahaṇena navamadivasādupari sātmyaṃ bhavati ityuktatvāt | tathāhi - ‘paraṃ navāhamūrdhvaṃ tu navāhātsātmyatāṃ vrajet’ iti || marśe doṣotkleśādvyāpado bhavanti ityata āha - marśe iti | atha tayościkitsāmāha - doṣotkleśa iti | vamanaśodhanamiti śirovirecanādirūpaṃ nasyam | yathāsvamiti yathādoṣaṃ | bṛṃhaṇamiti snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ | bṛṃhaṇanasya viṣayamāha - śira iti | śirorogādiṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ yujyate || 24-31 || Gū. atha bṛṃhaṇanasya kalpanā - atheti sugamam | snehavyāpat cikitsāmāha - marśe śirovireke iti | vividhā vyāpādastadrogāḥ smṛtāḥ | taddoṣotkleśakṣayāt dhātukṣayāt jñeyāḥ | doṣotkleśeṣu kiṃ kartavyaṃ ? tadāha yuñjyādvamanaśodhanamiti yeṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ dīyate tānāha - manyā grīvā, aṃsaḥ skandhaḥ, tadgade | snehairghṛtādyairmadhuraiḥ bṛṃhaṇaṃ yojyam || 24-31 || kuṅkumanasyam| saśarkaraṃ paya:piṣṭaṃ bhṛṣṭamājyena kuṅkumam || 32 || nasyaprayogato hanyādvātaraktabhavā rujaḥ | bhrūśaṅkhākṣiśiraḥkarṇasūryāvartārdhabhedakān || 33 || Dī. kuṃkumanasyamāha - śarkarā sitopalā, kuṃkumaṃ keśaraṃ kāśmīrajam | ājyena ghṛtena kṛtvā ghṛtena bharjayitvā saśarkaramiti samānaśarkaram | tadanu kṣīreṇa piṣṭvā nasyaṃ deyam | tadghṛtaṃ nasyaprayogataḥ bhrūśaḍkhādirujaḥ hanyāt iti || 32 || 33 || Gū. sa yathā - saśarkaraṃ sitāsahitaṃ payaḥ dugdham, ājyena ghṛtena kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ piṣṭvā tannasyaprayogataḥ vātaraktādirujaḥ hanyāt || 32 || 33 || anyabṛṃhaṇanasyamāha - nasyaṃ syādaṇutailena tathā nārāyaṇena vā | māṣādinā vā sarpirbhistattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ || 34 || Dī. athā'parāṇi bṛṃhaṇanasyādīnyāha - aṇutaileneti | aṇutailena nasyaṃ vātaraktabhavā rujo hanyādityatra saṃbandhaḥ | ‘gavāṃ śakṛt kvāthavipakvamuttamaṃ hitaṃ ca tailaṃ timireṣu nasyataḥ | ghṛtaṃ tathā kevalameva paittike tathāṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgucchayo’riti | aṇutailaṃ tu vātavyādhicitsoktamanyatra jñātavyaṃ | keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthaṃ yathā ‘tilapīḍanopakaraṇakāṣṭhānyāhṛtyānalpakālatailaparipītā-nyaṇūni kāṇḍaśaḥ parikalpyātikuṭya ca mahākaṭāhe pānīyenāsrāvya kvāthayet | tataḥ snehamastudṛṣatsarakapāṇyoranyatareṇādāya vātaghnauṣadhapratīvāpaṃ snehapākakalkena vipacet | etadaṇutailamupadiśanti vātarogeṣviti’ | nārāyaṇena taileneti śeṣaḥ | māṣādineti | atrā'pi tailena sambandhaḥ | nārāyaṇatailaṃ māṣatailaṃ ca vātavyādhicikitsoktaṃ jñātavyaṃ tattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ sarpirbhiriti | yāni yāni dravyāṇi vātaraktahṛnnābhicakṣuḥśiraḥkarṇarogāṇāṃ vihitāni taistairdravyai- reva sādhitāni sarpīṃṣi tatra tatra yojyānītyabhiprāyaḥ || 34 || Gū. anyadapyāha - aṇutailena atasītailena | sarpirbhirghṛtaiḥ tadroganāśakairauṣadhaiḥ sādhitaṃ tasya bṛṃhaṇaṃ syāt || 34 || doṣeṣu snehavyavasthā | tailaṃ kaphe syādvāte ca kevale pavane vasām | dadyānnasyaṃ sadā pitte sarpirmajjānameva ca || 35 || Dī. atha catuḥsnehasya doṣaviśeṣeṇopādeyatvamāha - tailaṃ kaphe syādvāte ceti | atra savāte iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, kevale vāte svatantre atrāṇutailameva pradhānaṃ | yaduktaṃ ‘caturvidhastu snehasya vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | śleṣmasthānavirodhitvātteṣu tailaṃ viśiṣyata’ iti || 35 || Gū. rogabhedena tailādīnāṃ nasyabhedamāha - tailamati | sugamam || 35 || māṣādinasyam | māṣā'tmaguptārāsnābhirbalārubukarohiṣaiḥ | kṛto'śvagandhayā kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 36 || koṣṇo nasyaprayogeṇa pakṣāghātaṃ sakampanam | jayedarditavātaṃ ca manyāstambhāpabāhukau || 37 || Dī. athāparamapi yogamāha - ātmaguptā kapikacchū: rāsnā surabhī balā sāmaśabdavācyā rubuka eraṇḍaḥ | rohiṣo gandhatṛṇaḥ aśvagandhayā saha militvā kvāthaḥ hiṅgusaindhavayoḥ prakṣepaḥ | tadvyavahārato hiṅgu raktikādvayaṃ saindhavaṃ māṣaikaṃ prakṣepaḥ | jayedarditavātaṃ ceti cakāragrahaṇāt karṇanādarujāyāṃ praśasta iti prasiddhiḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘māṣabalāśūkaśimbīkattṛṇarāsnorubūkāśvagandhānāṃ | kvātho nasyanipīto rāmaṭhalavaṇānvitaḥ koṣṇaḥ | apaharati pakṣāghātaṃ manyāstambhaṃ sakarṇarujam | durjayamarditavātaṃ saptāhājjayati cāvaśya’miti | iti marśavidhiḥ || 36 || 37 || Gū. atha pakṣavātārditādau nasyam - māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchūḥ, balā prasiddhā, rubukaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, rohiṣaḥ kattṛṇaḥ, aśvagandhā hayagandhā koṣṇaḥ kkātha: sakampanaṃ kampavātaṃ hanyāt || 36 || 37 || atha pratimarśamāha - pratimarśasya mātrā tu dvidvibindumitā matā | pratyekaśo nastakayoḥ sneheneti viniścitam || 38 || snehe granthidvayaṃ yāvannimagnā coddhṛtā tataḥ | tarjanīyaṃ sravedbinduṃ sā mātrā bindusaṃjñitā ||39|| evaṃvidhairbindusaṃjñairaṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sa deyo marśanasye tu pratimarśo dvibindukaḥ ||40|| samayāḥ pratimarśasya budhaiḥ proktāścaturdaśa | prabhāte dantakāṣṭhānte gṛhānnirgamane tathā ||41|| vyāyāmādhvavyavāyānte viṇmūtrānte'ñjane kṛte | kavalānte bhojanānte divāsuptotthite tathā || 42|| vamanānte tathā sāyaṃ pratimarśaḥ prayujyate | īṣaducchikkanātsneho yadā vaktraṃ prapadyate || 43 || nasye niṣiktaṃ taṃ vidyātpratimarśaṃ pramāṇataḥ | ucchindanna pibeccaitanniṣṭhīvenmukhamāgatam || 44 || kṣīṇe tṛṣṇāsyaśoṣārte bāle vṛddhe ca yujyate | pratimarśena śāmyanti rogāścaivordhvajatrujāḥ ||45|| valīpalitanāśaśca balamindriyajaṃ bhavet | Dī. ‘pratyekaśo nastakayorupaiti vadanaṃ yathā | tathaitairvihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram | etaiḥ padārthairvirahitaḥ sneho yadā bhavati tadāntaḥ na prāpnoti iti bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kenāpyatra paṭhitaḥ || 38-45 || Gū. atha pratimarśamāha - pratimarśasya nasyamātrā dvitribindumitā kathitā | pratyekaśo nāsikayoḥ snehena ghṛtena | bindumātrāmāha - evaṃvidhairbindusaṃjñairaṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sneheti sugamaṃ | pratimarśanasyasamayamāha - eṣu caturdaśasamayeṣu pratimarśe nasyaṃ prayujyate | dhamanasya niṣiktalakṣaṇamāha - īṣaducchikkanāt īṣat chikkanāt yadā snehaḥ vaktraṃ mukhaṃ prapadyate nasye niṣiktaṃ dattaṃ pratimāṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ tatastadā taṃ ucchiṣṭaṃ vidyāt | tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha - ucchiṣṭaṃ na pibetpratimarśam | anyeṣu keṣu yujyate tānapyāha - kṣīṇe dhātukṣīṇe tathā tṛṣṇā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tacchoṣārte bāle tathā vṛddhe ca yujyate pratimarśena ete śāmyanti tathā ūrdhvatrujā grīvāmūlordhvajāḥ śāmyanti tathā valīpalito yujyate valī tvakśaithilye palitaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ tathā indriyajaṃ balaṃ bhavet || 38-45 || atha palite nasyam | bibhītanimbakambhārī śivā śeluśca kākinī ||46|| ekaikatailanasyena palitaṃ naśyati dhruvam | Gū. bibhītaṃ bibhītakamajjānaṃ nimbaṃ nimbabījaṃ kambhārī prasiddhā, tasyā bījaṃ, śivā harītakī majjā, śeluḥ śākhoṭakamajjā, kākinī kikaībījam eṣām ekaikatailalasyena palitaṃ naśyati || 46 || atha nasyagrahaṇe nasyavidhimāha -- atha nasyavidhiṃ vakṣye nasyagrahaṇahetave || 47 || deśe vātarajomukte kṛtadantanigharṣaṇam | viśuddhaṃ dhūmapānena svinnabhālagalaṃ tathā || 48 || uttānaśāyinaṃ kiṃcitpralambaśirasaṃ naram | āstīrṇahastapādaṃ ca vastrācchāditalocanam || 49 || samunnamitanāsāgraṃ vaidyo nasyena yojayet | koṣṇamacchinnadhāraṃ ca hematārādiśuktibhiḥ || 50 || śuktyā vā yatra yuktyā vā plotairvā nasyamācaret | nasyeṣvāsicyamāneṣu śiro naiva prakampayet || 51 || na kupyenna prabhāṣeta nocchidenna hasettathā | etairhi vihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate || 52 || tataḥ kāsapratiśyāyaśiro'kṣigadasaṃbhavaḥ | śṛṅgāṭakamabhiplāvya sthāpayenna gileddravam || 53 || Gū. vātarajomukte deśe sthāne kṛtadantanigharṣaṇaṃ kṛtadantadhāvanaṃ, dhūmapānena viśuddhaṃ, tathā svinnabhālagalaṃ dhūmapānena | yadvā sveditabhālagalaṃ tathā uttānaśāyinaṃ naraṃ nasyena yojayet | plotaṃ plotakaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat | nasyaniṣikte kathaṃ niṣṭhīvedityāha - nocchidenna kiṃcitkṣodayet | etaiḥ kopādibhiḥ vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ nasyaḥ antarmadhye na prapadyate tataḥ kāsādayaśca bhavantītyāha - pratiśyāyo nāsāsrāvaḥ | tataḥ koṣādeḥ śṛṅgāṭakādisthāpane śikṣitamāha - śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāsāvaṃśaṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ āplāvya nasyaṃ draveṇāplutya na sthāpayet | dravaṃ na gilet, spaṣṭamanyat || 47-53 || atha nasyadhāraṇārthaṃ mātrāsaṃkhyāmāha - pañca sapta daśaiva syurmātrā nasyasya dhāraṇe | Dī. pañcasaptādisaṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ doṣādibalābalaviṣayam | mātrāpramāṇaṃ tu vāgbhaṭe -‘yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā’ iti || nasyadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ityata āha - upaviśyātha niṣṭhīvennāsāvaktragataṃ dravam || 54 || vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ niṣṭhīvetsaṃmukhe na hi | nīte nasye manastāpaṃ rajaḥ krodhaṃ ca saṃtyajet ||55|| śayīta nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca prottāno vākśataṃ naraḥ | tathā vairecanaścānte dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ || 56 || Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | nasyānantaraṃ nāsādidravam upaviśya niṣṭhīvet | kābhyāṃ ? vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ | kathaṃ ? sammukhaṃ nahi niṣṭhīvet | tiryak niṣṭhīvanāt samyagdravanirgamo bhavati ityarthaḥ | niṣṭhīvanānantaraṃ kartavyamāha - nīte iti | krodhaṃ ceti | caśabdastantrāntaroktagrahaṇārthaḥ | uktaṃca - ‘rajodhūmamanastāpasnānakrodhādivarjayet’ iti | vākśataṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇaśatamātram | vairecananasyānte iti śirovirecanasyottarakālaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ iti | dhūmaḥ snigdhādiragre vakṣyamāṇaḥ, kavalaḥ prāguktalakṣaṇaḥ hitaḥ pathyastasmātkartavya ityarthaḥ || 54-56 || Gū. nasye nīte yatkartavyaṃ tadāha - rajo dhūli: | yathā dhūmapraveśo na bhavet | sa pītanasya uttānaḥ san vākśataṃ bhavet | virecananasyānte dhūmaḥ kavalaśca hitaḥ deyaḥ || 54-56 || atha nasye kati lakṣaṇāni bhavanti ? ityāha - nasye trīṇyupadiṣṭāni lakṣaṇāni prayogataḥ | śuddhihīnātiyogāni viśeṣācchāstracintakaiḥ ||57|| Dī. prayogata iti nasyaprayogāt | śāstracintakaiḥ śāstraṃ vaidyakaśāstraṃ tasya cintakāḥ vicārakā iti || 57 || Gū. śuddhyādibhedena nasye lakṣaṇamāha - nasye iti | spaṣṭam || 57 || nasyaśuddhilakṣaṇamāha - lāghavaṃ manasaḥ śuddhiḥ srotasāṃ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ | cittendriyaprasādaśca śirasaḥ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 || Dī. lāghavamiti śarīrasya | śarīragrahaṇenaiva śirograhaṇe labdhe punaḥ śirograhaṇaṃ dehasyordhvamūlādapi lāghavapratipādanārtham | manasaḥ śuddhiḥ manaso hlādakatvāt manasaḥ śuddhiḥ | tathā srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ srotāṃsi prāṇadhātumalāmbho'nnavāhināṃ śuddhatā | tathā cittendriyaprasādaśca manasaḥ indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ prasannatā | tathā vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ vyādhayo nasyasādhyā rogāḥ | tantrāntare tu - ‘prasannadṛṣṭirdṛḍhadantakeśaḥ śaśāṅkavakraḥ palitairvihīnaḥ | pikābhikaṇṭhaḥ kamalāsya gandho nasyopasevī bhavatīha martyaḥ’ iti | anyatrāpyuktam - ‘indriyāṇāṃ ca vaimalyaṃ kuryādāsyasugandhatām | hanudantaśirogrīvātrikabāhūrasāṃ balam || valīpalitakhālityaṃ vyaṅgānāmapyasaṃbhavam iti || 58 || Gū. śuddhimāha - lāghavaṃ śirasaḥ manasaḥ śuddhirmūrcchādyasrāvatvaṃ srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ, cittaprasādaśca śirasaḥ śirorogādināśaḥ | prasannatvaṃ śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ idaṃ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 || atha hīnaśuddherlakṣaṇamāha - kaṇḍūpadehau gurutā srotasāṃ kaphasaṃsravaḥ | mūrdhni hīnaviśuddhestu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 59 || Dī. atha hīnaśuddherlakṣaṇānyāha - hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇaṃ | kiṃ tat | kaṇḍūpadehāviti mukhanāsikādīnām upadehaḥ śleṣmaṇābhiliptamiva mukhaṃ bhavatīti | gurutā cātra śirasaḥ | srotasāṃ kaphādivahānāṃ kaphasaṃsrava iti pracuraśleṣmasaṃbhava iti tātparyārthaḥ || 59 || Gū. hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇamāha - upadeho liptatā, gurutā gurutvam, srotasāṃ nāsādīnām | kaphasaṃsrāvaḥ | hīnaśuddheḥ alpaśuddheḥ || 59 || atiśayaśuddhasya lakṣaṇamāha - mastuluṅgāgamo vātavṛddhirindriyavibhramaḥ | śūnyatā śirasaścāpi mūrdhni gāḍhaṃ virecite ||60|| Dī. ativirecitalakṣaṇamāha - mūrdhni śirasi | ativirecite sati mastuluṅgāgamādayo bhavanti | mastuluṅgaṃ mastiṣkam, vātavṛddhirityatra vātaduṣṭiriti vā pāṭhaḥ | indriyavibhramaḥ indriyanāśaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā mastakaśūnyatā | ‘śūnyatā manasaścā'pi’ iti pāṭhāntaram || 60 || Gū. mastuluṅgāgamo mastikābhyantarāt luṅgo mātuluṅgaḥ tajjalasadṛśo niḥsāraḥ vātavṛddhiḥ, indriyavibhramaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā, idaṃ gāḍhavirecitaśiraso lakṣaṇām ||60 || hīnātiśuddhau cikitsāmāha - hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnamācaret | samyak viśuddhe śirasi sarpirnasye niṣecayet ||61|| Dī. hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnaṃ kramādācarediti jñeyam | hīnaśuddhe śirasi kaphaghnam, atiśuddhe vātaghnaṃ, samyakśuddhe śirasi, nasyena samyak śuddhe sarpiryojayedityarthaḥ || 61 || Gū. hīnātiśuddhyādau kriyāmāha - kaphavātaghnaṃ nasyamācaret || 61 || atisnigdhalakṣaṇacikitsāmāha - kaphaprasekaḥ śiraso gurutendriyavibhramaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ tadatisnigdhe tatra rūkṣaṃ pradāpayet || 62 || bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi tasyācārikamādiśet | Dī. atisnigdhe etallakṣaṇam | tatkim ? kaphaprasekādi kaphaprasekaḥ srāvaḥ, śirasaḥ gurutā śirojāḍyam, indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ vibhramaḥ | rūkṣam annaṃ pradāpayet | anabhiṣyandi srotasāṃ yallepakaraṃ na bhavati etamācārikam ādiśet | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān || pravātapānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitiḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhasvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 62 || Gū. atisnigdhe lakṣaṇamāha - indriyavibhramaḥ bhrāntitvam ayathārthaśaktiḥ, atisnigdhe idaṃ lakṣaṇam | tatra rūkṣamavacārayet | nasye'varukṣaṃ dāpayet | nasye bhojanācāramāha - anabhiṣyandi mahiṣīdadhyādi nasyācārikaṃ nasye ye śiṣṭā ācaranti tadācaret || 62 || prakaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhaścānuvāsanam | etāni pañca karmāṇi kathitāni munīśvaraiḥ ||63|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhi- rnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || Dī. tāni kāni vamanadīni || 63 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhirnāmā- ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || Gū. pañcakarmasaṃkhyāmāha - recanaṃ virekaḥ, nirūhaṃ nirūhaṇabastiḥ | anuvāsanabastiḥ | nanu bastikarma ekavidhaṃ bhavati tatkathaṃ dvividham ? ucyate - anuvāsanasya nirūhasya ca pṛthakkaraṇāt || 63 || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūrtha- dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasya- varṇanīyo'dhyāyaḥ || Editor's notes 1 vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘jīvantī-jala-devarārujalada-tvak-sevyagopīhimam | dārvītvak-madhuka-plavā-guruvarī puṇḍrāhva- bilvotpalam|| dhāvanyau surabhiḥ sthire kṛmiharaṃ patraṃ truṭiṃ śeṇukam | kiñjalkaṃ kamalādbalāṃ śataguṇe divye'mbhasi kvāthayet || tailādrasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśoṣya tena tailaṃ pacet salilakena daśaiva vārān | pāke kṣipecca daśame samabhāgadugdhaṃ vaidyā mahāguṇamuśantyaṇutailametat’ iti varṇitam | ↩

title: 9. atha dhūmapānavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha dhūmapānavidhiḥ | dhūmasaṃkhyā - dhūmastu ṣaḍvidhaḥ proktaḥ śamano bṛṃhaṇastathā | recanaḥ kāsahā caiva vāmano ghrāṇadhūpanaḥ || 1 || śamanasya tu paryāyau madhya: prāyogikastathā | bṛṃhaṇasyāpi paryāyau snehiko mṛdureva ca || 2 || recanasyāpi paryāyau śodhanastīkṣṇa eva ca | Dī. tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - yathā nasyena cordhvajatruroganāśastathā dhūmenā'pi | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu viśeṣānnasyamiṣyate | jatrūrdhvaṃ kaphavātotthavikārāṇāmajanmane || ucchedāya ca vātānāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ sadātmavān’ iti | tena nasyādhyāyānantaraṃ dhūmapānādhyāyaḥ || atha evaṃ karmapariśeṣāt śuddhikaratvena nasyānte dhūmapānavidhirārabhyate | tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ dhūmasaṃkhyāmāha - ṣoḍhā dhūmapānaprakāraḥ | tatra śamana iti | duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanam | aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca | vyādhiśamananena prastutavyādhiśamanam | aprastutavyādheranudīraṇaṃ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe – ‘na śodhayati yaddoṣān śamānnodīrayatyapi śamīkaroti ca kruddhān tatsaṃśamanamucyata’ iti | doṣaśabdo'tra doṣeṣu doṣakāryavyādhiṣvapi vartate kārye kāraṇopacārāt | bṛṃhaṇa iti | bṛṃhaṇo balakaraḥ | dhātuvṛddhikara ityanye | tadāśrayatvāddoṣo balaṃ recana iti | śiro virecayatīti recanaḥ | kāsaheti kāsanivāraṇāya yo dīyate sa kāsahā kathitaḥ | vāmana iti | vāmayatīti vāmanaḥ | atha ghrāṇadhūpana iti | nāsikayā pīto dhūmo ghrāṇadhūpanasaṃjñaḥ | eke ghrāṇadhūpanasthāne vraṇadhūpana iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | etatsaṃgatam | atha teṣāṃ keṣāṃcitsaṃjñāntarāṇi darśayannāha - ekārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante | prayogaḥ svasthasya satatopayogaḥ | tatra sādhuprāyogikāḥ snehā yatra bhavantīti snehikaḥ || 1 || 2 || Gū. tasya ṣaḍvidhatvamāha - śamanādibhedena ṣaḍvidho dhūma: proktaḥ kathitaḥ | śamanabṛṃhaṇarecanaparyāyānāha - śamano doṣaśamanastasya paryāyau dvau ekaḥ madhyaḥ madhyanāmā aparaḥ prāyogikaḥ prāyogikanāmā | bṛṃhaṇasya dvau paryāyau ekaḥ snehanaḥ eko mṛdu: | recanasyā'pi dvau paryāyau ekaḥ śodhanaḥ aparastīkṣṇaḥ || 1 || 2 || yeṣāṃ dhūmo na vihitastānāha - adhūmārhāśca khalvete śrānto bhītaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||3|| dattabastirviriktaśca rātrau jāgaritastathā | pipāsitaśca dāhārtastāluśoṣī tathodarī || 4 || śiro'bhitāpī timirī chardyādhmānaprapīḍitaḥ | kṣatoraskaḥ pramehārtaḥ pāṇḍurogī ca garbhiṇī ||5|| rūkṣaḥ kṣīṇo'bhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsavaḥ | bhuktānnadadhimatsyaśca bālo vṛddhaḥ kṛśastathā || 6 || Dī. idānīṃ ye dhūmapāneṣu nārhāstānāha - adhū mārhāśca khalvete iti | ete vakṣyamāṇāḥ śrāntādayaḥ te tu na dhūmayogyā ityādi | śrānto bhārādinā | bhīto bhayayuktaḥ | duḥkhito ghanabandhanādinā | dattabastiriti kṛtabastiḥ | bastigrahaṇenānuvāsanāsthāpananirūhabastayo gṛhyante | virikta iti viśeṣeṇa recitaḥ | rātrau jāgarita iti | rātrijāgaraṇena vātavṛddhiḥ syāt | śiro'bhitāpo śirorogapīḍitaḥ | timirīti mandadṛṣṭiḥ | chardyādhmānaprapīḍita iti | chardipīḍitaḥ, ādhmānapīḍitaśca, ādhmāna udarāpūraḥ | kṣatoraska iti uraḥkṣatī | pramehārta iti pramehapīḍitaḥ | rūkṣo vātaprakṛtyā | athavā rūkṣā'hāreṇa janitavāyunā pīḍitaḥ | kṣīṇa iti kṣīṇadhātuḥ | abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsava iti | abhyavahṛtaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhakṣitaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ yena sa tathā | tatra kṣaudraṃ madhu ete dhūmapānaviṣaye na yogyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt īdṛśā anye'pi boddhavyāḥ || 3-6 || Gū. ekānte śrāntādayaḥ adhūmārhā dhūmayogyāḥ na | śrāntaḥ śramayukta:, bhīrurbhayayukta:, duḥkhitaḥ duḥkhārtaḥ, kenacit duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ dhananāśādibhiḥ | kṣatoraska iti | yasya abhyavahṛtaṃ bhakṣitaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣaudram āsavo madyaṃ yena saḥ abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudrāsavaḥ pumān | tathā bhuktānnadadhimatsya: bhuktam annaṃ dadhi matsyāśca yena saḥ bālaḥ vṛddhaḥ tathā kṛśo durbalaḥ || 3-6 || akāle dhūmapāne doṣaṃ tatpratīkāraṃ cāha - akāle cātipītaśca dhūmaḥ kuryādupadravān | tatreṣṭaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ nāvanāñjanatarpaṇam || 7 || sarpirikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā | madhurāmlau rasau vāpi śamanāya pradāpayet || 8 || Dī. atha yogyapītasya dhūmapānasya doṣamāha - akāla iti | asya kālo virecanokto boddhavyaḥ | atipīta iti | vihitaparimāṇādibhyo'nyathā pītaḥ svamānādbahupīto vā | nāsādeyastathā dhūmo yāvatā vartyavasāda ityādi | upadravānatra dhūmopahitajanitān | te tu tṛṣṇādāhajvarakṣavathusadanāghrāṇarogādhmānādayaḥ | tatpratīkāramāha - tatreti | dhūmapānātiśayajanitopadraveṣu | iṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | nāsāgatadoṣadūrīkaraṇāt | yato ghreyamapyatra vettivetyupadravatvāt| añjanamapyatra tadvihitameva | yataḥ | rogopadravaḥ pītalohitatīkṣṇaistannirvarṇatvāt | tarpaṇaṃ santarpaṇaṃ | tṛṣṇādāhajvaropadravatvāt | yata: tṛṣṇādāhajvarādīnāṃ sparśadoṣeṇa sīdatīti | kriyāsu asamartho bhavatītyarthaḥ | ata eva tarpaṇamiti | aparāṇyāha - sārpirikṣurasamityeko yogaḥ | drākṣāṃ payo veti dvitīyaḥ | śarkarāmbu veti tṛtīyaḥ | madhurāmlau rasau vāpīti caturthaḥ | vamanāya pradāpayediti vamanaprābalyam | tantrāntaroktaṃ yathā ‘vamanātkoṣṭhaśuddhiḥ syāddhūmagandhaśca naśyati | vidhinā'nena śāmyanti sadanaṃ kṣavathujvarāḥ’ ityādi || 7 || 8 || Gū. tathā akāle asamaye pīto dhūmaḥ upadravān kuryāt | tatra dhūmopadrave kiṃ vihitaṃ, tatrāha - tatra dhūmopadrave sarpiṣaḥ pānam iṣṭam ucitaṃ nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ tathāñjanatarpaṇaṃ gaṇḍādikaṃ sarpirghṛtapānam ikṣurasaṃ pauṇḍrakādīnāṃ rasaṃ drākṣā gostanī payo dugdhaṃ gavyaṃ vā, śarkarāmbu vā sitodakaṃ vā, madhurāmlau rasau vā, śamanāya dāpayet, sarpiṣaḥ punaruktirviśeṣaghṛtaprayogārtham | drākṣādimadhudravye gṛhīte'pi punarmadhuragrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣayogārtham || 7 || 8 || dhūmaḥ kadā gṛhyate ko vā guṇa ityāha - dhūmastu dvādaśādvarṣādgṛhyate'śītikānna ca | kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyānmanyāhanuśirorujaḥ || 9 || vātaśleṣmavikārāṃśca hanyāddhūmaḥ suyojitaḥ | dhūmaprayogātpuruṣaḥ prasannendriyavāṅmanāḥ || 10 || dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśru: sugandhivadano bhavet | Dī. atha dhūmasya vayobhedenopādeyatvamanupādeyatvamāha - dvādaśavarṣādupari arthādbālyāvasthāyāḥ dhūmapāno yojyaḥ | yāvadaśītivarṣāṇi bhavanti upari gṛhyate | aśītivarṣādupari dhūmapāno na vihita ityabhiprāyaḥ | etadviṣayaṃ prāyogikadhūmapāne svasthopayogitvena darśitam | yato'nyatra sarvairnibandhakārairapaṭhitatvāt | atha samyag yojitasya dhūmapānasya guṇamāha - dhūmaprayogāt iti | samyak pītaḥ | atha dhūmayogena phalamāha | indriyāṇi buddhīndriyāṇi | teṣāṃ prasannatā tadviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyamityarthaḥ | vākvacanaprāgalbhyaṃ manaḥ indriyatvenobhayātmakatvātpunargrahaṇam | dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśruriti | keśāḥ śiroruhāḥ śmaśru nāsādhogatauṣṭhoparilomaviśeṣaḥ | dvijā dantāḥ | sugandhivadano bhavedityasya sthāne sugandhiviśadānana iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 9 || 10 || Gū. dhūmo dvādaśādvarṣāt gṛhyate aśītikādvarṣānna gṛhyate tathā suyojito dhūmaḥ kāsādīn hanyāt | dhūmopayogāt kīdṛśaḥ puruṣo bhavedityāha - dṛḍhāḥ keśā dvijā dantāḥ śmaśruḥ mukhakeśāśca yasya saḥ || 9 || 10 || yayā nāḍyā dhūmo gṛhyate tadvidhānamāha - dhūmanāḍī bhavettatra trikhaṇḍā ca triparvikā || 11 || kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhā rājamāṣāgamāntarā | dhūmanāḍī bhaveddīrghā śamane rogiṇo'ṅgulaiḥ || 12 || catvāriṃśanmitaistadvaddvātriṃśadbhirmṛdau matā | tīkṣṇe caturviṃśatibhiḥ kāsaghnī ṣoḍaśonmitaiḥ ||13|| daśāṅgulairvāmanīye tathā syādvraṇanāḍikā | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūlā kulitthāgamarandhrakā || 14 || Dī. idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ netrasvarūpamāha - tatreti | dhūmapānaviṣaye dhūmanāḍī dhūmapānārthaṃ nāḍī netrābhidhānā | kathaṃbhūtā trikhaṇḍā | ata eva triparvikā kathitā | trigranthiyutetyādi | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhetyanena gopucchākārā kāryā | gopucchākāratvaṃ ca trikhaṇḍānāmiti bhāvaḥ | antare suṣiraṃ tu rājamāṣavadvartulānurūpaṃ kāryamityaryaḥ | eke antaranāḍikāyāḥ prānte rājamāṣasadṛśaṃ randhraṃ vadanti | mūlamukhaṃ tu rājamāṣāt kiṃcidadhikaṃ bhavati | kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāhākāratvāt | atha nāḍīsvarūpamabhidhāya saṃprati śamanādīnāmaṅgulabhedena nāḍīvibhedamāha | daśāṅgulairvāmanīyaḥ etatpañcaprakāraṃ mukhyapānatvena nāḍīviṣayatvādvihitam | ṣoḍhā saṃjñakamavaśiṣṭaṃ yat ghrāṇadhūpanam | tasya nāḍīsvarūpaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | ata eva nāḍībhedenaiva pañcaprakāraṃ pūrvamuktaṃ tadyathā - dhūmanāḍī | śamaneti śamanākhyadhūmapānayogyetyarthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtā | āturasya catvāriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā | nanu tantrāntare aṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitā nāḍī prāyogikābhidhāne śamanadhūmapāne praśastā tathāca ‘elādinā kuṣṭhanatoddhṛtena kṣaumaṃ vilipyāṅgulakāṣṭhamānam | prāyogike vartiriyaṃ tu netramaṣṭhāṅgulaṃ ṣaḍguṇitaṃ praśastam’ iti suśrutenoktam | apare tu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ prāyogike netramāhuḥ | taduktaṃ ‘sārddhaṃ tryaṃśayutaḥ pūrṇo hastaḥ prāyogikādiṣu’ iti | tatkathamatra catvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitaṃ netram ? ucyate | samalasya tu madhyaḥ | prāyogikasya tu dvau bhedau darśitau | tadbhedatvena nāḍībhedamapi jānīyānna doṣaḥ | athavā śleṣmaprakṛtau baddhadoṣe ca nare ṣaḍviṃśadaṅgulā mātrā | anyatra tvaṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaṃ tena virodhaḥ | svamate tvācāryeṇa viśeṣaṃ vicārya sāmapratipālanārthaṃ madhyabhāvaṃ netraparimāṇaṃ likhitamityadoṣaḥ | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaparimāṇeṣu kutracidvirodheṣu boddhavyam | mṛdāviti bṛṃhaṇākhye dhūmapāne dvātriṃśadaṅgulamitaṃ netraṃ bhavati | tīkṣṇa iti recanākhye dhūmapāne caturviṃśatyaṅgulamitaṃ netramatra | kāsaghne dhūmapāne ṣoḍaśāṅgulipramitaṃ | nāḍīviṣaye vāmanīye dhūmapāne daśāṅgulaṃ netramiti | pūrvamuktaṃ vraṇadhūpanārthaṃ nāḍīsvarūpamanyatrāha dhūmanimittam | īdṛśī nāḍikā netrākhyā bhavati | kādṛśī | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūleti | nāḍikā uttaramukhaṃ vraṇalagnārtham | kalāyasadṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtā | kulatthāgamarandhraketi | kulattho'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadgamanaśīlo randhraḥ suṣirastena saṃyuta ityarthaḥ | nāḍikārandhraṃ tu kulatthasadṛśaṃ kāryamiti bhāvaḥ || 11-14 || Gū. sāmānyato yā dhūmanāḍī bhavetsā trikhaṇḍā trīṇi khaṇḍāni dorakāni yasyāḥ sā, triparvikā trīṇi parvāṇi granthīryasyāḥ sā triparvikā kaniṣṭhikāṅgulī | tatparimāṇamāha - sthūlā punaḥ rājamāṣāgamā antare madhye rājamāṣaḥ tadgamaṃ chidram antare bhavati | idānīṃ śamanādau dhūmanāḍīpramāṇamāha - śamane śamanadhūmapāne yā nāḍī nalikā sā rogiṇāṃ catvāriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā matā | mṛdau mṛdudhūmapāne nāḍī sā dvātriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā | tīkṣṇe tīkṣṇadhūmapāne caturviṃśairaṅgulairdīrghā | kāsaghne dhūmapāne yā nāḍikā sāpi daśāṅgulaireva dīrghā īdṛśī | sthūlamānamāha | kalāyo vartulakastat maṇḍalavatsthūlā punā randhre yathā kulatthāgamanaṃ bhavettadvat ||11-14 || idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ īṣikāvidhānamāha - atheṣikāṃ pralimpecca suślakṣṇāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām | dhūmadravyasya kalkena lepaścāṣṭāṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15|| kalkaṃ karṣamitaṃ liptvā chāyāśuṣkaṃ ca kārayet | īṣikāmapanīyātha snehāktāṃ vartimādarāt ||16|| aṅgārairdīpitāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā netrasya randhrake | vadanena pibeddhūmaṃ vadanenaiva saṃtyajet || 17 || nāsikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vametsudhīḥ | śarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā kalkamaṅgāradīpitam || 18 || chidre netraṃ niveśyātha vraṇaṃ tenaiva dhūpayet | Dī. idānīṃ vartividhānaṃ darśayitumāha - atha īṣikāṃ pralimpediti | korthaḥ piṣṭairbheṣajaiḥ karpaṭāvayavaṃ pralikhya tena śarakāṇḍamaṅgulīsamamaṣṭāṅgulamānena veṣṭayitvā tataḥ pariśoṣya vartiḥ kāryā | avaśiṣṭaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ śarakāṇḍagrahaṇārthamuktam | snehakādiṣvapi vartikaraṇam | īṣikā kāśamucyate | ‘ṣāguri’ iti loke | atha kathaṃ vartiḥ prajvālya netre dhāryā tatprakāramāha | adalāditi | dalamatra patralepaṃ | īṣikāvartividhānaṃ ca prāyogike pradhānatamaṃ | ropaṇīyā vartiriyam | ṣaḍbhāgagodhūmena netramāvartyātmānaṃ praśasyata iti | kecit snehenābhyajyedagninā dagdhvā netre niveśya dhūmaḥ peyaḥ | yadā vadanena mukhena kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibet tadā mukhenaiva tannirgamaṃ kuryāt | nasikābhyāṃ pītamapi mukhenaivameva vamedityarthaḥ | nāsikābhyāmiti dvivacanena nāsikārandhradvayena sambandhaḥ | tata ityanena mukhapītenetarameva nāsikayā pītamityarthaḥ | tathāhi ‘mukhena taṃ vametpūrvaṃ nāsikāyāṃ punaḥ pibet’ iti | nanu tantrāntare nāsikāpītaṃ paścānmukhapītaṃ dhūmaṃ doṣakaraṃ bhavati tathāca - ‘mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva nastaḥ pītaṃ ca nastataḥ | yo vamennastato dhūmaṃ nastapītaṃ mukhena vā | sa netrakarṇanāsāsyasaṃśrayāt labhate gadān’ iti | tatkathamatra nasikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vamet sudhīriti grahaṇam | ucyate | sudhīrityudīraṇenā'tra virodhaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ | yato dhūmapānabhedena rogaviśeṣe'pi kutracinmukhapītaṃ kutrāpi nāsikāpītaṃ vā | mukhanāsikāpītamiti | tathācoktaṃ -‘uraḥkaṇṭhāśraye roge mukhenaiva pibennaraḥ | śiraḥkaṇṭhākṣināsauṣṭhe nāsayā satataṃ pibet | tiryaktve tu mukhenaiva nāsayā na kathaṃcana | pragāḍhaṃ pānamicchanti dhūmasyāṃśena tadvida’ iti | kathaṃ pibedityapi darśanāt yathā tatra prāyogikaṃ trīṃsnīnucchvāsānādadyāt | prāṇena prīṇayet trīṃścaturoveti | ‘snehikaṃ mukhanāsābhyāṃ yāvadaśru pravartanam’ | nāsikābhyāṃ vairecanikamādoṣadarśanāt | mukhenaiva kāsaharaṃ śvāsaśuddhirlāghavaṃ śirasi samaḥ evaṃ vicārya mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva vamet | nāsāpītaṃ ca nāsikayaiva | ubhābhyāṃ pītaṃ mukhenaiva vamedityadoṣaḥ | ata eva sudhīpadanirūpaṇamatra virodhaparihārāya boddhavyam | idānīṃ dhūmapānaviṣayatvena ghrāṇadhūpanamapyāha - kalkamatra nimbavacādīnāṃ vihitam | yataḥ ‘vraṇe nimbavacādīnāṃ dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyata’ iti | chidre iti śarāvasaṃpuṭarandhre | netramiti nāḍīviśeṣaḥ | sā dhūmapānārthe kathitaiva tadvadatrāpi jñeyam | vraṇadhūpanaṃ tu vedanāsrāvaśāntaye iti | athavā pūrvamuktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ vihitam | athavā - ‘śarāvasaṃpuṭayutaṃ vraṇadhūmaṃ nayedvraṇe | dhūmanetreṇa matimān vedanāsrāvaśāntaye’ iti || 15-18 || Gū. īṣikā śaratṛṇaviśeṣajanyā yā daśāṅgulānāṃ dhūmadravyakalkena limpet punaḥ śuṣke vartisnehoktaṃ kṛtvā īṣikām apanīya dūrīkṛtya netrasya nalikārandhre dhṛtvā dīpitāṃ kṛtvā vadanena dhūmaṃ pibet | vadanenaiva tyajet | tataḥ nāsikābhyām evaṃ kṛtvā vadanenaiva vamet | vraṇadhūmastu dīpanakalkaśarāve dhṛtvā chidre netraṃ niveśya vraṇaṃ dhūmayet ayaṃ dhūmapānavidhiḥ ||15-18|| śamanadhūmādau yaddravyakalko dhūmārthaṃ deyastadāha - elādikalkaṃ śamane snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ mṛdau || 19 || recane tīkṣṇakalkaṃ ca kāsaghnaṃ kṣudrikoṣaṇam | vāmane snāyucarmādyaṃ dadyāddhūmasya pānakam || 20 || vraṇe nimbavacādyaṃ ca dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyate | Dī. atha pūrvamuktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ ṣaṭprakāraṃ tadarthaṃ katipayāni dravyāṇyāha - śamane prāyogike elādikalkaṃ dhūmapānārthamāhuḥ | elādigaṇamatra suśrutoktaṃ tadyathā -‘elātagarakuṣṭhamāṃsījaladhāmakāṃ tvakpatranāgapuṣpapriyaṅguhareṇukāvyāghrīnakhaśukticaṇḍāghauṇeyaka-śrīveṣṭakacorakabālakaguggulusarjaturuṣkapuṇḍarīkāgaruspṛkkośīrabhadradārukuṅkumāni purāṇakesaraṃ ce’ti | tatra prāyogikanimittatvena kuṣṭha: tayoḥ parityāgaḥ kāryaḥ mastiṣkasrāvabhayāt | yaduktaṃ ‘natakuṣṭhe snāvayato dhūmavartiprayojite | mastuluṅgaprabhāvena tasmāttaṃ na prayojayet’ iti | mṛdāviti bṛṃhaṇākhye | snigdhamityeraṇḍādiphalamajjāprāyam | athavā snigdhamityanena samastadhūmavidhānaṃ sasnehaṃ kāryamiti pūrvoktatvāt | sārjarasamiti | sarjarasaprāyaṃ prāyogikamityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ -‘snigdhabhajjamadhūcchiṣṭasnehaguggulusarjakaiḥ | snehikā bastirebhistu netraṃ dvātriṃśadaṅgulam’ iti | recanatīkṣṇakalkamiti | recanamiti śodhanākhyadhūmapāne | tīkṣṇakalkamiti śirovirecanadravyakṛtavartirityartha: | śirovirecanairvartirnetraṃ hastamitamityuktatvāt | śirovirecanairityapāmārgabījādibhiḥ | hastamitamiti caturviśadaṅgulaṃ | kāsaghre kṣudrikoṣaṇamiti kāsaghne dhūmapāne | kṣudrikā kaṇṭakārikā | ūṣaṇamatra trikaṭukaṃ grāhyaṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | tadyathā bṛhattryūṣaṇaṃ bṛhatī śṛṅgī ceṅgudītvagmanaḥśilā | eṣā kāsaharā vartirnetraṃ ṣoḍaśakāṃgulam’ iti | vāmane snāyucarmādyamiti | vāmane dhūmapāne | snāyucarmādyaṃ vartyai dadyādityarthaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt asthikhuravallūramapi gṛhyate | taduktaṃ ‘vāmanīye tu ballūrasnāyvasthikhuravarmabhiḥ| vartirdaśāṅgule netraṃ dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ iti | vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsamiti | eke dhūmasya pānakamityanena ghrāṇadhūpanasya vyākhyānaṃ kurvanti tatra dhūmasya ghrāṇadhūpanasya pānakamiti tadvihitadravyamityarthaḥ | iti na sarvamataṃ | ‘dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ ityādivacanāt || 19 || 20 || Gū. śamane elādikalkaṃ deyam | elādirelādigaṇaḥ tatrailādinā kuṣṭhavarjeneti suśrutaḥ | tathā elādigaṇo vāgbhaṭe -
