harītakī lodhraḥ samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā āmalakī ete kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ eṣāṃ cūrṇam asminkarmaṇi karṇapūraṇe || 147 || || 148 || svarjikārasayogaḥ - svarjikācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ bījapūrarasaṃ kṣipet | karṇastrāvarujādāhāḥ praṇaśyanti na saṃśaya: || 149|| Dī. bījapūraphalasvarasaṃ, tatra manāk svarjikākṣāraprakṣiptaṃ deyam || 149 || Gū. svarjikākṣāraḥ, taccūrṇaṃ tathā bījapūrarasam || 149 || āmrāditailam | āmrajambūpravālāni madhukasya vaṭasya ca | ebhiḥ saṃsādhitaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇopaśāntikṛt ||150|| Dī. atra jambūpatrāṇi jambvāmrayostaruṇapatrāṇītyartha: | evaṃ madhukasya vaṭasya ceti | tailamatra nimbakarañjasarṣapajanitamapi deyam | tathāca - ‘etaiḥ śṛtaṃ nimbakarañjatailaṃ sasārṣapaṃ srāvaharaṃ pradiṣṭam’ iti | nimbādīnāṃ tailaṃ jalena sādhyaṃ militatvāt ||150|| Gū. karṇasrāve - āmrajambūnāṃ patrāṇi madhukasya vaṭasya ca pallavāni ebhiḥ sādhitaṃ kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇarogaśāntikṛt | pūtikarṇe pūraṇamiti sugamam || 150 || karṇakīṭe hīratālādiyogaḥ - pūraṇaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ param || 151 || Dī. mūtrayutena haritālenaiko yogaḥ | kevalasārṣapatailena dvitīyaḥ | asmatsaṃpradāye tu gomūtreṇa haritālaṃ saṃpiṣya tena kaṭutailaṃ vipācya tattailaṃ grāhyamiti pracarati | ‘athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakaṭiharaṃ param’ ityasya sthāne ‘dhūpanaṃ karṇadaurgandhye gugguluḥ śreṣṭha ucyata’ iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 151 || karṇakīṭe – śigrusvarasādiyogaḥ - svarasaṃ śigrumūlasya sūryāvartarasaṃ tathā | tryūṣaṇaṃ cūrṇitaṃ caiva kapikacchūjaṭārasam || 152 || kṛtvaikatra kṣipetkarṇe karṇakaṭiharaṃ param | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe lepādividhirnāmai- kādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || Dī. sūryāvartā suvarcalā | sā dvidhā ekā mocalīśabdavācyā | aparā brahmasauvarcalīti | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukam | kapikacchū vānarī | śeṣaṃ subodham || 152 || iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracite śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe lepamūrdhatailakarṇa- pūraṇā'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || Gū. karṇakīṭe - śigru: śobhāñjanam, tasya svarasaḥ sūryāvartā suvarcalā tasyā vā svarasaḥ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭucūrṇaṃ tathā kapikacchū vānarī | sadyoniḥsṛtasvarasaṃ | sudāruṇaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ karṇapūraṇāt || 152 || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthapikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne lepanādi- vidhirapyāyaḥ ||11|| Editor's notes 1 dīpikāsammataḥ | ↩ 2 tathāhi suśrute - ‘tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate'timātraṃ tat pluṣṭam, yatra uttiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāścoṣadāharāgapākavedanāścirācca upaśāmyanti taddurdagdham; samyagdagdhamanavagāḍhaṃ tālaphalavarṇaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca; atidagdhe māṃsā'valambanaṃ, gātraviśleṣaḥ, sirāsnāyusandhyasthivyāpādanamatimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrcchāśca upadravā bhavanti; vraṇaśca asya cireṇa rohati rūḍhaśca vivarṇo bhavati’ iti su. sū 12 | ↩ 3 idaṃ tvasaṅgatam | madhu mākṣikaṃ, karpūraṃ prasiddham etairlepanam | ityevābhiprāyo granthakartu: | ↩

title: 12. atha raktamokṣavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha śoṇitavisrāvavidhiradhunā vidhīyate atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ yathā lepādayo dehakāntikarāstadvacchoṇitavisrāvaṇamapi | ataḥ śoṇitasrāvaṇamāha - śoṇitaṃ srāvayejjantorāmayaṃ prasamīkṣya ca | prasthaṃ prasthārdhakaṃ vāpi prasyārdhārdhamathāpi vā || 1 || śaratkāle svabhāvena kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ | tvagdoṣagranthiśothādyā na syū raktasruteryataḥ || 2 || Dī. prasthamatra sārdhatrayodaśapalāni | tathācoktaṃ ‘vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe | sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prasthamāhurmanīṣiṇa’ iti | nanu tantrāntare prasthaṃ prasthadvayaṃ ca krameṇa raktasrāvaṃ kathitaṃ tathāhi - ‘jaghanyamadhyaprabaleṣu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthastathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ca’ iti | tatkkāthamatra prasthaṃ prasthārdhaṃ ca kathitaṃ, katham ? ucyate | tantrāntare yadidaṃ tadbahudoṣasyāvajinaḥ puruṣasya paraṃ pramāṇamāmananti | atra tu saśeṣadoṣaraktaṃ rakṣaṇīyamityālocyācāryeṇa prasthādisaṃgrahaḥ kṛta ityadoṣaḥ | tathāhi ‘raktaṃ svabhāvādṛtuvihitatvādanāturasyāpi raktasrutiḥ praśastā’ iti | yataḥ pittaṃ śaradi kupyatīti vacanādraktasyāpi kopo bhavatīti niyamaḥ | tathāca pittaprakopeṇaiva śoṇitaṃ ca prakupyatīti| tasmāccharadi śoṇitavisrāvaṇaṃ vihitam | tatsrāvaṇāt tvagdoṣādayo'pi na syu: | tvagdoṣā aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni nyacchanīlikādayaśca | granthayo vātādimilitvā śirāgranthiśca | śothā doṣaduṣṭibhavā vraṇaśothādayaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt anye'pi śoṇitajā rogā raktagulmavidradhivisarpādayaḥ || 1 || 2 || Gū. atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma: | āmayaṃ raktajanyaṃ kuṣṭādyaṃ rogaṃ prasamīkṣya dṛṣṭvā janto: prāṇinaḥ śoṇitaṃ srāvayet | kiyatparimitaṃ srāvayedityāha - prasthaṃ mukhyaṃ prasthārdhaṃ madhyaṃ prasthārdhārdhaṃ nyūnaṃ vā kadā raktaṃ srāvayet svabhāvena raktasrāvasvabhāvena śaratkāle raktasrutiṃ srāvaṃ kuryāt, kutaḥ ? tvagdoṣā granthiśothādyā raktasruteryato na syuḥ kuṣṭhavātaraktādayaḥ | granthirvraṇādigranthiḥ || 1 || 2 || ādau raktasya rasavarṇaguṇādīnāha - madhuraṃ varṇato raktamaśītoṣṇaṃ tathā guru | śoṇitaṃ snigdhavisraṃ syādvidāhaścāsya pittavat ||3|| visratā dravatā rāgaścalanaṃ vilayastathā | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāmete raktaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 4 || Dī. atha śoṇitasya prakṛtiṃ vaktumāha | madhuraṃ varṇata iti | makṣikāpipīlikādīnāṃ prācuryamupasarpaṇānmādhuryamasya pratītam | varṇato raktamiti | raktamāraktam indragopaprakāśamityeke, tadevapadmālaktaguñjāphalavarṇamapyuktam | athavā vastrādilagnaṃ satprakṣālyamānamapi na vivarṇatāṃ yātītyapare | aśītoṣṇamiti | na caikāntataḥ śītaṃ nātyuṣṇamiti | yato'gnīṣomīyādraktasya tattulyaguṇayoramlaśītayorabhilāṣo raktakṣaye bhavatīti darśanāt | athavā prakopo'sya doṣaireva tanmūlatvadoṣānurūpamanuṣṇaśītam | tathāhi - ‘yasmādraktaṃ vinā doṣairna kdācitprakupyati | tasmāttasya yathādoṣaṃ kālaṃ vidyātprakopanam’ iti | snigdhavisraṃ syāditi | snigdhaṃ vikṣuṇṇaṃ visramāmagandhi vidāhaścāsya pittavaditi pittasya yena vastunā yathā vidāhastena vastunā tathā vidāhaḥ śoṇitasyāpītyarthaḥ | atha śoṇite pāñcabhautikatvaṃ pratipādayannāha - yasmādeti visrādaya: pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇāḥ śoṇite dṛśyante tasmādraktaṃ pāñcamautikamiti | tatra visratā vigandho bhūmiguṇaḥ dravatā dravabhāgo'yamambuguṇaḥ | rāgo raktatā tejoguṇaḥ | calanaṃ naikatra sthitiśīlatvamayaṃ vātaguṇaḥ sādanamityapare | vilaya iti vilayanopyākāśaguṇaḥ | eke vilayasthāne laghuteti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāmiti | ādiśabdena aptejovāyvākāśāni gṛhyante ||3 || 4 || Gū. raktam ādau rasato madhuraṃ, varṇato raktaṃ, guṇata aśītoṣṇaṃ, tathā gurumātrayā guru, tathā snigdhaṃ, sacikkaṇaṃ, visram āmagandhi, vidāho dāhakartṛtvaṃ ca asyāpi tadeva | rakte bhūmyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ guṇāśca santi tānāha - visratā āmagandhitā bhūmiguṇaḥ sacchidratā vā | ete guṇāḥ bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāṃ kramātsmṛtā: ||3||4|| duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe kiṃ bhavatītyāha - rakte duṣṭe vedanā syātpāko dāhaśca jāyate | raktamaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūḥ śothaśca piṭikodgamaḥ || 5 || vṛddhe raktāṅganetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā | gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ nidrā mado dāhaśca jāyate || 6 || kṣīṇe'mlamadhurākāṅkṣa mūrcchā ca tvaci rūkṣatā | śaithilyaṃ ca sirāṇāṃ syādvātādunmārgagāmitā ||7|| aruṇaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu śīghragam | askandi sūcinistodi raktaṃ syādvātadūṣitam ||8|| pittena pītaṃ haritaṃ nīlaṃ śyāvaṃ ca visrakam | askandyuṣṇaṃ makṣikāṇāṃ pipīlānāmaniṣṭakam ||9|| śītalaṃ bahalaṃ snigdhaṃ gairikodakasaṃnibham | māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ skandi mandagaṃ kaphadūṣitam || 10 || dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ triduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhakam | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate || 11 || viṣaduṣṭaṃ bhavecchyāvaṃ nāsikonmārgagaṃ tathā | visnaṃ kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ bahu || 12 || Gū. idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasyā'pi lakṣaṇamāha - rakte duṣṭe iti | vātādidoṣadūṣite vedanā pīḍā pāko dāhaśca vraṇeṣveva prācuryamasyābhihitam | raktamaṇḍalateti raktavarṇamaṇḍalotpattiḥ | kaṇḍūḥ pāmāviśeṣaḥ, śotho vraṇaśothaḥ, piḍakā granthādayaḥ | atha raktātivṛddhau satyāṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadāha -raktāṅganetratvamiti | tena raktāṅganetratā ca bhavati, sirāṇāṃ pūrṇatā tatheti | sirāścātra raktavahā jñeyāḥ, tāsāṃ pūrṇatā raktatetyarthaḥ | medo medovṛddhiḥ prāyeṇātrāsthigatamedovṛddhiḥ syādityatra viṣayaḥ yataḥ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu satataṃ meda ucyata’ iti | kṣīṇe'mlamadhurākāṅkṣeti | śoṇitakṣaye sati vātavṛddhau satyāṃ tatpratīkārārthatvādamlarasecchā | tathā raktasya dravatvāttatkṣaye sati tejovṛddhau satyāṃ madhuraprārthanā | eke kṣīṇe'mlaśītalākāṅkṣeti paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | tvagvirūkṣateti vātavṛddhitaḥ sirāṇāṃ raktavahānāṃ ca śaithilyaṃ bhavati | atiraktatvāt | ghātātprahārāt unmārgagamitā raktasyetyarthaḥ | idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasya vātādīnāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇānyāha | aruṇādyuktalakṣaṇai: kṛtvā vātadūṣitaṃ raktaṃ jānīyāt | tatrāruṇamīṣadraktaṃ kṛṣṇābhāvaṃ vyākhyānayanti | phenilaṃ phenayuktaṃ paruṣamapicchilaṃ, tanu acchaṃ, śīghragamāśupravṛtti ata evāvaskandādīni | askandi styānarahitam | sūcībhiriva nistodanaṃ gātreṣu pittena yadā duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ syāttadā etādṛśaṃ bhavati kiṃ tatpītamiti|| pītaṃ pītavarṇam | tacca nirāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | haritaṃ śyāmavatpratibhāsam | nīlaṃ haritaśyāvam | tacca sāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | śyāvaṃ haritakṛṣṇam | visrakamāmagandhikam | askandi ceti styānarahitam | bhakṣikāpipīlikānāniṣṭamiti | aniṣṭamapriyam | yataḥ tāsāṃ mate'nusaraṇādaniṣṭatvamavagantavyaṃ kaphadūṣitaṃ raktamīdṛśaṃ bhavati śītalaṃ sparśādvīryāt bahalaṃ dhanaṃ gairikodakasannibhamiti pāṇḍulohitaṃ kathitam | māṃsapeśīprabhamitistyānatvāt | pāṇḍulohitamiti bhāvaḥ | ata eva skandi kathitam | skanditvādevamavargatvamasyoktam | atha saṃsargasannipātānvitaraktavikṛterlakṣaṇānyāha - dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ śoṇitamiti śeṣaḥ, yato dvābhyāṃ doṣābhyāṃ dūṣitaṃ tatsaṃsṛṣṭamiti kathitam | etena dvābhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ militaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | triduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sannipātadūṣitaṃ kathitaṃ tribhirdoṣairdūṣitaṃ triduṣṭam | tacca pūtigandhikaṃ bhavati | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktamiti | sarveṣāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ lakṣaṇairyuktamiti | tadeva kāñjikābhaṃ ca bhavatīti | idānīṃ viṣaduṣṭasya raktasyākṛtiṃ darśayannāha - viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ tena duṣṭaṃ dūṣitamityarthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ kena lakṣitaṃ tadāha - śyāvamiti | haritakṛṣṇaṃ varṇato bhavati | nāsikonmārgagaṃ tatheti | nāsikayā unmārgagāmi bhavati | tena nādhaḥ pravartate iti tātparyārthaḥ | viṣaprabhāvāt nāsikopalakṣitatvāttena mukhunetrakarṇairapi pravartata iti bhāvaḥ | visramityāmagandhi | sarvakuṣṭhakaramiti viṣaprabhāvāt | tathāhi ‘viṣeṇa dūṣitaṃ raktaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ matam’ iti || 5-12 || Gū. duṣṭe kupite rakte vedanā pīḍā syātpākādayaśca jāyante | raktavṛddhilakṣaṇamāha - vṛddhe rakte raktāṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati raktāṅgatvaṃ raktanetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ dhamanyādīnāṃ pūraṇaṃ raktenaiva, gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ gurutā, madaḥ pūgabhakṣaṇavat, dāha uṣṇatvam | kṣīṇe rakte kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha -kṣīṇe idaṃ bhavati - amlamadhurākāṅkṣā spṛhā, mūrcchā mūrcchitaṃ kṣīṇe tvaci rūkṣatā śaithilyaṃ vātasyaiva unmārgagāmitā ca | vātaduṣṭaraktalakṣaṇamāha - vātadūṣitaṃ raktam evaṃvidhaṃ syāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ tadāha - aruṇaraktaṃ phenilaṃ phenavat, rūkṣaṃ sneharahitaṃ, tanu adhanaṃ, paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ, śīghragamanaṃ śīlaṃ askandi, ghanatvarahitaṃ, visrāvaviśeṣaḥ srāvayuktaṃ, pittadūṣitaraktamāha - pittena dūṣitaṃ pītaharitādivarṇaṃ raktaṃ bhavati tadāha - visrakaṃ srāvagandhi askandi cāñcalyarahitaṃ makṣikādīnāṃ aniṣṭakaṃ bhakṣaṇe hitaṃ na | kaphadūṣitaraktamāha - kaphadūṣitaṃ śītalādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha - śītalaṃ śītaguṇaṃ sparśena vā śītalaṃ, bahulaṃ bahutaraṃ, snigdhaṃ sacikkaṇaṃ, gairikodakasannibhaṃ gairikajalasadṛśaṃ, punaḥ māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ granthirūpaṃ, skandi ghanatvasadṛśaṃ, mandagaṃ mandagamanaṃ, dvidoṣatridoṣaduṣṭalakṣaṇamāha – dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭadvidoṣalakṣaṇamāha - dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvidoṣalakṣaṇayuktaṃ bhavati triduṣṭaṃ tridoṣaduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhaṃ durgandhaṃ tathā kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate | viṣaduṣṭamāha - viṣaduṣṭaṃ viṣayuktaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ bhavet nāsikāgandhaṃ tathā unmārgagam | visram āmagandhi, kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ kāñjikatulyaṃ tathā sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ, tathā bahu adhikam || 5-12 || prakṛtistharaktalakṣaṇamāha - indragopaprabhaṃ jñeyaṃ prakṛtisthamasaṃhatam | Dī. atha vikṛtaraktamabhidhāya prakṛtisthaṃ darśayannāha - yaḥ prāvṛṭkālajo jantuviśeṣaḥ indravadhūriti loke | sa cānekaprakāravarṇaḥ, atra tu rakta eva gṛhyate | asaṃhatamiti nātyacchaṃ nātighanaṃ na styāyatītyanye || Gū. indragopo vīravadhūṭī tadvat raktaṃ tathā asaṃhatam astyānam evaṃbhūtaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ raktaṃ jñeyam || yeṣu raktasrāvo vihitastānāha - śothe dāhe'ṅgapāke ca raktavarṇe'sṛjaḥ srutau || 13|| vātarakte tathā kuṣṭhe sapīḍe durjaye'nile | pāṇiroge ślīpade pade ca viṣaduṣṭe ca śoṇite || 14 || granthyarbudāpacīkṣudrarogaraktādhimanthiṣu | vidārīstanarogeṣu gātrāṇāṃ sādagaurave || 15 || raktābhiṣyandatandrāyāṃ pūtighrāṇāsyadehake | yakṛtplīhavisarpeṣu vidradhau piṭikodgame ||16|| karṇauṣṭhaghrāṇavaktrāṇāṃ pāke dāhe śiroruji | upadaṃśe raktapitte raktasrāva: praśasyate || 17|| eṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgairvā jalaukālābukairapi | athavāpi sirāmokṣaiḥ kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ || 18 || Dī. atha raktasrāvo yeṣāṃ vihitastānāha - śothe vraṇaśothe ekāṅgaje'pi srāvyaḥ | yataḥ sarvāṅgaśotho niṣiddhaśca sa vāmlabhojananimittaḥ | pāṇḍurogyarśasodariśoṣigarbhiṇīnāṃ ca śvayathau, aṅgadāhe aṅgapāke ca | raktavarṇe'sṛjaḥ srutāviti kevalaraktapitte | sapīḍe durjaye'nile iti | tathāhi - ‘uṣṇāmlalavaṇādervātaharasyopayogātkupitena śoṇitenāvṛto vāto yadā vedanākārī tadā sirāvyadha iti | pāṇiroge dāhādau tena bāhurogo'pi gṛhyate | yaduktaṃ -śoṇitāvṛtavātajanitayorbāhuśoṣāpabāhukayorapyaṃśayorantare sirāvyadhaḥ | apacyāmiti | utpannamātrāyāmityarthaḥ | na tu rūḍhāyāṃ tasyām | kṣudrarogeṣu arūṃṣikādiṣu | vidradhāviti ṣaḍvidhavidradhiṣu madhye pacca visrāvyāḥ taduktaṃ - ‘srāvyā vidradhayaḥ pañca bhaveyuḥ sarvapādata’ iti | upadaṃśe iti | upadaṃśagrahaṇāt parivartikaśūkadoṣaśukavyāpatsu ca meḍhramadhye sirāvyadhaḥ | raktapittamiti | romakūpodgatamityeke | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha śoṇitavisrāvaṃ yairvastubhiḥ kuryāttāni darśayannāha - eṣu pūrvokteṣu śothaprabhṛtiṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgādicatuḥprakārā yathāyogyānurūpato yojyā | śṛṅgaṃ tu gośṛṅgaṃ tacca saptāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ bhavati | tathāca ‘srāve tu śvetagośṛṅgaṃ vakraṃ saptāṅgulāyataṃ | kṣiptvāntaḥ picupeśīkaṃ yojyaṃ vātayute'sṛji | aṅguṣṭhamūlavanmūlaṃ chidramagre'sya mudgavat | vastrapaṭṭāvanaddhaṃ ca raktamācūṣaṇāddharet’ iti | jalaukāḥ prasiddhāḥ, tāśca dvādaśadhā bhavanti | tāsāṃ ṣaṭ saviṣā: tāvantya eva nirviṣāśca | vistāro'pi tāsāmanyatra jñātavyaḥ | atra granthagauravabhayānna likhitaḥ | alābukā tumbīśabdavācyā | tasyā lakṣaṇaṃ kenaciditi darśitam | tadyathā - aṅguṣṭhāṅgulapariṇāhā ca - turaṅgulā'nāśasaṃmitā sumukhā kṛṣṇamṛdāliptatanuḥ śreṣṭhā raktā ca sevane'lābūḥ | sāntardīrghamayutā tayā ca visrāvayedraktamiti | śirāmokṣairiti śirā raktavahāstāsāṃ mokṣaḥ śastreṇa kuryāditi | mokṣo rudhirasyeti || 13-18 || Gū. śothe dāheti śothādirogeṣu nṛṇāṃ raktasrāvaḥ praśasyata ityanvayaḥ | raktavarṇe dehe asṛjaḥ srutau sādisrāve sapīḍe pīḍāsahite anile durjaye jetumaśakye gātrasādo gātraśaithilyaṃ raktābhiṣyandam āraktanetraṃ, spaṣṭamanyat | eṣu rogeṣu kena raktaṃ srāvayedityāha - jalaukā nirviṣā purātanāśca ‘mahyakāṃ vājayavanayājyapautanayā (?) śubhā’ iti suśrutoktatvāt alābu tumbīśirā tadvidhānasthānaṃ taddvidhā nipuṇairvaidyairjñeyam || 13-18 || yeṣu sirāmokṣo niṣiddhaḥ tānāha - na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛśasyātivyavāyina:| klībasya bhīrorgarbhiṇyāḥ sūtikāpāṇḍurogiṇām ||19|| pañcakarmaviśuddhasya pītasnehasya cārśasām | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānāmudaraśvāsakāsinām ||20|| chardyatīsāraduṣṭānāmatisvinnatanorapi | ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya gatasaptatikasya ca || 21 || āghātasrutaraktasya sirāmokṣo na śasyate | eṣāṃ cātyayike roge jalaukābhistu nirharet ||22|| Dī. atha yeṣāṃ sirāmokṣaṇaṃ na syāttānāha - kṛśasya kṣīṇasya puṃsaḥ | klībo napuṃsakaḥ | pañcakarmeti | vamanavirecananiruhānuvāsananasyāni taiḥ śodhitasya puṃsaḥ | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānāmiti | sarvāṅgatvena vraṇaśothā ekāṅgatā api gṛhyante | āghātātprahārādinā srutaṃ raktaṃ yasya sirāmokṣo dvividhaḥ pracchannaḥ sirāvyadhaśva | ‘na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛtasyātivyavāyina’ ityādivyākhyā pūrvaṃ pratipāditā | adhunā'pi viśeṣamāha | kṛśasya garbhiṇīnāṃ copakṣīṇadhātutvāddehabhayāt | ativyavāyino vātaprakopabhayānna vidhyet | klībasya pradhānadhātukṣaye alpasatvena ca niḥsṛtavināśāt | bhīrośca tamobahulatvāllohitadarśanena mūrcchābhayānna vidhyet | sūtikāyā garbhiṇīvat | pañcakarmaviśuddhasyetyādi | vāntaviriktayoraktasarjanayorapītasnehayorvamanavirecanānantarameva vātaprakopabhayācchirāṃ na vidhyet | āsthāpitajāgaritayormarutprakopabhayānna vidhyet | anuvāsitasya mande'gnau bhūyo'gnimāndyabhayāt | anye vyadhā anumānato nirūpaṇīyāḥ | sirāmokṣo na śasyata iti dvirukte sati viśeṣeṇa sirāniṣedhaparatvāt vācyaḥ, ātyayike tu śṛṅgālābujalaukāprabhṛtiparatvāccāvekṣya | athātyayike kṛśādīnāmapi śoṇitavisrāvaviṣayaṃ vaktumāha - eṣāmiti| pūrvoktānāṃ kṛśādīnāmapi yadi āthātyayike roge sati tadā jalaukābhirnirharet | paramasukumārayogatvānnirharedvisrāvayecchoṇitamiti śeṣaḥ | atyayo'vināśo bhavatyasmādityātyayiko vidradhyādirananyasādhyaḥ | tathā viṣajuṣṭānāṃ puruṣāṇāmapi jalaukābhistu nirharaṇaṃ kartavyam | na kevalaṃ jalaukābhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇāpi viṣaprabhāveṇa sakalaśarīradūṣitatvāt sarvaṃ raktaṃ dūṣitameva | ata eva sirāmokṣaḥ | yataḥ ‘sirāsarvāṅgaśodhinī’ iti vacanāt || 19-22 || Gū. kṛśasya durbalasya ativyavāyinaḥ atistrīsaktasya pañcakarmāṇi vamanadīni tacchuddhasya atisvinnatanoḥ atisveditasya ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya bālasya gatasaptatikasya ata ūrdhvaṃ vṛddhasyetyarthaḥ | āghrāṇena nāsikayā raktaṃ srutasya eṣāṃ ca ātyayike na kāryaṃ jalaukāmī raktaṃ na haret || 19-22 || vātādiduṣṭaṃ kena srāvayedityāha - tathā ca viṣaduṣṭānāṃ śirāmokṣo'pi śasyate | gośṛṅgeṇa jalaukābhiralābubhirapi tridhā || 23 || vātapittakaphairduṣṭaṃ śoṇitaṃ srāvayedbudhaḥ | dvidoṣābhyāṃ tu saṃduṣṭaṃ tridoṣairapi dūṣitam ||24|| śoṇitaṃ srāvayedyuktyā sirāmokṣaiḥ padaistathā | gṛhṇāti śoṇitaṃ śṛṅgaṃ daśāṅgulamitaṃ balāt ||25|| jalaukā hastamātraṃ tu tumbī ca dvādaśāṅgulam | padamaṅgulamātrasya sirā sarvāṅgaśodhinī || 26 || śīte niranne mūrcchāyāṃ tandrābhītimadaśramaiḥ | yutānāṃ na sravedraktaṃ tathā viṇmūtrasaṅginām ||27|| Dī. atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa śṛṅgādiviṣayaṃ vibhajannāha - bhiṣagiti grahaṇāddṛṣṭakramo jñeyaḥ | tena vātaduṣṭaṃ śṛṅgeṇa, yataḥ ‘uṣṇaṃ samadhuraṃ śṛṅgaṃ gavyaṃ snigdhaṃ prakīrtitam | tasmādvātopasṛṣṭeṣu hitaṃ tadavasecane’ iti | pittaduṣṭaṃ tu rudhiraṃ jalaukābhirnirharet | tathāhi ‘śītādhivāsā madhurā jalaukā vārisaṃbhavā | tasmātpittopasṛṣṭe tu hitā sā tvavasecane’ iti | kaphaduṣṭaṃ tu - alābubhiriti | athātivyastamabhidhāya pittadoṣaduṣṭasya raktasyāvasecanopāyamāha - dvidoṣābhyāmityādipadaiḥ krūrapradhānaiḥ yuktetyanena yathāyogyānurūpaṃ yojyam | tena padopalakṣitatvācchṛṅgālābupracāro'vagantavyaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘sarvāṇi vātapittakaphaduṣṭāni śoṇitāni’ | sarvairiti śṛṅgādibhiryathāyogyamityabhiprāyaḥ | atha śṛṅgādīnāṃ kiyaddūre pracārastaṃ darśayannāha - daśāṅgulamityubhayataḥ | tena caturdikṣu daśāṅgulamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra viṣayapadaṃ pracchannam | ata evāha kaścit - ‘avagāḍhe jalaukā syātpracchannaṃ piṇḍite hitam | sirā ca vyāpake rakte śṛṅgālābu tvaci sthite’ iti | atha śoṇitaṃ na srāvayettānāha - śīte iti | śīte śītārdite deśe puruṣe ca niranne iti laṅghite | atitandrā nidrānāśaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘madamūrcchāśramārtānāṃ vātaviṇmūtrasaṅginām | nidrā'bhibhūtabhītānāṃ nṛṇāṃ nā'sṛk pravartate’ iti | viṇmūtrasaṃgināmiti | viṇmūtrādīnāṃ saṃgo pravṛttistadyuktānāmityarthaḥ | viṇmūtragrahaṇenaiva vātasaṃgasyāpyavarodhaḥ || 23-27 || Gū. śṛṅgādīnāṃ śoṇitagrahaṇe pramāṇamāha - sugamam | yeṣāṃ raktaṃ na srāvayet tānāha - śīte śītakāle viṇmūtrasaṃgināṃ apravartinām || 23-27 || rakte vidhānamāha - apravartitarakte ca kuṣṭhatrikaṭusaindhavaiḥ | mardayedvraṇavaktraṃ ca tena samyakpravartate || 28 || Dī. idānīmapravartitasya śoṇitasya cikitsāyogaṃ vaktumāha - yadā śītādihetubhirna sravettadā trikaṭukādicūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vraṇaṃ gharṣayet | trikaṭukaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, saindhavaṃ ca, śeṣaṃ sugamam || 28 || Gū. vraṇavaktraṃ vraṇamukhaṃ, śoṇitasamayavidhānaṃ cāha, sugamam || 28 || idānīṃ sukhavisrāvaṇārthaṃ hitopadeśamāha - tasmānna śīte nātyuṣṇe na svinne nātitāpite | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasya srāvayecchoṇitaṃ budhaḥ ||29|| Dī. tasmāditi pūrvoktāpravartitaraktaviṣayadarśanāt | na śīte nātyuṣṇeti sādhāraṇakāle | ata evoktaṃ suśrute - ‘vyabhre varṣāsu vidhyeta grīṣmakāle tu śītale | hemantakāle madhyāhne śastrakālāstrayo matā’ iti | na svinne iti svedite | nātitāpite iti śramādibhiḥ saṃtapte | sūryatāpādityanye | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasyeti | yavāgūratra tilayavāgū: tasyāḥ sadyaḥ snehanīyatvāt | raktotkleśakāritvācca | anye tu yavāgūrviraladraveti bahusṛtām | tṛptasyeti kathanāt || 29 || atha kena hetunā raktātipravṛttistaddarśayannāha - atisvinnasyoṣṇakāle tathaivātisirāvyadhāt | atipravartate raktaṃ tatra kuryātpratikriyām || 30|| atipravṛtte rakte ca lodhrasarjarasāñjanaiḥ | yavagodhūmacūrṇairvā dhavadhanvanagairikaiḥ || 31 || sarpanirmokacūrṇairvā bhasmanā kṣaumavastrayoḥ | mukhaṃ vraṇasya baddhvā ca śītaiścopacaredvraṇam || 324|| vidhyedūrdhvaṃ sirāṃ tāṃ ca dahetkṣāreṇa vāgninā | vraṇaṃ kaṣāyaḥ saṃdhatte raktaṃ skandayate himam ||23|| vraṇāsyaṃ pācayetkṣāro dāhaḥ saṃkocayetsirām | vāmāṇḍaśothe dakṣasya karasyāṅguṣṭhamūlajām || 34 || dahetsirāṃ vyatyaye tu vāmāṅguṣṭhasirāṃ dahet | sirādāhaprabhāveṇa muṣkaśothaḥ praṇaśyati || 35 || viṣūcyāṃ pārṣṇidāhena jāyate'gneḥ pradīpanam | saṃkucanti yatastena rasaśleṣmavahāḥ sirāḥ || 36 || yadā vṛddhiryakṛtplīhnoḥ śiśoḥ saṃjāyate'sṛjaḥ | tadā tatsthānadāhena saṃkucantyasṛjaḥ sirāḥ ||37|| rakte duṣṭe'vaśiṣṭe'pi vyādhirnaiva prakupyati | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ raktaṃ nātikramo hitaḥ ||38|| āndhyamākṣepakaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ timiraṃ śiraso rujam | pakṣaghātaṃ śvāsakāsau hikkāṃ dāhaṃ ca pāṇḍutām ||39|| kurute'tisṛtaṃ raktaṃ maraṇaṃ vā karoti ca | dehasyotpattirasṛjā dehastenaiva dhāryate || 40 || vinā tena vrajejjīvo rakṣedraktamato budhaḥ | Dī. atisvinnetyatyarthaṃ svedite puruṣe deśe vā | soṣṇakāle grīṣmartau śaradṛtau vā | atisirāvyadhāditi ajñaprayuktena śastreṇāvagāḍhavyadhanādraktātisrutirbhavati | pūrvamuktaṃ tatra kuryātpratikriyāmityataḥ tāṃ pratikriyāṃ darśayannāha - atra sarjaraso rālaḥ| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yacca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ rasāñjanasaṃjñaṃ keciditi vyākhyānayanti | sarjaḥ śālabhedaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ tadeva | dhavo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | dhanvano dhāmana iti prasiddhaḥ | lodhrādibhiścūrṇīkṛtābhirvraṇamukhamavacūrṇyāṅgulyagreṇāvapīḍayediti pracāraḥ | sarpanirmokaḥ sarpakañculikā | kṣaumavastrayorbhasmeti | paṭāmbaradagdhabhasma kṣaumam atasībhavam | taddagdhvā bhasmakāryam evaṃ vastrasya vastragrahaṇāt kārpāsasaṃbhavaṃ bhasmāpi mukhavraṇasya | badhveti yathoktavraṇabandhanadravyairgāḍhaṃ badhnīyādityarthaḥ | śītaiścopacaredvraṇaṃ śītācchādanabhojanāgāraiḥ śītaiḥ pradehapariṣekaiśca vraṇaṃ śastrādijanitaṃ yadyupacaret | vā pakṣāntaraprakāramāha - vidhyedūrdhvamityādi | prāktanavyaktāt parasthāne tāmeva pūrvaviddhāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet | raktagaticchedanārtham kṣāreṇāgninā vā dahediti vastrādipadābhiprāyaḥ | atha lodhrādīnāṃ śoṇitātipravṛttau prayuktānāṃ pratyekaphalamāha -kaṣāyo'tra lodhrasarjarasāñjanaprabhṛtikaḥ | sa ca vraṇagharṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvamevātra darśitaḥ | anye tu harītakyādiḥ pañcavalkalādikaḥ | etena kimuktam, ayaṃ kaṣāyaḥ vraṇaṃ śastrāghātajaṃ rudhiraṃ saṃdhatte nivārayedityarthaḥ | vraṇagrahaṇena jalaukāmukhakṣatajamapi grāhyam | himaṃ śītalam | raktamityatipravartitaṃ skandayedastyānībhūtaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | kṣāro'tra vihito'pāmārgādijanitaḥ kṣaumādijanito vetyatra vihitaḥ, sa ca vraṇāsyaṃ vraṇamukhaṃ pācayet | tenātipravartitaraktaṃ saṃsthāpya samyakprarohayedityabhiprāyaḥ | dāho'gnikṛtaḥ śalākāpravṛttibhiḥ sa ca śirāṃ raktavahāṃ saṃkocayet | tenātipravartitaṃ samyagavatiṣṭhate | idānīṃ raktātisrāve upadeśaṃ darśayannāha | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ iti | sāvaśeṣaṃ doṣaraktaṃ punaḥ saṃśamanādibhirjayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yathātiyoganiḥsṛtasya raktasya vyāpadaṃ darśayannāha | āndhyamandhatām | atrordhvajatrugatarogaṃ śirasyatipravṛttaṃ raktaṃ karoti | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha raktasrāvaṇe bhūyobhūyotikramo na karaṇīya ityāha | utpattiriti | upasthitipralayeṣu śoṇitameva hetuḥ śoṇitena | etenaiva dhāryate sthāpyate | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 30-40 || Gū. atisvinnasyeti sugamam | atipravṛtte kriyāmāha - atipravṛtte rakte evaṃ kuryāttadāha -lodhraṃ, sarjo rālaḥ, rajāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, yava kāṣṭhadhanvanaḥ | sarpanirmokaṃ sarpakaṃcukaṃ vastraṃ cīraṃ kṣaumaṃ paṭṭavastram | śītaiḥ śītopacāraiḥ tāṃ śirāṃ bāhu ūrdhvaṃ vidhyet | ūrdhvaṃ tasmāt śirābandhāt ūrdhvam | tathāca vāgbhaṭe ‘tāmeva vā śirāṃ vidhyedbandhāttasmādanantaram’ iti | kṣāreṇa dahet lipetkṣāreṇa ṭaṅkaṇādinā kṣāreṇa vahninā vā daheddāhaṃ kuryāt | kaṣāyaḥ kaṣāyadravyaṃ rodhrādi vraṇaṃ saṃdhatte saṃnahanaṃ saṃkurute| himaṃ śītalaṃ candanādidravyaṃ raktaṃ skandayate śoṣayati sthāpayati vā, kṣāraḥ vraṇaṃ pācayati, dāhaḥ śirāḥ saṃkocayet dāho yathā sugamam | visūcyāmiti sugamam | duṣṭe rakte niḥsṛte kiṃcidavaśiṣṭe'pi vyādhirna kupyati ataḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ srāvyam | atikramo na hitaḥ | raktasya niśe:ṣasrāve doṣasrāvaṇāttadāha - atisrutaṃ atiniḥsṛtaṃ raktasya jīvasya sāmye | taddehasyotpātādīnāha - sugamam || 30-40 || srute rakte'pi doṣakope pratīkāramāha - śītopacāraiḥ kupite srutaraktasya mārute || 41 || koṣṇena sarpiṣā śothaṃ savyathaṃ pariṣecayet | kṣīṇasyaiṇaśaśorabhrahīraṇacchāgamāṃsajaḥ || 42 || rasaḥ samucitaḥ pāne kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitāḥ | Dī. atha śoṇitāvaśeke paścāt karma darśayannāha | śītopacārāḥ sekādyāḥ | etena kimuktaṃ, anatiśītādikaṃ prayatnataḥ upācaraṇīyamiti subodham| ata eva koṣṇena sarpiṣeti | īṣaduṣṇena sarpiṣetyarthaḥ | atha raktātikrameṇa kṣīṇasya puruṣasyānantaraṃ bheṣajamāha - kṣīṇasyeti | raktakṣīṇapuruṣasyetyarthaḥ | eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | urabhro meṣaḥ | hariṇastāmravarṇo mṛgaḥ | eṣāṃ māṃsaiḥ saṃsruto rasa iti| eke hariṇacchāgasaṃbhavaḥ raktaḥ samucita iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitā iti | kṣīrādisiktamodanaṃ bhuñjītetyabhiprāyaḥ || 41 || 42 || Gū. srute rakte vraṇasthāne kupite dāhāditvāt śītopacāraiḥ upacaretsrutaraktasya mārute kupite savyathaṃ śothaṃ koṣṇena sarpiṣā secayet | rakte kṣīṇe kriyāmāha - kṣīṇasya raktasrāvaṇakṣīṇasya puruṣasya eṇādīnāṃ māṃsarasaḥ hitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhikāyuktaṃ kṣīraṃ vā hitam | eṇo hariṇaḥ, śaśaḥ, urabhro meṣaḥ, hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo mṛgaḥ, eṇo raktavarṇaḥ chāgaḥ || 41 || 42 || atha raktasrāvaṇāt samyak śuddhilakṣaṇānyāha - pīḍāśāntirlaghutvaṃ ca vyādherudrekasaṃkṣayaḥ || 43 || manaḥsvāsthyaṃ bhaveccihnaṃ samyagvisrāvite'sṛji | Dī. pīḍāśāṃtirvedanāvyapagamaḥ | laghutvaṃ śarīrasyeti | etacchārīraṃ visrāvitaliṅgam | manaḥsvāsthyamiti manasaḥ prasādaḥ | etena mānasaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||43|| Gū. samyak srutaraktalakṣaṇamāha - asṛji rakte samyakvisrāvite sati pīḍāśāntyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojanā | pīḍā vyathā tacchānti: laghutvaṃ dehasya vyādheḥ rogasya punaḥ udreka ādhikyaṃ tasya saṃkṣayaḥ samyak nāśaḥ manaḥsvāsthyam || 43 || raktamokṣe niṣedhavargamāha - vyāyāmamaithunakrodhaśītasrānapravātakān || 44 || ekāśanaṃ divāsvapnaṃ kṣārāmlakaṭubhojanam | śokaṃ vādamajīrṇaṃ ca tyajedābaladarśanāt || 45 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitaśārṅga- dharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitasrāvavidhi- rnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || Dī. idānīṃ raktasrute: kiṃ tyājyaṃ taddarśayannāha - atrātiśayaṃ niṣiddhaṃ na tu sakṛdeva | śokaṃ dhanabandhunāśādijanitam | vādamityatibhāṣaṇam | ābaladarśanāditi | raktasrutasya yāvadbalo na bhavati tāvadvyāyāmādayo niṣiddhā ityabhiprāyaḥ || 44 || 45 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitavisrāvavidhiradhyāyaḥ || 12 || Gū. vyāyāmaṃ śramaṃ, maithunaṃ strīsevāṃ, śītaṃ jalaṃ, tena snānaṃ, pravāto bahuvātasevanam, ekāsanam, ekabhojanam, amlo amlarasaḥ, kaṭu kaṭurasaḥ; kṣāro yavakṣārādiḥ, na saindhavaniṣedhaḥ tasya kṣārābhāvāt vādaṃ vāgvādam ajīrṇaṃ bahubhojanajanyaṃ yāvat balādhikyaṃ bhavati tāvat etān tyajet || 44 || 45 || iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne raktamokṣavidhi- rnāmādhyāyaḥ ||12|| Editor's notes 1 saviṣalakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāśca yāḥ| saviṣā varjayettābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramaḥ’ iti | jalamokaḥ sthānaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ | dvividhā striyaḥ puruṣāśca | tanvaṅgyo'tyantamṛdavaḥ striyo viparītāḥ puruṣā | striya: sukumāreṣu asukumāreṣu puruṣā yojyāḥ | ↩

title: 13. atha netrakarmavidhiradhyāyaḥ
text: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - śirāvyadhenā'pi netraprasādanaṃ bhavati, tadvatsekādibhirapi | ata āha - tāni kāni karmāṇītyāha - seka āścotanaṃ piṇḍī biḍālastarpaṇaṃ tathā | puṭapāko'ñjanaṃ caibhiḥ kalpairnetramupācaret || 1 || Dī. athedānīṃ netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | seko'tra dhārādinā svedarūpaḥ | āścyotanaṃ netramadhye tailādikṣepaṇarūpam| nimīlitonmīlanākṣibhedena sekaāścyotanayorbhedamāhuḥ | piṇḍīti prasiddhā | akṣṇorbahirlepaḥ sa biḍālasaṃjñaḥ | tarpaṇamiti netratṛptikaraṃ karma tacca netrabastiriti prasiddham | puṭapāka iti | puṭapāka uktyā dravyasya raso netraprasādane vihitaḥ sa puṭapākaḥ kathitaḥ | asyāpi dvividhaṃ karma vyācakṣate | ekaṃ tarpaṇavat kāryam aparaṃ āścyotanavaditi | añjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tacca nānāvidham cakārāt śastrakarmāpyatra boddhavyamiti kecit | na svamatam | tadanyatra jñātavyam || 1|| Gū. atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi | ebhiḥ sekādibhiḥ kalpairnetrarogam upācaret | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vakṣyati || 1 || sekavidhiḥ | sekastu sūkṣmadhārābhiḥ sarvasminnayane hitaḥ | mīlitākṣasya martyasya pradeyaścaturaṅgulāt ||2 || sa cāpi snehano vāte rakte pitte ca ropaṇaḥ | lekhanaśca kaphe kāryastasya mātrā'dhunocyate || 3 || ṣaḍvākśataiḥ snehaneṣu caturbhiścaiva ropaṇe | vākśataiśca tribhiḥ kāryaḥ seko lekhanakarmaṇi ||4|| kāryastu divase seko rātrau cātyayike gade | Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ seka āścyotanapiṇḍītyādikam | tatra tāvatsekavidhiradhunā vidhīyate sūkṣmadhārā netrāñjanaśalākā'nurūpaṃ nirgatā dravapātrāt | sarvasminnayane iti sarvākṣiroge yathā doṣāpekṣayā vā sarvagrahaṇaṃ | samastanetramaṇḍale ityeke | caturaṅgulamiti caturaṅgulaṃ yathā syāt tena caturaṅgulotsedhaṃ dhārāṃ kṛtvā secayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā yathā sukhotsedhaṃ secayedityapi | athavā caturaṅgulenākṣivistāraṃ yāvat tāvanmaryādīkṛtya dravyakalkaṃ kṛtvā karpaṭe badhvākṣisekaḥ kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘avyakte'kṣigade kāryaṃ plotasthairguṇḍanaṃ bahiḥ’ ityādi | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa sekasya karmaviśeṣamāha - vāte kevalānilajanite'kṣirogaḥ, snehanaḥ snehakṛtasvedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | yathā - ‘sarpirmāsavasāmajjābhedaḥ syādauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | snehana iti vikhyātaḥ’| raktapitta iti vyaste milite vā ropaṇaḥ svedaḥ | ropaṇastu tantrāntare yathā - ‘stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravayācitaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ śītaśca svedaḥ kāryo'pi ropaṇam’ iti | kaphe kaphaprāye'kṣiroge lekhanaḥ sveda iti lekhano doṣalekhana iti, sa ca snigdhasya vihitaḥ | tathāhi - ‘sneho hitotirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ| jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravasaṃyutaiḥ || kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaḍkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ | lekhane lekhanasvedo vihitoyaṃ bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ iti | tasyeti trividhasekasya mātrāparimāṇaṃ kāryaṃ kālaṃ vā adhunā idānīṃ tasya mātrā'dhunocyate ityuktaṃ prāk tadidānīṃ tanmātrāviśeṣamāha - srehaḥ teṣu svedeṣu ṣaṭśatavākyāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat snehasvedaḥ kartavya ityabhiprāyaḥ | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā | tathāhi ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā cchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | atraikaladhvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāgiti paṭhanti | ropaṇe svedaścaturbhiriti catuḥśatavākyaiḥ lekhanakarmaṇīti lekhanasvede | ekaśatavākyaiḥ kṛtvā tāvat svedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | athākṣisvedasya kālamāha - ātyantake gade prakupite'kṣiroge rujādibhiḥ pīḍita ityarthaḥ | rātrau vetyatra vāgrahaṇāt niśāyāḥ, prathamo yāmo'bhipretaḥ | tathāhi - ‘snigdhoṣṇairvātajaḥ pittaraktato mṛduśītalaiḥ | tīkṣṇarūkṣoṣṇaviśadaiḥ praśāmyati kaphātmakaḥ | tīkṣṇoṣṇamṛduśītānāṃ vyatyāsāt sānnipātikaḥ | tasya kālo divā sarvo yāmaḥ syāt prathamo niśi’ iti || 2-4 || Gū. atha sekaḥ | mīlitākṣṇa: mudritanetrasya puruṣasya sekaḥ pradeyaḥ | seka: secanaṃ, sa sekaḥ sarvasminnayane caturaṅgulāt sūkṣmadhārābhihitaḥ | dhārāśabdo dugdhādivācakaḥ | sekasya snehādibhedena trividhatvamāha - sa eva sekaḥ secanaṃ vāte ca ropaṇaḥ kaphe lekhanaḥ tasya sekasya mātrāpramāṇam adhunā ucyate tāṃ mātrāmāha - sneheṣu ṣaḍvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kāryaḥ | caturbhirvākśataiḥ ropaṇe sekaḥ kāryaḥ | lekhanakarmaṇi tribhirvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | sekaḥ kadā kārya ityāha -sekastu divasa eva kāryaḥ | anyadapi asādhuko rātrāvapi || 2-4 || atha trividhākṣisvedānāṃ prayogadvāreṇa karma darśayannāha - sa yathā - sa yathetyādinā darśayati granthakāraḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlaiḥ śṛtamājaṃ payo hitam ||5|| sukhoṣṇaṃ secanaṃ netre vātābhiṣyandanāśanam | pariṣeko hito netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam || 6 || rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye || 7 || śuṣkākṣipāke ca hitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | sābaraṃ madhukaṃ tulyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitam ||8|| chāgakṣīre ghṛtaṃ sekātpittaraktābhighātajit | triphalālodhrayaṣṭībhiḥ śarkarābhadramustakaiḥ ||9|| piṣṭaiḥ śītāmbunā seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | lākṣāmadhukamañjiṣṭhālodhrakālanusārivāḥ || 10 || puṇḍarīkayutaḥ seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | śvetalodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ paṭavisrutam || 11 || uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekācchūlaghnamambake | Dī. eṣa ca vātābhiṣyande praśastaḥ | abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ sarasapākarujaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣirogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | tathāhi ‘vātāt pittāt kaphādraktādabhiṣyandaścaturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākara’ iti | eraṇḍapatretyādiyoge kṣīrasādhanaṃ kṣīraparibhāṣayaiva boddhavyam | tantrāntare'yamadhimanthanāmnā vihitaḥ tatra kaṇṭakārīyutamiti paṭhanti | tathāca -‘kaṇṭakārīśiphairaṇḍamūlatvakpatrasādhitam | kṣīramājaṃ hitaṃ seke cakṣu:spandādhimanthayoḥ’ iti | anyacca ‘pariṣeke hitaṃ netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam | rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye | śuṣkākṣipāke vihitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | pariṣekaṃ sekābhidhānaṃ payotrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā mānuṣamiti kecit | koṣṇamīṣaduṣṇam | saindhavamiti sasaindhavacūrṇaprakṣiptam | athavā rajanīdārusiddhaṃ paya iti yogaḥ | kṣīrapākamatra kṣīraparibhāṣayā kartavyam | rajanī dāruharidrā | eke rajanīdārudravyadvayaṃ vadanti | tatra rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru | mārutaparyāyepi hitametat | mārutaparyāyaṃ tat sarvāṅgam akṣiroge paṭhanti | tadyathā ‘vāraṃ vāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīvrāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | śuṣkākṣipāke ca idameva secanaṃ sadā sarvasminkāle kṛtau vā hitamityarthaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākamapi sa cākṣigata eva boddhavyaḥ | tadyathā ‘yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃlakṣanetrāviladarśanaṃ yat | sarūkṣaṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi’iti | idānīṃ raktapittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha -pittābhighātobhiṣyanda eva | yaṣṭīmadhu yaṣṭī bhadramustakaḥ śreṣṭhamustaḥ nāgaramothā iti loke piṣṭa iti kalkīkṛtaḥ | ayaṃ poṭṭalakaḥ baddhena chedo vihitaḥ | poṭṭalakadvāreṇaiva tadadharāseka ityanye | tagaraṃ, sārivā āsphotā, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ tadabhāve tadbījānyatra gṛhyante | atra kvātharūpeṇa seko boddhavyaḥ | athākṣisādanaharayogamāha | ayaṃ dhārābhidhānopi svedaḥ poṭṭalakena badhvā kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | ambake netre || 5-11 || Gū. sa yathā - sukhoṣṇam ājaṃ payaḥ netre secane hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ payaḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlai: śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandam āgataḥ pākaṃ netraṃ | vātābhiṣyande sekaḥ, anyacca pariṣeke secane sasaindhavaṃ koṣṇaṃ payaśchāgīdugdhaṃ netre hitaṃ, rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru saindhavena samanvitaṃ tatsiddhaṃ ca hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ tathā mārutaparyāyeṇa roge | tathā śuṣkākṣipāke hitaṃ vātābhiṣyande vātaparyaye śuṣkākṣipāke sāvaraṃ lodhraṃ madhukaṃ yaṣṭī etat tulyaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ chāgīkṣīre sthitaṃ sekāt secanāt pittaraktābhighātajidbhavati | abhighāto netrābhighātaḥ | netrābhighāte sekaḥ śarkarā sitā'bhiṣyande kālānisārivā kalisāri | puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, raktābhiṣyande paṭavisṛtaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, punaḥ uṣṇāmbunā marditam, ambake netre sekātsecanāt śūlaghnaṃ bhavati netraśūleti ||5-11|| āścyotanam | athāścyotanakaṃ kāryaṃ niśāyāṃ na kathaṃcana ||12|| unmīlite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye bindubhirdvyaṅgulāddhitam | bindavo'ṣṭau lekhaneṣu snehane daśa bindavaḥ || 13 || ropaṇe dvādaśa proktāste śīte koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ | uṣṇe ca śītarūpāḥ syuḥ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||14|| vāte tiktaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam | tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca kaphe kramādāścyotanaṃ hitam ||15|| āścyotanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mātrā syādvākśataṃ hitā | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyośchoṭikā'thavā || 16|| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ | Dī. athāścyotanamāha - āścyotanaṃ netrasecanaṃ, taccādāveva sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇām | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmādāvāścyotanaṃ hitam | rūkṣoṣṇakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharoganibarhaṇam’ iti | atrādāviti nirāmāvasthāyāṃ vātapittavajjñeyam | nirāmāvasthā ca rūkṣādyupalakṣitā jñeyā | uktaṃca videhe - ‘abhiṣyande'vamanthe ca netrayoḥ kaphasaṃbhave | utpanna eva kartavyaṃ netrayoḥ kaphanāśanam | lākṣyāścākṣṇoḥ parīṣekastīkṣṇaścāścotanādikam iti | atra sāmanirāmalakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā - ‘udīrṇavadanaṃ netraṃ rāgadveṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāsrayuktamāmānvitaṃ viduḥ | mandavedanatākaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhastu prasannatā | praśastavartmatā cākṣṇoḥ saṃpakvaṃ gadamādiśet’ iti | niśāyāṃ na kathaṃ cana iti | rātrau na kartavyamevetyanena divā kartavyatā'sya pratipāditā | dvyaṅgulāditi | dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ kṛtvā dvyaṅguloccenopādeyamityarthaḥ | bindubhiriti | binduparimāṇaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulaparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt| yāvatpatatyasau bindurdṛśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te’ iti | lekhanādiṣu bindusaṃkhyāmāha - bindava iti | bindavo lekhane'ṣṭau, snehane daśa, ropaṇe dvādaśa | te śīte koṣṇarūpiṇa iti | te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle hemante śiśire ca koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ koṣṇāḥ | evam uṣṇakāle śītarūpiṇaḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatra lekhanādau jñeya: | vātādikramāt snigdhādikamāha - vāta iti | vāto'tra netrābhiṣyandādau tiktarasaprāyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca hitam | pitte madhuraśītalaprāyaṃ, kaphe tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca āścyotanaṃ netrasecanarūpam iti | athā'ścyotanaṃ mātrāsvarūpamāha - āścyotaneṣviti | sarveṣu lekhanādiṣu vākśatamiti | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk netrasecane tu snehanādiṣu mātrāviśeṣaḥ proktaḥ | atra tu netramadhye bindukṣepaṇatvena sarveṣu vākśatamātrameva | kecidatra mātrālakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā -‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā choṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu nāsti || 12-16 || Gū. athāścyotanam | athānantaram āścyotanaṃ kathyate tat āścyotanaṃ niśāyāṃ rātrau na kāryaṃ kathaṃcana | tallakṣaṇamāha – unmīlita uddhāṭite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye dvyaṅgulāt bindubhiryaddīyate tadevāścyotanam | lekhanādau kiyanto bindavo deyāstadāha - te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ uṣṇe uṣṇakāle śītarūpa eṣa niścayaḥ | vātādau kīdṛśā āścyotanā deyāstadāha -sugamam | āścyotananāmānyāha - budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ iyaṃ vāṅmātrā smṛtā | keyaṃ tadāha sarveṣāṃ āścyotanānāṃ vāṅmātrā hitā nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ nimeṣo netranimeṣastanyaunmeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā aṅgulyācchoṭikī gurvakṣaro dīrghākṣarastasyoccāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ vāṅmātrā ekā || 12-16 || athāścyotanārthaṃ yogānāha - bilvādipañcamūlena bṛhatyeraṇḍaśigrubhiḥ || 17 || kvātha āścyotane koṣṇo vātābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | ambupiṣṭairnimbapatraistvacaṃ lodhrasya lepayet || 18 || pratāpya vahninā ṣiṣṭvā tadraso netrapūraṇāt | vātotthaṃ raktapittotthamabhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet || 19|| triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam | strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit ||20|| kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ vāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet | Dī. araṇi: agnimanthabhedaḥ tadabhāve agnimantha eva dviguṇaḥ kārya iti paribhāṣoktatvāt | athānyaprakāramāha - lodhro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak tvaca eva lodhrasaṃjñā vikhyātā | atra strīdugdhaṃ saṃmiśryāścyotanaṃ kāryamiti vyavahāraḥ | tantrāntare'pi ‘nimbasya patraiḥ parilipya lodhnaṃ svedāgninā cūrṇamathāpi kalkam | āścyotanaṃ mānuṣadugdhayuktaṃ pittāsradāhāpahamagryamukta’miti | aparamapi ‘triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam’ | triphalāścyotanamiti kvātharūpam | athavāhimakaṣāyarūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ kalkarūpamityeke | yaduktaṃ ‘jātā rogā vinaśyanti na bhavanti kadācana | triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa prātarnayanadhāvanaḥ || strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit | kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ cāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet’ | kṣīrasarpiriti dohanamātreṇaivotpannaṃ taṃ haiyaṅgavīnamityāhuḥ | kṣīramatra gavyam | tathāca ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpi karṣaṇa’miti | yadvā kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrasarpiḥ ghṛtamiti kevalaṃ gavyamājaṃ vā grāhyam | strīstanyādiyogoyamapi āgantujadoṣe praśasta ityāhuḥ | tantrāntarīyoktatvāt | yaduktam ‘āgantudoṣaṃ prasamīkṣya kāryaṃ vaktroṣmaṇā svedanamāditastu | āścyotanaṃ strīpayasā ca sadyo yaccāpi pittakṣatajāpahaṃ syāt’ iti || 17-20 || Gū. tadyathā - bilvādipañcamūlena ‘bilvāgnimanthasyonākapāṭalā kumbhakārā bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī vātābhiṣyande ambu jalaṃ tatpiṣṭairnimbapatrairlodhrasya tvacaṃ lepayet | tāṃ tvagninā pratāpya piṣṭvā tadrasaḥ netrapūraṇād abhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet | raktavātapittābhiṣyande kṣīrasarpirdugdhaghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ manthanotthaṃ, āścyotane abhiṣyandaśūle || 17-20 || idānīṃ piṇḍikāvidhānamāha - piṇḍī kavalikā proktā badhyate paṭṭavastrakaiḥ ||21|| netrābhiṣyandayogyā sā vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyate | abhiṣyande'dhimanthe ca saṃjāte śleṣmasaṃbhave ||22|| snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya śirastīkṣṇairvirecayet | adhimantheṣu sarveṣu lalāṭe vyadhayecchirām || 23 || aśānte sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet | abhiṣyandeṣu sarveṣu badhnīyātpiṇḍikāṃ budhaḥ ||24|| Dī. vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyata iti | vraṇamatra śastrakṣārāgnikṛtaṃ jalaukāpātanakṛtaṃ vā tatraiva boddhavyam | anyadvraṇaṃ ca yannetrayordoṣajanitam | tathāgantuje piṇḍīvihitā athāsyāgre'bhiṣyandādhimanthayoḥ karmāntaroktaṃ ślokadvayamāhureke | etaddvayaṃ ca prakaraṇāntaroktatvenāsmābhirapi nātra varṇitam | asaṃgatatvāt | atha sarvābhiṣyandipiṇḍikāviṣayamāha - sarveṣviti | vātapittakapharaktasvarūpeṣu | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyaṃ dravyādikaṃ vicārya badhnīyādityarthaḥ | ata eva vātābhiṣyande snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā deyā | evaṃ pittaraktādike madhuraśītetyabhiprāyaḥ || 21-24 || Gū. atha piṇḍikā vastrapaṭṭakaiḥ badhyate sā piṇḍikā balikā ca proktā sā netrābhiṣyandayogyā | vraṇeṣvapi sā badhyate | athābhiṣyande śirovirecanamāha śleṣmasaṃbhave abhiṣyande tathādhimanthe netraroge snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya puruṣasya śirastīkṣṇairnasyairvirecayet srāvayet | snigdhakṛtatailābhyaṅgasvinnaṃ sveditam uttamāṅgaṃ mastakaṃ yasya saḥ | tasya adhimanthānyākriyāmāha - sugamam || 21-24 || idānīṃ piṇḍikārthaṃ prayogavarānāha - vātābhiṣyandaśāntyarthaṃ snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā bhavet | eraṇḍapatramūlatvaṅnirmitā vātanāśinī || 25 || pittābhiṣyandanāśāya dhātrīpiṇḍī sukhāvahā | mahānimbaphalodbhūtā piṇḍī vā pittanāśinī ||26|| śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmābhiṣyandanāśinī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmapittaharā bhavet || 27 || triphalāpiṇḍikā proktā nāśane śleṣmapittayoḥ | piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyena ghṛtabhṛṣṭā ca piṇḍikā ||28|| lodhrasya harati kṣipramabhiṣyandamasṛgbhavam | śuṇṭhīnimbadalaiḥ piṇḍī sukhoṣṇā svalpasaindhavā ||29|| dhāryā cakṣuṣi saṃyogācchothakaṇḍūvyathāpahā | Dī. tatra vātābhiṣyandanāśanī yathā (vāteti) | atrairaṇḍasya patrāṇi mūlaṃ tvak cāṅgatrayaṃ saṃgṛhya kalkamāhuḥ | kalkārthaṃ cātra payaḥ ityapare | sāmānyatvena jalaṃ deyamiti sarvatra | vātanāśinītyanenaiva kevalaṃ vātābhiṣyande kathitaṃ kintu adhimanthādīnāṃ vātarujāyāmapi śastametat | evaṃ pittakaphayorapi boddhavyam | atha pittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ piṇḍīyogamāha - dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kāñjikaṃ jalaṃ vā sarvatra | mahānimbo nimbārkaḥ sa ca vakāṇaniṃbaśabdavācyaḥ | atrāpyanukte jalam | eke śigrupatrakṛtetyādikaṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti ‘śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍo śleṣmābhiṣyandahāriṇī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī vātapittavināśinī’ iti śleṣmapittayoriti | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande yogamāha | śigruḥ sobhāñjanakaḥ triphalā haritakyādikam| atrāpi kalkārthaṃ yathāyogyaṃ vihitaṃ dravaṃ deyam | atha raktābhiṣyandārthaṃ yogamāha - piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyeneti | kāñjikadravabhāgena| tadabhāve jalamatra grāhyam | tena pūrvaṃ lodhraṃ kāñjikena saṃpiṣya paścāt ghṛtena saṃpācya piṇḍikā kāryā | athābhiṣyandādīnāṃ śothakaṇḍūharaṇārthaṃ yogottamamāha | atra śuṇṭhīnimbadalāpekṣayā svalpo deyaḥ | svalpasaindhaveti śuṇṭhīmānāllaghutaram saṃyogo piṇḍīviśeṣaṇam | tena saṃyogayuktā vastrapaṭṭādibhiḥ susaṃhatā ityarthaḥ | eke saṃyogāditi pañcamyantaṃ paṭhanti | tatrāsyāḥ saṃyogādeva śothādayo yāntīti bhāvaḥ || 25-29 || Gū. athābhiṣyande kriyāmāha | atha vātādināśe piṇḍikāmāha - mahānimbaphaleti | vāte pitte ca piṇḍī | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande piṇḍī śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ | atha śleṣmapittaraktābhiṣyande piṇḍī ghṛtamṛṣṭā kāñjikapiṣṭā lodhrapiṇḍikā asṛgbhavaṃ raktabhavam abhiṣyandaṃ harati | śothakaṇḍvādau piṇḍī nimbadalaiḥ nimbapatraiḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 25-29 || atha biḍālavidhiḥ | biḍālako bahirlepo netre pakṣmavivarjitaḥ || 30 || tasya mātrā parijñeyā mukhalepavidhānavat | Dī. idānīṃ biḍālakaviṣayamāha - mukhalepavidhānavadityanena yathā mukhalepavidhistadvadatrāpi boddhavyaṃ, mukhalepavidhistu pūrvādhyāye lepanamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇākhye jñātavyaḥ || 30 || Gū. atha biḍālaḥ netrapakṣmavivarjite bahirbhāge yo lepaḥ sa biḍālaka ucyate tasya mātrā mukhalepamātrā mukhalepavidhānavadvijñeyā || 30 || atha lepaḥ | sa yathā - dī. - atha lepamāha - sa yathetyanena yogān darśayati gnanthakāraḥ | yaṣṭīgairikasindhūtthadārvītārkṣyaiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ ||31|| jalapiṣṭairbahirlepaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ | rasāñjanena vā lepaḥ pathyāviśvadalairapi || 32 || kumāri kāgnipantrairvā dāḍimīpallavairapi | vacāharidrānimbairvā tathā nāgaragairikaiḥ || 33 || dagdhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭayute ghṛte | piṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpaham || 34 || lohasya pātre saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbaphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepānnetrabādhāṃ vyapohati || 35 || saṃcūrṇya maricaṃ keśarājasvarasamardanāt | lepanādarmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karotyeṣa prayogarāṭ || 36 || svināṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhinnāmañjananāmikām | śilailānatāsindhūtthai: sakṣaudrai: pratisārayet || 37|| Dī. yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī | eke yaṣṭīsthāne pathyāṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pathyā harītakī sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ dārvī haridrā tārkṣyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidrā dviguṇā grāhyā taddravatvāt aparamapi vakṣyamāṇacatuṣṭayaṃ sarvanetrāmaye vihitamiti śeṣaḥ | kiṃ tadāha - rasāñjanena lepa eko yogaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ | viśvādalairapi pathyā viśvadalairapi dvitīyo yogaḥ | pathyā harītakī viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī etayordalāni patrāṇi athavā dalasthāne jaleti pāṭhaḥ | tatra jalaṃ vālakaṃ | vacā haridrā viśvaiḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyo yogaḥ | nāgaragairikaiścaturthaḥ viśvānāgaraśabdābhyāṃ śuṇṭhī kathitā | badhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭaghṛtapiṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ saindhavamatra manāk deyam | madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sikthakam | loke momaśabdavācyam | ghṛtamatra gavyaṃ lepotra punarjalena pracarati añjanaṃ tu ghṛtenaiva vyavahāraḥ | sadyo netrarujāpahamiti | abhiṣyandodhimanthādīnāṃ vedanāpahamiti | ayaḥ ‘lohapātreṇa saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbūphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepo netrabādhaṃ vyapohati’ | nimbūphalarasastu lohapātre prakṣipya tadanu lohadaṇḍenāpi gharṣayet yāvat ghano bhavati | eke lohapātreṇetyasya sthāne kāṃsyapātreṇeti paṭhanti mānayanti ca | netrabādhāmiti netravyathāṃ tenābhiṣyandādīnāmityarthaḥ | athārmanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha | keśarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ | armātiraktārmasaṃjñaṃ, netrābhyantaresya pracāra ityeke | prayogarāṭ prayogaśreṣṭhaḥ | svinnāṃ bhitvā viniṣpādya bhinnāmañjananāmikāṃ śilailāmanasindhūtthaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet | pratisārayedityanena śilācūrṇaṃ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa saṃplāvya yojyaṃ | kutra yojyaṃ tadāha añjananāmikāmiti | guhāñjanīti loke | sā ca paṭalante pakṣmasamīpe bhavati | svinnāmiti tāṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsvedya paścāt śastreṇa bhitvā vidārya tadanu niṣpīḍyata iti pūyamānīya paścāt pratisārayet| ata eva bhinnāmiti viśeṣaṇamasyāḥ śilailanatasindhūtthairiti śilā manaḥśilā elā kṣudrailā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam || 31-37 || Gū. sa yathā - yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, dārvī dāruharidrā, tārkṣyaḥ kharparaṃ, samāṃśakaiḥ samabhāgaiḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ sarve ye netrāmayā abhiṣyandādayastān hanti | anyacca rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, pathyā harītakī, viśvā śuṇṭhī, dalaṃ patrajaṃ, kumārī, agnipatraiḥ etaiḥ ṣaḍyogāḥ | anyacca lodhraṃ saindhavaṃ agnau dagdhvā madhūcchiṣṭe ghṛte kṛtam etatpiṣṭam añjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ bhavati | anyacca sugamam | athārmasu lepaḥ maricaṃ saṃcūrṇayitvā keśarājo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, tasya svarasamardanāt punaḥ lepanāt eṣaḥ prayogarāṭ armaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karoti | arma vraṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇam añjananāmikāṃ svinnāṃ sveditāṃ punaḥ bhitvā vidārayitvā punaḥ viniṣpīḍya pīḍayitvā śilā elā nataṃ tagaraṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ sakṣaudrairetaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt | netrāñjananāmikā netrapiḍakā || 31-37 || tarpaṇam | atha tarpaṇakaṃ vacmi netratṛptikaraṃ param | yadrūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkaṃ ca netraṃ kuṭilamāvilam || 38 || śīrṇapakṣmaśirotpātakṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutam | timirārjunaśukrādyairabhiṣyandādhimanthakaiḥ || 39 || śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāṃ yuktaṃ vātaviparyayaiḥ | tannetraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ netrarogaviśāradaiḥ || 40|| durdinātyuṣṇaśīteṣu cintāyāsabhrameṣu ca | aśāntopadrave cākṣṇi tarpaṇaṃ na praśasyate || 41 || vātātaparajohīne deśe cottānaśāyinaḥ | ādhārau māṣacūrṇena klinnena parimaṇḍalau || 42 || samau dṛḍhāvasaṃbādhau kartavyau netrakośayoḥ | pūrayedghṛtamaṇḍena vilīnena sukhodakai: || 43 || athavā śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrajena vā | nimagnānyakṣipakṣmāṇi yāvatsyustāvadeva hi ||44|| pūrayenmīlite netre tata unmīlayecchanaiḥ | dhārayedvartmarogeṣu vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śataṃ budhaḥ || 45 || svacche kaphe sandhiroge mātrāpañcaśataṃ hitam | śukle ca ṣaṭśataṃ kṛṣṇaroge saptaśataṃ matam ||46|| dṛṣṭirogeṣvaṣṭaśatamadhimanthe sahasrakam | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣu dhāryamevaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 47 || svinnena yavapiṣṭena snehavīryeritaṃ tataḥ | yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena kaphamasya viśodhayet || 48 || ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vāpi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param | tarpaṇe tṛptiliṅgāni netreṣvetāni bhāvayet || 49 || sukhasvapnāvabodhaṃ ca vaiśadyaṃ varṇapāṭavam | nivṛttirvyādhiśāntiśca kriyālāghavameva ca ||57|| atha sāśru guru snigdhaṃ netraṃ syādatitarpitam | rūkṣamasnāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ netraṃ syāddhīnatarpitam || 51 || rūkṣasnigdhopacārābhyāmetayoḥ syātpratikriyā | Dī. idānīṃ tarpaṇavidhānaṃ darśayannāha - athetyādi | biḍālānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanakaṃ karma vacmi | kīdṛśaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇayogyaṃ bhavati tadāha - yadrūpamityādi | yādṛśaṃ rūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkamiti vātābhiṣyandādeva | āvilaṃ kaluṣaṃ śīrṇapakṣmeti romaśātanaṃ śirotpāta iti yathā - ‘avedanā vāpi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyaṃti ca yāḥ sa tādṛgvyādhiḥ śirotpāta iti pradiṣṭa’ iti | kṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutamiti kṛcchronmīlanaḥ ākuṃcanasaṃjñaḥ | yathā -‘vātādyā vartmasaṃkocaṃ janayanti gatā yadā | tadā draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti kuṃcanaṃ nāma tadviduḥ’iti | timirārjunaśukrādyairiti timiraṃ tu liṅganāśasya mūlameva | yataścaturthapaṭalagato doṣastimiraṃ karoti tacca nānārūpaṃ bhavati | arjunamiti śuklabhāgagatarogaviśeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamaśca binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tadarjunaṃ vadantī’ti | śukramiti kṛṣṇabhāgagataṃ tacca trividhaṃ śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ ceti | śukramatra puṣpaśabdavācyaṃ phūlīti loke | ādigrahaṇādetādṛśairanyairapi | abhiṣyandādhimanthakairiti abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ | ayamapi sarvanetrarogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | adhimantho netre śotharūpo rujāvāṃśca bhavati sa ca vṛddhenābhiṣyandenaiva kriyāvatāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ caturvidho jāyate | śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāmiti śuṣkākṣipākaḥ sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā - ‘yatkūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃdahyate cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yatpratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣī’ti | śotha iti | śothajanetrapākaḥ | yataḥ -‘kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakkodumbarasannibhaḥ | saṃraṃbhī pacyate yastu netrapākaḥ sa śothaja’ iti | vātaviparyayairyuta iti vātaviparyayo netrarogaviśeṣaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ | yathā ‘vāraṃvāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīkṣṇāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | taṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyamiti yatpūrvoktarogaviśeṣe varṇitaṃ tannetramityarthaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | atha tarpaṇakriyāyāmayogyaviṣayamāha - durdinātyuṣṇaśītairityanena śītoṣṇavarṣāsvarūpaṃ kālaṃ tarpaṇavihitam | prāptiniṣedhatvāt | durdinamiti varṣā meghavṛṣṭyākulaṃ dinaṃ niṣiddhaṃ nānyat | evamatyuṣṇamiti | grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitadivasam | atiśītaṃ vātādivyāptaṃ dinamiti saṃbhrameṣviti bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ | aśāṃtopadrave cākṣṇīti | āmadoṣajananopadravasahitaṃ nākṣi tarpayedityabhiprāyaḥ| tadyathā - ‘udīrṇavedanaṃ netraṃ rāgaśoṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāśruyuktamāmānvitaṃ vidu’riti | idānīṃ tarpaṇasya kartavyavidhāvapi karmavidhānamāha - tarpaṇārthī puruṣaḥ prathamameva śobhanaṃ sthānamanvicchet | tatra vātātaparajorahite iti| etayorlakṣaṇatvenāgnidhūmarahite iti grahaṇaṃ | yaduktaṃ - ‘pratisūryāgnirahite nīrujo dhūmamārute | gṛhe sukhe nirābādhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca samācaredi’ti | uttānaśāyinetyanena niścalasya vītakrodhatayāsya cāvarodhaḥ tantrāntaradarśanāt ‘uttānaśāyinaḥ kāryaṃ niścalasya yathāsukham | tarpaṇaṃ netrayugale vītakrodhabhayasya ce’ti | atha paścātkarmāha - ādhārau māṣacūrṇena netrakośayoriti netrapuṭayoḥ | dvau ādhārau kuryāt | ādhāro māṣapiṣṭīmayaḥ palīsaṃjñaḥ | klinnena māṣacūrṇeneti | klinnaṃ jalena marditam | kathaṃbhūtāvādhārāviti | parimaṇḍalau pari samantato bhāvena maṇḍalākārau tenārdhāṅgulotsedhaḥ dvyaṅgulavistāraṃ yathā syāt kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi ‘ardhāṅgulo'rdhavistāraṃ yathā syānnākṣirodhakṛt’ iti | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtāvādhārau | samāhitau na viṣamaiḥ | dṛḍhāviti na śīrṇau | asaṃdhāviti saṃdhirahitau | etena tannipuṇena kāryāvityarthaḥ | idānīṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ dravyaviśeṣamāha - pūrayennetrādhārāviti śeṣaḥ | kena pūrayettamāha - ghṛtamaṇḍenetyādi | vilīnaghṛtasya ghanībhūtasyoparitano bhāgo ghṛtamaṇḍa ityucyate | kīdṛśena sukhodakaiḥ kṛtvā vilīne | eke sukhodarkairevākṣipūraṇamāhuḥ | tadasaṃgatam | athavetyanena dravyāntaramāha - dhautena sarpiṣetyarthaḥ | kṣīramathanātsamudbhūtaṃ navanītaghṛtaṃ kṣīraghṛtamityucyate | kṣīramatra gavyaṃ grāhyaṃ tadvihitatvāt | tathāhi - ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaśreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpakarṣaṇa’miti | atha kiyatparimāṇena pūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tamāha - eke tu ‘pakṣmāṇi yāvanmajjanti romavattā yadā bhruvo’riti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tata unmīlayecchanairiti | unmīlanaṃ tu śanaiḥ kuryāt | śanairityanena karmāntaraṃ sūcayati | kathamunmīlayettadāha carakaḥ - ‘tato vastreṇa pītena nīlena haritena vā | patrairācchādya nayane tataḥ paśyedyathāsukhami’ti | atha tarpaṇasya dhāraṇaṃ kiyatkālena kāryaṃ tadāha - vartmarogeṣviti kṛcchronmīlanapakṣmaghātaprabhṛtiṣu | vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śatamiti| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk teṣāṃ śatamityarthaḥ| athavāṅgulyoḥ choṭikāsvarūpaṃ vāṅmātrātmatvena kathitam | tathāca ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṃgulyācchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhairi’ti| svasthe kaphe iti prakṛtisthe kaphe athavā svasthe puruṣe nīroge, nirupadrave ityanye ata eva sopadrave doṣe tarpaṇaṃ na vihitamiti pūrvoktameva | saṃdhirogajalasrāvaprabhṛtike kṛṣṇaroge śuddhaśukraśirāśukrapramukhe kaphe ca vikārābhipanne ata eva ṣaṭśatamityarthaḥ | pañcaśatān dṛṣṭirogeṣviti pitte nakulāndhyaprabhṛtiṣu dṛṣṭirogeṣviti bahuvacanatvena pittaje raktaje vā'ṣṭauśatāni kuryāt | adhimanthe sahasrakamityasya sthāne adhimanthe navaśatamiti paṭhanti | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣviti bahuvacanatvenāpi sannipātātmake vyādhau sahasramātraṃ yāvaddeyaṃ | tantrāntare saptaśatamātrābhiḥ sannipāte vihitam | tathāca ‘vācāṃ sahasramātrā syāddhārayenmārutavyathe | pittaje raktaje vā... ...niva | sannipātātmake saptapañca svasthavidhau tathe’ti viṣayovagantavyaḥ | atha kaphasnehopanayanaṃ kuryāttamāha - idānīṃ doṣādiviśeṣeṇa tarpaṇaviśeṣasya dināntaramāha - ekāhamiti | ekadināntaraṃ granthakāradarśanāt| tathā ca - ‘ahanyahani vātotthe pittarakte dināntaram | tarpaṇaṃ sannipātotthadvyantaraṃ tryaṃtaraṃ kaphe’ iti | tatra pittaraktādidoṣe tarpaṇaṃ kāryam | vāgrahaṇena vātotthepi ahanyahani kāryaṃ dvitīyavāgrahaṇenāpi dvyantaraṃ boddhavyaṃ sannipātaviṣayaṃ eke kaṭūṣṇamiti paṭhanti | tryahamiti tridināntaraṃ tacca kaphetyanukte svasthādāvapi | pañcāhamiti pañcadināntaram | atha tarpaṇaliṅgāni yasya bhavanti tānāha - sukhaṃ yathā syāt | svapnāvabodho bhavati | vaiśadyaṃ netrasyeti | varṇapāṭavamiti varṇaṃ śvetakṛṣṇādikaṃ tasya pāṭavaṃ nirmalatvam etena vyaktavartmane bhavataḥ | nivṛttiravalokanapracāro dṛḍhataro bhavati | kriyālāghavamiti sūkṣmāvalokanepi samarthadṛṣṭirbhavatītyarthaḥ | athātitarpitasya lakṣaṇānyāha - atheti sugamam | atha hīnatarpitasya lakṣaṇamāha - rūkṣamasnigdham, asrāvilam asrairnetrajalairāvilaṃ kaluṣīkṛtaṃ rāgamāraktatāṃ hīnatarpitanetramiti | atha hīnātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakāramāha - etayorhīnātitarpitayoḥ | tenātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakārato rūkṣakriyāhīnatarpitā snigdhā kriyetyabhiprāyaḥ || 38-51 || Gū. atha tarpaṇam athānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ cikitsitaṃ vacmi kathayāmi | tarpaṇakaṃ netratṛptikaraṃ | keṣu rogeṣu tarpaṇaṃ kriyate tānāha - yannetraṃ rūkṣaṃ bhavati | śuṣkaṃ kuṭilaṃ vakram āvilaṃ malayuktaṃ śīrṇapakṣma śīrṇaṃ gataṃ | pakṣma netrarogaṃ yasya tat | ete vātaparyantādayo netraroganidāne jñeyāḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ | netrarogaviśāradairvaidyaiḥ yatra tarpaṇaṃ na vihitaṃ tadāha - sugamam | yatra tarpaṇaṃ na hitaṃ yena vidhānena vā tadāha - vātādīnāṃ hīne rahite deśe uttānaśāyinaḥ puruṣasya netrakośayoḥ uparibhāge klinnena ārdreṇa māṣacūrṇena parimaṇḍalau maṇḍalākārau samau dṛḍhau asaṃbādhau kartavyau | tatra netre vilīnena drutena ghṛtagaṇḍena pūrayet | sukhodakairvā athavā | śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrotthitena sarpiṣā vā yāvat akṣipakṣmāṇi nimagnāni bhavanti tāvat kāryaṃ | mīlite netre pūrayet | pūraṇānantaraṃ tataḥ śanaiḥ unmīlayet | dhāraṇe pramāṇamāha - vāṅmātrālakṣaṇaṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktameva | sugamaṃ cānyat | tarpaṇe dāhakaphādhikye pratīkāramāha - tataḥ snehavīryeṇa īritam asya kaphasvinnena yavapiṣṭena yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena viśodhayet | tarpaṇaṃ kiyaddinaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - ekāhaṃ tryahaṃ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā iṣyate | atha tarpaṇe tṛptilakṣaṇamāha - tarpaṇe netrasya sukhasvapnādīni tṛptiliṅgāni bhāvayet vicārayediti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sukhena svapnatvaṃ sukhena bodhatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā netrasya | varṇasya pāṭavaṃ paṭutvaṃ nirvṛttirnirāvṛttiḥ spaṣṭadarśanatvaṃ vyādhiśāntiḥ | kriyālāghavaṃ nimeṣonmeṣakriyālaghutvam | atitarpitamāha - sāsru-asruyuktaṃ guru snigdhaṃ ca | atha hīnatarpitanetramāha - rūkṣam asrāvilaṃ raktāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ rogayuktaṃ hīnatarpitaṃ netram evaṃ syāt | atitarpitahīnatarpitayoḥ pratikāramāha - rūkṣopacāreṇātisnigdhasya na hīnasnigdheneti yāvat || 38-51 || puṭapākaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - tarpaṇoktavidhānakriyāvyāpattisamānadharmatvaṃ puṭapākamāha - ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākasya sādhanam ||52|| dvau bilvamātrau māṃsasya piṇḍau snigdhau supeṣitau | dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ ||53|| tadekasthaṃ samāloḍya patraiḥ supariveṣṭitam | puṭapākena tatpaktvā gṛhṇīyāttadrasaṃ budhaḥ || 54 || tarpaṇoktavidhānena yathāvadupacārayet | dṛṣṭimadhye niṣecyaḥ syānnityamuttānaśāyinaḥ ||55|| snehano lekhanaścaiva ropaṇaśceti sa tridhā | hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ ||56|| dṛṣṭerbalārthamitaraḥ pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | sarpirmāṃsavasāmajjāmedaḥsvādvauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 57 || snehanaḥ puṭapākaśca dhāryo dve vākśate dṛśoḥ | jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravyasaṃyutaiḥ || 58 || kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaṅkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ || 59 || lekhano vākśataṃ dhāryastasyaitāvadvidhāraṇam | stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravyapācitaḥ || 60 || lekhanāttriguṇo dhāryaḥ puṭapākastu ropaṇaḥ | vitarettarpaṇoktāṃ tu kriyāṃ vyāpattidarśane || 61 || Dī. atha puṭapākavidhānamāha - atha puṭapākasya traividhyamāha - sa puṭapākaḥ | atha teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye kaḥ kasya vihitastamāha - atirūkṣasya puruṣasya snigdhasyāpi puruṣasyeti śeṣaḥ | lekhano lekhanaḥ puṭapākaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ dṛṣṭidṛḍhīkaraṇārtham itaro ropaṇapuṭapākaḥ | sa eva pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | vraṇavātādayo netragatā eva boddhavyā: | idānīṃ snehanapuṭapākamādau pradarśayannāha - vasāmāṃsāśritaḥ | sneha iti śeṣaḥ | tathāca ‘śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā’ majjā mastakamajjā sthūlāsthiṣu ca bhavati | bheda udarasthatvagasthiṣu ca | tathācoktaṃ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyata’ iti | dṛśa iti | dṛśi madhye niṣevya iti viṣayaḥ | atha lekhanapuṭapākamāha - jāṅgalānāṃ jantūnāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairiti | yakṛtkālakhaṇḍaḥ | yadyapi jāṅgalavargo'ṣṭavidha: kathitaḥ | tadyathā jāṅgalā viṣkirāḥ pratudā guhāśayāḥ | prasahā: parṇamṛgā bileśayā grāmyāśceti | tathāpi keṣāṃcinmate paṃcaiva śreṣṭhatamā: jāṅgalaviṣkirapratudaparṇamṛgabileśayāśca te ke jāṅgalādyāstān keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthamāha - eṇahariṇaparṇakuraṅgādayo jāṅgalāḥ | lāvatittirakapiñjalavartīrurvādayaḥ | viṣkirāḥ kapotapārāvatakaliṅgādayaḥ | pratudā: siṃhavyāghravṛ(ṣā?)śvakaśṛgālamārjārādayo guheśayāḥ | kākakaṅkakuraracāṣabhāsādayaḥ | prasahā: mṛdubhūrivakavṛkṣaśāyikāvānaraprabhṛtayaḥ | parṇamṛgāḥ śvāvicchaśagodhānakulādayo bileśayāḥ| aśvāśvataragokharoṣṭrabastorabhramedaḥpucchaprabhṛtayo grāmyā iti jāṅgalavargaḥ samāsena proktaḥ | yadyasya doṣasya vihitaṃ tattatraiva jñātavyam | lekhanadravyasaṃyutairiti lekhanadravyairvakṣyamāṇakṛṣṇaloharajaḥprabhṛtikaiḥ īdṛśaiścetyabhiprāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajaḥkṛṣṇasāravarṇatāmrarajaśca vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ siṃdhujaṃ saidhavaṃ kāsīsaṃ dvividham ekaṃ bhasmasadṛśaṃ kiṃcidamlalavaṇarasaṃ, dvitīyaṃ puṣpakāsīsam īṣatpītaṃ tuvaraṃ tadbhavameva srotoñjanamiti | rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham | ekaṃ srotoñjanakṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛti dravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākvāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ | mastu dadhnastoyaviśeṣam | tathāca ‘dadhnastu yadadhastoyaṃ tanmastu parikīrtita’miti | athāto ropaṇapuṭapākamāha - stanyaṃ strīdugdhaṃ tadabhāve gavyamājaṃ vā | jāṅgalaśabdena jāṅgalaprāṇināṃ vasā majjā medo grāhyaṃ ropaṇakriyāyāṃ vihitatvāt | madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakagavyaṃ niṃbaprabhṛtikaṃ lekhanatriguṇo dhārya ityanena vākśatatrayaṃ sūcitam | atha puṭapākavyāpatticikitsāmāha - vitarediti | puṭapākavyāpattidarśane hīnātiyoge tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ cikitsāṃ kārayet | etena tāni lakṣaṇāni atrā'pi jñeyāni iti granthakṛtā sūcitam | tathāhi -‘tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyārhe na ca yojayet | yāvantyahāni yuñjīta dvistato hitabhāk bhavet’ iti || 52-61 || Gū. atha puṭapākaḥ | ataḥ ūrdhvam ataḥ paraṃ puṭapākasya sādhanaṃ vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmi | tatsādhanamāha - māṃsasya jāṅgalamāṃsasya bilvamātrau dvau piṇḍau snigdhau sucikkaṇau tathā supeṣitau sūkṣmapeṣitau bilvadravyāṇāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ dravaḥ kuḍavayutaḥ | phalaṃ tanmāṃsauṣadham ekatvaṃ samāloḍya samyak melayitvā patrairjambvādibhirveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ mṛttikāṃ veṣṭya puṭapākayuktyā tadrasaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tarpaṇoktavidhānena avacārayet | tasya grahaṇavidhānamāha - saḥ snehādibhedena tridhābhūtaḥ | uttānaśāyino nityaṃ niṣevyaḥ syāt tasya kiṃvidho hitastadāha - sugamam | snehamāha - sarpirghṛtaṃ māṃsādīni medāṃtāni jāṅgalāni svādvauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ kṛtasnehanastena puṭapākaḥ īdṛśaḥ iṣyate vāṅmātrā dve śate dhāryāḥ | lekhanamāha - lekhanadravyāṇi kṛṣṇalohādīni kṛṣṇaloharajaścūrṇaṃ siṃdhusrotoñjanaḥ cūrṇaṃ dadhimastu dadhijalaṃ lekhano vāk śataṃ dhāryaḥ | etāvadeva tasya dhāraṇam | atha ropaṇamāha - stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ jāṅgalaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsaṃ madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakadravyāṇi kaṭukyādīni taiḥ pācitaḥ lekhanāt | ropaṇaḥ triguṇapramāṇo dhāryaḥ | lekhane vākśatādidhāraṇaṃ vyāpattidarśane upadrave tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ vitaret || 52-61 || añjanam | atha saṃpakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamācaret | hemante śiśire caiva madhyāhne'ñjanamiṣyate ||62|| pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate | varṣāsu nābhre nāpyuṣṇe vasante ca sadaiva hi ||63|| lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva tathā syātsnehanāñjanam | lekhanaṃ kṣāratīkṣṇāmlarasairañjanamiṣyate || 64 || kaṣāyatiktarasayuksasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam | madhuraṃ snehasaṃpannamañjanaṃ tu prasādanam ||95 || guṭikārasacūrṇāṃni trividhānyañjanāni ca | kuryācchalākayā'ṅgulyā hīnāni ca athottaram ||66|| śrānte prarudite bhīte pītamadye navajvare | ajīrṇe vegaghāte ce nāñjanaṃ saṃpraśasyate || 67|| hareṇumātrāṃ kurvīta vārtiṃ tīkṣṇāñjane bhiṣak | pramāṇaṃ madhyame'dhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu mṛdau bhavet ||68|| rasakriyā tūttamā syāttriviḍaṅgamitā hitā | madhyamā dviviḍaṅgā syāddhīnā tvekaviḍaṅgikā ||69|| vairecanekacūrṇaṃ tu dviśalākaṃ vidhīyate | mṛdau tu triśalākaṃ syāccatasra: snaihike'ñjane ||70|| mukhayoḥ kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṣṭāṅgulonmitā | aśmajā dhātujā vā syātkalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||71|| tāmralohāśmasaṃjātā śalākā lekhane matā | suvarṇarajatodbhūtā śalākā snehane matā || 72 || aṅgulīva mṛdutvena kathitā ropaṇe budhaiḥ | sāyaṃ prātarvāñjanaṃ syāttatsadā naiva kārayet ||73|| nātiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ saṃpraśasyate | kṛṣṇabhāgādadhaḥ kuryādapāṅgaṃ yāvadañjanam || 74 || Dī. atha añjanaprakāramāha - athaśabdo'trāmadoṣānantaraṃ sūcyate | tenāparipakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamapraśastamityabhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ ‘añjanaṃ pūraṇaṃ kkāthapānamāme na śasyata’ iti | prāptamañjanamiti yadyasya samayasyoktaṃ tattatraiva yojyamiti prāptaśabdena varṇitam | atha kathamācarettadāha - hemanta ityādyaṃ janaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo yathā | atha trividhāñjanamāha -śukrādiṣu ropaṇaṃ kledakaṇḍūpakṣmaprarohaṇādiṣu snehanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ tacca timirādiṣu atha trayāṇāṃ sāmānyena dravyāṇyāha - kṣārādivastunirmitaṃ lekhanāñjanaṃ kathitaṃ kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraprabhṛtikaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ maricādikam amlarasam amlīkamātuluṅgapramukhaṃ ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu | kaṣāyādinirmitaṃ bhavati | kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ tikto nimbādiḥ | sasnehamiti | snehaṃ ghṛtatailādikaṃ prasādāñjanaṃ tu snehanasaṃjñaṃ kathitam | tattu madhurādinirmitaṃ bhavati | madhuraṃ madhurarasaprāyaṃ dravyam | madhuraṃ ghṛtaguḍādisnehasaṃpannamiti snehārtham | ata eva snehanaṃ kathitam | atha trividhāñjanasya rūpamāha -guṭikārasacūrṇādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tattrividhaṃ tu śalākayā aṅgulyā vā yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt | añjanamiti tāni yathottaraṃ tu hīnāni jñātavyāni yo yasmāduttaraṃ yathottaraṃ tena guṭikāñjanādrasakriyāñjanaṃ hīnaṃ rasāccūrṇāñjanamiti | atha yeṣāṃ rogiṇāmañjanaṃ na praśastaṃ tānāha -śrānte puruṣe | śrāntatā ca chardanavāhanajā bhavati | prarudite prakarṣarodane kṛte | bhīte bhayayukte pītamadye pītaṃ madyaṃ yena ajīrṇe āmājīrṇe viṣṭabdhe tu śūlādau vihitametat | vegāghāte mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ cakārādbhuktavati rātrijāgaraṇe ca nāñjanaṃ vihitaṃ tathācoktam - ‘bhuktavāṃstu śiraḥsnātaśrāntaśchardanavāhanai: | rātrau jāgaritaścāpi nātijvarita eva ce’ti | athāñjanasya parimāṇamāha - hareṇumātramiti | hareṇustripuṭaḥ | kalāyaḥ reṇuketyapare | madhyame'ñjane sārdhaikapramāṇaṃ yathā syādvartiṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛdāvityañjane dviguṇaṃ hareṇudvayaṃ yathā syāttathā vartiṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | atha rasakriyāñjanamāha - rasakriyā vakṣyamāṇāñjanasamūhāñjanaviśeṣo'vagantavyaḥ | uttamamātrā mṛdvañjano viḍaṅgo dravyaviśeṣo vyākhyātaḥ | madhyameti na tīkṣṇe mṛduriti hīneti tīkṣṇāñjana ityarthaḥ | ekaviḍaṅgaparimitā rasakriyā vartermātrā boddhavyā | taduktaṃ - ‘viḍaṅgamātraṃ tvapare madhyaṃ dvāvuttamatrayaṃ | rasakriyāṇāṃ vartīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam’ iti | athāparāñjanānāṃ mānamanyattadāha - vairecanikaṃ cūrṇamañjanaprastāve boddhavyaṃ | tacca tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ kathitam ata eva dviśalākonmitameva mṛdāviti mṛducūrṇāñjane snehaneñjane catasraḥ śalākāḥ | tena catuḥśalākonmitāñjanaṃ proktamityarthaḥ | śalākālakṣaṇaṃ vidhānamapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | athāñjanaśalākāmāha – mukhayoriti | śalākāyā ūrdhvādhobhāgagatayoreva mukhaśabdo vācyaḥ | tau tu kuṇṭhitau vigatadhārau kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tena mukulākārāvityapare | tathāca ‘vakrāṃte mukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍale’tyādi | ślakṣṇeti | sarvatraiva ślakṣṇā kāryā mṛdutvena sasnigdhetyarthaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭabhiraṅgulaiḥ kṛtvā parimitā kāryā aśmajā sphaṭikādipāṣāṇaracitā | na kevalaṃ pāṣāṇajanitā dhātujā vā | dhātuśabdena suvarṇādikaṃ gṛhyate | tena suvarṇaraupyatāmrakāṣṭhāsthimayāḥ | kṛtā śalākā añjane śastā aṣṭāṅgulamitā śubhā iti | kalāyaparimaṇḍaletyanena parisamantādvartulā kāryā ityabhiprāyaḥ| kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ || asyāgre keciditi paṭhanti ‘vāme karatale kṛtvā sajalaṃ nikaṣopalam | dakṣiṇenāñjanaṃ nītvā kareṇa nikaṣecchanaiḥ || tena kalkena matimān śalākāgraṃ pralipya ca | utthāpya cottaraṃ vartma vāmenāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇā || vartma śuklāntare cālpāṃ śalākāṃ supravartayet | prathamaṃ savyanetraṃ ca paścādañjyāttu dakṣiṇaṃ | śalākāṃguṣṭhadeśinyā navāṃtarnayanaṃ spṛśet’ ityādi kaiścittaṃtrāntarādavagamyātra likhitaṃ na svamataṃ | lekhane lekhanāñjane snehane snehanāñjane | ropaṇe ropaṇāṃjane | ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu dṛṣṭisādanaṃ | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyam anyavastujanitā śalākā yojyā | athāñjanakarmaṇaḥ kālamāha - sāyaṃprātaḥ ityanena sāyaṃ tīkṣṇāṃjanaṃ kuryāt | prātaḥ gaṇḍūṣānantaraṃ yathā sadācāre rasāṃjanādikaṃ tadvadanyadapi sadā sarvakāle tadañjanaṃ na kārayedityarthaḥ | yataḥ | cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāt | ‘yojayetsaptarātre tu sravaṇārthe rasāñjanami’ti | tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ yathā ‘divā na tu prayoktavyaṃ netrayostīkṣṇamañjanaṃ | virekadurbalā dṛṣṭirādityaṃ prāpya sīdati | tasmāt sāyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu dhruvamañjanamiṣyate | rātrau svapnaguṇādakṣipuṣṭā hyañjanakarṣiteti’ | na kevalaṃ sarvakālaṃ niṣiddhaṃ kiṃtu yadā atiśītoṣṇavātābhraṃ ca bhavati tadā tasyāṃ velāyāmapi nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | kutra sthāneñjanaṃ kuryāttadāha - kṛṣṇabhāgādityādi sugamam || 62-74 || Gū. athāñjanaṃ atha athānantaraṃ pakkadoṣasya puruṣasya divasapañcakānantaram āgatapāke'kṣṇi añjanam ācaret | idānīṃ sādhāraṇāñjanavidhimāha - hemante ityādau | hemante śiśire madhyāhneñjanam iṣyate grīṣme śaradi ca pūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe varṣāsu anabhre abhrarahite | nātyuṣṇe na uṣṇasamaye vasante sadaiva iṣyate | lekhanādibhedenāñjanabhedānāha - lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ ca prasādanaṃ cetyaṃjanabhedaḥ | lekhanaṃ tatra kṣārādirasaiḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ | prasādanaṃ guṭikādibhiḥ | trividhamañjanamāha - guṭikādīni trividhānyaṃjanāni śalākayā aṅgulyā vā kriyate | yeṣu añjanaṃ na deyaṃ tānāha - vegaghāte | mūtrādyavarodhe vartyādau | añjanapramāṇaṃ tīkṣṇe'ñjane hareṇumātrāṃ vartiṃ kurvīta | hareṇu reṇukā kalāpo vā madhyame tīkṣṇānmadhyārdhāṃ hareṇumātrātaḥ ardhārdhaṃ sā hareṇumātrā mṛdau tīkṣṇānmṛdau dviguṇaṃ hareṇuto dviguṇaṃ sakriyā | uttamādi pramāṇamāha - sugamam | vairecanādau kiyantyaḥ śalākā ityāha -yato vairecanikaṃ cūrṇaṃ netre bahusrāvakaraṃ tadvairecanikam añjanaṃ vāradvayaṃ śalākayā dīyate | snehakāle catasra: śalākā vidhīyante | śalākāpramāṇaṃ yathā kasya śalāketi | ca mukhayodvaryoḥ | kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṅgulonmitā | mukhayordvayoḥ kuṇṭhitā na tīkṣṇā ślakṣṇā sundarā aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇā aśmajā pāṣāṇajā dhātujā svarṇādidhātujā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā | kalāyo vartulakastatparimāṇā sthūlā | lekhanādau kīdṛśī śalākā vidhīyate tāmāha - sugamam | kasminkasmin samaye kasmin bhāge añjanaṃ kuryādityāha - sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyāṃ prātaḥ vā añjanaṃ syāt | añjanaṃ tadā na kārayet | tat añjanam atiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ na praśasyate | atiśīte atyuṣṇe kāle nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ || 62-74 || pūrvamuktaṃ lekhanaropaṇasnehanabhedena trividhāñjaneṣu vartirasacūrṇatrividharūpaṃ, tatrādau lekhanīvartiradhunā vidhīyase | candrodayā | śaṅkhanābhirvibhītasya majjā pathyā manaḥśilā | pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam ||75|| chāgīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya vartiṃ kṛtvā yavonmitām | hareṇumātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya jalaiḥ kuryādathāñjanam || 76 || timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalamarbudam | rātryāndhyaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ vartiścandrodayā jayet ||77|| Dī. iyaṃ candrodayā vartirlekhanī kathitā | rātryañjanayogena candrodayābhidhānamasyāḥ | tīkṣṇāñjanatvāt | śaṅkhanābhiriti madhye āvartatvena laghucakrākāraṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ samudrajaṃ śaṃkhaṃ śaṅkhanābhiśabdena vācyam | athavā śaṅkhasya nābhirmadhye grāhyam | atinirmalatvāt | vibhītakasya vibhītakaphalamajjā pathyā harītakī | yavonmiteti | yavaparimāṇāṃ vartiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | añjanārthaṃ tu hareṇumātrā saṃghṛṣyāñjayet | lekhanāñjanatvāt jalairityanena pūrvaṃ vartiḥ kṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya kāryā paścādañjanasamaye pānīyena saha ghṛṣyāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | māṃsavṛddhirarmādijanitā śeṣaṃ sugamam || 75-77 || Gū. atha vartiḥ | śaṅkhanābhiḥ śaṅkhamadhyabhāgā | etānsaṃpiṣya yavonmitāṃ vartiṃ kuryāt | hareṇumātrāṃ reṇukāmātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya añjanaṃ kuryāt | asyāñjanasya candrodayāvartiriti saṃjñā timirādīn jayet | vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ varṣaprabhavaṃ jayet | iti candrodayāvartiḥ || 75-77 || karañjavartiḥ | palāśapuṣpasvarasairbahuśaḥ paribhāvitā | karañjabījavartistu dṛṣṭeḥ puṣpaṃ vināśayet ||78|| Dī. atha puṣpārthalekhanīvartidvayamāha - palāśapuṣpaṃ kiṃśukābhidhānaṃ bahuśaḥ ityanena saptavāramityabhiprāyaḥ | karañjabījavartiriti| karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ ||78|| Gū. atha lekhanīvartiḥ palāśapuṣpasvarasena karañjī bījareṇuḥ bahuśaḥ bhāvitā tadvartiḥ śukrādīn samullikhet dūrīkuryāt || 78 || samudraphenādivartiḥ | samudraphenasindhūtthaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍavalkalaiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukādīṃśchastravallikhet || 79 || Dī. anyadyogamāha - samudraphenetyādi | samudraphenaṃ prasiddhaṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ śaṃkhaṃ prasiddhaṃ dakṣāṇḍavalkalairiti | dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ tasyāṃḍatvageva grāhyā | eke samudraphena ityādikaṃ viparītaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā - ‘samudraphenadakṣāṇḍatvaksindhūtthaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukraghnī śigruvāriṇe’ti | vyākhyānayanti tatra mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ śigruvāriṇā śigrusvarasena śastravallekhanena lekhanī kathitā || 79 || Gū. anyacca samudraphenaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍakukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaiḥ śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tadbījaiḥ tadvartiḥ śukraṃ puṣpaṃ lekhanī vartiḥ || 79 || dantavartiḥ | dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragohayājakhurodbhavaiḥ | śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutaiḥ sarvairvicūrṇitaiḥ || 80 || dantavartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇā śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī parā | Dī. atha lekhanīdantavartimāha - dantī hastīti rūḍhiḥ, varāhaḥ śūkaraḥ, uṣṭraḥ kramelako'pi govṛṣabho'pi, hayo ghoṭakaḥ, ajo bastaḥ chāgasaṃjñaḥ | kharo gardabhaḥ eteṣāṃ dantairityarthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutairiti | śaṅkhaśabdena sarvatra śaṅkhanābhirgrāhyā | muktā mauktikaṃ ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ ślakṣṇā iti sūkṣmatvena saṃsnigdhā yathā syāt | parā utkṛṣṭā atrānukte peṣaṇārthaṃ jalameva grāhyam || 80 || Gū. atha lekhanī dantavartiḥ dantī hastī tadādīnāṃ dantaiḥ ajaḥ chāgaḥ kharo gardabha ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ | dantavartiḥ lekhanīvartiḥ || 80 || nīlotpalavartiḥ | nīlotpalaṃ śigrubījaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā || 81 || etatkalkaiḥ kṛtā vartiratinidrāṃ nivārayet | Dī. nīlotpalamityādi | iyamapi lekhanīvartiḥ kathitā | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyamiti | sarvatra kalkārthamatra jalamāhuḥ | anuktatvāt || 81 || puṣpavartiḥ | tilapuṣpāṇyaśītiḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulāḥ ||82|| jātī kusuma pañcāśanmaricāni ca ṣoḍaśa | sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭvā jale vartiḥ kṛtā kusumikābhidhā ||83|| timirārjunaśukrāṇāṃ nāśinī māṃsavṛddhihṛt | (etasyāścāñjane mātrā proktā sārdhahareṇukā ||84||) Dī. idānīṃ ropaṇīvartividhānamāha - tileti | iyaṃ ropaṇī kusumikāvartiḥ kathitā | atra tilapuṣpāṇi aśītisaṃkhyākāni pippalītaṃḍulāḥ pippalīmadhyagatabījāni sarṣapākārāṇi ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāni grāhyāṇi | jātī sumanāḥ tasyāḥ puṣpāṇyapi pañcāśadgaṇitāni maricāni ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākānītyarthaḥ | jalairiti bahuvacanatvena kutrāpi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | timiropalakṣitatvena gataṃ cakṣuḥ nivartayedityapi yojyaṃ ropaṇatvāt | kecidasyāgre iti paṭhanti | etasyāścāñjane mātrā proktā sārdhahareṇukā etatpūrvaṃ kathitameva tasmādbahubhirna svīkṛtaṃ paunaruktyabhayāt | eke ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulā ityasya sthāne ‘ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ kaṇāḥ smṛtā’ iti paṭhanti etanna manoharam || 82-84 || Gū. atha ropaṇīvartiḥ | aśītiḥ tilapuṣpāṇi | kaṇā pippalī tasyāḥ kaṇikāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ | jātīmukulāni puṣpāṇi pañcāśat | iyaṃ kusumikā vartiḥ | tasyā mātrā sārdhahareṇukā | kusumikā vartistimirādau || 82-84 || rasāñjanavartiḥ | rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve mālatīnimbapallavā: | gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktā vartirnaktāndhyanāśinī || 85 || Dī. athānyāṃ ropaṇīvartimāha - rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyaṃ tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ | haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā mālatīpallavā nimbapallavā iti | mālatī jātī nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ etayoḥ pallavāni komalapatrāṇi | gośakṛdrasa iti gopurīṣasvarasaḥ | śakṛdityasya sthāne yakṛditi pāṭhāntaram || 85 || Gū. rasāñjanaṃ dve haridre haridrā, dāruharidrā, mālatī jātī nimbaḥ tayoḥ pallavāḥ komalapatrāṇi gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaṃ jalaṃ tena vartiḥ kṛtā naktāndhyaṃ rātryāndhyaṃ jayet || 85 || dhātryādivartiḥ | dhātryakṣapathyābījāni ekadvitriguṇāni ca | piṣṭvā vartiṃ jalaiḥ kuryādañjanaṃ dvihareṇukam || 86 || netrasrāvaṃ haratyāśu vātaraktarujaṃ tathā | Dī. idānīṃ snehanīvartiṃ darśayannāha - dhātryakṣeti | iyaṃ snehanī vartiḥ kathitā | ekadvitriguṇāni yathākramaṃ yojyāni | vātaruktarajaṃ tathetyanena vātajanitāṃ raktajanitāmabhiṣyandādīnāṃ rujaṃ haratītyanye vyākhyānayanti | saṃmatoyamanyatroktatvāt | yathā ‘pathyākṣadhātrīphalamadhyabījaistridvyekabhāgairvidadhīta vartiḥ | tathāñjayedaśrumatipravṛddhamakṣṇorharet kaṣṭamapi prakopamiti ||86|| Gū. dhātrī āmalakī akṣaṃ vibhītakaṃ pathyā harītakī krameṇa ekadvitriguṇāni etāni dvihareṇumātram añjanaṃ kuryāt | netrasrāvaṃ harati snehanī vartikā netrasrāve || 86 || rasakriyā | tutthamākṣikasindhūtthaṃ sitāśaṅkamanaḥśilāḥ ||87|| gairikodadhiphenaṃ ca maricaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | saṃyojya madhunā kuryādañjanārthaṃ rasakriyām || 88 || vartmarogārmatimirakācaśukraharāṃ parām | Dī. atha rasakriyāmāha - iyaṃ ca lekhanīsaṃjñakā rasakriyāñjanārthaṃ vihitā, atra tu mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā śarkarā, śaṅkaṃ śaṅkhanābhi:, udadhiphenaṃ - samudraphenaṃ ceti cūrṇayediti | anena samānamānameteṣāṃ grāhyam | saṃyojya madhunā kuryāditi ko'rthaḥ | etaccūrṇaṃ madhūktaśalākayā saṃgṛhya śukrādideśaṃ gharṣayedityabhiprāyaḥ | madhuplāvitāṃ vartimāhureke ||87-88|| Gū. atha lekhanīrasakriyā tutthaṃ mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā sitopalaṃ, śaṃkhaṃ, manaḥśilā, gairikam, udadhiphenaṃ, maricaṃ, madhunāñjanam imāṃ rasakriyāṃ rasānāṃ tutthakadīnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā, yadvā rasaviśiṣṭā yataḥ puṣpaharī rasakriyāyāṃ dhātuḥ nāsti karpūramevāsti || 87-88 || tathāca lekhanī rasakriyā -- vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyukto mukhyaḥ karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ || 89 || kṣipramañjanato hanti kusumaṃ tu dvimāsikam | Dī. athāparāṃ lekhanīṃ rasakriyāmāha - karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ karpūrajaḥ śakalaḥ tena karpūraśakalaṃ saṃgṛhya vaṭakṣīreṇa saha saṃghṛṣyāñjayedityarthaḥ | mukhya ityuttamaḥ | yataḥ kaṃrpūrastrividho bhavati | tadyathā ‘īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāsa iti sa tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ | lakṣaṇenāpi ‘īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñastathāṅkura: | śvetaḥ potāśrayaḥ sarve rasavīryavipākataḥ | prabhāvenāpi te proktāḥ pūrvapūrvaguṇādhikāḥ | tatrāpi yo navakṣudra: sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ’ iti mukhyaśabdena vyākhyātaḥ | eke ‘vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karpūrajaṃ rajaḥ | kṣipramañjanato hanti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva’ iti paṭhanti || 89 || Gū. atha puṣpaharī rasakriyā sugamam || 89 || atinidrāyāṃ yogaḥ - kṣaudrāśvalālāsaṃghṛṣṭairmaricairnetramañjayet ||90|| atinidrā śamaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva | Dī. kṣaudraṃ madhu aśvalālā ghoṭakavaktrajanito dravaviśeṣaḥ | atinidrāpi sannipātajvarajanitā boddhavyā | iyamapi lekhanī rasakriyā kathitā || 90 || Gū. athātinidrāyāmañjanaṃ sugamam || 90 || prabodhanāñjanam | jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca maricaṃ kaṭukī vacā || 91 || saindhavaṃ bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ tandrāghnamañjanam | śirīṣabījagomūtrakṛṣṇāmaricasaindhavaiḥ || 92 || añjanaṃ syātprabodhāya sarasonaśilāvacaiḥ | Dī. tatra jātīpuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣṣaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ kaṭukā kaṭurohiṇī, bastamūtraṃ chāgamūtram | śeṣaṃ subodham | iyamapi gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtya vartisvarūpā lekhinī rasakriyā kathitā | athavā kṛṣṇā pippalī | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śirīṣabījādibhiḥ sarasonaśilāvacairiti | rasono hlasunavācyaḥ | śilā manaḥśilā vacā vikhyātā etāni dravyāṇi atra godhūmaṃ vihāya samamātrāṇi grāhyāṇi | gomūtramānaṃ tu kalkārthaṃ yāvat | prabodhāyetyanena sannipātajvarajanitaṃ tandrīvināśanāyāñjanamatrāhuḥ || 91 -92 || Gū. atha nidrāyāmañjanaṃ, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, kaṭukī vacā | bastaśchāgastanmūtreṇāñjanaṃ, atha sannipāteñjanam | śirīṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadbījaṃ kṛṣṇā pippalī rasonaḥ lasunaḥ śilā manaḥśilā vacā etairañjanam || 91-92 || dārvyādirasakriyā | dārvī paṭolaṃ madhukaṃ sanimbapadmakotpalam || 93 || prapauṇḍarīkaṃ caitāni pacettoye caturguṇe | vipācya pādaśeṣaṃ tu śṛtaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet ||94|| śīte tasminmadhu sitāṃ dadyātpādāṃśikāṃ nara: | rasakriyaiṣā dāhāśruraktarāgarujo haret || 95 || Dī. idānīṃ lekhinīrasakriyāmabhidhāya ropaṇīrasakriyāmāha - dārvīti | dārvī dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ| padmākha iti loke | yatra padmamasti tatra kamalaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvatra, kamalā'bhāve padmabījamiti | sarvatracaturguṇatā ca kvāthyadravyāṇām | kkāthyadravyaṃ tu dārvyādikaṃ ca samamātraṃ deyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ caturthaṃ suśṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ tacca pādaśeṣaṃ punaḥ pacedityarthaḥ | sāndrībhūte himasadṛśe tasmin | sitā madhu ca melayitvā pādāṃśaṃ kṣipediti | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthaśeṣāt | nara iti vaidyaḥ | iti ropaṇī rasakriyā proktā | dāhādayo'tra netrasyeti saṃbandhaḥ || 93-95|| Gū. atha ropaṇīrasakriyā | dārvī dāruharidrā, paṭolaṃ, madhukaṃ,
