yaṣṭī, nimbaṃ, padmakam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ prapauṃḍarīkaṃ tadraktam; etāni tulyāni caturguṇe toye jale pacet | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kkāthaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet | madhusitā sitotpalam | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthāt | eṣā rasakriyā dāhādiharī rasarūpaikā kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā rasānāṃ tutthādidhātūnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā dravyāṇāṃ kriyā rasakriyā aśrusrāvādau || 93-95 || rasāñjanādirasakriyā | rasājanaṃ sarjaraso jātīpuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||96|| etatsamāṃśaṃ madhunā piṣṭvā praklinnavartmani | añjanaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam || 97 || Dī. iyamapi ropaṇīrasakriyāñjanasamūhe vihitā | tatra rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sarjaraso'gnivallabhaḥ | loke rāla iti | lavaṇamatra saindhavaṃ netrahitatvāt | tathāca - ‘madhu yavapādāsaṃga: śatāvarīmudgasaindhavāmalakī cakṣuṣya: saṃkṣepādvargaḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirayam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||96-97|| Gū. atha pakṣmaprarohaṇādau kriyā | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkkāthodbhavam | sarjaraso rālaḥ | jātī mālatī tatpuṣpaṃ praklinnavartmani, kledaḥ klinnatā, spaṣṭamanyat ||96-97|| guḍūcīsvarasaḥ karṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ syānmāṣakonmitam | saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ syātsarvamekatra mardayet || 98 || añjayennayanaṃ tena pillārmatimiraṃ jayet | kācaṃ kaṇḍūṃ liṅganāśaṃ śuklakṛṣṇagatāngadān ||99 || Dī. athānyā ropaṇī rasakriyā api darśayannāha - guḍūcītyanena | latāyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyamiti | kṣaudratulyaṃ māṣaparimitaṃ mardanamasya kāṃsye tāmraje vā pātre ityasmadīyasaṃpradāyaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 98 || 99 || Gū. atha pakṣmarogādau timirādau armamasūratimirādau punarnavārasakriyā | dugdhena kaṇḍūṃ kṣaudreṇa netrasrāvaṃ ca sarpiṣā | puṣpaṃ tailena timiraṃ kāñjikena niśāndhatām ||10.|| punarnavā jayedāśu bhāskastimiraṃ yathā | Dī. atra kṣīrādīnāṃ vyastena kṛtvā sarvaropaṇī rasakriyā jñātavyā dugdhasya strībhavaṃ sarpiratrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ kāñjikaṃ śuktaviśeṣaṃ prasiddham | punarnaveti punarnavāsvarasaḥ || 10. || Gū. atha punarnavānupānamañjane punarnavā dugdhādinā kaṇḍvādīn jayet yathā bhāskarastimiram ||10.|| babbūlarasakiyā | babbūladalani:kātho lehībhūtastadañjanāt || 101 || netrasrāvaṃ jayatyeṣa madhuyukto na saṃśayaḥ | hiñjalarasakriyā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā pānīye nityamañjanam ||102|| cakṣu:srāvopaśāntyarthaṃ kāryametanmahauṣadham | Dī. babbūladalāccaturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā niḥkkāthya pādaśeṣaṃ paṭe visrāvya nītā punarvipacet yāvat sāndro bhavati | paścāt pādayuktena madhunā saṃsrāvyāñjayedityabhiprāya: | iyamapi ropaṇī rasakriyā vyākhyātā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ katakaphalamiti prasiddham | etanmahauṣadhamiti mahāñjanavarametadityartha: | ayamapi yogo ropaṇīrasakriyāyāṃ kathitaḥ ||101||102|| Gū. atha netrasrāve'nyaḥ prayogaḥ sugamam | babbūladalaṃ patraṃ tasya kvātho lehībhūtaḥ lehākārastasyāñjanaṃ hijjalo hiṃgoṭhaḥ tatpalaṃ pṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā pānīyenāñjanam || 101 || 102 || idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā katakarasakriyā | katakasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā madhunā netramañjayet || 103 || īṣatkarpūrasahitaṃ smṛtaṃ netraprasādanam | Dī. netraprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭisādanam | tasyāḥ prasannatvena netrasyā'pi prasannatvam | tathācoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena yathāhi - ‘kanakasthānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vividhātmanām | dhautānāṃ vimalā śuddhistaile velakarādibhiḥ | evaṃ netreṣu vartyā ca añjanāścyotanādibhiḥ | dṛṣṭirnirākulā bhāti nirmale nabhasīnduvat’ iti || 103 || Gū. atha snehanī rasakriyā | katakaphalaṃ nirmalī iti loke prasiddhā | kiṃcit bhīmasenakarpūreṇāñjayet | netraprasādanaṃ netraprasannakaraṃ, netraprasādane || 103 || atha śirotpāte rasakriyā | sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ cāñjanaṃ syācchirotpātasya śāntaye ||104|| gū. - sarpirghṛtam || 104 || Gū. sarpirghṛtam || 104 || kṛṣṇasarpavasārasakriyā | kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkha: katakātphalamañjanam | rasakriyeyamacirādandhānāṃ darśanapradā || 105 || lekhanāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvakśilākācaśaṅkhacandanasaindhavaiḥ | dravyairañjanayogo'yaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanaḥ || 106 || kaṇārasakriyā | kaṇā chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā | acirāddhanti naktāndhyaṃ tadvatsakṣaudramūṣaṇam ||107|| cūrṇāñjanam| śāṇārdhaṃ maricaṃ dvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayo: | śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavaṃ śāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt ||108|| piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ śubham | kaṇḍūkācakaphārtānāṃ malānāṃ ca viśodhanam ||109|| Dī. atra vividharasakriyāmamidhāya saṃprati cūrṇāñjanaviṣaye kaiścit pratipāditāmekāṃ rasakriyāmāha - añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaprabhṛtīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ sarpavasāktaśalākayā paścāt cūrṇaliptayāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | kutracidrasāñjanaṃ vinā pracarati tatrāñjanaśabdena kajalametat kāryamiti śeṣaḥ || 105 || atha lekhanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, candanamatra raktaṃ netrahitakaratvāt | dakṣāṇḍatvagityādiyogaścūrṇāñjanam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu madhūktaśalākayā ca gṛhītvāñjanaṃ kāryam evaṃ sarvatra | cūrṇāñjane eke saindhavairityasya sthāne gairikairiti paṭhanti, dravyairañjanayogo'yamityasya sthāne tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyamiti kathayanti | etatpadadvayamapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt| tathāca - ‘dakṣāṇḍatvakśilāśaṅkhakācacandanagairikaiḥ | tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanam’ iti || 106 || aparamapi lekhanāñjanamāha - kaṇā pippalī, chāgayakṛt chāgakālakhaṇḍam | paktvā | kecit ‘paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā’ ityasya sthāne ‘paktvā tadrasapeṣitā’ iti paṭhanti | tatra tadrasapeṣiteti tat svedāmbunā piṣṭvā ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadvaditi chāgayakṛnmadhye ca svinnaṃ tadrasasupiṣṭaṃ ca ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ kṣaudramatra yogadvaye'pi pracarati | kecinmadhunā saha bhakṣaṇayogadvayamidamāhuḥ | keṣāṃcinmate yakṛdityupalakṣaṇatvena tallagnaṃ pittaṃ grāhyam | tanmadhye pippalī maricaṃ melayitvā dhāryaṃ paścāt śuṣkaṃ tanmadhunā saṃghṛṣyāñjayediti na svamatam || 107 || athānyacca lekhanāñjanamāha - śāṇārdhaṃ māṣakadvayamitaṃ maricamiti pippalyarṇavaphenayośca dvau śāṇau tena pratyekaṃ śāṇamitamityarthaḥ| arṇavaphenaḥ samudraphenaḥ | eke dvāvityanena militvā śāṇaikamāhuḥ | tanna manoharaṃ | sauvīrakāñcanānnava śāṇā grāhyāḥ | śāṇaṣṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ | sa caturmāṣakapramito jñeyaḥ | sauvīrāñjanaṃ suvīrāśabdavācyaṃ tacca kṛṣṇanadīsaṃbhavaṃ bhavati | tadabhāve rasāñjanameva grāhyaṃ, malaśca netrasaṃbhava eva ||108 || 109 || Gū. athacūrṇāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvak iti | dakṣāṇḍatvak kukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, kācaṃ śvetakācaṃ śaṅkhaṃ candanaṃ saindhavam ebhirdravyaiḥ piṣṭairayamañjanayogaḥ puṣpādilekhanaḥ | puṣpādau naktāndhye - kaṇā pippalī chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā punastadrasapeṣitā tadrasaḥ yakṛdrasaḥ | acirāt śīghreṇa naktāndhyaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭimandatāṃ hanti | tadvat ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ ca kṛtam | sakṣaudraṃ madhusahitam | naktāndhye cūrṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇarūpamañjanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam | arṇavaphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ maricaṃ śāṇārdhaṃ pippalyarṇavaphenayordvau śāṇau pratyekaṃ śāṇāṣṭakaḥ saindhavam ardhaśāṇaṃ sauvīrakāñjanaṃ navaśāṇaṃ citrāyāṃ citrānakṣatre sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavati | kaṇḍvādau ||105- 109 || idānīṃ ropaṇacūrṇāñjanamāha - (mṛducūrṇāñjanam) śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvā samyagāplāvya vāriṇā | gṛhṇīyāttajjalaṃ sarvaṃ tyajeccūrṇamadhogatam || 110 || śuṣkaṃ ca tajjalaṃ sarvaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ bhavet | vicūrṇya bhāvayetsamyaktrivelaṃ triphalārasaiḥ || 111|| karpūrasya rajastatra daśamāṃśena nikṣipet | añjayennayane tena sarvadoṣaharaṃ hi tat || 112 || sarvarogaharaṃ cūrṇaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakāri ca | Dī. etanmṛducūrṇāñjanatvena ropaṇatvena kathitaṃ śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvetyādi | śilāyāṃ pāṣāṇaghaṭitā peṣaṇārthaṃ pātraviśeṣaḥ | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ tacca tutthabhedaḥ | khaparīyāśabdavācyo loke | samyagāplāvya vāriṇā ca | asmāt saṃpradāye tu tadrasakaṃ jalenaiva dṛṣadi saṃpeṣya paścānnirmalapātre bahujale saṃplāvya muhūrtaṃ vilambya tadupari svacchaṃ jalamapanīyādhaḥsthitaṃ tat parpaṭasaṃnibhaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tadgrāhyamityarthaḥ | karpūracūrṇaṃ tu daśamāṃśaṃ parpaṭīsvarūpadravyāt | sarvadoṣamiti vātapittakapharudhiraṃ | sarvarogamiti netrābhiṣyandādhimanthaprabhṛtikaṃ | cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakārītyanena dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ kathitam || 110-112 || Gū. atha prasādanāñjanaṃ cūrṇam | rasakaṃ kharparaṃ śilāyāṃ piṣṭvā vāriṇā samyak āplāvya cālayitvā vāriṇā jalena tat pātrāntare gṛhṇīyāt | adhogataṃ pāṣāṇādikaṃ tyajet | tat śuṣkaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ punaḥ saṃcūrṇya trivelaṃ triphalārasena bhāvayet | daśamāṃśena karpūrarajaḥ kṣipet | spaṣṭamanyat || 110-112 || prasādanāñjanam (sauvīrāñjanam) agnitaptaṃ hi sauvīraṃ niṣiñcettriphalārasaiḥ ||113|| saptavelaṃ tathā stanyaiḥ strīṇāṃ siktaṃ vicūrṇitam | añjayettena nayane pratyahaṃ cakṣuṣorhitam || 114 || sarvānakṣivikārāṃstu hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ | Dī. atha snehanābhidhaṃ prasādanasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - agnitaptaṃ sauvīramiti | sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ tacca suramāśabdavācyaṃ triphalā harītakyādikaṃ tasyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ kvathitaraso vā tathetyanena strīdugdhenāpi saptavelamāhuḥ | stanyairiti bahutvenājaṃ gavyaṃ vā kṣīraṃ grāhyaṃ | siktamityatrāpyagnitaptamiti saṃbandhaḥ || 113 || 114 || Gū. anyacca sauvīraṃ suramā strīṇāṃ stanyairdugdhaiḥ spaṣṭamanyat || 113 || 114 || atha dṛṣṭiprasādanī nāgaśalākā vikhyātā, tāmapi darśayannāha - triphalābhṛṅgaśuṇṭhīnāṃ rasaistadvacca sarpiṣā ||115|| gomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ sikto nāgaḥ pratāpitaḥ | tacchalākā haratyeva sarvānnetrabhavāngadān || 116 || Dī. tadvadityanena pūrvoktasauvīrāñjanavidhānavadatrāpi | saptavāraṃ pratyekaṃ triphalādidravyeṇa nirvāpaṇamāhuḥ | uktamanyatrāpi - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | anyatroktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | ‘triphalasalilayoge bhṛṅgarājadraveṇa haviṣi ca viṣamiśre kṣīra ājye madhūke | pratipadamabhitaptaṃ saptadhā sīsamekaṃ praṇihitagatipaścāt kārayettacchalākam || timirapaṭalakaṇḍvāsrāvaraktaprakopāmupacitabahu-doṣānnarmasaṃjñāṃstu rogān | saviturudayakāle sāñjanā vyañjanā vā harati nayanarogān śodhyamānā śalākā’ iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyamajāpayaḥ | yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtva: pṛthak pṛthak || taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā vyañjanā vā | taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti’ iti ( vā. u. 13|34|35) || 115 || 116 || Gū. atha sīsakaśalākā | triphalā bhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ śuṇṭhī eṣāṃ rasaiḥ jalaiḥ sarpiṣā ghṛtena gomūtramadhu ajā kṣīraiḥ etaiḥ saptasaptavāraṃ siktaḥ secito nāgaḥ | sīsakaśalākā netrarujaḥ haret | triphalādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ rasaiḥ sapta saptadhā sikta ityarthaḥ | tathāca suśrute - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | triphalādīnāṃ samāhāraḥ dvandvātpratyekaṃ rase niṣecanamiti dhvanitam | iti sīsakaśalākā || 115 || 116 || pratyañjanam | gatadoṣamapetāśru saṃpaśyansamyagambhasi | prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ ||117|| na vā'nirgatadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ saṃprayojayet | pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇatapte netre cūrṇaṃ prasādanam || 118 || nayanāmṛtāñjanam | śuddhe nāge drute śuddhaṃ tulyaṃ sūtaṃ vinikṣipet | kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ tayostulyaṃ sarvamekatra cūrṇayet || 119 || daśamāṃśena karpūraṃ tasmiṃścūrṇe pradāpayet | etatkṛtāñjanaṃ netragadajinnayanāmṛtam || 120 || Dī. idānīṃ cūrṇāñjanāntargataṃ pratyañjanavidhānamāha - akṣi prakṣālya tataḥ pratyañjanaṃ kāryam | netre tīkṣṇapratapte prasādanaṃ cūrṇaṃ hitam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||117 || 118 || atha prasādanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ nāgaśuddhistu pūrvaṃ dhātuśodhanā'dhyāye kathitā | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ śuddhamiti śodhitaṃ | śuddhirasasya pūrvaṃ rasaśodhanādhyāye pratipāditā | kṛṣṇāñjanamiti rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākkāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ tayostulyamiti pāradasīsakasāmyaṃ rasāñjanamityaryaḥ | trayāṇāṃ daśāṃśenātra karpūramiti | idaṃ nayanāmṛtaṃ nāma prasādāñjanacūrṇaṃ prasiddhameva kṛtāñjanasthāne pratyañjanamiti pāṭhāntaram || 119 || 120|| Gū. pratyañjanakaraṇe vidhānamāha - sīsakaśalākayā vahnitaptayā añjane kṛte doṣanāśe pratyañjanaṃ kartavyamityāha - gatadoṣaṃ tathā nayanāstraṃ gatanetrajalam akṣi netram ambhasi saṃpaśyan | tataḥ akṣi prakṣālya yathā doṣānurūpaṃ pratyañjanamañjanaṃ sadoṣe netre dhāvanaṃ netramityapyāha -anirvāntadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ na prayojayet | na kārayet | pratyañjanaṃ kārayet| prakṣālanaṃ vinaiveti dhvanitārtha: | tīkṣṇaṃ tannetre prasādanaścūrṇo vā kārya: | sa yathā - śuddhe tailādibhi: śuddhe vā śalākākāreṇa śuddhe nāge sīsake sati drutaṃ vahninā drāvitaṃ nāgaṃ śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ hiṅgulotthaṃ aṣṭakarmaśuddhaṃ vā tulyaṃ nikṣipet | tayo: sīsakasūtakayostulyaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇayet | tata: sarvamekatra cūrṇayet | tasmina cūrṇe karpūraṃ bhīmasenākhyaṃ daśamāṃśena pradāpayet | etatpratyañjanaṃnāma netragadahā nayanāmṛtaṃ pratyañjanaṃ cūrṇam ||117|| ||120|| sarpaviṣe saṃjīvanāñjanam | jayapālabhavāṃ majjāṃ bhāvayennimbukadravai: | ekaviṃśativelaṃ tu tato vartiṃ prakalpayet ||121|| manuṣyalālayā ghṛṣṭvā tato netre tayā'ñjayet | sarpadaṣṭaviṣaṃ jitvā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||122|| Dī. atha netraprakaraṇapāriśeṣyāt viṣaharī vartimāha - jayapālaṃ dantibījaṃ prasiddham | tanmadhyagatā majjā grāhyā | majjeti meṅgīśabdavācyā sarpadaṣṭaviṣamapi viṣasādharmyāt sthāvaraviṣatakṣaṇepyasyā: pracāra: | eke sannipātaviṣaye'ñjanamasyā: pravadanti || 121|| 122 | | Gū. atha sarpaviṣaharamañjanam | sugamam ||121|| || 122|| atha dṛṣṭiprasādanārthaṃ sārvakālikaṃ yogadvayamāha - bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣordīyate yadi | jātā rogā vinaśyanti timirāṇi tathaiva ca ||123|| śītāmbupūritamukha: prativāsaraṃ ya: kālatrayeṇa nayanadvitayaṃ jalena | āsiñcati dhruvamasau na kadācidakṣi- rogavyathāvidhuratāṃ bhajate manuṣya: || 124|| Dī. bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi sugamam | jātārogā ityādi padadvayaṃ kecidanyathā paṭhanti | yathā ‘acireṇaiva tadvāri timirāṇi vyapohatīti’ dvitīyayoge prativāsaraṃ pratidinaṃ kālatrayaṃ prātarmadhyāhṇāparahṇādikam | jaleneti mukhagaṇḍūṣajanitena āsiñcatītyanena vāraṃvāraṃ secanamabhihitam | tathācoktaṃ ‘jalagaṇḍūṣai: prātarbahuśombhobhiḥ prapūrya mukharandhram | nirdayamañjannakṣi kṣapayati timirāṇi nāsādya’ iti | eke bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi yogadvayaṃ nātra paṭhanti | nāsaṅgatamiti manyamānairasmābhirapi likhitam || 123-124 || atha trikhaṇḍānāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kavirapi khaguṇaprakarṣatāṃ solluṇṭhavacanena dyotayati -- āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayam | jñātvā kaiścidbudhaistaistu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitāḥ ||125|| kiṃcidarthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā | kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamasyāṃ kurvantu sādhavaḥ || 126 || vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ | vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 127 || alpāyuṣāmalpadhiyāmidānīṃ kṛtaṃ samastaśrutipāṭhaśaktyā | tadatra yuktaṃ pratibījamātra- mabhyasyatāmātmahitaṃ prayatnāt || 128 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmavidhi- rnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | Dī. atha netraviṣaya-pradhānatvena tadarthaṃ sarvakālaṃ yanna vidheyamiti matvā tat pratipālanārthamupadeśamāha – ‘cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatna: kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā | vyartho loko'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne'pi vitte ||’ ayamapi tantrāntarādāhṛtya kenāpi likhitaḥ na svamatam | asyārthastu sugama eva || dī. - āyurvedasamudrasya arthamaṇisañcayaḥ | gūḍha eva gūḍho guptaḥ, yathā samudre maṇisamūhaḥ pracchannaḥ sarvaireva na dṛśyaḥ tathā'yurvede'pi artho'bhiprāyaḥ | sarvaireva nādhigata ityarthaḥ | ata eva kaiścidbudhairjñātaḥ | arthamaṇisaṃcaya iti saṃbandhaḥ | yaireva jñātastaistu vividhā saṃhitāḥ kṛtāḥ | vividhasaṃhitā hārītasuśrutabhṛgvagniveśādayaḥ | atha kaviḥ svātmīyaviṣayamāha –kiṃcidarthamityādi | tata iti saṃhitāsamūhāt | mayā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa kiṃcidarthaṃ svabuddhyā ekadeśīyaprayojanaṃ nītvā āhṛtya iyaṃ saṃhitā kṛtā nibaddhetyabhiprāyaḥ | na tu khakapolakalpitā | etena munipraṇītatvaṃ saṃkṣepatvaṃ ca darśitam | atha kavivijñaptimāha - kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamityādi | asyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ sādhavaḥ sajjanāḥ kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kṛpayā kaṭākṣasya dṛṣṭeḥ kiṃcidbhāgasya nikṣepaṃ kurvantu | anumatārthakriyā avaśyameveti bhāvaṃ sūcayati | tenāvaśyameva kaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kurvaṃtu | yataḥ kaṭākṣamātrā'valokanenā'pi hṛdayaṃgamā kṣamā bhavati kimuta sakaladṛṣṭyā | etena granthasya samīcīnatā darśitā | idānīṃ kavireva nijagranthasyotkṛṣṭatvamāha - yā iyaṃ saṃhitā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīriva yogaratnaiḥ prayogamaṇisamūhaiḥ kṛtvā vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ karoti | vividhagadānāṃ vyādhīnām ārtireva dāridryaṃ tasya nāśanaṃ yathā lakṣmīrbahudhanapradānena akiṃcanapuruṣasya daridranāśaṃ karoti tathā iyamapi saṃhitā suyogaiḥ kṛtvā nānārogajanitapīḍāṃ hantīti bhāvaḥ | etenāsyāḥ prayogasāphalyaṃ darśitam | tat prayogasāphalyasya vyāpāramāha - vilasatvityādi | sā saṃhitā, saṃhitā niruktistu pūrvādhyāye darśitā | śārṅgadharācāryasya sā saṃhitā śārṅgadharācāryanirmitā sā ityabhiprāyaḥ | nānyā | etena granthasya sarvamatānubandhatvaṃ darśitaṃ, sarojanirmaleṣu kavihṛdayeṣviti vilasatu vilāsaṃ karotu kamalanirmalahṛdayapuruṣeṣu sthitiṃ karotvityabhiprāyaḥ | na tu piśunahṛdayeṣu teṣāṃ hṛdayānāmanirmalatvāt na tasyāḥ sthiteravakāśaḥ | yataste svabhāvavaśagāḥ kathaṃ paraguṇamavadhārayituṃ samarthāḥ | tasmāt sajjanahṛdayeṣveva vilāsa iti bhāvaḥ | sahṛdayatvāt | etena granthasya
